target: 紧. 你往最靠近的摊位去

target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你疯了吗? 我们不能随便挑一个这样的老摊位!

target: 这是 波莉.  波莉 罪有应得.

target: 但这不重要 最重要的是,一旦你带你的朋友离开这家餐厅 就要感谢的人!

target: 有野餐菜篮子相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相相接相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 你只需要决定 在哪里散开你的支票被子。

target: 第一步是确定你的位置上没人尿 因为当场野餐很无礼 别人已经说过了

target: 完美的野餐也最好和三至六位朋友一起享受. 幸好我们在那个号码里

target: 寻取高山上有好气相接之地. 我会舔我的手指 测试风 当我们走。 我看过电影里的人

target: 随你怎么说,伙计。 我会跟着你走 直到你找到一个我们可以坐的地方

target: "'利亚姆 德·利昂考特? 如果我听到一个假名字".

source: "There's too much alliteration, and what's a 'lion court?' Don't lions live in prides or something? Get outta my line!"
target: "有太多的取悦,什么是'狮子会'?" 狮子不活在骄傲或什么的? 滚出我的线!"

source: It's a bad day to be Liam! Not your problem, though. You and your friends enjoy the picnic and gain +N2 STAMINA eating delicious hoagies.
target: 今天真不顺心 利亚姆! 不过不是你的问题 你和你的朋友享受野餐 并获得+N2 STAMINA 吃美味的花鸟。

source: The real John Doe, Password1234, and Giacomo Calzone get turned away when they show up, though.
target: 真正的"多伊"(John Doe),"密码"(Picto1234)和"吉克莫·卡尔佐"(Giacomo Calzone)虽然出现后被转出.

source: Password1234's sobs fill the air. It was her birthday, and her one wish was to get into this picnic. You lose -N2 SOUL for ruining her day.
target: 密码1234的"泣"能填满空气. 这是她的生日, 她的一个愿望是 进入这个野餐。 你因为毁了她的一天而输了N2 SOUL

source: What makes you think that putting three idiots in a trenchcoat will get you into this picnic?
target: 你凭什么认为把三个白痴放进战衣里 会让你参加这个野餐?

source: Because Scott and I have gotten into twenty-two clubs, nine weddings, and one exceptionally turnt baby shower with the "two idiots in a trenchcoat" trick.
target: 因为 斯科特 我进入了二十二个俱乐部,九个婚礼 和一个特别的转身婴儿淋浴 与"两个白痴穿着战衣"的花招。

source: And adding one more person just means more people on the team, and teamwork makes the dream work!
target: 再加一个人只是意味着 团队中更多的人, 团队合作使梦想成功!

source: Ooh, and guess what Polly? We still have our Chancellor costume in the car!
target: 你猜怎么着? 波莉? 我们车里还有我们的总理服装!

source: "The Chancellor?" Wasn't that the infamous fascist overlord character you played at Camp Spooky?
target: "总理?" 难道不是那个臭名昭著的法西斯 凌驾于你扮演的Spooky营的人物吗?

source: Yep, and you can't spell "infamous fascist overlord" without "famous!" The Chancellor will totally be on the guest list. Let's do it!
target: 是的,你不能拼出"臭名昭著的法西斯霸主" 没有"出名!" 总理将完全出现在客人名单上. 让我们开始吧!

source: You all get into costume and approach the bouncer. "Who are you supposed to be?" he asks.
target: 你们都穿好衣服 接近保镖 "你是谁?"他问。

source: I'm the Chancellor, you snivelling idiot! I'd better be on the list, or there will be hell to pay!
target: 我是总理,你这个白痴! 我最好在名单上, 否则会有地狱支付!

source: "The Chancellor?! But we thought you were dead! I'm sorry, but you're not on the list..."
target: "总理? 但我们以为你死了! 对不起,但你不在名单上... ..."

source: WHAT?! This is an outrage! You'd better put me on that list, or I'll be putting your DAUGHTER on MY list!
target: 什麽? 这太令人愤怒了! 你最好把我列入名单 否则我就把你女儿列入我的名单

source: ...My list of teenagers that I send to die in the Dome Games, that is. I'm threatening you, if that wasn't clear.
target: 我的青少年名单,我送死 在穹顶运动会,这就是。 我威胁你,如果那还不清楚的话。

source: "But I don't even have a daughter! Please, have mercy!"
target: "但我甚至没有女儿! 请怜悯!"

source: You DEFINITELY won't have a daughter anymore if you don't let me into this picnic!
target: 如果你再不让我去野餐 你绝对不会有女儿了!

source: "Gah, I'm so scared and confused! Just enjoy the picnic, man!"
target: "哎呀,我好怕又糊涂了! 享受野餐吧,伙计!"

source: That had absolutely no business working as well as it did.
target: 这绝对是行不通的。

source: But it did, and that's what matters! You get +N2 STAMINA from the delicious hoagies at the picnic.
target: 但它做到了, 这才是最重要的! 你从野餐的美味小鸡那里得到+N2 STAMINA.

source: Unfortunately, you lose -N2 MIND pretending to be the Chancellor for so long. Posing as a fascist overlord is weirdly hard on your mental health!
target: 不幸的是,你输了N2 MIND 假扮总理这么久。 作为法西斯霸主的潜逃 对你的精神健康来说是不可思议的艰难!

source: Start a brawl
target: 开始争吵

source: You sit at the bar next to two patrons arm-wrestling. One of them wins, and the other breaks a stool over his head. They tackle each other to the ground.
target: 你坐在酒吧旁边 两个赞助人手腕摔跤。 其中一人取胜,另一人把一个凳子打到他头上. 他们互相对付对方到地上

source: YEAHHHH! FIGHT! FIGHT! FIGHT!
target: 对! 战斗! 战斗! 战斗!

source: You watch those two balls of muscle roll around on the floor. Sigh. Must we always resort to violence?
target: 你看着那两个肌肉球在地上滚来滚去. 叹曰. 我们一定要诉诸暴力吗?

source: I mean, you actually DO resort to violence a lot, but you're not feeling it today. You're in more of a holier-than-thou pacifist mood right now.
target: 我的意思是,你确实经常诉诸暴力, 但你今天没有感觉。 你现在的心情比和平主义还好

source: Instead of throwing punches, you decide to put on your super cool badass face. It's more than enough to convince people not to mess with you.
target: 而不是出拳,你决定 把你的超级凉爽的坏蛋的脸。 这足以说服人们不要惹你

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what's up with your face? Are you in pain? Are you trying to hold in a fart?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你的脸怎么了? 你痛吗? 你是想放屁吗?

source: No, I know that face. That's a fighting face! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wants to throw down!
target: 不,我知道那张脸。 这是一个战斗的脸!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 想要扔下来!

source: HEY, EVERYONE! %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% WANTS TO FIGHT!!!
target: 嘿,每个人!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% 想要战斗!

source: Yay, a fight! It's like sports without boundaries! Can I be your cheerleader, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 耶,一场战斗! 这就像运动无疆界! 我可以做你的啦啦队长吗? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: GIMME A B-I-K-E-R! %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'S GONNA BREAK YOUR ARMS!
target: GIMME一个B -I -K -E -R!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%'是要去打破你的枪!

source: Hey, remember how you decided violence wasn't the answer? Well, it turns out peer pressure is ALWAYS the answer, so you're fighting someone.
target: 嘿,还记得你是如何决定暴力不是答案吗? 结果发现同伴压力总是答案 所以你在和别人打架

source: There's gotta be at least one person in this bar whose ass you could kick... who do you challenge?
target: 酒吧里至少有一个人可以踢你的屁股... 你向谁挑战?

source: Barry-Bob, the buff badass magician
target: 巴里 -鲍伯,那个混蛋魔术师

source: Nick-Nhag'zhaz, your worst nightmare... who happens to be made out of nightmares
target: Nick -Nhag'zhaz, 你最糟糕的噩梦... 恰好是噩梦造成的

source: You open the fight by inviting Barry-Bob to pick a card from your deck.
target: 你邀请Barry -Bob 从你的甲板上取出一张牌来打拳击

source: Barry draws the ace of clubs. You shuffle it back in. "Now... is THIS your card?!"
target: 巴里画出梅花 A. 你把它洗回来。 现在... 这是你的名片吗?"

source: You swing a wooden club in Barry's face!
target: 你当着Barry的面打木牌!

source: Barry opens his sleeve and releases a beautiful white dove to take the hit instead.
target: 巴里打开袖子,放出一头美丽的白鸽来取出命中.

source: Then he casts "Slapakazam", a spell that allows him to slap you in the face with his wand. Ow.
target: 然后他投出"斯拉帕卡扎姆"(Slapakazam),这个咒语允许他用他的魔杖扇你一巴掌. 呜.

source: You cast a spell, expending -N2 MAGIC, and reach in your pocket and pull out a hanky, which is tied to another hanky, and another, and another...
target: 你施了个咒语,花费 -N2 MAGIC, 伸入你的口袋,拔出一手帕, 绑在另一手帕上, 另一手帕, 另一手帕,和另一手帕...

source: Until you have a hanky-rope long enough to tie Barry up!
target: 直到你有一个手帕 足够长的绑住巴里!

source: And now, with the help of my lovely assistants, we will make you disappear!
target: 现在,在我的可爱助手的帮助下,我们将让你消失!

source: Wait, can you have teams in this fight? I thought it was a one-versus-one thing.
target: 等等,你们能有团队参加这场战斗吗? 我以为是一对一

source: Forget that shit! We're in MAGIC FIGHT territory, baby; there are no rules!
target: 忘了那个狗屎! 我们在MAGIC FIGHT领地,宝贝,没有规则!

source: Your friends help you roll Barry-Bob out of the door. He lays a curse on all your future children as he bounces down the road.
target: 你的朋友帮你把Barry -Bob弄出门 他在路上弹跳时 诅咒你所有未来的孩子

source: Everyone laughed at you for learning sleight-of-hand magic until you proved you could use it for violence! You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 人人都嘲笑你学了魔术 直到你证明你可以用它来使用暴力! 你得到了+N2 HYPE!

source: THAT'S who you're picking a fight with? You don't even want me to proofread your last will first?
target: 这就是你和谁打架? 你甚至不想让我先校对你最后的遗嘱?

source: Too late! You throw the first punch. It passes straight through Nick-Nhag'zhaz's face and sucks you into their twisted nightmare dimension.
target: 太迟了! 初一一一击出. 它直接穿过Nick -Nhag'zhaz的脸 把你吸进他们扭曲的噩梦中

source: You're forced to face all your greatest fears: sharks, bananas (they're a genetically-modified monoculture, it's weird!), and even emotional intimacy!
target: 你不得不面对你最大的恐惧:鲨鱼,香蕉(它们是一种基因改造的单一文化,这很奇怪!),甚至情感亲密!

source: Uh... why is Nick-Nhag'zhaz cuddling %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Is this part of the fight?
target: 额... 尼克 -纳格扎斯为什么在拥抱 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 这是战斗的一部分吗?

source: You're cowering in terror, your -N2 MIND spiraling down the drain, when suddenly you hear a warm voice in your head:
target: 你在恐怖中畏缩,你的-N2 MIND螺旋上下排出, 当你突然听到一个温暖的声音在你的脑海中:

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, dear, it's your mother. I'm in your heart always, or something. Remember what I told you when you were a scared little kid?"
target: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%亲爱的,这是你的母亲。 我总是在你心中,或什么的。 记得你小时候我跟你说的吗?"

source: "I told you that it's okay to be afraid, because fear is what makes us human... not literally, though, because we're monsters. But you get it."
target: "我告诉过你,害怕是没关系的, 因为恐惧是我们人类... ... 不是字面上,虽然, 因为我们是怪物。 但你会明白的。"

source: "Never let your fears conquer you, my %SONDAUGHTER%! And when all else fails, KICK YOUR FEARS IN THE CROTCH! It always works! Do it now!"
target: "永远不要让你的恐惧征服你,我的"%SONDAUGHTER%!" 当其他的失败, 踢你的恐惧在十字架上! 它总是工作! 现在就动手!"

source: WHOA, NICE! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% kicked %HISHER% nightmares in the nards!
target: 哇,不错!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 脚踢 %HISHER% 噩梦在鼻孔里!

source: Yeah... I saw... still... wincing in sympathy...
target: 对... 我看见了... 还是... 满怀同情...

source: I can't believe that worked. Why does Nick-Nhag'zhaz even have a crotch? Aren't they made of nightmares?
target: 我不敢相信这能奏效。 为什么Nick -Nhag'zhaz甚至有一条裤子? 他们不是做噩梦的吗?

source: Because while Nick's body is made of nightmares, their own worst nightmare is getting kicked in the crotch! Ironic, right?
target: 因为尼克的身体是被噩梦所制成, 而他们自己的最糟糕的噩梦却被踢入了地牢! 讽刺,对不对?

source: You survived your nightmares, you no longer shudder at the sight of plantains, and you gained +N2 HYPE for winning a fight!
target: 你从恶梦中幸存下来,你不再对浮游生物的目光感到恐惧,你赢得了+N2 HYPE的胜利!

source: Grab some drinks
target: 去拿点喝的

source: You and your friends take a seat at the bar. A tough-looking unicorn and a boisterous storm elemental sit next to you.
target: 你和你的朋友在酒吧坐下来 一个长得硬的独角兽和一个狂暴的风暴元素坐在你旁边.

source: Hey, guys! I didn't know you drank here!
target: 嘿,伙计们! 我不知道你在这里喝酒!

source: Hi, Susanne! We're just passing through on our road trip. Do you and your friend come here a lot?
target: 嗨,苏珊娜! 我们只是路途经过。 你和你朋友经常来这里吗?

source: Yeah, all the time. Whiskey and I OWN this place.
target: 是啊,所有的时间。 威士忌和我拥有这个地方。

source: Well, not literally, someone else does that. But we own, like, the CRED of this place.
target: 嗯,不是字面上的,别人这样做。 但我们拥有这个地方的CRED

source: We're tight with all the regulars. Like Johnny there! What's up, man? How's your niece?
target: 与一切常相相相相紧. 像约翰尼一样! 怎么了,伙计? 你外甥女怎么样?

source: The biker Whiskey's shouting at looks up and says, "My name's Broderick. Who the hell are you?"
target: 自行车手威斯克高叫起头来,说道:"我叫布罗德里克. "你到底是谁?"

source: Haha! Classic Johnny, such a jokester.
target: 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 经典的约翰尼,这样一个笑话。

source: Uhhh, right. So, what's good to drink here?
target: 嗯,对了。 这里有什么好喝的?

source: Try the fermented gasoline! It'll put hair on your chest!
target: 试试发酵的汽油! 它会把头发放在你的胸口!

source: Sure, the gasoline's pretty good -- if you're into fruity stuff. I'm a screwdriver man myself.
target: 当然,汽油很好,如果你喜欢水果的话。 我自己也是个螺丝刀手

source: The bartender slides Whiskey a literal metal screwdriver in a pint glass. He starts chewing on it vigorously.
target: 酒保在一品脱玻璃中滑出一副字形的金属螺丝刀. 他开始猛烈地咀嚼它。

source: You gotta love the authentic rustic flavor!
target: 你得喜欢这种生锈的口味!

source: What are you gonna order, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? No pressure, but we're totally gonna judge you based on your choice!
target: 你要点什么? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 没有压力,但我们完全会根据你的选择来判断你!

source: A Punch In The Face
target: 拳打脸

source: The Strongest Spirit: The Spirit of Someone Really Strong
target: 最强的精神: 一个非常强壮的人的精神

source: A glass of water
target: 一杯水 一杯水 一杯水 一杯水 一杯水

source: You pay the bartender -N2 MONEY, and he slides you a shot of strong liquor. You take a sip...
target: 你付酒保N2钱,他给你打一针烈酒 你喝点...

source: Not bad! It's missing something, but honestly, you're just glad the Punch In The Face was a drink and not a literal assault.
target: 不错! 但老实说,你只是庆幸"拳打脸" 是饮料,而不是字面攻击。

source: Yeah, about that...
target: 是啊,关于这个...

source: HEY EVERYBODY! %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% ORDERED A PUNCH IN THE FACE!
target: 嘿,每个人!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% 点了个花花公子!

source: The entire bar collectively socks you in the jaw. It hurts like hell. Susanne's got a mean right hook, and Whiskey's hooves are... well, hooves.
target: 整个酒吧都把你打入下巴里 痛得如来地. 苏珊娜的右下勾拳很狠 怀斯基的蹄子是... 好了,蹄子们。

source: You swallow all the blood in your mouth. It's... delicious for some reason?!
target: 你吞下你嘴里所有的血迹 这是... 好吃有原因吗?

source: Pretty good, huh? Blood is the secret ingredient that makes A Punch In The Face work!
target: 不错吧? 血是使"一拳入面"起作用的秘密成分!

source: Awww, man! I wish I still had blood in me! I'll never know the true flavor of this artisanal beatdown...
target: 啊,伙计! 我真希望我还有血! 我永远不会知道这个手工打人的真正味道...

source: Don't worry, Polly. You can possess my body, and we can try the Punch In The Face together.
target: 不用担心 波莉. 你可以拥有我的身体, 我们可以一起尝试拳打脸。

source: Really? I'd never possess someone without their consent... but if you're okay with it, then sure!
target: 真的吗? 没有他们的同意,我永远不会拥有一个人... 但如果你不介意,那当然!

source: Totally, bro! That's the power of teamwork!
target: 绝对的,兄弟! 这就是团队合作的力量!

source: You do another shot with Polly/Scott, because what's a little permanent cerebral damage between friends? You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你再试一次 波莉/斯科特因为朋友之间的脑损伤是什么? 你得到了+N2 HYPE!

source: You pay -N2 MONEY, and the waiter brings out a ghostly brew. The spirit of an extremely muscular man comes pouring out of the glass!
target: 你付N2钱,服务员 带来一个幽灵的酿酒。 一个极有肌肉的人的精神从玻璃中涌出!

source: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%," he says, "I AM THE SPIRIT OF THE STRONGEST MAN IN THE WORLD."
target: "%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%他说,"我是世界上最强壮的人的精神。"

source: "I HAVE MANY NAMES, BUT YOU MAY CALL ME MR. WORLDWIDE."
target: "我有很多名字, 但你可以叫我先生。 全世界。"

source: "TELL ME: ARE YOU WORTHY OF CONSUMING ME? WHAT FEATS OF INCREDIBLE STRENGTH HAVE YOU PERFORMED?"
target: "告诉我,你对我的烦恼吗? 你表现得怎么样?

source: Well, pull-ups aren't my strong suit, but my pet fish died last winter and I bore the crushing weight of his loss every day.
target: 嗯,拉起不是我的强力西装, 但我的宠物鱼去年冬天死了, 我承受了 他每天损失的被压抑的重量。

source: "IMPRESSIVE. HAVE YOU EVER USED YOUR STRENGTH AND HEROISM TO HELP OTHERS?"
target: "令人沮丧。 你曾经使用你的钢筋 和英雄帮助他人吗?

source: Uhh... my mom calls me a "strong, helpful little %BOYGIRL%" when I help her carry in the groceries!
target: 额... 我妈妈叫我"强壮,有帮助的小%BOYGIRL%" 当我帮她搬运杂货时!

source: "GOOD ENOUGH. YOU ARE CLEARLY STRONG, BUT NOW IT'S TIME FOR THE TRUE TEST."
target: "食物足够。 你非常有力, 但现在它的时间 真正的测试。"

source: "ARE YOU STRONG ENOUGH TO LIFT... THIS PINT GLASS?!"
target: "你是否有足够的自由... ... 这个金丝雀?"

source: You try to pick up the cup you've been given. WOW, this thing is heavy. What kind of goliath was the bartender who brought it to you?!
target: 你试着拿起你得到的杯子 哇,这东西很重。 酒保带给你的是什么鬼东西?

source: Want us to help you lift it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? If we work together, we could do it!
target: 要我们帮你抬起它, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 如果我们合作,我们就能做到!

source: Yeah! True strength comes from friendship and teamwork!
target: 对! 真正的力量来自友谊和团队精神!

source: Well that's a little corny... but fuck it, whatever gets this alcohol into %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s bloodstream the fastest!
target: 嗯,这有点老套... 但他妈的,无论什么 得到这种酒精进入 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%血液流速最快!

source: Your friends work together to tip the Strongest Spirit into your waiting mouth. It tastes like an old gym sock and +N2 SOUL from the literal soul of Mr. Worldwide! Refreshing!
target: 你的朋友们一起工作 把最强大的精神倾注到你的等待口中 味道像一只老式健身袜子 从字面上从先生的灵魂取出+N2 SOUL. 环球网! 刷新! 刷新! 刷新!

source: You can't help but feel nervous about your choice. Your friends are clearly hyping you up to order something intense and alcoholic...
target: 你对自己的选择不禁感到紧张. 你的朋友们显然在哄你 来点烈酒...

source: But you're thirsty, and you like water! You order one. It costs -N2 MONEY.
target: 但你渴了,你喜欢喝水! 你点一个。 花了2个钱。

source: ...Since when did they start charging for fucking WATER here? This place is really going down the tubes.
target: 他们什么时候开始为这该死的水收费的? 这地方真的要下管子了。

source: No kidding. But good on you for getting water, boo. Nothing's cooler than a hydrated body!
target: 别开玩笑了 喝水对你有好处,布克 没有比水合体更酷的了!

source: And now we have a designated driver! Thanks for looking out for us, bro.
target: 现在我们有位指定司机了! 谢谢你照顾我们 兄弟

source: Why are you looking at us like that? Did you really think we were gonna judge you for not ordering alcohol? We weren't serious!
target: 你为什么这样看着我们? 你真的以为我们会因为你没有点酒而审判你吗? 我们不是认真的!

source: It was just a test to see if you could resist peer pressure -- and you passed!
target: 只是测试一下你能否抵御同伴的压力--你通过了!

source: Now you get to bask in the glow of PEER VALIDATION!
target: 现在,你得到的泡 在发光 PEER 评估!

source: Nice! You earned your friends' respect, and +N2 STAMINA from being hydrated!
target: 不错! 你赢得了朋友的尊敬 +N2 STAMINA因为被水化了!

source: Play some pool
target: 玩点游泳池

source: You head over to the pool table to start a game, but find two legendary idiots already in the middle of a game when you get there.
target: 你到台球台开始比赛 但到场后 发现两个传说中的白痴

source: All right: I'll sink the 6 in the top-left corner pocket, which will knock the 7 into the 8 ball and ricochet them both into opposite pockets!
target: 好,我把6个打入左上角口袋, 将7个打入8个球, 把他们两个打入对面口袋!

source: Not if I block your amazing trick-shot with my even-more-amazing counter move! FORE!!!
target: 如果我用我更厉害的计时器 挡住你那惊人的诡计 福尔多!

source: Susanne hits the cue ball. Whiskey swings his cue stick like a baseball bat at the cue ball. The ball ricochets off the ceiling and shatters the 8 ball to smithereens.
target: 苏珊娜打入了球口 威士忌会像棒球棒一样在球杆上摇摆 球从天花板上击出并击碎了8个球至相去相去相去.

source: Dammit! You win another round of Death Balls, my friend. Here's your twenty dollars. I'll go pay for the property damages too...
target: 该死! 你赢得了另一轮死亡球,我的朋友。 这是你的20美元。 我也会去赔偿财产损失...

source: Death Balls, huh? Can't wait to turn this one into a story of how I died.
target: 死亡球,是吗? 迫不及待想把这个变成我死因的故事

source: What are you saying? You think you can withstand the almighty power that is Death Balls? HAHAHAHAHAHA!
target: 你在说什么? 你以为你能承受死亡之球的万能力量吗? 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

source: Listen: I am the greatest Death Balls player in the whole bar. No one has ever defeated me, and NO ONE EVER WILL.
target: 听着,我是全酒吧最伟大的死亡球员 没有人会打败我, 没有人会。

source: All the ranting is getting you intrigued. You politely ask Whiskey how exactly Death Balls is played.
target: 所有的叫声让你感兴趣。 你礼貌地问Whiskey 到底怎么玩"死亡球"的

source: YOU DARE CHALLENGE ME TO DEATH BALLS AT MY OWN TABLE?!
target: 你挑战我 死亡桶在我的自己的桌子上!

source: No?
target: 没有吗?

source: NANI?! Did someone say we have a new Death Balls challenger?!
target: 纳尼! 有人说我们有新的死亡球挑战者吗?

source: Yup. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% over here thinks %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% got some big, brass 8-balls between %HISHER% legs!
target: 对  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 这边想 %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% 中间有大铜八球 %HISHER% 脚!

source: I ACCEPT YOUR CHALLENGE, WEAKLING!
target: 我接受你的挑战,韦克林!

source: You challenged no one, nor do you know how this game is even played... but this is your life now, you guess. How will you beat an all-time Death Balls champion?
target: 你没有挑战任何人,你也不知道这游戏是怎么玩的... 但这是你现在的生活,你猜。 你怎么击败一个永远的死亡球冠军?

source: BEND PHYSICS WITH THE TIMESPACE-DEFYING CURVED SHOT!
target: 时空防守的枪声响起!

source: The sad reality is you will never be better than Whiskey... you must resort to the oldest deus ex machina in the book: the power of love.
target: 可悲的现实是,你永远不会比威士忌更好... 你必须求助于书中最古老的神职人员 爱的力量

source: In order to pull off a feat like this, you'll need to really concentrate. You close your eyes and focus your breath. In, out, in, out...
target: 为了完成这样的壮举,你需要真正集中精神. 你闭上眼睛 集中你的呼吸 进出出出出出出.

source: When you open your eyes, the bar is gone. You're at the Sacred Tribunal of the Laws of Physics.
target: 当你睁开眼睛,酒吧就不见了。 你在物理法则的神圣法庭。

source: Here, the Lords of Timespace preside over a constant hearing of regular people pleading to break the laws of physics.
target: 在这里,"时空之王"主持一个常年的听证会,由常人恳求打破物理定律.

source: "The Razkath Empire has devastated my people for centuries," the current defendant begs. "If I could just part the Tuzkur Sea, we could escape them!"
target: ""拉兹喀特帝国数个世纪来对我国人民的破坏",现任被告乞讨. "如果我能把图兹库尔海分开,我们就能逃脱"

source: The Lords decree, "Nermal the Noble, your intentions are pure, but your circumstances are not extreme enough to permit breaking the laws of physics. NEXT!"
target: 领主下令:"诺贝尔,你的意图是纯洁的,但你的情况并不足以允许违反物理法则. 下一个!"

source: The bailiff drags Nermal away. You step up and say you'd like to break physics to win a game of billiards and look cool in front of your friends.
target: 法警把Nermal拖走了。 挺身而出,表示想打破物理学,以取一局台球取胜,在朋友面前显得很酷.

source: "Hmmmm, the pursuit of coolness is indeed a noble task," says one Lord.
target: "嗯,追求凉爽的确是一个崇高的任务",一位主说.

source: "Yes, and billiards is known to be one of the coolest games ever created," says another. "I'm in!"
target: "是的,而台球已知是有史以来最酷的游戏之一"又说出一出. "我进去了!"

source: "Are you guys fucking serious?" a third snaps. "Nermal can't save his people, but we're going to allow physics to break for a fancy billiards trick-shot?"
target: "你们他妈的是认真的吗?"第三秒 "Nermal不能救他的人, 但我们要允许物理学突破 一个花哨的台球花招?"

source: "Well, maybe we would have voted to acquit Nermal if he'd had a fancy billiards trick-shot to back up his argument."
target: "也许我们本来会投票让Nermal无罪释放 如果他有一个花哨的台球花招来支持他的论点"

source: In a 4-to-3 vote, the Lords vote to let you break the laws of physics to look cool in front of your friends! Way to abuse the system, champ!
target: 在4比3的投票中,主公们投票让你打破了物理法则,在你的朋友面前看起来很酷! 如何滥用系统,冠军!

source: You return to reality, imbued with your new power. You hit the cue ball, and it follows an impossible, predetermined path.
target: 你回到现实,充满了你的新力量 你击出球, 它沿着一条不可能的,预先确定的道路。

source: It hits ALL of the balls, including Whiskey's -- ouch!
target: 它打出所有的球, 包括威士忌的 -- 呜!

source: NOOOOOO! NOT MY BALLS! IT'S MY SECRET WEAK SPOT!
target: 不,不,不,不,不,不,不,不,不。 不是我的枪! 这是我的秘密 威克弹簧!

source: DID %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% JUST BEAT WHISKEY?!
target: 已经 %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS% 只是贝特whistey!

source: Yup! Whiskey forks over the +N2 MONEY you were apparently betting with the hand he's not using to hold his aching balls. You lost -N2 MIND from bending timespace, though.
target: 没错! 威士忌叉在+N2钱上... ...你显然在用手打赌... ...他不会拿起他的痛球。 不过你从弯曲的时空上输了N2 MIND

source: You play your best and have faith in the power of love.
target: 你尽了最大努力,对爱的力量有信心.

source: To no one's suprise, Whiskey destroys you. Sad trumpet noise.
target: 至无人出,怀斯克毁汝. 悲哀的喇叭声。

source: You peer down at the 8 ball in the pocket with tears in your eyes. But... could it be...?
target: 你在口袋里的8个球 眼中流了眼泪 不过... 会不会... ?

source: The 8 ball looks up at you with loving bishi eyes!
target: 8号球用可爱的双眼看着你!

source: I'm sorry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%-senpai. I fought so hard. I wanted you to win. But still, I failed you...
target: 对不起 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%- 森佩尔。 我打得这么厉害 我希望你能赢。 但我还是让你失望了...

source: No, it's not your fault! I thought of nothing but taking down my opponent. It's my fault you suffered so much,  8 ball-kun!
target: 不 这不是你的错! 我一无是处地想着要干掉我的对手 都是我的错,你受了这么多苦,8个球!

source: Remember me as I was, Senpai, and just know that I... I love...
target: 记得我以前的样子,森派, 只要知道我... 我爱...

source: 8 ball-kun dies before she can finish. You didn't even get to tell her you love her too! Tears pour down your face.
target: 8个球还没完就死了 你甚至没有告诉她你也爱她! 泪倒出相相相相相.

source: Can anyone explain why %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is hysterically sobbing over the 8 ball?
target: 有人能解释为什么%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 歇斯底里地为这8个球哭泣吗?

source: SHHH! Don't talk over the emotional climax!
target: 嘘! 不要谈论情感高潮!

source: The tears keep falling and falling -- until you hear 8 ball-kun gasp for air again!
target: 眼泪不断倒下 -- 直到你再次听到8个球的气喘吁吁!

source: I'm... alive?! Senpai, the power of your love brought me back to life! I think I can still win this -- put me back on that board!
target: 我…… 还活着吗? Senpai, 你的爱的力量让我复活了! 我想我还是能赢的 把我放回董事会去!

source: You put the 8 ball-kun back on the board, line up your shot, and manage to sink her in the pocket! You win!
target: 你把8个球放回板上,排好你的镜头, 并设法让她沉入口袋里! 你赢了!

source: How the fuck does that count as a win? I still sank the 8 ball first.
target: 这他妈的怎么算赢? 我仍然先把8个球打沉了

source: Because of the power of love, dumb-dumb! Everyone knows love trumps all other logic in an epic battle.
target: 因为爱的力量,哑巴! 在史诗般的战斗中,每个人都知道爱凌驾于其他逻辑之上。

source: Yeah, I'm checking the rules, and "the power of love" apparently is the ultimate trump move.
target: 是啊,我在检查规则, "爱的力量"显然是 最终的优势动作。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% won! Whiskey, pay %HIMHER% the +N2 MONEY you bet.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 赢了! 威士忌,给钱 %HIMHER% +N2 钱你敢打赌。

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
target: 不,不,不,不,不,不,不。

source: Hooray! Who cares that you lost -N2 HYPE due to how cheap deus ex machinas are? You even start a passionate long-distance relationship with 8 ball-kun!
target: 万岁! 谁在乎你输了N2 HYPE 是因为前机械师的便宜程度? 你甚至和8个球开始热情的长途恋情!

source: Spook people by posing as ghosts
target: 假扮鬼来害人

source: You get a moment alone with Polly and Scott and pitch your sheet ghost idea to them. They're immediately onboard.
target: 你一个人待会儿 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 和你的床单鬼想法给他们。 他们马上上船了

source: You spy your first victim laying flowers on three graves. You sneak up behind the gravestones, wait for the right moment, and pounce!
target: 你监视你第一个受害者 在三个坟墓上放花 你偷偷地爬到墓碑后面,等待正确的时机,并扑出!

source: BOO!
target: 鲍!

source: AWOOOO! I'm a ghost!
target: 摆摆! 我是一个鬼!

source: Eh, close enough.
target: 嗯,够近了。

source: OH, GOD! Where did you three come from?!
target: 天啊! 你们三个从哪里来的?
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: We're ghoOoOoOoOoOoOosts! We've come to haunt you and make you pay for your various crimes or whatever!
target: 我们是GHOOOOOOOOOSTS! 我们来骚扰你 让你为各种罪行付出代价!

source: Wait... you mean you're the ghosts of Casey, Tori, and Alex? Guys, it's me, Matteo! From the polycule!
target: 单单... 你是说你是凯西、托里和亚历克斯的鬼魂? 伙计们,是我,马特奥! 从多管起!

source: The... wha?
target: 那个... 怎么会?

source: I know I deserve the eternal torment you have in store for me, after the fatal sex swing incident that killed you three...
target: 我知道我应该得到你给我的永恒的折磨 在致命的性秋千事件之后 杀死了你们三个...

source: If only I'd assembled it correctly. But I was too lazy to read the instructions, and that laziness cost you all your lives.
target: 如果我装的正确就好了 但我太懒了 读指示, 懒惰花费你的全部生命。

source: (Note from the devs: we must point out that assuming all poly relationships are kinky is oversimplistic and plain wrong. Some might be, some are not, but this one was.)
target: (devs的注:我们必须指出,假设所有的多层关系都是古怪的,是过于简单化的,是完全错误的. 有些可能,有些不是,但这个是。 )

source: I miss you all so much... is there anything I could do to show you how sorry I am? Seriously, I'll do anything!
target: 我非常想念你们... 有什么我可以做 让你知道我有多抱歉吗? 说真的,我什么都愿意做!

source: (What do we do, Polly? I think this guy is confusing us with someone else.)
target: (我们该怎么办, 波莉? 我觉得这家伙把我们和别人搞混了).

source: (Just roll with it. The first rule to good pranking is not knowing when to quit.)
target: (随取而出. 首要规则是 不知何时退出)

source: Well, if you aren't bailing, then you're taking advantage of the situation. How can Matteo make it up to you guys?
target: 好吧,如果你不保释, 那你在利用 情况。 Matteo怎么补偿你们?

source: "Invest 1000 dollars in the hottest new business on the market: Polly & Scott's Edible Food!"
target: "在市场上最热门的新业务投资1000美元: 波莉 & 斯科特"食用食品"("食用食品").

source: "Give us that sandwich you're eating and we're square."
target: "把你们吃的三明治给我们,我们是正方形的"

source: Polly & Scott's Edible Food...? You're sure investing in that will make you all forgive me for basically murdering you?
target: 波莉 & 斯科特食用食品吗? 你确定投资会让大家 原谅我谋杀你吗?

source: Totally! P&SEF is gonna be the biggest thing since sliced bread! It's gonna have sliced EDIBLE bread!
target: 绝对! P&SEF将是自被切成面包以来最大的东西! 它会切成EDIBLE面包的!

source: P&SEF has been a long time in the making! At first it was "Polly & Scott's Recycled Food", which had a rocky start.
target: P&SEF在制作中已经很长时间了! 起初是"波莉 & 斯科特"再生食品",它有一个摇滚的起步。

source: Apparently "recycled food" is just poop, so nobody bought it.
target: 很明显"循环食品"只是大便,所以没人买.

source: But then Polly remembered that "edible" refers to something other than consumable drugs, and that was the big eureka they needed to get started!
target: 但后来 波莉 记得"可食"是指除了可食用药物以外的东西,这就是他们需要开始的大"可食"(Eureka)!

source: I see. I still don't get why you're insisting on this company in particular, but you guys did always encourage me to take some initiative with my finances...
target: 原来如此 我仍然不明白你们为什么特别坚持这家公司 但你们一直鼓励我主动利用我的财务...

source: Especially after I blew all our life insurance accounts investing in edible vibrators. I guess edible food's downright sensible compared to that, huh?
target: 尤其是在我毁了我们所有的人寿保险账户后 投资了可食用振动器 我猜食用食物的直线 与那相比,是明智的,是吧?

source: It's okay, bro! After this investment, we totally forgive you for accidentally murdering us. Everyone makes mistakes!
target: 没事的,兄弟! 这次投资之后 我们完全原谅你不小心杀了我们 每个人都会犯错!

source: Matteo makes his investment and leaves, and you all high-five over another successful prank pulled.
target: Matteo投资并离开, 你们都击倒了另一个成功的恶作剧。

source: Though, this is less of a prank and more of you scamming a grieving widower of three, which is objectively a dick move. So you gain +N2 MONEY but lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 虽然,这不是一个恶作剧, 更多的你骗 一个悲伤的鳏夫三, 这是客观上的老二举动。 所以,你得到+N2 货币,但损失 -N2 索尔。

source: Wait, seriously? You just want my sandwich? Why? Ghosts don't even eat, do they?
target: 等等,真的吗? 你只要我的三明治吗? 为什么? 鬼甚至不吃东西,是吗?

source: Who are you, the ghost police? Don't question us!
target: 你是谁,鬼警察? 不要质疑我们!

source: Fine, it's just... I'm already halfway done with this sandwich, and I had to go across town to the good deli to get it!
target: 好吧,这只是... 这个三明治我已经吃到一半了 我不得不去镇上好店买!

source: Are you sure I can't just devote the rest of my life to honoring your memories or something? Maybe donate to an organization that prevents sex-swing deaths?
target: 你确定我不能用余生来纪念你的记忆吗? 也许捐给一个防止性倾向死亡的组织?

source: Nope. We want that sandwich, or else your soul burns in guilt and agony for eternity. Them's the rules.
target: 没有。 我们想要三明治 否则你的灵魂会永远 内疚和痛苦地燃烧 其相为道.

source: Defeated, Matteo gives you all the sandwich. It's a BLT on rye! Yum!
target: 失败了,Matteo给了你所有的三明治。 这是雷的BLT! 汤!

source: Wow... I'm actually glad I did that. My soul feels lighter now that I'm absolved of the guilt of--
target: 哗... 我其实很高兴我这样做。 我的灵魂感觉轻了点 现在我被免除了...

source: Yeah, cool story bro. Are these tomatoes fresh? It's delicious!
target: 是啊,酷的故事兄弟。 这些番茄新鲜吗? 好吃吗?

source: The sandwich really is good. You can see why Matteo considered giving up spiritual salvation for it.
target: 三明治真的不错。 你明白为什么Matteo会考虑为此放弃精神救赎.

source: You gain +N2 STAMINA from your snack, but lose -N2 SOUL because you stole it from a grieving widower of three.
target: 你从你的零食中获得了+N2 STAMINA,但输了 -N2 SOUL,因为你偷了它 从一个悲伤的鳏夫3。

source: Raise the dead
target: 举起死者

source: You're all wandering around the graveyard when you hear gritty guitar riffs and a guy whine-singing about how much he "hates this town."
target: 你们在墓地到处走来走去 当你听到Gritty吉他里夫 和一个家伙在抱怨他"给这个镇子加了多少钱"

source: You follow the sound to Gerard the necromancer lounging in the graves, listening to music and drinking beer.
target: 你跟着歌声去杰拉德 巫师在坟墓里闲逛 听音乐喝啤酒

source: Oh, great. I see you've found my secret hideout for the rare nights that I choose to do my brooding outdoors.
target: 哦,伟大的。 看来你已经找到我的秘密藏身之处了 我选择在户外闲逛的稀有夜晚

source: That's cool! Graveyard-drinking is a hobby of mine too. I usually bump EDM, though. Really "livens" up the place, if ya know what I mean.
target: 这很酷! 喝地铁也是我的爱好 我通常碰EDM,虽然。 真正"生活"的地方, 如果你明白我的意思。

source: Tch, whatever... could you take your bubbly attitude elsewhere? I'm busy drowning my dark and twisted thoughts in booze...
target: 随便你... 你可不可以别处摆出粗鲁的姿态? 我忙着把黑暗和扭曲的思绪淹没在酒中...

source: Ah, damn, my beer is slightly out of my reach. Just a sec.
target: 啊,该死,我的啤酒有点不够用 单

source: LOREM IPSUM DOLOR SIT AMET!
target: 劳伦·伊普斯姆·多勒尔·阿特!

source: Light flashes from Gerard's staff, then a zombie claws out of the dirt! It's rotting, shambling, and crying "BRAAAAINS!"
target: Gerard的手杖闪出光来 然后一只僵尸爪子从地上掉出! 它腐烂了,令人羞愧, 并哭着"BRAAINS!"

source: Yep, "brains", right. Could you just hand me my beer there? It's to the left... no, MY left... yup, perfect. Good work, thrall.
target: 是的,"血栓",没错。 你能把我的啤酒递给我吗? 左边... 不,我的左边... 不错,完美。 干得漂亮,谢尔

source: Aww, your zombie's so cute! Like one of those old, leathery Chihuahuas you can't help but love.

target: 越狱的犯人接下来会加入他 在他跑出警方之后,被牛仔的毅力所鼓舞,放弃了犯罪加入他.

target: 牛仔不停地走来走去,聚集了更多的门徒. 大城市和小城镇的观察者 都在寻找孤独的游骑兵

source: "He's a metaphor for the lone walking ranger in all of our hearts," the magazines say. He inspires spiritualists everywhere. They even make a Walking Ranger Funko Pop.
target: "他是一个比喻 孤独的步行护林员 在我们所有的心脏,"杂志说。 他激励着各地的灵学家. 他们甚至做一个游骑兵 风子流行。

source: The cowboy and his followers walk serenely into the sunset, never to be seen again...
target: 牛仔和他的追随者静静地走入了夕阳,永远不再被人看见......

source: SUCKERRRS!
target: 苏克瑞斯!

source: What?! But truth-or-dare's not near as excitin' as a regular duel to the death! It ain't even a duel at all!
target: 你说什么? 但真相还是大冒险 并没有像对死亡的常规决斗那样兴奋! 这根本不是一场决斗!

source: I agree that truth-or-dare doesn't quite pack the same -N2 HYPE as two cowboys quick-drawing in the desert...
target: 我同意真相或大冒险 不像两个牛仔在沙漠里快速地 装满了N2 HYPE

source: But %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% kept the word "classic" in the name, so by law, they're technically the same.
target: 但是,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%在名称中保留了"经典"一词,因此根据法律,它们技术上是相同的.

source: Can't argue with that! LET THE TRUTH OR DARE DUEL BEGIN!
target: 这话不能说! 让真相或痛苦开始吧!

source: In round one, the cowboy gets you to admit that you wet the bed until you were thirteen. Rough start.
target: 在第一回合,牛仔让你承认 你湿了床直到你13岁。 很难开始。

source: You retaliate by daring him to lick a mescaline cactus. He then dares you to bare-knuckle box the purple fairies flying around his head.
target: 你为了报复他 大胆地舔一粒迷幻仙人掌 然后,他敢你 光指箱 紫色仙子飞在他的头上。

source: You point out that you can't do that because he's hallucinating them, but you lose a point anyway.
target: 你指出,你不能这样做,因为 他的幻觉他们, 但你失去了一点反正。

source: It's looking bleak, but then inspiration hits you: you dare the cowboy to shoot himself in the leg!
target: 它看起来很凄凉,但随后灵感击中你:你敢让牛仔自相残杀!

source: Hmm, normally I'd think that shooting myself in the leg is a pretty dumb idea...
target: 嗯,通常我会认为 射击自己的腿 是一个相当愚蠢的想法...

source: But I don't wanna lose, and I didn't get to shoot anything earlier, so... why not?
target: 但我不想输, 我没有得到拍摄任何早期,所以... 为什么不呢?

source: The cowboy shoots himself in the leg and quickly remembers why not: fatal blood loss.
target: 牛仔自相残杀腿部并快地记起原因:致命失血.

source: Good work, bro! You live another day!
target: 干得好,哥们! 你再过一天!

source: Or at least until Scott or I somehow endanger your life with our antics again.
target: 或至少直到 斯科特 或者我又用我们的怪癖 来危害你的生命

source: Yeah... or, just a thought: you and Scott could do your best to NOT do that?
target: 对... 或者,只是一个想法: 你和 斯科特 能尽力不这样做吗?

source: Unlikely! Now let's go, we've got a road trip to survive!
target: 可能吧! 可能吧! 可能吧! 可能吧! 现在,我们走吧,我们有一个 公路旅行生存!

source: Visit the horsies
target: 拜访霍斯

source: You decide to visit the horse stables. You're always down to see some cute animals and indulge your inner horse girl.
target: 你决定去马厩看看 你总是低调地看到一些可爱的动物 并放纵你的内马女孩。

source: Look, Polly, this one likes me! You can see in his eyes that he really loves my head pats.
target: 听着, 波莉这一个喜欢我! 你可以从他的眼睛里看到 他真的喜欢我的头拍。

source: Totally! You can always tell what a horse is thinking when you look into its eyes. They're the big, derpy windows into its soul.
target: 绝对! 你总是能分辨出一匹马在看它的眼睛时在想什么 它们是进入它灵魂的大而活泼的窗户

source: Like I can tell this one really wants a bite of my pocket. Do you smell the ketamine cookies in there, big guy?
target: 我看得出来他真的想咬我的口袋 你闻到氯胺酮饼干了吗,大家伙?

source: What is your horse thinking, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 你的马在想什么,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: You look into the eyes of the horse you're petting. At first you don't see anything, so you REALLY squint. And then...
target: 你看着马的眼睛 你宠物。 一开始你什么也看不见,所以你真的很精采。 礛...

source: You can envision the horse's wants. Its desires. The things it craves most in the world.
target: 你可以想象马的欲望。 其欲相从. 世界上最渴望的东西。

source: And it craves... violence. Arson. Bloodshed. So much bloodshed.
target: 它渴望着... 暴力行动。 纵火. 血流成河 血流成河 血流成河 这么多的流血。

source: "Doooo itttt, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!" the horse says with its eyes. "Burn down the world! Commit tax fraud! It is our DESTINY!"
target: "DOOOOOI Ittt,,,,,,,, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"马用眼睛说。 "把世界烧了! 交税骗局! 这是我们的DESTINY!"

source: Well? What's your horse saying, bro?
target: 怎么样? 你的马在说什么,兄弟?

source: "Why are you still standing there?" the horse's eyes demand. "Why haven't you committed tax fraud yet?! As your horse overlord, I COMMAND YOU!"
target: "你为什么还站在那里?" 马的眼睛要求. "为什么你还没有犯过税务欺诈? 作为你的马霸, 我命令你!"

source: What's wrong, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? You won't deny this adorable horsie its sweet, innocent desires by staying silent, will you?
target: 或? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 你不会拒绝这个可爱的Horsie 通过保持缄默来达到它甜蜜的,无辜的愿望,对吗?

source: Crap! You don't want to let your friends down, but does that mean you need to do the horse's bidding? You decide to...
target: 妈的! 你不想让朋友失望,但这意味着你需要做马的招标吗? 你决定...

source: Chalk up the horse's disturbing demands to your own weird, intrusive thoughts and just pat its dumb head.
target: 把马的烦扰 要求你自己 怪异的,侵入性的想法 拍拍它的愚蠢的头。

source: Do the horse's bidding.
target: 做马出价.

source: Pledge yourself to your new horse overlord and do whatever he demands until the end of your days.
target: 保证你的新马霸主 并做他要求的,直到你的日子结束。

source: You play dumb (or maybe you just are dumb, who knows?) and give the horse a friendly head pat.
target: 你装傻(也许你只是哑巴, 谁知道呢? ) 给马一个友善的头拍。

source: "Noooo! What about the tax fraud?!" screams the horse with its eyes. "I was very explicit about you committing tax fraud!"
target: "不呜呼! 那骗税的事呢? "我非常明确地说你有税务欺诈行为!"

source: But does it HAVE to be tax fraud? If these intrusive thoughts are gonna be in your head, can't you at least have a say in things?
target: 但它必须是税务欺诈吗? 如果这些侵扰性的想法在你脑子里, 你就不能至少有发言权吗?

source: "Fine, no tax fraud. We'll burn down an orphanage then! Ashes to ashes! Dust to dust!"
target: "好,不要骗取税收. 那我们就把孤儿院烧了! 烟灰倒地! 尘去尘去!"

source: Hmm, yeah, still gonna need to tone it back a little.
target: 嗯,是的,仍然需要 调回一点点。

source: "Ugh. Fine. You could scratch my ears, maybe?"
target: "U. 精细。 你可以刮我的耳朵,也许?"

source: Sure! Finally, we're getting somewhere.
target: 当然! 终于有进展了

source: "Good... and now that I've gotten pets, we're close enough to burn down an orphanage together! OUR FRIENDSHIP WILL BE FORGED IN FLAMES!"
target: "不错... 现在,我得到了宠物, 我们已足够接近烧毁 一个孤儿院一起! 我们的朋友将会在电影中被遗忘!"

source: Aaaand we're back to square one.
target: 我们又回到原地了

source: You decide to just get the horse an apple. It's just a dumb horse, after all. All these homicidal requests are just your fucked-up psyche talking, right?
target: 你决定给马买个苹果 毕竟只是一匹笨马. 所有这些杀人请求 都是你他妈的精神错乱的谈话,对吧?

source: Oh, boo, you really aren't good at this horse whispering thing. Can't you see in its eyes that it didn't want an apple?
target: 哦,嘘,你真的不擅长 这马耳语的事情。 难道你看不出来它不想吃苹果吗?

source: Yeah, I was getting a clear "burn down an orphanage and commit tax fraud" message from your horse. Why didn't you respect its wishes?
target: 是的,我得到了一个清晰的"烧掉一个孤儿院 并犯下税收欺诈"的信息 从你的马。 你为什么不尊重它的愿望?

source: Whoops. Caring about the lives of little orphans gives you +N2 SOUL, but being so painfully lame and unwilling to commit crimes costs you -N2 HYPE.
target: 呜呼. 关心小孤儿的生活给你+N2 SOUL, 但这么痛苦的跛脚和不愿犯罪,你花费了 -N2 HYPE.

source: Fuck it; you hated being in charge of your own life and decisions anyway. Might as well turn over your autonomy to a fuckin' horse.
target: 去他的,你讨厌自己负责自己的生活和决定 不如把你的自主权交给一匹马

source: You start by committing tax fraud, netting the horse thousands of dollars. It's risky, but you hope it will be enough to appease your new friend.
target: 你从偷税漏税开始, 净掉这匹马上千美金。 这很冒险 但你希望这足以安抚你的新朋友

source: No, this meager sum is not enough. The horse commands you to rob banks. Fine, ski mask robbery it is.
target: 不,这微薄的金额是不够的。 马命令你抢劫银行 好吧,滑雪面具抢劫。

source: You stick up a bank. The teller is taking too long to fill the bag. You can feel the horse growing impatient...
target: 你建了家银行。 计票员要花太长时间才填好袋子. 你能感觉到马变得不耐烦...

source: But... you don't want to hurt the teller! She's filling the bag as fast as she can! This isn't necessary!!
target: 不过... 你不想伤害出纳员! 她正在尽快填满袋子! 这是没有必要的!

source: Sigh... how can you say no to those eyes?
target: 叹... 你怎么能对眼睛说不?

source: You shoot the teller in the head and make off with the money. Not without shitting yourself a little, though.
target: 你射中计票员的头,然后用钱逃出. 不过,没有拉屎自己一点点。

source: When they're covering the robbery on the news later, they call your crime outfit "Whinny and the Poo."
target: 当他们稍后在新闻上报道抢劫事件时,他们称你的犯罪服为"Whinny and the Poo".

source: You gain +N2 HYPE for being so devoted to the horse, but you still lose -N2 SOUL for committing murder. Bummer.
target: 你因为如此热衷于马而获得+N2 HYPE,但你仍然因为谋杀而失去-N2 SOUL. 可恶

source: Fuck it; you hated being in charge of your own life and decisions anyway. Might as well turn over your autonomy to a fuckin' horse.
target: 去他的,你讨厌自己负责自己的生活和决定 不如把你的自主权交给一匹马

source: No words are spoken, but the covenant is complete. You stare into its eyes and sign your mind, body, and soul over to this horse.
target: 无言而出,但约而成. 你凝视着它的眼睛 将你的思想、身体和灵魂 标注在这匹马上

source: Uhh, Polly? Does %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% seem... like a husk of %HISHER% former self to you?
target: 额... 波莉? 对 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 看来... 钩hu %HISHER% 以前的自我吗?

source: Nah, %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% always making that face.
target: 没有 %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% 总是做那张脸。

source: %HESHE% probably just did something HUGE to make that horse happy. Good job, boo!
target: %HESHE% 也许只是做了一些HUGE 使这匹马快乐。 干得漂亮,嘘!

source: You go about your life pretty much as normal after that.
target: 之后你过着正常的生活

source: But every once in a while you pass a stranger in the street, and their eyes are as empty and soulless as your own.
target: 但偶尔你也会在街上通过一个陌生人,他们的眼睛和你自己一样空虚而无灵魂.

source: This is comforting, in a way. It's good to know who your allies are in the Hivemind of Horse.
target: 这在某种程度上是安慰的。 很高兴知道你的盟友在马的蜂巢里

source: The horse rewards you for your loyalty, of course; being in its fold grants you +N2 HYPE, +N2 MONEY, and +N2 MAGIC via its lucrative, arcane powers.
target: 当然,这匹马奖励你的忠诚; 在它的折叠中,你 +N2 HYPE, +N2 MONEY,和+N2 MAGIC 通过其有利可图的, arcane的力量。

source: But you also have to commit several atrocities on the horse's behalf: theft, arson, tax fraud, stabbing yourself in the leg for the laughs...
target: 但你也得替马犯下多起暴行:偷盗,放火,偷税取利,为取笑而自刺腿. .

source: Your new life of horse-crime takes a toll on you, and you lose -N3 MIND and -N3 SOUL.
target: 你的马犯罪新生活让你付出了代价,你失去了N3 MIND和N3 SOUL.

source: Display your own art
target: 显示自己的艺术

source: You tell your friends that you intend to display some of your own artwork at this exhibition.
target: 你告诉你的朋友,你打算 展示一些你自己的艺术品 在这个展览。

source: Sounds fun! And look: they even hung up a blank canvas for people to draw on!
target: 听起来很有趣! 看,他们甚至挂起一幅空白的画布,供人们借鉴!

source: Hello friends. Are you also admiring Vincenzo Spinelli's piece, "Bianco e Nient'altro"? This all-white portrait was his last great work before he died.
target: 你好,朋友们。 你还欣赏文森佐·斯宾内利的作品"Bianco e Nient'altro"吗?. 这幅全白的肖像画是他死前的最后一部伟大的作品.

source: What'd he die of, boredom?
target: 他死了吗,无聊?

source: Looks like ol' Polly and friends are gonna have to put the "TWERK!" in artwork!
target: 看起来像OL' 波莉 朋友们得把"TWERK"放进艺术品里!

source: Yeah! Let's draw something fun on that boring canvas!
target: 对! 让我们画一些有趣的 在无聊的帆布上!

source: What?! You can't draw on Spinelli's masterpiece! It'd be a crime against art! And also against the actual law!
target: 你说什么? 你不能利用斯宾内利的杰作! 那会是反艺术罪! 也违反法律!

source: Don't worry, Liam, our art will be hella legit. We'll even do our drawings on paper first and pick the best one.
target: 不用担心 利亚姆我们的艺术会很合法 我们甚至会先在纸上画图 然后再选最好的

source: Well, I'm not just going to stand by and let you deface an art piece... not without my input, anyway. Give me a marker!
target: 好吧,我不只是要 站在一边,让你去毁损一个艺术作品... 无论如何,没有我的投入。 给我一个标记!

source: You all take a moment to create your drawings and take turns showing them off.
target: 你们都花点时间来创造出你们的图画,然后轮流展示它们.

source: Feast your eyes, plebeians: a blank page! Inspired by "Bianco e Nient'altro", it's an expression of ennui in an increasingly consumerist--
target: 睁开眼睛吧 先生们 空白一页! 受到"Bianco e Nient'altro"的启发,它是一个日益消费主义者的"ennui"的表达 --

source: Ugh, Liam's disqualified for being boring. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what'd you draw?
target: 唉哟 利亚姆因为无聊被取消资格  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你画了些什么?

source: You drew Keith Bloodclaw, your Warrior Cats OC... which quickly gets disqualified for "having excessive abs".
target: 你画了Keith Bloodclaw,你的勇士猫... 很快就因为"腹肌过重"而被取消资格.

source: It's okay, boo! You can still make a mark on the art world... by choosing which piece should be exhibited: mine or Scott's?
target: 没事的,嘘! 你仍然可以在艺术界留下印记... 选择要展示的作品:我的或 斯科特''的吗?

source: Scott's piece
target: 斯科特块

source: Polly's piece
target: 波莉块

source: Scott translates his drawing to the museum wall. Immediately, art snobs are falling all over it to discuss its "imaginative brushstrokes" and "clear call-to-action."
target: 斯科特 他的画被翻译到博物馆的墙上 立刻,艺术取笑者们纷纷倒下,来讨论其"想象性的刷子打"和"清晰的呼唤-行动".

source: "Monsieur Howl!" says one art critic. "Can you explain what inspired you to choose an uncooked macaroni frame for your masterpiece?"
target: "Monsieur Hal!"说一个艺术评论家。 "你能解释什么激励你选择了 一个未经烹饪的通心粉框来做你的杰作吗?"

source: Oh, that's easy. I really like macaroni, but I'm not allowed to boil water by myself anymore, so I just eat the noodles raw.
target: 哦,这很简单。 我真的很喜欢通心粉,但是我不能再一个人煮水了, 所以我只吃面条生的.

source: I spilled some on the picture while I was working, so I just rolled with it!
target: 我在工作时在照片上洒了些 所以我就随身带着它滚了!

source: Ugh, this is such an insult to Vincenzo Spinelli! You destroyed his masterpiece with your shitty macaroni art!
target: 这是对文森佐·斯宾内利的侮辱! 你用你的烂通心粉艺术毁了他的杰作!

source: "Oh, I wouldn't say he destroyed it. In fact, Monsieur Howl understood my art better than anyone!"
target: "哦,我不会说他毁了它。 事实上,霍尔先生比任何人都更了解我的艺术".

source: The art critic removes his fake mustache and giant beret to reveal...
target: 艺术评论家取出他的假胡子和巨贝雷帽来揭示......

source: VINCENZO SPINELLI?! But you're supposed to be dead!
target: 文克诺・斯皮内利? 但你应该已经死了!

source: "Nay, I merely faked my own death so I could watch 'Bianco e Nient'altro' in secret, waiting for the day a true artist would correctly interpret it... as a blank canvas!"
target: "是的,我只是假装自己死了,这样我就能秘密地看"Bianco e Nient'altro",等待着真正的艺术家能够正确诠释的那一天...... 作为一幅空白的画布!"

source: "Buff, gentle artist of luscious fur -- thank you for realizing my dream. You are a true artist at heart."
target: "Buff,温和的画家 柔和的皮毛——谢谢你实现了我的梦想. 你是一个真正的艺术家的心。"

source: "You, and not the purple vampire who obviously didn't get my art."
target: "你,而不是紫色吸血鬼 谁显然没有得到我的艺术。"

source: Sheesh, okay...
target: 谢斯,好吧...

source: Hooray! You gain +N2 SOUL for choosing the piece with the wholesome message! But you lose -N2 STAMINA because that macaroni came out of your road trip food supplies.
target: 万岁! 选择带整齐口信的棋子,你可以得到+N2 SOUL! 但你输了N2 STAMINA 因为通心粉是从你的出行食品中运来的

source: Polly translates her drawing to the museum wall. Immediately, art snobs are falling all over it to discuss its "melancholy color palette" and "abundance of absolute dumptruck ass."
target: 波莉 把她的画翻译到博物馆的墙上 立即,艺术取笑者们纷纷倒地地地来讨论它的"美容色调色板"和"绝对垃圾车屁股的丰收".

source: "Madame Geist!" says one art critic. "Can you explain what inspired you to choose derrieres as the main focus of this piece?"
target: "Geist夫人!"有一个艺术评论家说. "你能解释是什么激励你选择了德里耶斯作为这部作品的主要焦点吗?".

source: Well, I was gonna do a piece based on "The Wasteland" by T.S. Eliot and the feelings of oppression and isolation it evokes...
target: 好吧,我本来要根据 T. S. 的"荒地" 做一个作品。 Eliot和它引发的压迫和孤立的感觉...

source: But then I got bored, and I started thinking about butts, and the rest kinda speaks for itself.
target: 但后来我变得无聊了, 我开始想屁股, 其余的有点说得通。

source: I can't believe you destroyed a masterpiece with a stupid butt. Vincenzo Spinelli is probably rolling in his grave.
target: 真不敢相信你居然用蠢屁股毁了一部杰作 Vincenzo Spinelli可能正在他的坟墓里滚来滚去

source: "Oh, I wouldn't say that. In fact, Madame Geist understood my art better than anyone!"
target: "哦,我不会说。 事实上,盖斯特夫人比任何人都更了解我的艺术!"

source: The art critic removes his fake mustache and giant beret to reveal...
target: 艺术评论家取出他的假胡子和巨贝雷帽来揭示......

source: VINCENZO SPINELLI?! But you're supposed to be dead!

source: I cannot fucking believe this. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is thinking of the number 69.
target: 我他妈的不敢相信。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 正在思考69号。

source: Haha, nice!
target: 哈哈,不错!

source: Polly high-fives you.
target: 波莉 击掌你。

source: The art critics LOSE IT. "He really guessed it! He's a real artist after all!"
target: 美术批评家们都输了 "他真的猜到了! 他毕竟是一个真正的艺术家".

source: I could've proven that WITH MY REAL ART! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% didn't have to turn my esteemed Q&A into a dirty joke!
target: 我用我真正的艺术就能证明这一点!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 没必要把我敬爱的QQA变成脏笑话!

source: 69 isn't just a joke! It's a timeless hieroglyphic, artistically rendering 2 consenting adults giving mutual fellatio in a carnal testament to human sexuality.
target: 69号不只是个笑话! 这是一个永恒的象形文字, 艺术上使两个同意的成年人 在性爱的证明中相互交待。

source: "That woman is right!" says another art critic. "I never realized it before, but the number 69 DOES look like two people practicing oral sex. What an amusing discovery!"
target: "那个女人是对的!" 另一位艺术评论家说. "我以前从未意识到,但是69DOS的号码看起来像两个人在练习口交. 多么有趣的发现!"

source: Ugh, you guys are the worst. At least I still have my beautiful artwork to comfort me...
target: 唉,你们是最糟糕的。 至少我还有我美丽的艺术品来安慰我...

source: Wait... WHAT? This isn't my painting! What did you guys do?!
target: 单单... 什麽? 这不是我的画! 你们干了什么?

source: Go swimming
target: 去游泳吗?

source: You're about to get in the water when a loud whistle stops you in your tracks. It's the lifeguards!
target: 当大口哨声 阻止你进入轨道时 你就要下水了 是救生员!

source: Heyyy, long time no see! What brings you guys to the lake?
target: 嘿,好久不见! 什么风把你们吹来湖边?

source: We wanted to go swimming! You can do that at a lake, right?
target: 我们想去游泳! 你可以在湖边这样做,对不对?

source: You sure can, brah, but only if you know how to swim safely.
target: 你当然可以,宝贝,但只有你知道如何安全游泳

source: Okay, how do we do that?
target: 好吧,我们如何做到这一点?

source: Uhhh...
...Damn, dude, we totally forgot. Anyone got any ideas?
target: 该死的,伙计,我们完全忘了。 有人有主意吗?

source: Hmm... I know you shouldn't eat beforehand... move your arms and legs around... avoid wearing heavy stuff that'll drag you down, like metal or stone...
target: 垛... 我知道你不该事先吃东西... 手臂和腿转动... 避免穿重物会把你拖下水,像金属或石头...

source: Oh, balls, I'm totally made of stone! Do you think that's why I lost my last job as a lifeguard?
target: 哦,球,我完全由石头做成! 你觉得这就是为什么我失去了我作为救生员的最后一份工作吗?

source: That makes sense. It must be why I got fired, too; I'm usually pretty stoned.
target: 这有道理。 这一定是我被解雇的原因,我通常都醉了。

source: But you guys aren't made of stone or metal, so you're safe, I think. Have fun out there!
target: 但你们不是用石头或金属做的 所以你们安全了,我想 玩得开心点!

source: Are you sure that's all it takes? You haven't told us any actual tips on swimming safely yet...
target: 你确定只有这些吗? 你还没有告诉我们任何关于安全游泳的实际提示...

source: Eh, fair enough. If you're nervous, I'm sure I've got something in my lifeguard bag that'll help you swim.
target: 额,很公平。 如果你紧张,我肯定我的救生包里有东西可以帮助你游泳.

source: But then again, I also have a lot of random shit in here. Does any of this crap seem helpful for swimming, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 但再说一遍,我这里也有很多乱七八糟的东西 任何这些垃圾 似乎有助于游泳, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: The very smol and intense swimming instructor that's as harsh as he is kawaii.
target: 和他一样严酷的游泳教练

source: Life insurance. Just in case.
target: 人寿保险. 以防万一 以防万一 以防万一 以防万一 以防万一

source: The pair of bright, arcane armbands that allow their user to cast a forbidden floating spell.
target: 使用户可以投出被禁活浮咒的一对明亮的,弧形的臂章.

source: Awww, he's so cute! How harsh can one little otter be?
target: 啊,他太可爱了! 小水獭能有多严厉?

source: "YOU THINK I CAN'T BE HARSH AND CUTE AT THE SAME TIME?!" the instructor barks. "I CONTAIN MULTITUDES, ROOKIE! I'LL SHOW YOU HOW TOUGH I CAN BE!"
target: "你认为我不能在同一个时间是 harsh和cute!" 教练吠叫。 "我拥有MUTITITUDES,罗基! 我会告诉你,我可以有多努力!"

source: The swimming lessons are INTENSE. You practice kicking, paddling, diving, washing the sensei's car, peeling potatoes...
target: 游泳课是INTENSE. 你练习踢,划,潜水,洗洗感官的车,剥土豆...

source: Okay, not to be THAT girl, but I don't see how preparing lunch is gonna help with swimming.
target: 好吧,不是做那个女孩, 但我不明白准备午餐 会如何帮助游泳。

source: "DON'T QUESTION ME, ROOKIE! POTATO-PEELING IS THE BEST WAY TO TRAIN YOUR BODY FOR THE WATER!"
target: "不要问我,罗基! 跳跃是训练你身体以取水的最佳方式!"

source: "THE REPETITIVE PEELING MOTIONS STRENGTHEN YOUR PALMS AND PHALANGES SO YOU CAN CARVE A PATH THROUGH EVEN THE TOUGHEST RIPTIDES!"
target: "重温的打水动能强化你的口袋和花瓶 这样你就可以通过最深的口袋 来保存一条路"

source: Fair enough, but what about the car-washing thing? How will that help us swim?
target: 很好,但洗车的事怎么办? 这能帮助我们游泳吗?

source: "Um... okay, I admit, that was just me taking advantage of you."
target: "额... 好吧,我承认,那只是我利用你。"

source: "BUT DO YOU KNOW HOW HARD IT IS TO WASH YOUR DIRTY CAR WHEN YOU'RE TWO FEET TALL?!"
target: "但你知道它有多难 洗你的脏车,当你是两只脚球?"

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA training, but when you finally start swimming, it's super easy!
target: 你输了N2STAMINA的训练,但当你终于开始游泳的时候,这是超容易的!

source: Who knew swimming had so much in common with peeling potatoes? Nobody probably, because it makes no sense, but here you are!
target: 谁知道游泳跟剥马铃薯有这么多共同点? 没人可能,因为它没有意义,但你在这里!

source: "EXCELLENT WORK, PUPILS!" the instructor says. "I CAN FINALLY RETIRE KNOWING THAT I'VE MOLDED YOU SAD SACKS INTO SPECTACULAR SWIMMERS!"
target: "出色的工作,PUPIELS!" 教官说. "我终于知道,我已经 移动了你们 萨德囊塞到 斯克塔克利亚的游泳者!"

source: Thanks a million, little dude. You want a snack before I put you back in your travel cage for nappies?
target: 谢谢你,小家伙。 你想吃点小吃吗?

source: "YES! I REQUEST A CUP OF WARM MILK AND POSSIBLY A BEDTIME STORY BEFORE I RETURN TO MY SLUMBER."
target: "对! 我要求一个温暖的米克和 可能是一个贝蒂米的故事 在我回到我的数量之前。"

source: Can do. You put your instructor to bed, and gain +N2 HYPE swimming in the lake!
target: 我们能做到这一点。 你把你的教练上床睡觉, 并获得+N2 HYPE游泳 在湖中!

source: Ahh, true. Swimming can be pretty dangerous; it'd be smart to have your life insurance worked out before you jump in the water.
target: 啊,没错。 游泳可能相当危险,在跳入水中之前,最好先弄好人寿保险。

source: You look over the lifeguards' life insurance policy. It claims to cover "every danger you might encounter while swimming"...
target: 你看看救生员的人寿保险单 它声称涵盖"游泳时可能遇到的所有危险".

source: ...yet it doesn't cover drowning?
target: 难道它不覆盖溺水吗?

source: Well, yeah, you can't have it all. But this policy covers lots of other potentially deadly swimming scenarios.
target: 嗯,是的,你不能拥有这一切。 但这项政策涵盖了许多其他潜在的致命游泳场景.

source: Like dying from a work-related swimming accident!
target: 就像死于与工作有关的游泳事故一样!

source: Or death by water bears. That'd be a hella bad time.
target: 或被水熊所杀. 那会是一个糟糕的时机。

source: Aren't water bears microscopic anyway?
target: 水不是有显微镜吗?

source: But there's still, like, millions of them living in the lake. We're totally outnumbered!
target: 但仍有上百万人生活在湖中. 我们完全寡不敌众!

source: Yeah. A million water bears vs. one %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? I don't fancy your chances.
target: 对 一百万只水熊对. 一个 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 我不喜欢你的机会。

source: Okay, but why is "death by fire" covered by this policy?
target: 好吧,但为什么"死于火灾" 包含在这个政策?

source: Dude, if you don't understand the dangers of burning alive, maybe it'd be irresponsible of us to let you swim...
target: 哥们,如果你不明白活活烧死的危险, 也许让我们游下去是不负责任的...

source: C'mon, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're thinking too hard about it. Polly and I will feel a lot better if you took the extra safety precaution before we go swimming.
target: 来吧,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%,你考虑得太严了。  波莉 如果你在游泳前采取额外的安全防范措施 我会感觉好多了

source: Word. I've already picked the stripper I'm gonna hire for your funeral, so we'll need that life insurance check if this goes sideways.
target: 语已. 我已经选了脱衣舞娘 我将聘请你参加葬礼 所以我们需要人寿保险的检查 如果这走在一边的话

source: Fine, if it means that much to them. You lose -N2 MONEY buying this nonsensical life insurance.
target: 好吧,如果这对他们很重要的话。 你输了 -N2货币 购买这种非感性人寿保险。

source: The good news is, you go on to have a great day in the lake! Much fun is had, no one dies from water bears or a lake fire, and you gain +N2 HYPE.
target: 好消息是,你去湖边过个好日子! 有很多乐趣,没有人死于水熊 或湖火, 你得到+N2 HYPE。

source: Whoa, mad respect. The Arcane Armbands of Buoyancy are suuuper powerful magic items.
target: 哇,疯狂地尊重。 阿卡内臂章(英语:Arcane Armbands of Buoyancy)是苏普尔强大的魔法物品.

source: Really? They just look like regular floaties to me.
target: 真的吗? 他们只是看起来像普通活人。

source: That's 'cause you don't have the "magic touch", dude. Wanda and I got ours from the wizard who lives at Fill It.
target: 那是因为你没有"魔法感",伙计。 Wanda和我从住在Fill It的巫师那里得到了我们的

source: Fill It... the gas station?
target: 填满... 加油站吗?

source: That's just what they WANT you to think. The wizard who lives in the Fill It parking lot told us it's actually a magical pocket dimension!
target: 他们就是希望你这样想 住在Fill It停车场的巫师告诉我们 这其实是一个神奇的口袋维度!

source: We were skeptical at first too, but then the wizard gave us some magic cosmic brownies that totally opened our eyes!
target: 我们一开始也很怀疑 但巫师给了我们一些神奇的宇宙棕褐色 完全打开了我们的眼睛!

source: Then, when Wanda and I were tripping magical balls, the wizard gave us the Armbands of Buoyancy to aid us on "whatever you do next, I don't fucking care."
target: 然后,当万达和我 绊倒神奇球, 巫师给了我们臂章 Buoyancy 帮助我们 "无论你下一步做什么,我他妈的不在乎"。

source: But there was a catch: we had to dump magic onto the armbands to make them work.
target: 但有一个发现:我们不得不把魔法扔到臂章上,以使它们发挥作用。

source: We used the magic metal elephant trunks at Fill It to get the magic at the time, but I dunno where you'll find any magic all the way out here...
target: 我们用Fill It的神奇金属大象树干来获得当时的魔力,但我不知道你们会从哪里找到任何魔力...

source: Hey, we've been filling our car with magic! Let's use some of that!
target: 嘿,我们一直在给我们的车装上魔法! 让我们用一些!

source: I'm pretty sure dumping our hard-earned fuel on these floaties would be a terrible idea.
target: 我敢肯定,将我们辛苦得到的燃料 倾倒在这些浮标上将是一个可怕的主意。

source: Pfft. Spoken by someone who totally lacks the "magic touch".
target: P. 由完全缺乏"魔法感"的人所言.

source: C'mon, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, we gotta do it! The flotation spell won't work otherwise!
target: 来吧, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我们必须做到这一点! 浮出水面的咒语是行不通的!

source: Ugh, fine. You lose -N2 MAGIC dunking the floaties in gasoline.
target: 呃,没事。 你输了N2 MAGIC在汽油中漂浮。

source: At least you still have fun playing in the lake, and gain +N2 HYPE splashing around with your friends!
target: 至少你还在湖里玩得开心 和朋友一起玩得开心!

source: Build sand castles
target: 建造沙地城堡

source: You're having fun building castles when you notice that your sandy abodes have acquired some new tenants.
target: 当你发现你的沙地住所 已经收购了一些新房客时 你们正在玩乐建造城堡

source: Bros, look! Those hermit crabs are moving into our sand castle.
target: 兄弟们,看! 那些隐士蟹要搬入我们的沙地城堡了

source: That's dope. We have king and queen crabs now. You guys are, like, the kingmakers of the lake.
target: 这是涂料。 我们有王和王后螃蟹了 你们是湖里的霸主

source: Yup! And check out the king's brother sharpening that shell shard into a spear. I smell a regicide coming on!
target: 没错! 检查一下国王的弟弟 把炮弹磨成长矛 我闻到一个死党来了!

source: Hi Wanda! Hi Stu! What're you doing at the lake?
target: 嗨,万达! 嗨,斯图! 你在湖边干什么?

source: Uh... fuck... what ARE we doing here?
target: 额... 他妈的... 我们在这里做什么?

source: Aren't you lifeguards?
target: 你们不是救生员吗?

source: Oh yeah! Good catch. That explains these rescue floaties and this whistle and why my swimsuit says "Lifeguard."
target: 哦,对了! 接得漂亮 接得还不错 Good catch. 这解释了这些救援浮标和这个口哨 以及为什么我的泳衣上写着"生命卫士"

source: And that reminds me: as the lifeguards, we gotta check to make sure your sand castles don't have any OSHA violations.
target: 这提醒了我: 作为救生员,我们得检查一下 以确保你的沙地城堡没有违反OSHA的行为。

source: Yup, them's the rules for some reason. And I can tell you already that these castles aren't up to code at all.
target: 是啊,这是规则 出于某种原因。 我可以告诉你,这些城堡 根本不符合密码。

source: Bummer, dudes. We'll be back with the paperwork to condemn them. It should take five minutes to an hour depending on if we forget what we're doing on the way.
target: 可恶,伙计。 我们会带回文件 来谴责他们 这需要5分钟到1小时, 取决于我们是否忘记了我们在路上在做什么。

source: We have to do something, bros. If they condemn our sand castles, King and Queen Snippy won't have a place to call home!
target: 我们得做点什么 兄弟 如果他们谴责我们的沙城堡,国王和斯尼皮王后就没有地方叫回家!

source: There's gotta be some way to get the castles up to code before the lifeguards return. Time to save your crabs from total OSHAnnihilation!
target: 在救生员回来之前 一定有办法把城堡弄好 是时候把螃蟹从OSHAnnihilation中拯救出来!

source: You may have to replace the sand with another material. Sand isn't well-known for its integrity as a material.
target: 你可能不得不用另一种材料来取而代之 沙地作为材料的完整性并不为人所熟知.

source: You probably have to ditch the Murder Plaza. Chances are the Murder Plaza is the least-safe part of this sand castle.
target: 你可能必须放弃谋杀广场。 可能谋杀广场是这个沙地城堡最不安全的地方

source: You and your friends spend -N2 MONEY on concrete, metal scaffolding, and other construction materials to reinforce your sand castle.
target: 你和你的朋友花N2货币 用于混凝土 金属脚手架 以及其他建筑材料来强化你的沙城堡

source: We're back, dudes. Ready for us to hand down our verdict?
target: 我们回来了,伙计。 准备好让我们做出判决了吗?

source: Wait a sec, Stu. Something's different about their sand castle...
target: 等一下,斯图。 他们的沙地城堡有些不同...

source: Are you admiring the marble balconies with which King Snippy can address his devoted subjects?
target: 你是在欣赏斯尼皮国王 能用大理石瓦片 来讨论他的专有主题吗?

source: Or are you more into the Romanesque support columns in the throne room, which stabilize the castle and look super kickass?
target: 还是你更喜欢罗马式的柱子 在王座室里 稳定城堡,看起来超级棒?

source: Do you like where I wrote "Scott thinks ur super cool" in this wall before the cement dried?
target: 你喜欢我写的地方吗?斯科特 在水泥干燥之前 觉得我们超酷吗?

source: Waaait, I figured it out! Your sand castle's not made of sand anymore!
target: Waait,我终于想通了! 你的沙子城堡已经不是沙子了!

source: But... if it's not made of sand anymore... can you even call it a sand castle?
target: 不过... 如果不是沙子做的的话... 你甚至可以称之为沙地城堡吗?

source: That's a good question. But let's not be so technical. Architecture is much more about art, and less about "chitecture".
target: 问曰. 但是,让我们不要这么技术性。 建筑学更注重于艺术,而较少涉及"奇特".

source: We've still made a sand castle, but we've broken the artistic boundary of using sand and totally redefined your preconceptions of what a sand castle can be!
target: 我们仍然建造了一座沙城堡,但我们打破了用沙的艺术界限,彻底地重新定义了你们对沙城堡的先入为主的观念!

source: A sand castle can be concrete! It can be metal! It can even be... OSHA COMPLIANT!
target: 沙地城堡可以混凝土! 它可以是金属的! 这甚至可能是... OSHA 完美无缺!

source: Oh, sure, it's compliant. This sounds more like an art piece than a building now anyway, so it's not under our jurisdiction to judge it.
target: 哦,当然,这是顺从的。 这听起来更像是艺术作品 而不是建筑物 现在,所以它不 在我们的管辖范围 判断它。

source: Sweet! You gain +N2 MIND from the artistic insights of building a sand-less sand castle.
target: 可爱! 你从建设无沙城堡的艺术洞察力中获得+N2 MIND.

source: Awww, are you sure? The Murder Plaza was, like, the best part of the castle!
target: Awww,你确定吗? 谋杀广场是城堡的最好部分!

source: And I spent so long sculpting little bloodthirsty sand golems!
target: 我花了这么长的时间雕塑出 嗜血的沙丘!

source: How are King and Queen Snippy gonna have Sexy Knifeplay Thursdays now?
target: 国王和斯尼皮王后 周四的"性感小刀"怎么样?

source: Actually, it's King Scuttle now. King Snippy was mysteriously found dead with a seashell spear in his thorax.
target: 实际上,现在是斯克特尔国王了。 斯尼皮国王被神秘地发现死在了胸口,并带着一把海贝长矛.

source: Oh... where was his body found?
target: 哦... 他的尸体在哪发现的?

source: The Murder Plaza, obviously. It's thematic!
target: 很明显是谋杀广场 这是主题!

source: Goddammit...
target: 该死的...

source: You lose -N2 HYPE getting rid of the awesome Murder Plaza and all its amazing sand-torture devices, but it's for the best.
target: 你失去了N2 HYPE 摆脱了可怕的谋杀广场 和它所有惊人的沙牙装置, 但这是最好的。

source: Sah, dudes! Ready for us to hand down our verdict?
target: 嘘,伙计们! 准备好让我们做出判决了吗?

source: Stu, check it out! They got rid of the Murder Plaza! That puts you right in OSHA compliancy, my dudes.
target: 斯图,看看! 他们摆脱了谋杀广场! 这样你们才对 OSHA的忠诚,我的伙计。

source: Wow, that was pretty easy. We didn't even have to clean out the mold in the guest house!
target: 哇,那很简单。 我们甚至不用清理客房的模具!

source: Yeah, OSHA certifications are stupid easy to get. As long as you don't have asbestos, Murder Plazas, or less than three windows, you're good to go.
target: 是啊,OSHA的认证是愚蠢的容易得到的。 只要你没有石棉,谋杀广场,或者不到三个窗户,你可以走了。

source: Great! You gain +N2 MIND from the relaxing joy of building a sand castle, sans Murder Plaza.
target: 不错! Great! 你从建造沙地城堡的轻松快乐中获得了+N2 MIND, sans Murder Plaza.

source: Collect seashells
target: 收集贝壳

source: You, Scott, and Polly set about collecting seashells, as a little memento of your trip together.
target: 你,你是谁? 斯科特,以及 波莉 收集贝壳 作为你们一起旅行的小纪念品

source: Check this shell out! Scott, hold it up to your ear!

target: 老实说,这就是最初吸引我到邪教... 我渴望伴侣关系和证明 即使我不得不从Eldritch的恐怖中获得

source: Thank you, sweet legs. Don't worry, life is long; we'll have more kids for you to eat. I'm sure we'll have a chance to get this right next time.
target: 谢谢你,可爱的腿。 别担心,生活很长;我们会有更多的孩子给你吃. 我敢肯定,我们会有一个机会 做到这一点下一次。

target: 你因为不容许吃孩子而得到+N2 SOUL, 但失去N2 STAMINA 从所有你永远不会有的后代 吃午饭。

source: Fill the car's tank
target: 装好车箱

source: You park under the ancient, fantasy-land bridge overtop this gas station and go inside to pay.
target: 你停在古老的幻想之地桥下 翻过这个加油站 然后进去付钱

target: 来一瓶汽油!

target: 额... 当然,随便什么。 你要怎么付账?

source: With money, of course. I heard it makes the world go around, and I definitely don't want the world to stop going around, so let's keep spending!
target: 当然是用钱 我听说它让世界四处走动,我绝对不希望世界停止走动,所以让我们继续花花!

source: Sorry, but PeTroll doesn't accept money as a form of payment.
target: 抱歉,但PeTroll不接受金钱作为支付形式.

target: 什麽? 但你需要钱! 听着,起初我也不明白,但让我告诉你:这些小文件看起来不太像,但是可以用来得到你想要的任何东西!

source: Like right now, I want gas, so I give you the papers, you give me gas, then you can give the papers to someone else to get something you want!

target: 这是一个叫做"经济学"的神奇系统!

source: ...Or is it "econimation"?
target: ...还是"经济化"?

source: I think it's "economy", sir. And trust me when I say that economy is meaningless to trolls.
target: 我觉得这是"经济",先生。 相信我,我说经济对巨怪毫无意义

source: PeTroll only accepts "magical forms of payment." Like dragon scales, or cursed lockets, or first-born children...
target: PeTroll只接受"神奇的支付形式",如"龙鳞","被诅咒的锁","长子"等. .

source: Damn, too bad none of you are having a baby anytime soon or this'd be a lot easier. How else can you "magically pay" for this gas?
target: 该死,太糟糕了,你们没有 一个孩子的任何时间 很快,否则,这将是容易得多。 不然你怎么能为这毒气"付大钱"?

source: Forfeit your fondest memory to the gas pump.
target: 把你的最美好的记忆 给加油机。

source: Hunt down a boar to feed the gas pump, as was done for centuries before coin ever existed.
target: 像硬币存在前几个世纪一样 猎杀一只野猪喂油泵

target: 我最美好的记忆,是吧? 我已经"伪造"了很多那些 禁欲派对,但让我们看看...

target: 我第一次在围棋比赛中打败了我妈,我有一个很好的记忆. 这是一个伟大的一天!

source: Mine's when I found a chocolate cookie in the bushes at the dog park!
target: 我在狗公园的灌木丛里发现了巧克力饼干!

target: 那时我发现自己对巧克力过敏,但很值钱.

target: 不过请放心,它涉及很多史诗故事的拍打和性刺激,这些对于你的性格来说是基础性的——现在它消失了!

source: (Corporate makes me say that, but honestly, you should go to Fill It next time; gas is cheaper there, and costs a real currency. Bye.)
target: (Corporate让我说,但老实说,你下次应该去填充它;那里的煤气更便宜,而且要花一大笔钱。) 再见。

target: 我很高兴我们得到了汽油,兄弟, 但我感觉怪怪的现在... 就像我头上有个洞 以前充满了欢乐

target: 我知道,伙计,但没关系。 我们会在旅途中 给那个洞填满很多新的美好回忆!

target: 没错! 我们能先吃点巧克力冰淇淋吗? 我没有理由相信 我不应该吃!

target: 听起来不错! 从记忆损失中失去-N2 HYPE,但为汽车获得+N2 MAGIC.

source: Thank God you packed your medieval flails and crossbows or this would never work. -N2 STAMINA later, you've tracked and killed a wild boar.
target: 谢天谢地 你打包了中世纪的花招和弩 否则就行不通了 -N2 Stamina晚点 你跟踪并杀死了一只野猪

source: Okay, great. Now you just need to smear the boar's blood on your hands, faces, and the gas pump.
target: 好吧,伟大的。 现在你只需要把猪的血涂在你的手,脸部和油泵上.

source: Cool! I'm gonna do a boar's blood smokey eye!
target: 凉爽! 我要做野猪的血烟眼!

target: 诵出圣咒. 只要找到我的《员工礼仪手册》里的一页...

source: "O ancient trolls, accept this blood spilled for your great hoard / and allow these travelers passage they can barely afford..."
target: "古老的巨怪们,接受这血洒给你的大囤积 并允许这些旅行者通过他们几乎买不起..."

source: "...and enjoy this sacrifice, old as Man, old as Time / old as the tedious practice of chanting in rhyme."
target: "... 享受这个牺牲吧,老如人,老如时光" "老如流韵的乏味"

source: The ground shakes, and there's a sound like the Earth just let out a fart of Biblical proportions.
target: 地上摇晃 有声音说地球只是放出圣经比例的放屁

source: I guess that means your transaction's been accepted. Here's your +N2 MAGIC.
target: 我猜这意味着你的交易被接受。 这是你的+N2 MAGIC。

source: Have a "troll-tastic" day or whatever. Try not to hit any other wild boars on your way out.
target: 过个"巨怪"的日子什么的 出门时尽量别撞到其他野猪

source: Use the restroom

target: 你去洗手间排出管子 但门是锁上的 这很奇怪,但你猜你可以拿着它...

target: 然后店员就出现在你面前 几乎让你尿裤子了

target: 哈罗 %SIRMAAM%. 欢迎来到神秘的"PeTroll Gas Passage","其中乐趣和幻想在去天堂的路上短暂地停留了".

target: 我不能让你进入洗手间 直到你解开我的谜题三... 一百块。

target: 她给你一本厚厚的故事书 标题页上写道:"漫游冒险者 Lavatory Conference Riddles由C.E.O. 吉布博克(英语:Gibblebock)".

target: 真的吗? 为什么她让你在上厕所之前 填写客户满意度调查表?

target: 首先 这不是客户满意度调查 这是"一时冲动地折磨我们客人的神奇心灵".

target: 其次,如果你不打算买任何东西, 公司政策说,你必须付出 比硬币更有价值的东西:个人信息。

target: 呃,没事。 这本"里多斯"一书虽然是BIG,但只是十二部"高出奇"一卷中的一出! 你打算怎么办?

target: 吸去并填出书来:120页 关于你对使用浴室的感受.

target: 在其中你与这些谜语的作者对抗,直到死亡。

target: 你叹息,磨你的二号铅笔, 并填写整个。 他妈的。 书曰.

source: "Riddle 13.C: How did you first hear about the concept of using the bathroom?"
target: "Riddle 13.C:你是如何第一次听到使用浴室的概念的?"

source: "a. Social media."
target: "a. (中文(简体) ). 社交媒体".

source: "b. I got a referral code."
target: "b. (中文(简体) ). 我有转诊代码".

source: "c. From my family, when they begged me to stop going in the kitchen."
target: "(c. ) (中文(简体) ). 从我的家人, 当他们求我停止去厨房。"

source: "b. Depends whether it's #1 or #2"

target: "(c. ) (中文(简体) ). 从来没有。 我对社会是一种令人作呕的威胁".

target: 当你完成调查时,我的意思是谜语, 你一直持有它如此之久, 你可能已经永久地损坏了你的肾脏。

target: 当你终于有时间上厕所的时候,你会得到+N2 MIND, 但这种详尽无遗的经历仍然花费你-N2 HYPE.

target: 对... 让我拿我的标准问题 调查霍恩。

source: The clerk pulls an ancient bull horn off her belt. She blows into it, and an enormous troll in a business suit appears.
target: 书记从她腰带上拉出一头古老的牛角. 她吹入了它, 一个巨大的巨怪 在一个商业服出现。

source: "Hello, Employee #58359!" he says. "Have I been summoned to defeat a plucky adventuring party? Or perhaps a feral soccer mom with expired coupons?"
target: "你好,员工#58359",他说。 "我被召去打败一个勇敢的冒险派对吗?" 或者说,也许一个有过期优惠券的野外足球妈妈?"

source: "Great!" says Gibblebock as he swings a briefcase-warhammer at your face. "Thank you for choosing the Gas Passage as your preferred method of death!"
target: "好极了!"吉布博克说,当他朝你脸上挥出一个公文包枪手时. "谢谢你选择了气体通道 作为你喜欢的死亡方法!"

source: You fight. It's intense, bloody, and made worse by Gibblebock asking you survey-related questions while you beat each other up.
target: 你打起来。 这是激烈的,血腥的, 更糟糕的是,吉布博克问你 调查相关问题 而你们互相殴打。

source: "How did you first hear about the Survey By Combat?" "Would you recommend this ass-kicking to a friend?"
target: "你是如何第一次听到" 通过战斗调查?" "你会建议这个屁股踢朋友?"

source: "On a scale of 'frowny face, neutral face, or smiley face', how satisfied are you with my roundhouse kick?"
target: "在"浮华相貌,中性相貌,或笑出相貌"的尺度上,你对我的"圆通相貌"踢得有多满意?

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA in the fight, but finally, you've brought Gibblebock to his knees.
target: 在比赛中你输了N2 Stamina 但最后 你让Gibbbock跪倒了

source: "I guess it's true... the customer... is always right. But please... before you kill me, I have one last request..."
target: "我想这是真的... 顾客... 永远是正确的。 但请... 在你杀了我之前,我还有最后一个请求..."

target: "我把它评为ZERO STARS!" 你尖叫着勇敢地斩首吉布博克.

target: 哗... 好吧,你可以去洗手间了。 事实上,你可以做任何你想做的事。

target: 那家伙签了我的工资 所以如果他死了 我要回家了

target: 好样的,英雄! 你在浴室里得到了+N2 MIND,并杀死了C. E. O. Gibblebock,叶老西里康谷的灾祸!

target: 去店里买东西吧

target: 对不起 %SIRMAAM%你敢嘲笑我老板的好名声吗 贪婪的吉伯博克? 因为那样违反商店政策

source: Sorry, we didn't mean to. Do you guys sell any snacks or anything here?
target: 抱歉,我们不是故意的 你们卖点心什么的吗?
