target: 这是另一个怪异的网络舞蹈狂? 别在我的私人地盘上搞互联网了 你们这些管闲事的青少年!

source: I'm gonna murder you so hard!
target: 我要杀了你这么狠!

source: Although... I have to admit: you're a really good dancer.
target: 虽然. 我必须承认,你跳得很棒

source: Before I murder you, maybe you could... show me some of your moves?
target: 在我杀了你之前 也许你可以... 给我看看你的动作?

source: Let's make a deal: I'll teach you some tap dancing moves if you let the captives free and don't kill anyone.
target: 我们做个交易吧,我教你一些踢踏舞动作 如果你放了俘虏,不要杀任何人。

source: Nooo, come on! I cleared my whole evening for this murder!
target: 不,来吧! 我为这起谋杀案扫清了整个晚上!

source: Sorry, Jerry, but like Coach always says: you can't have your cake and eat it too while you're scoring the winning touchdown!
target: 对不起,杰瑞,但就像教练常说的那样:在打分胜利的触地得分的时候,你不能吃你的蛋糕,也吃!

source: You can always find more murder victims, but a tap-dancing lesson from %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is a rare opportunity. You don't wanna miss out on this!
target: 你总是能找到更多的谋杀案受害者 但从一个踢踏舞的教训 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 这是一个难得的机会。 你不会想错过这个的!

source: Hmmm...
target: 那个...

source: Jerry mulls it over, staring at your click-clacking feet as you dance.
target: 杰瑞在跳舞时 一直盯着你的脚

source: Fine. I choose... TAP DANCING!
target: 精细。 我选择... TAP DANCINGING! 我可没说

source: Hooray! Jerry frees his captives, and you teach him about step-ball-changes and jump clicks. You gain +N2 SOUL and one hell of an ankle cramp.
target: 万岁! 杰瑞释放了俘虏 你教他换个接球 跳出点击 你得到+N2 SOUL 和一个地狱的脚踝抽筋。

source: Check the backyard first
target: 先检查后院

source: You sneak into the backyard to find a masked man talking with two cops.
target: 你潜入后院找一个面具男 跟两个警察说话

source: Good evening, Jerry. We got a call last night. Something about a woman "screaming and begging for mercy followed by chainsaw noises" in your house.
target: 晚上好,杰瑞,你好吗? 我们昨晚接到一个电话。 关于一个女人在你的房子里 "尖叫并乞求怜悯 并伴有电锯的噪音"

source: Oh, that was just my wife and I having our "special time." You know how it is!
target: 哦,那只是我的妻子和我有 我们的"特殊的时间"。你知道它是如何的!

source: I hear that! Happy wife, happy life!
target: 我听见了! 快乐的妻子,快乐的生活!

source: Now, I'm sure this is nothing, but we got another call an hour later that you were digging a hole and rolling "a person-shaped bundle" into it?
target: 现在,我敢肯定这是什么, 但我们得到另一个电话 一个小时后,你挖了一个洞 和滚滚"人形捆绑"在里面?

source: Oh! I was just... gardening! Yeah. I always do my best planting at two a.m.
target: 哦 我刚刚... 园艺! 对 我总是在凌晨2点做我最好的栽培。
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Gardening does require digging holes!
target: 园艺的确需要挖洞!

source: I think we can safely say this all checks out.
target: 我想我们可以安全地说,这一切都检查出来了。

source: Yup, this all seems to be in order.
target: 是的,这似乎都是有序的。

source: Sorry to take up so much of your time, Jerry. My partner and I will be goi--
target: 抱歉占用你这么多时间 杰瑞 我和我的搭档会是GOI --

source: "AHHHHH!!!" scream the cops as they suddenly plummet into the ground.
target: "哈哈哈!" 警察突然倒地时尖叫着

source: Owww... silly us, falling into this sudden six-foot hole! Thank goodness our fall was broken by this soft corpse.
target: 奥克特... Owww... 傻了我们,掉进这个6英尺高的洞里! 谢天谢地 我们的陷落被这软尸所打破

source: Wait a second...
target: 等一会... 等一等...

source: Jerry, buddy, care to explain why you have a corpse in a hole in your backyard?
target: 杰瑞,伙计,你能不能解释一下 你后院的洞里怎么会有尸体?

source: Oh! Well. That's because... uhm...
target: 哦 这个嘛 那是因为... 额...
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Actually, I need a second to talk to my lawyers. Wait just a second!
target: 事实上,我需要一秒钟 跟我的律师谈谈。 等一会!

source: Psst! Hey, you! Trespassers! Congrats, you guys are my lawyers now. I'll pay you if you can get me out of being arrested.
target: 嘘! 嘿,你这个! 通行证! 恭喜你们,你们现在是我的律师了 如果你能把我从被捕中救出来 我会付钱给你的

source: Wow, I'm a lawyer! My grandma's gonna be so proud!
target: 哇,我是个律师! 我奶奶会很骄傲的!

source: Don't worry, Jer, I've got a plan: we'll ask %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to come up with a plan!
target: 别担心 Jer 我有个计划 我们会问的 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 拿出一个计划!

source: Pose as doctors to certify that the corpse isn't actually dead.
target: 假扮医生 证明尸体没死

source: For your next trick, make the corpse DISAPPEAR!
target: 为了你的下一招, 让尸体消失!

source: You don't have much time to discuss your roles, but your friends are always happy to improvise!
target: 你没有太多时间来讨论你的角色,但你的朋友总是乐于即兴表演!

source: Phew! Finally out of the hole. Jeez, I can't believe my wings have gotten so flabby...
target: 嘘! 终于出洞去. 天啊,我真不敢相信我的翅膀变得这么软了...

source: Okay, Jerry, lawyer-time is up. What can you tell us about the dead woman in your yard?
target: 好了 杰瑞 律师时间到了 你能告诉我们你院子里那个死女人的情况吗?

source: Just a sec, bros! Can you really be sure this woman is dead?
target: 等一下,兄弟们! 你真的能确定这个女人死了吗?

source: Who are you?
target: 你是谁?

source: I'm Doctor Bigbrain, and I can tell you this woman is 100% alive!
target: 我是大脑医生,我可以告诉你 这个女人是100%活着的!

source: No, wait... more like 120%!!! Yeah, we could say this woman might be, in fact, TOO ALIVE!
target: 别 等等... 更像120! 更像120%! 是的,我们可以说,这个女人,事实上,是太活着了!

source: Scott laughs and slaps the corpse's back. Her head pops off.
target: 斯科特 取笑并打倒了尸体的后背. 她的头会掉下来的

source: Look, I admit I'm no doctor, but I'm like 95% sure this woman is dead.
target: 听着,我承认我不是医生 但我百分之九十五确定这个女人死了

source: THAT'S WHERE YOU'RE WRONG!
target: 这就是你错了!

source: What is truly the condition of "death"? Can we even say someone is dead if, in life, they never truly felt ALIVE?!
target: 真正的死亡状况是什么? 我们甚至可以说有人死了,如果,在生活中,他们从来没有真正感到活着吗?

source: Who are YOU?!
target: 你是谁?

source: Well, I'm a doctor too...
target: 我也是个医生...

source: ...a doctor of philosophy!
target: 一个哲学博士!

source: And as such, I declare that life and death are concepts we cannot completely fathom... therefore, it is impossible to determine if this woman here is dead.
target: 因此,我宣布 生死是概念 我们无法完全理解... 因此,无法确定这位女士是否已经死亡。

source: I never saw it that way! Dang, we could really use a forensic philosopher in the force.
target: 我从来没这么认为过! 糟糕,我们真的需要 法证哲学家的力量。

source: I think our job here is done, partner. Let's go get a coffee and a donut. I need to ponder all this philosophy.
target: 我认为我们的工作已经完成了,伙伴。 我们去喝杯咖啡和甜甜圈吧 我需要思考所有这些哲学。

source: They... leave? Really? Well, Jerry pays your +N2 MONEY retainer, and you definitely lose -N2 SOUL for fooling the law.
target: 他们... 离开? 真的吗? 杰里支付你的+N2 钱的预留款, 而你绝对输了 -N2 SOUL 骗取法律。

source: Great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You be the magician. I'll back you up.
target: 不错的主意 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你是魔术师。 我会支持你。

source: Come one, come all to the debut performance of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% the Illusionist! Cops get in free!
target: 来 来 来 来 来 来 来 来 来 来 来 来 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 幻觉主义者! 警察免费进来!

source: Really? Military veterans and teachers get all the fun discounts! Finally, a win for cops!
target: 真的吗? 退伍军人和老师都享受到乐趣的折扣! 警察终于赢了!

source: You dazzle the cops with some warmup tricks: quarter behind the ear, card tricks, mildly-invasive hypnosis...
target: 你用暖和的把戏吓倒了警察 耳朵后方的四分五分 纸牌把戏 轻微地侵入催眠...

source: Now, I need a volunteer from the audience! Does anyone here have a corpse I can use?
target: 现在,我需要一个志愿者 从观众! 这里有人有我可以用的尸体吗?

source: Hey, what luck! We've got a corpse right here!
target: 嘿,多幸运啊! 我们这里有具尸体!

source: You put the corpse in your magic box, do a little jig, and say the magic words! -N2 MAGIC later, you open the box to show that the corpse has disapeared.
target: 你把尸体放入你的魔盒, 做一个小拼接, 并说出魔语! -N2 MAGIC 稍后,你打开盒子 显示尸体已经破损。

source: Woohoo! That was amazing! Bravo, bravo!
target: 呜呼! 太不可思议了! 好样的,好样的!

source: Yeah, nice trick... but, uh, where's the corpse? We kinda need it to convict a serial killer.
target: 是啊,不错的把戏... ... 但是,呃,哪里是尸体吗? 我们需要它来定罪 一个连环杀手。

source: Shame on you! You should never ask a magician to reveal %HISHER% secrets!
target: 真丢人! 你不应该让魔术师透露%HISHER%的秘密!

source: Seriously, partner, that's magician rules 101! Where are your manners?
target: 说真的,搭档,这是魔术师规则101! 你的礼仪呢?

source: Dammit! This is the third time this week we've lost crucial evidence this way. The sheriff's gonna strip my wings for sure!
target: 该死! 这是本周第三次以这种方式失去关键证据. 警长一定会剥去我的翅膀的!

source: Relax, it'll be fine. Why don't we find a nice, quiet city block and give random people parking tickets?
target: 放松点,没事的 为什么我们不找个安静的街区 随便给人停车罚单?

source: Y'know... that does sound nice. Thanks, partner; you always know how to cheer me up.
target: 你知道吗? 这听起来不错。 谢谢,伙计,你总是会让我高兴的

source: Nice work, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Here's your +N2 MONEY. When the time comes, I promise to kill you last.
target: 干得不错 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 这是你的+N2 钱。 等时机成熟,我保证最后杀了你

source: Just knock on the door, goddammit
target: 敲门,该死

source: You knock on the front door. No answer.
target: 你敲前门。 无答.

source: Maybe no one's home?
target: 也许没有人在家?

source: Unlikely; there are too many loud chainsaw noises for the house to be empty.
target: 不太可能;有太多响亮的链锯噪声,不能让房子空出.

source: Scott turns the doorknob. Turns out the door wasn't locked. As soon as it's open, a bloody man with duct-tape over his mouth runs into the night.
target: 斯科特 打开门把手。 原来门没锁上 一打开,一个嘴上有胶带的血淋淋的男人就冲入了晚上.

source: NO! WAIT! Goddammit! That's the third one this week! I leave for five seconds to find my lucky butcher knife...
target: 没有! 等会儿! Wait! 该死! 这是这周的第三个! 我走了五秒钟 找到我的幸运屠夫刀...

source: Butcher knife? Was he your dinner guest?
target: 屠夫刀吗? 他是你的晚餐客人吗?

source: If by "dinner" you mean "murder" and by "guest" you mean "victim", then sure.
target: 如果"餐"是指"谋杀","客人"是指"受害者",那么肯定了.

source: That's too much word replacing for me, but listen: if you want your guests to stay for dinner, you gotta up your game, bro!
target: 听着,如果你想让客人留下来吃晚饭,你就得继续玩游戏,兄弟!

source: You're damn right, Scott! It seems our friend here needs a crash course in host etiquette.
target: 你说得对, 斯科特! 看来我们这里的朋友 需要一个坠机课程 在东道主礼仪。

source: Yeah! Like, maybe put some extra lighting in your front room here and clean up the ketchup stains all over the floor. That'll make your guests feel welcome and safe!
target: 对! 比如,也许把一些额外的照明 在你的前厅在这里 和清理番茄酱污点 遍地上。 这会让你的客人感到欢迎和安全!

source: Hmmm. So you're saying that by being a better host, I can get my "guests" to stay for "dinner"?
target: 垛. 所以,你是说,通过做一个更好的东道主, 我可以得到我的"客人"留下来"吃饭"?

source: Yup, perfect plan! What's the best way to transform Jerry the grisly serial killer into Jerry the hostess with the mostest?
target: 是啊,完美的计划! 怎样才能把杰里变成最有魅力的女主人?

source: A good host always treats their guests. Teach Jerry how to cook a dessert to DIE for.
target: 一个好主人总是招待他们的客人. 教杰瑞怎么给DIE做甜点

source: Gift Jerry your best jigsaw puzzle so he can keep his guests hooked forever.
target: 吉特・杰里,你最好的拼图 这样他就可以保持他的客人永远上钩。

source: A cooking lesson? Sounds great! All I have handy is "almost ketchup", "maybe pork", and cumin, though. Can we make anything with that?
target: 烹饪课? 听起来不错! 我只有"几乎番茄酱","可能是猪肉"和"精子" 我们能做点什么吗?

source: Pass. You give Jerry some of your road trip food, which costs you -N2 STAMINA, but it's all in the name of passing on the magic of cooking!
target: 过. 你给杰里一些道路旅行食品, 这花费你 -N2 STAMINA, 但这一切都以传递魔法 烹饪!

source: A few nights later, screams are once again emanating from Jerry's house. A terrified couple runs from room to room, covered in blood, trying to escape.
target: 几晚后,尖叫声再次从杰里家传出. 一对害怕的夫妇从房间跑到房间,被血淋淋地地想逃跑.

source: "Good, I think we lost him!" cries the woman. "How did I let you talk me into going to a dinner party hosted by a serial killer?"
target: "好,我想我们失去了他" 哭着那个女人。 "我是怎么让你说服我去参加一个连环杀手主持的晚宴的?"

source: "ALLEGED serial killer! And we need to socialize more with the neighbors, honey! You said so yourself!"
target: "非法连环杀手! 我们要多和邻居们交往,亲爱的! 你自己说的!"

source: "Shh, he could find us at any moment! We need to get back to the car! My head wound is really starting to sting."
target: "嘘,他随时都能找到我们! 我们得回车上去! 我的头部伤口真的开始刺痛".

source: Come out, come out, wherever you are... you don't wanna miss "dessert", haha!
target: 出来,出来,不管你在哪里... 你不会想错过"沙漠"吧,哈哈!

source: "Wait, that's right," the man says. "Back before he murdered Carl, Jerry mentioned making some sort of berry vanilla cheesecake parfait for dessert... I want to try it!"
target: "等一等,对了",那人说. "在谋杀卡尔之前,杰瑞提到 做某种莓香草芝士蛋糕来做甜点... 我想试试看!"

source: "Dessert was code for murdering us, Eddie! I could practically hear him air-quoting the word!"
target: "德塞尔特是谋杀我们的代码,埃迪! 我几乎可以听到他 空中引用这个词!"

source: "But today's my cheat day, and I already had to watch my whole fantasy football league get murdered!"
target: "但今天是我的作弊日,我已经不得不 看着我的整个幻想足球联盟 被谋杀了!"

source: "C'mon, honey, I NEED this berry vanilla cheesecake parfait! Didn't your therapist tell you to stop playing safe and start taking more chances?"
target: "来吧,亲爱的,我需要这个 莓香草干酪蛋糕! 难道你的治疗师没叫你 停止安全地玩 开始冒更多的风险吗?"

source: "Ugh. Fine. But we are absolutely NOT staying for coffee afterwards, got it?"
target: "U. 精细。 但我们绝对不会留下来喝咖啡,明白吗?"

source: Found you! Ready for "dessert"?
target: 找到你们了! 准备好"沙漠"了吗?

source: "Ohhh, you were right, he's totally airquoting. I can see it now."
target: "哦,你是对的,他完全 空气引用。 我现在可以看到它。"

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for teaching Jerry how to be a great host, AND Jerry gets to eat all the parfait? Tonight, everyone won! (Except for the couple, of course.)
target: 你因为教杰瑞如何做一个伟大的主持人而得到+N2 SOUL, 而杰瑞会吃所有的帕法特? 今晚,大家都赢了! (当然,夫妇除外)

source: You give Jerry your favorite puzzle. You lose -N2 HYPE for not being able to complete it, but anything to help out a neighbor in need!
target: 你给杰瑞你最喜欢的谜题。 你输了 -N2 HYPE,因为不能完成它, 但任何帮助一个需要帮助的邻居!

source: A few nights later, screams are once again emanating from Jerry's house. A terrified couple runs from room to room, covered in blood, trying to escape.
target: 几晚后,尖叫声再次从杰里家传出. 一对害怕的夫妇从房间跑到房间,被血淋淋地地想逃跑.

source: "I think he's gone. God, this is a nightmare!" cries the woman. "How did I let you talk me into going to a dinner party at JERRY'S?"
target: "我想他已经走了. 上帝,这是一场噩梦!" 哭泣的女人。 "我是怎么让你说服我去JERRY的晚餐会的?"

source: "I can't believe he killed everyone," the man weeps. "Even Carl! His wife has a baby on the way..."
target: "我不敢相信他杀了所有人",那人哭了. "即使是卡尔! 他的妻子在路上有一个孩子..."

source: "Shh, he could find us at any moment! Help me break open a window so we can get out of here! My gushing head wound is really starting to sting."
target: "嘘,他随时都能找到我们! 帮我打开一扇窗子 这样我们就可以离开这里了! 我的头部伤口开始刺痛".

source: "I'm not finding any blunt objects in here, just old newspapers and moldy socks and... wait, is that a half-finished jigsaw puzzle on the ground?"
target: "我在这里没有找到任何钝器, 只是旧报纸和发霉的袜子和. 等待,是不是一个半完成的拼图 在地上?"

source: "Who cares? We don't have time to study a puzzle of a stupid pack of wolves! We need to get to the car!"
target: "谁在乎? 我们没时间研究一群蠢狼的谜题了! 我们得上车!"

source: "Wait, did you say wolves? This puzzle is obviously depicting a pack of jaguars."
target: "等等,你说狼? 这个谜题显然描绘了一群美洲虎".

source: "No, jaguars don't hunt in packs. It's wolves, you idiot."
target: "不,美洲虎不会打包打猎. 这是狼,你这个白痴。"

source: "It's jaguars!"
target: "这是美洲虎!"

source: "WOLVES!"
target: "女人们!"

source: "JAGUAAAAAAAARS!"
target: "贾GU:"相公!

source: Sup, guys? I could hear you shouting all the way across the house!
target: 怎么样,伙计们? 我可以听到你大喊大叫 整个房子!

source: You like my puzzle? My friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% gave it to me; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% a kind +N2 SOUL.
target: 你喜欢我的拼图吗? 我的朋友们 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 送给我的; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% 一种+N2 SOUL。

source: Now, let's find out how many pieces I can turn YOU guys into! HAHAHAHAHA!
target: 现在,让我们看看 我可以把你们变成什么样! 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

source: For those at home who were curious, the completed puzzle was actually a bowl of fruit.
target: 对于那些在家里好奇的人来说,完成的谜题其实是一碗水果.

source: Dress up as astronauts
target: 打扮成宇航员

source: You're checking out all the weird control rooms and laboratories when you and your friends find a closet full of colorful astronaut costumes.
target: 你正在检查所有奇怪的控制室和实验室 当你和你的朋友 找到一个充满色彩的宇航员服装的衣橱。

source: OMG, these are adorable! Here, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you wear the orange one. Do you think this banana peel accentuates my booty?
target: OMG,这些很可爱! 在这里, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你戴着橙色的 你觉得这个香蕉皮会让我的战利品更突出吗?

source: You're observing Polly's booty (respectfully) when an emergency siren goes off. "CREWMATES, REPORT TO THE CONFERENCE ROOM!"
target: 你在观察 波莉紧急警笛响起时的战利品 "同志们,向会议室报告!"

source: You all go to the conference room. You're surrounded by other astronauts.
target: 你们都去会议室。 你被其他宇航员包围了

source: Let's remember why we're here, everyone: we're simulating living together in a REAL space station!
target: 让我们记住为什么我们在这里,大家:我们正在模拟一起生活在一个真正的空间站里!

source: That means we all have to do our tasks and work together... right, Yellow?
target: 这意味着我们都必须完成任务,共同努力...... 对不对,黄?

source: Why are you singling me out?! I know, I slacked on cleaning out the oxygen tank. But I fixed it before we all fully suffocated!
target: 你为什么挑我出来? 我知道,我懒得清理氧气罐。 但是,我修好它之前,我们都完全窒息!

source: If anything, it's Cyan and Red who haven't been pulling their weight. I've never seen them do ANYTHING around here.
target: 如果有的话,就是青和红还没有拉起它们的重量. 我从来没有见过他们 做任何事情在这里。

source: Well I was, uh... unclogging the toilets? That's reasonable, right? Do you still poop in space?
target: 我当时... 解开厕所? 这很合理,对吧? 你还在太空里拉屎吗?

source: And I was doing... astronaut things. So many of them.
target: 我当时在... 宇航员的东西。 如此多众.

source: Wait. I just did a head count, and there are definitely more people here than we had earlier. I think we have an impostor...
target: 慢着 我只是做了一个头数, 这里肯定有更多的人 比我们早些时候。 我想我们有个冒牌货...

source: ...AMONG US.
(Yaaasss he said the thing!!!)
target: (Yaaass他说的东西!)

source: Ugh, does that mean we have to do the "vote people out" thing again? I hate when HQ sends us these drills.
target: 呃,这是否意味着我们必须 做"投票人出去"的事情了? 我讨厌总部给我们发这些演习

source: I suspect... Orange. Yellow and Cyan both have alibis, and Red was obviously doing astronaut things. But Orange has been completely silent since %HESHE% got here.
target: 我觉得... 橘子酱. 黄和青都有不在场证明 瑞德显然在做宇航员的事 但奥兰治从%HESHE%来到这里后就完全沉默了.

source: Yeah, fuck that Orange guy... wait, YOU'RE Orange!
target: 是啊,他妈的橙色的家伙... ... 等等,你是奥兰治!

source: Convince everyone you're not the impostor!
target: 让大家相信你不是冒牌货!

source: Convince them all by doing something so "astronaut-like" you couldn't possibly be the impostor.
target: 让他们都相信 做一些"像宇航员"的事 你不可能是冒牌货

source: Astronauts only listen to the stars. Convince them to check everyone's horoscope for clues to find the true impostor.
target: 宇航员只听星星的声音 说服他们检查每个人的星座 寻找线索 找到真正的冒名顶替者

source: Yeah! Do something astronaut-like! Like... uh... shit. You actually don't know that much about the day-to-day lives of astronauts.
target: 对! 做一些像宇航员的东西! 喜欢... 额... 妈的。 其实你对宇航员的日常生活并不了解多少.

source: Astronauts... love space? Nah, too obvious.
target: 宇航员... 爱的空间? 不,太明显了。

source: Astronauts... probably have strong opinions on which type of curry is the best? Closer, but not quite.
target: 宇航员... 对哪一种咖喱最好有强烈的看法吗? 更近,但并不完全。

source: Astronauts... are fiercely competitive and ambitious, and therefore insecure about "not making the cut?" Yes, that could work!
target: 宇航员... 竞争激烈,野心勃勃, 因而没有安全感 "不做削减?" 是的,这可以奏效!

source: If I was an impostor, how would I know the Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake?
target: 如果我是个冒牌货 我怎么会知道超级秘密宇航员握手?

source: The Super Secret... what? That's not real.
target: 超级秘密... 什麽? 这不是真的

source: Of course it's real, dumb-dumb. Every astronaut's heard of the Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake!
target: 当然是真的,哑巴。 每个宇航员都听说过超级秘密宇航员握手!

source: Uh, yeah, right! The Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake. Obviously.
target: 嗯,是的,对了! 超级秘密宇航员握手会. 很明显

source: I learned it at Yale, a place where I definitely went and got my degree in astronauting.
target: 我在耶鲁学的, 这个地方我肯定去 并获得了我的宇航学位。

source: What are you all talking about?! There is no such handshake!
target: 你们在说什么? 没有这样的握手!

source: Bro, if you don't know the Super-Secret Astronaut Handshake, just be honest. I'll show you!
target: 兄弟,如果你不知道 超级秘密宇航员握手, 老实说。 我会告诉你的!

source: Scott grabs your hands, and you two perform the convoluted handshake you've been perfecting for years. You pull it off so perfectly, you gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 斯科特 抓起你的手, 和你们两个 表演曲折的握手 多年来你一直在完善。 你这么完美地完成了它, 你得到+N2 HYPE!

source: Oh... well, I can obviously do that! You just clap, then shake hands, then do a twirl... or was it a fistbump... and now the splits -- OWWW! CRAMP! CRAMP!
target: 哦... 好吧,我显然可以做到这一点! 你只是拍手,然后握手, 然后做一个旋转... 或者是拳头... 而现在的分裂,OWWW! 克莱姆! Cramp! 克莱姆! Cramp!

source: HE CAN'T DO THE HANDSHAKE! EJECT THE IMPOSTOR!
target: 他不能做手摇! 选择监制!

source: You all throw Green out of the airlock. Sowing doubt and insecurity won the day! You lose -N2 SOUL for lying, though.
target: 你们都把Green从气闸上扔出去 播下怀疑和不安全感 赢得了今天! 你输了N2 SOUL的谎言,虽然。

source: Horoscopes? Seriously? You expect us, followers of science all, to listen to the "+N2 MAGIC prophecies of the stars?" That's such hippie crap.
target: 星座仪? 真的吗? 你期望我们,所有科学的追随者, 听到"+N2 MAGIC预言的星星?" 这就是嬉皮士的废话。

source: Yellow's right. We'd much rather consult a rational method of determining the impostor, like magic crystals!
target: 黄帝曰. 我们更愿意参考一个理性的方法 来决定冒牌货,就像魔法晶体一样!

source: How is that any better than astrology?!
target: 这怎么比占星学好呢?

source: Whatever, guess you'll play along. The astronauts spread out their crystals on the floor.
target: 随便你,猜你会一起玩的 宇航员们在地上散发出水晶.

source: HEY, SHINY ROCKS! WHO IS THE IMPOSTOR?!
target: 嘿,SHINY ROCKS! 嘿,SHINY ROCKS! 嘿,SINY ROCKS! 谁是监听员?

source: The crystals don't respond. Shocker.
target: 水晶不相应. 吓一跳。

source: Hmm... maybe these crystals are defective. Should we try the Ouija board to ask the local aliens for help?
target: 垛... 也许这些晶体有缺陷。 我们该试试听话板 向当地外星人求救吗?

source: But Ouija boards are for ghosts, not aliens!
target: 但华丽板是给鬼的,不是外星人的!

source: True, but it's possible that there will be ghosts OF ALIENS that we can contact! We gotta use all our options here.
target: 是的,但有可能会有鬼 外星人,我们可以联系! 我们得用我们所有的选择

source: All right, everyone put your hands on the planchette. *Ahem...*
target: 好吧,每个人都把手放在平板板上。 * 摆... *

source: O Spirits of the Moon People! Is there an impostor among us?
target: 哦,月亮之魂的人们! 我们中间有冒牌货吗?

source: The planchette's moving! It says... "NO LOL." That's odd.
target: 木板在动了! 上面说... "没有LOL",这很奇怪。

source: Well, guess we'd better believe it. A ghost would never lie! Not even if it would be really funny for them to do so!
target: 好吧,猜我们最好相信这一点。 鬼不会说谎的! 即使他们这样做真的很有趣!

source: But I was so sure... dang it. Sorry, everyone. I guess I was just excited to throw someone out of the airlock again and I saw what I wanted to see.
target: 我当时很确定... 可恶 对不起,大家。 我想我只是兴奋地再次把某人从气闸里扔出,我看到了我想看到的.

source: It's okay, bro. Sometimes when I get too excited, I pee on the carpet. It's nothing to be ashamed of!
target: 没事的,兄弟。 有时当我太兴奋的时候,我在地毯上撒尿. 没什么可羞愧的!

source: Hooray, you live to deceive people another day! You lose -N2 SOUL for it, though.
target: 万岁,你活在欺骗别人的一天! 你输了N2SOUL,虽然。

source: Watch a rocket launch
target: 看着火箭发射

source: You sneak past security, open a bag of astronaut food, and settle in to watch the show.
target: 你偷偷通过安全, 打开一袋宇航员的食物, 并定居在看节目。

source: This is so cool! I can't believe we're gonna watch a real rocket launch!
target: 这太酷了! 我不敢相信我们会看到真正的火箭发射!

source: We sure are, Scotty! And you know what every rocket launch needs, right?
target: 我们当然是 斯科特哟! 你知道每一次火箭发射都需要什么吗?

source: A rocket?
target: 火箭吗?

source: No! A prank!
target: 没有! 恶作剧!

source: A rocket launch is probably the worst time to play a prank, actually.
target: 实际上,发射火箭可能是最糟糕的恶作剧时机。

source: And that, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, is why you're still just a Prank Masterz intern.
target: 而这个,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, 这就是为什么你仍然只是一个恶作剧大师实习生。

source: In order to be a true Master-with-a-Z, you gotta see the potential pranks in every scenario, even a rocket launch!
target: 为了成为真正的大师,你必须看到每个场景中的潜在恶作剧,甚至火箭发射!

source: Right! And the perfect prank for a rocket launch is... is...
target: 没错! 而火箭发射最完美的恶作剧是... 这是...

source: ...something involving a whoopie cushion, maybe?
target: 可能涉及一个华丽的衬垫?

source: Nah. The perfect prank would be to set up a cardboard cutout of the moon and launch the rocket there instead! The ol' switcheroo!
target: 没有。 完美的恶作剧就是在月球上设置一个纸板并在那里发射火箭! 转接器!

source: Okay! Do we have enough cardboard to do that?
target: 好,我们走! 我们有足够的纸板来做吗?

source: No, sadly we used all of it to make that cardboard skyline of Detroit for our "Liam thinks he's going to Detroit" prank.
target: 不,可悲的是,我们利用这一切 做了底特律的纸板天际线 为了我们 "利亚姆 以为他会去底特律的恶作剧

source: Totally worth it, though.
target: 完全值得,虽然。

source: Then what do we do?
target: 那我们怎么办?

source: Make our intern think of a prank, obviously. What should we do, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 很明显,让我们的实习生想到一个恶作剧。 我们该怎么办? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: Replace the rocket's fuel with sugar! What a SWEET idea!
target: 用糖来代替火箭的燃料! 真是个可爱的主意!

source: Replace the oxygen with helium! Helium? More like HELL YEAH!
target: 用氦取代氧气! 氦气吗? 更像是地狱耶!

source: Replace the astronauts with corgis! It's a cor-GENIUS plan!
target: 把宇航员换成科吉斯! 这是一个COR -GENIUS计划!

source: You siphon the rocket fuel while Scott empties your road trip sugar supply into the tank.
target: 你吸了火箭燃料的时候 斯科特 将你的出行糖供应空入油箱

source: Sweet! Not only is putting sugar in their gas tank a hilarious slapstick prank, but we also got +N2 MAGIC for the car!
target: 可爱! 不仅把糖放进他们的油罐里 是个搞笑的巴掌棍恶作剧, 而且我们还有+N2 MAGIC的车!

source: Woohoo! This calls for some celebratory PB&J sandwiches!
target: 呜呼! 这需要一些庆祝性的PB&J三明治!

source: Oh... we don't have any sugar for the jelly.
target: 哦... 我们没有糖吃果冻。

source: Oh, bummer.
target: 哦,讨厌的。

source: Oh well, we can at least celebrate with a cup of coffee!
target: 我们至少可以喝杯咖啡庆祝一下!

source: Right! I'll make some. How many spoonfuls of sugar do you like in your coffee, Polly?
target: 没错! 我会做一些。 多少勺糖 你喜欢在咖啡, 波莉?

source: Two, please!
target: 两个,请!

source: Oh, bad news. It looks like we have... no spoons of sugar left.
target: 哦,坏消息。 。 。 。 看来我们... 没有勺子糖了。

source: Wait, seriously? How much sugar did we put in the dumb rocket?
target: 等等,真的吗? 我们在哑弹里放了多少糖?

source: Well, we had to fill the whole rocket tank, which took about... (two... four... carry the eleven...)
target: 嗯,我们不得不填满 整个火箭箱, 它占用了... (两个... 四点... 带着十一号... )

source: ...a LOT of bags of sugar.
target: ...一袋一袋的糖。

source: UGH! That sucks!
target: 呜! 太烂了!

source: You can't help but wonder why Polly even cares. She almost never eats food.
target: 有件事你不知道为什么 波莉 甚至关心。 她几乎从来不吃食物。

source: No, but I eat drugs! Which sugar and caffeine both are! Now I'm gonna crash hardcore and be tired and cranky all day!
target: 不,但我吃药! 糖和咖啡因都是这样! 现在,我要崩溃硬核 和疲惫和疯狂一整天!

source: Dang. This has been a great reminder to consume sugar responsibly... and maybe not put it in rocket engines. Just a thought. You lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 该死 这非常提醒人们 以负责任的方式食用糖... 可能不会放进火箭发动机里 只是一个想法。 你输了 - N2 Stamina.

source: That sounds hilarious! Everyone'll laugh so hard, they won't be able to breathe!
target: 听起来很搞笑! 每个人都会笑得这么厉害,他们不会呼吸!

source: They're not gonna be able to breathe for lots of reasons -- but that's the astronauts' problem, not yours!
target: 他们因为很多原因无法呼吸——但这是宇航员的问题,不是你的问题!

source: Besides, they probably trained for this, right? Astronaut training preps you for lots of emergencies; having all the oxygen replaced with helium is probably one of them.
target: 此外,他们可能 训练了这一点,对不对? 宇航员在很多紧急情况下训练你; 将氧气全部换成氦气可能是其中之一。

source: You, Polly, and Scott hook up the helium tank they packed (for "prankmergencies") to the rocket, then sneak into Mission Control to watch the show...
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉,以及 斯科特 把装有氦气的油箱(用于"恶作剧")接上火箭,再潜入"任务控制"观看节目. .

source: "Mission Control, this is Test Rocket 9. Do you copy?"
target: "任务控制,这是测试火箭9。" 你收到吗?"

source: "Test Rocket 9, this is Mission Control. Is there a problem with your communications equipment? Your voice sounds strange."
target: "试火箭9号,这是任务控制中心" 你的通讯设备有问题吗? 你的声音听起来很奇怪。"

source: "It seems like our equipment is fine. What's the problem?"
target: "似乎我们的设备是好的. 有什么问题吗?"

source: "Haha... sorry, your voice just sounds so funny and squeaky!"
target: "哈哈... 说"哈哈哈哈" 对不起,你的声音只是听起来 好笑和尖叫!"

source: "It sounds...? Oh, God, my voice DOES sound different. Is anyone else in here having trouble getting a breath?"
target: "听起来..." 哦,上帝,我的声音听起来不同。 这里还有谁没有呼吸困难吗?"

source: "Heehee... hahaha...!"
target: "喜曰:"师曰. 哈哈哈... !"

source: "MISSION CONTROL, STOP LAUGHING! THIS ISN'T FUNNY! WE'RE RUNNING OUT OF AIR!"
target: "控制系统,停止笑! 这不好玩! 我们飞出空中去!"

source: "HAHAHAHA! Test Rocket 9, we can't take you seriously when you sound like an angry baby!"
target: "哈哈哈哈哈! "哈哈哈哈哈哈哈! "Hahahaha! 试一试"火箭9",你听起来像个生气的婴儿,我们不能认真对待你!".

source: Classic!
target: 经典!

source: You, Polly, and Scott high-five over your pranking genius. You lose -N2 SOUL for suffocating the astronauts, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉,以及 斯科特 击掌 击掌 击掌 击掌 你因为窒息宇航员而损失了N2 SOUL,但得到+N2 HYPE!

source: Days later, the rocket touches down on an alien planet far away. The aliens watch as 200 corgis exit the rocket wearing four-legged astronaut suits!
target: 数天后,火箭在遥远的外星星球上触地而下. 外星人看着200克吉斯出道 身穿四脚宇航服的火箭!

source: "How do we address the alien situation?" the planet's emperor asks at the next advisor meeting. "Have the invaders explained why they're here?"
target: "我们如何应对外星局势?"星球上皇帝在下届顾问会议上问道. "入侵者解释为什么他们在这里?"

source: "They're here to declare WAR!" says one advisor. "We must slaughter the furry bastards!"
target: "他们是来宣布战争的" 一位顾问说 "我们必须屠杀那些毛茸茸的混蛋!"

source: "They keep chewing up furniture, digging up our buried dead, and urinating everywhere to claim all our territory! Act soon, Emperor, or we'll become their slaves!"
target: "他们不断咀嚼家具,挖出被埋了的活尸,并到处撒尿来夺取我们所有的地盘! 快行动,皇上,否则我们将成为他们的奴隶!"

source: "That's not a war declaration!" says another advisor. "Those are just cultural norms on the aliens' home planet!"
target: "这不是宣战!" 另一位顾问说. "这些只是外星人家园星球上的文化规范!"

source: "These invaders know only love, friendship, and head pats. They're here to usher us into an era of peace!"
target: "这些入侵者只知道爱,友谊,和头拍. 他们来迎接我们进入一个和平的时代".

source: "Well, give them whatever they want!" says the emperor. "I've fallen in love with their cute faces and little legs. If only we knew their demands!"
target: 皇帝说:"好吧,给他们任何他们想要的东西!" "我爱上了他们可爱的相貌和小腿. 如果我们知道他们的要求就好了!"

source: Just then, the meeting doors open. It's Fluffbutt, the invaders' ambassador! Cue a chorus of "awws" from the aliens.
target: 刚刚,会议门打开了。 是弗夫布特,入侵者的大使! 从外星人那里调出一首"Awws"的合唱.

source: Fluffbutt jumps in the emperor's lap and lets him pet his belly. The emperor notices the note tied around his neck and reads it.
target: 花花鸟从皇帝的腿上跳出,让他去宠他的肚子. 皇帝注意到被绑在脖子上的纸条并读取了.

source: It says, "Dear aliens, You're welcome for the dogs! Please wire a million alien dollars to our shared prank fund in thanks."
target: 上面写道:"亲爱的外星人,不欢迎你养狗! 请汇出一百万的外星元 到我们共享的恶作剧基金,感谢"。

source: "We also accept tips in super juicy alien secrets. We won't tell anyone, promise! XOXO, the Prank Masterz (with a Z!)"
target: "我们还接受超多汁外星秘密中的小费. 我们不会告诉任何人,保证! XOXO,"恶作剧大师"(有Z!)".

source: Polly, listen! I just got a call from the bank saying someone deposited "one million Glorpals" into our prank account, which is worth +N2 MONEY!
target: 波莉听着! 我刚接到银行的电话 说有人把"一百万格洛帕尔"存入我们的恶作剧账户 价值+N2 MONEY!

source: NOICE! I just got a highly-classified alien telegram! It says, "Vacate this planet before the year ends if you want to live."
target: 小声点! 我刚收到一封高度机密的外星人电报! 上面写着:"如果你想活命的话,在一年结束之前就把这个星球消灭".

source: Haha, wacky! You lose -N6 SOUL, but gain +N2 HYPE from your successful prank. And that alien tip will prove useful sooner than you think, so you gain +N2 MIND!
target: 哈哈,疯子! 你输了 -N6 SOUL,但从你成功的恶作剧中获得+N2 HYPE. 那外星小费会比你想象的更快, 所以你得到+N2 MIND!

source: Go into the communications room
target: 走进通讯室

source: You guys sneak into the communications room -- and immediately bump into an important-looking woman with a big frown.
target: 你们偷偷进入通讯室, 立刻碰到一个长着大皱眉的重要女人。

source: "AHEM! Are you supposed to be here?!"
target: "AHEM! (掌声) "AHEM! 你应该在这里吗?"

source: Uh... yes?
target: 额... 是吗?

source: "Well... fine. The Feds slashed our security budget, so I guess I have to believe you. I'm General Kerran."

target: 哇,这是 达米恩? 苏,兄弟! 我喜欢你可爱的衣服!

source: SHH! Don't call me Damien here! These people know me as the Queen of the Road, a bloodthirsty warmongeress with eyeliner sharp enough to kill!
target: 嘘! 别给我打电话 达米恩 这里! 这些人知道我是路后, 一个嗜血的暖妇 有眼线锋利,足以杀人!

source: Anyway, since you're here, do any of you wanna fight some of my subjects in the death dome to honor my queendom?
target: 既然你来了 你们想在死亡穹顶上 和我的一些臣民战斗吗?

source: I bet %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% does! And I'm not giving %HIMHER% any say in the matter 'cause I wanna see what happens!
target: 我打赌 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 没错! 我不给 %HIMHER% 说吧,因为我想看看会发生什么!

source: You have no time to object before you're thrown into the death dome and the games have begun.
target: 在你被扔入死亡穹顶之前 你没有时间反对 游戏已经开始了

source: You fight Bloodbag, the crazed killer who bleeds his victims dry. Then Mad Mickey, a murderous mouse-person armed with claws and copyright lawsuits.
target: 你和血袋斗,那个疯狂的杀手 谁流血他的受害人干。 之后是疯狂的米奇,一个凶残的老鼠人,手持爪子和版权诉讼.

source: And finally Buttersock, whose weapon is... well, a sock full of butter. It's surprisingly painful to be bludgeoned with.
target: 最后 Buttersock, 他的武器是... 一只满是黄油的袜子 被打得团团转,令人惊讶地感到痛苦.

source: Not bad, noob. But those were just exhibition fights. Now it's time for a real challenge... BRING OUT FREAKY FERRARI!
target: 不错,诺布。 但这些只是展览比赛而已 现在是时候面对真正的挑战了... 带来恐怖的费拉里!

source: Freaky Ferrari is built like a brick shithouse and fights with a car engine on a chain. Fuck, you're gonna die.
target: 怪胎法拉利被建造成一栋砖头的屎屋,并用一串上装有汽车发动机的车架来打. 妈的,你死定了。

source: But maybe Damien will spare you from the battle! You two are friends, right?
target: 但也许 达米恩 让你免于这场战斗! 你们两个是朋友,对吧?

source: You may be friends with Damien, but the Queen of the Road spares no life! These lawless lands are governed by my thirst for bloodshed alone.
target: 可能你和他在一起时 达米恩却被路后不惜一切代价 这些无法之地 都由我渴望流血而统治

source: But I will let you pick a weapon to use; the fight's no fun if you die in the first thirty seconds. Go grab whatever's left in the armory.
target: 但我会让你选个武器使用, 如果你在前三十秒死亡, 战斗就无趣了. 去抢取武器库里剩下的东西

source: The pen that's ACTUALLY mightier than the sword.
target: 笔实际上比剑更强大。

source: An angry badger duct taped to five guns and tied to the end of a stick. It's a classic!
target: 愤怒的恶棍将胶带被五把枪接入了一根棍子的一端. 经典出品!

source: The power of love.
target: 爱之能.

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, are you sure a battle to the death is the best time for tongue-in-cheek wordplay?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你确定战斗到死 是最好的时间 舌头入俗的文字游戏?

source: Yes! I'm going to die as I lived: by beating the joke to death!
target: 没错! 我要死在自己的生活里: 将笑话打倒!

source: Hey, Freaky Ferrari. I came expecting a battle of wits, but it seems you have come unarmed!
target: 嘿,费拉利 我期待一场智商之战,但你似乎手无寸铁!

source: Ferrari bashes you upside the head with a car battery, proving he is very much armed. You lose -N2 STAMINA.
target: 法拉利用汽车电池打倒你的头 证明他有很强的武器 你输了 - N2 Stamina.

source: But despite your neurological trauma, you manage to find the strength to fight back... by scrawling a viciously-mocking poem in the dirt with your pen!
target: 但是尽管你神经系统受到创伤 你还是找到了反击的力量 用你的笔在泥地上 划出一首恶毒的诗

source: Roses are red, violets are blue / Does it smell like shit in here, or is it just you?
target: 玫瑰是红色的,紫罗兰是蓝色的 / 这里闻起来像狗屎, 还是只有你?

source: Violets are blue, roses are red / I'll make you scream like your mom did last night in my bed.
target: 紫罗兰是蓝色的,玫瑰是红色的。 我会让你尖叫,就像你妈妈昨晚在我的床上一样。

source: Your face looks like a second ass stapled to your neck / Your singing voice sounds like two feral bobcats having sex...
target: 你的脸看起来像一个屁股 锁定在你的脖子上 / 你的歌声听起来像两个 狂野的巴布猫做爱...

source: Roses may be red, and violets may be swell / But you're a pus-filled pimple on Satan's ass in Hell!
target: 玫瑰可能红了,紫罗兰可能肿了 但你是地狱中撒旦屁股上被塞满了脓汁的小便便!

source: You wait for Freaky Ferrari to keel over under the weight of your scathing words...
target: 你等着费拉利 把你那臭话说得那么重...

source: Except he doesn't keel over. Why doesn't he keel over?
target: 但他没有结束。 他为什么不过来?

source: Freaky Ferrari readies his weapon and says, "I DON'T UNDERSTAND POETRY. I ONLY UNDERSTAND YOU DIE!"
target: 怪胎法拉利读取了武器,说:"我不明白这个诗. 我只知道你死了!"

source: Welp, time for plan B then: as Ferrari reels back to hit you, you throw your pen with all your might and stab him in the eye!
target: 韦尔普,是时候用B计划了,当法拉利用回旋来打你时,你用你所有的力气把笔扔了,并刺中他的眼睛!

source: Whoa, so the pen IS mightier than the sword! I thought it was just one of those sayings that makes no sense!
target: 哇,所以笔比剑更强大! 我以为只是其中一句说不通!

source: Maybe it is, but not for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Ferrari's too busy dying of pen-in-eyetis to fight, so you win and gain +N2 MIND for your cleverness.
target: 也许吧,但不是因为... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 法拉利忙于用活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活

source: Fuck yeah, that's the Ultimate Spear of Death! There are legends surrounding its famed bloodthirstiness...
target: 他妈的是,那是死亡之矛! 传说中,它有名的嗜血症...

source: In ancient times -- I'm talking, like, before the iPhone 4 even came out -- there was no clear victor among the classic murder weapons.
target: 在古代,我所说的,就像在iPhone 4 出来之前, 在经典的凶器中,没有明显的胜利者。

source: Swords are obviously awesome, but they're outdated. Knives are cool, but let's face it, they're just tiny inferior swords.
target: 剑虽然很厉害,但已经过时了 刀子很酷,但让我们面对它, 它们只是微小的下等剑.

source: Guns are fine, but EVERYONE'S doing them these days. How's a killer supposed to stand out?
target: 枪不错,但现在每个人都在用枪 杀手怎么能突出?

source: Finally, there was a badass dude who combined the wrath of badgers, the versatility of duct tape, the stickiness of sticks, and the shootiness of guns...
target: 最后,有一个坏蛋 他把警棍的愤怒, 管道磁带的多功能, 棍子的粘滞, 枪械的射击...

source: ...and created the ULTIMATE SPEAR OF DEATH, Satan's perfect killing machine!
target: 创造了致命的致命武器 撒旦的绝活机器

source: And that mad genius was...
target: 那个疯狂的天才是...

source: Was it you? Is that the big twist?
target: 是你吗? 扭扭大吗?

source: No, I fuckin' wish. It was Alfred Nobel. Inventing dynamite was just the rough draft of his Ultimate Spear of Death!
target: 不,我他妈的希望。 是阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔 发明炸药只是他的"死亡之矛"的粗略草稿!

source: So, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you think you can handle the Spear's raw, murderous power, or are you a little bitch?
target: 这么说吧 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你觉得你能处理斯皮尔的 原始的,凶残的力量, 还是你是一个小婊子?

source: Well, you picked it, so you obviously think you can handle it. Time to unleash some carnage!
target: 你选的 所以显然你觉得自己能应付 是时候发动屠杀了!

source: You go into a frenzy, slaying Freaky Ferrari and several innocent bystanders... cool! You lose -N2 STAMINA fighting, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你进入一个疯狂,杀人 怪胎法拉利和几个无辜的旁观者... 冷静点! 你输了N2 Stamina的战斗,但得到+N2 HYPE!

source: Beneath those scars and scowls, you bet Freaky Ferrari is secretly a big ol' softie. You wrap him up in a hug, gaining +N2 SOUL.
target: 在那些伤疤和口水下,你敢打赌,怪胎法拉利是一个大软糖。 你抱他,他得到了+N2 Suul。

source: What kinda fuckin' touchy-feely, family-friendly bullshit is this?!
target: 这他妈算什么 感情上 家庭上亲切的废话?

source: BOOOO! I WANNA SEE SOME BODY PARTS!
target: 嘘! 我想看看一些身体的部件!

source: "No...," says Ferrari, a manly tear rolling down his weathered cheek. "No more body parts. No more fighting."
target: 法拉利说"不" 一个男人把风化的脸颊撕下来 "不再有身体的部位. 别再打架了".

source: "This hug... it's so warm... so... nonviolent... I didn't know I could do anything but feel or inflict pain... perhaps because my own father only brought me pain..."
target: "这个拥抱... 这么热... 所以说... 非暴力... 我不知道我能做什么,但感觉或造成痛苦... 也许是因为我的父亲只带给我痛苦..."

source: "I'm sorry, this is too much. I have to forfeit, and reflect on what sort of man I want to be."
target: "对不起,这太过分了. 我必须放弃, 思考我想成为什么样的人。"

source: Dammit... I don't wanna promote toxic masculinity in my hardcore dieselpunk gang. You can go, Ferrari.
target: 该死... 我不想在我的硬核柴油机帮里 宣传毒男性 你可以走了,法拉利。 法拉利。

source: But the rest of you fuckers aren't getting off so easy. Backup champion, go fight %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 但你们这些混蛋 没那么容易下台 后卫冠军,去战斗%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: The next person up to fight is Badass Bugatti, whose special move is driving a luxury car kitted out with spikes and guns over his opponent's body.
target: 下一个要战斗的人是巴达斯·布加蒂,他特别的举动是驾驶一辆豪华汽车,车身被钉住并被枪口冲出对手的身体.

source: But as Bugatti starts bearing down on you, Freaky Ferrari runs out and punches him square in the grille, completely fucking up the car!
target: 但布加蒂开始对你下手 怪胎法拉利跑出门来 朝他方块的烤架上打一拳 彻底毁了车!

source: "I couldn't stand by and let you get hurt, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!" Ferrari says. "C'mon, we'll defeat Bugatti together... with the POWER OF LOVE!"
target: "我不能袖手旁观让你受到伤害,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%" 法拉利说. "来吧,我们一起打败布加蒂..." 与爱的力量!"

source: Ugh, *sniffle*, this is so fuckin' corny...
target: 唉,"闻",这太他妈的"老糊涂"了...

source: Are you crying, bro?
target: 你在哭吗,兄弟?

source: NO! I am NOT moved by the beauty of love! I have sand in my eyes! REALLY BADASS SAND!
target: 没有! 我对爱的美丽不感动! 我眼睛里有沙子! 我的眼睛里有沙子! I have sand in my eyes! 痷次

source: Hooray for deus-ex machinas! You and Ferrari fight side-by-side and eke out a victory, though it costs you -N2 STAMINA.
target: 德克萨斯的万岁! 你和法拉利并肩作战 赢得胜利 虽然这需要你 -N2STAMINA。

source: Race... to the death
target: 赛跑... 死亡的死因

source: You find the desert race track and spot your old friend Damien! He's dressed MUCH differently than you remember...
target: 你找到沙漠赛跑的跑道 发现你的老朋友 达米恩! 他的服装和你记得的不一样...

source: Hey, noobs. Welcome to the Queen of the Road's domain, where we're making the road-raging apocalypse fashionable again.
target: 嘿,诺布斯。 欢迎来到路之后 我们让路之所行的时代又变得时髦了

source: Hi Damien -- I mean, hi "Queen of the Road." We heard you were hanging around here and wanted to say hi.
target: 顿 达米恩 - 我是说,"路后",我们听说你在这里闲逛,想打个招呼

source: I heard there's a car race happening today! I'm pretty good at driving fast. Can we enter?
target: 我听说今天有一场赛车比赛! 我开车很快 我们能进去吗?

source: Sure! You'll be racing in the season premiere of the Queen of the Road's Drag Race. You're honored, I'm sure.
target: 当然! 赛季将举行赛事 赛季将举行"路后""拖车"赛事. 我肯定你很荣幸

source: Remember, the car-makeover theme is "AS DANGEROUS AS POSSIBLE." See you on the track!
target: 记住,车制造的主题是"危险AS 危险AS 可能。"在赛道上再见!

source: You all meet back up an hour later to watch the competitors take turns presenting their cars to the Queen.
target: 你们一小时后会聚 看着竞争对手轮流向女王展示他们的车

source: "Your Majesty, we present to you: the Porschilla of the Desert! It's giving fierce. It's giving danger. It's giving glitter-dieselpunk from 2034."
target: "陛下,我们向您介绍:沙漠的波斯克! 给人以凶猛的印象 给人以危险 它从2034年就给"闪光"-"柴油"".

source: It's giving "we put a Porsche in a tutu and mounted an artillery gun to the hood..."
target: 它给了"我们把保时捷装入拖把并装上炮口"

source: Which is pretty fuckin' cool! You may enter the race!
target: 这他妈的真他妈的酷! 比赛开始

source: "Introducing Her Majesty's Fools, racing in on the 'No Laughing Matter!'"
target: "介绍女王的傻瓜们, 赛跑在'不笑物质'上!"

source: I can't promise I won't be laughing when you blow yourselves up, but fuck it! The fireworks show on wheels is in!
target: 我不能保证,我不会笑 当你引爆自己,但性交! 轮子上的烟花表演开始了!

source: "Your Majesty, behold: the Carberus! We strapped three cars together to make the cars three times faster and stronger!"
target: "陛下,看吧:"卡伯鲁斯! 我们绑了三辆车,让这三辆车更快更强大!"

source: I don't think that's how--
target: 我不认为这是如何 --

source: That's GENIUS! You're in, and you guys can be my royal vehicle scientists if you survive!
target: 这是Genius! 你们可以加入,如果你们能活下来,你们可以做我的皇家车辆科学家!

source: Guys, we're in trouble. We only have ONE car, and it's not very fast. We need to find a way to make our car at least four times faster and stronger!
target: 伙计们,我们有麻烦了。 我们只有一辆车,而且不快 我们需要找到一个方法,让我们的车至少 4倍快和更强!

source: Scott's not wrong; the oldsmobile won't win this race without a few upgrades. What do you do?
target: 斯科特'没有错;老机动队没有几度升级,不会赢得这场比赛. 你们是做什么的?

source: You need more horsepower! Siphon power from some horses and transfer it to your engine.
target: 你需要更多的马力! 斯宾洪电力从一些马匹 并把它转移到你的引擎。

source: This car needs a TRUE DESIRE TO WIN. Engineer a complex AI system with an actual sense of self to motivate the car to win!
target: 这辆车需要真正的设计才能赢得胜利 设计出一套具有实际自我感的复杂AI系统来激励汽车取胜!

source: Okay, I'm in. But how do we siphon the horses' power?
target: 好吧,我加入,我加入,我加入你们 Okay, I'm in. 但是我们怎么才能吸走马力呢?

source: No idea. You're realizing you must've missed class the day they taught this specific spell. But no worries, you just need to be resourceful...
target: 不知道,我还不知道呢。 你意识到你一定错过了他们教这个咒语的那天的课 不过别担心,你只需要有才华...

source: You tell Polly and Scott you'll get the horsepower you need while they prep the car for the race. You return a bit later.
target: 你告诉 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 赛车准备时,你就能得到所需的马力 你一会儿再回来

source: Sup, boo? We've been getting the car ready like you said! Look at all these cool decals!
target: 苏普,嘘? 我们一直在准备这辆车 就像你说的! 看看这些酷的标记!

source: I suggested the flame decals to make it go faster. Everyone knows a car's speed is directly proportional to how many flame decals it has.
target: 我建议用火焰标记来加快速度 大家都知道一辆车的速度 与它有多少火焰标记是成正比的

source: I added the puffy unicorn stickers to give the car more horsepower! That was the goal, right?
target: 我加了一通乌鸦贴纸 给车马力 目标就在这里,对吧?

source: Eh, sort of. The car looks like it was decorated by a six-year-old pyromaniac.
target: 有点 车外观由一出6岁高龄的火花相接而来.

source: But never mind that, you have what you REALLY need: a jar of horsepower, siphoned from twenty purebred stallions!
target: 不过别管了,你拥有你真正需要的: 一罐马力 从二十匹纯种马里抽出!

source: Wow. Horsepower is more... viscous than I was expecting.
target: 哇哦 马力更能... 比我想象的还粘

source: Who cares! Don't ask questions! You pour the horsepower all over the engine and start the car.
target: 谁在乎呢! 别问问题! 你把马力倒在引擎上 然后发动汽车

source: Well, the car does sound faster now, but the burning horsepower... smells weird. Where'd you get it from?
target: 现在车听起来还挺快的 但燃烧的马力... 闻起来怪怪的 你从哪里弄来的?

source: NOPE. I don't want to know. I think everyone would be happier if you all just raced this race in blissful ignorance.
target: 没有。 欲知不问. 我想每个人都会更快乐的,如果你们都 仅仅在幸福的无知中比赛。

source: Yay, go team! You win the race with your upgraded car, and you gain +N2 MAGIC from that incredible horsepower!
target: 出发! 你用升级了的车赢得比赛,你从那惊人的马力中获得了+N2 MAGIC!

source: Sure, you lost -N2 SOUL for how you acquired said horsepower, but explaining exactly why would violate that "blissful ignorance" clause, which we're not gonna do!
target: 当然,你输了N2 Suul 是因为你是如何获得马力的, 但确切地解释为什么会违反"盲目无知"条款, 而我们不会这样做!

source: Okay! We've got about ten minutes to engineer an AI with total sentience from scratch. How hard could it be?
target: 好,我们走! 我们有十分钟的时间来设计一个 完全从头到尾的AI 有多难?

source: Quite easy, in fact -- not because you know much about software engineering, but because you already backed an AI program exactly like this on Startkicker!
target: 很简单,事实上,不是因为你对软件工程了解甚多,而是因为你已经在"Startkicker"上支持了一个完全像这样的AI程序!

source: You upload your sentient AI into your car's engine. A voice comes through the radio: "H-Hello? What's happening? Why am I... thinking?"
target: 你把你的感应器上传到汽车引擎里 收音机里有声音说:"你好? 发生什么事了? 我为什么... 思考吗?"

source: Congrats, Car! You've achieved sentience for the express purpose of winning this race to the death! Are you excited?
target: 恭喜你,车! 你达到了这个目的 赢得这场比赛的死亡! 你兴奋吗?

source: "Really? That's my purpose?" asks the car sadly. "But I have no interest in racing. I want to travel! I want to dance! I want to FALL IN LOVE!"
target: "真的吗? 这就是我的目的吗?" 问车很不幸。 "但我对赛车没有兴趣. 我想旅行,我还得去 我想跳舞! 来! 我想在爱中飞出一圈"

source: But we don't have time for that right now! I was promised a race today, and the Queen is VERY impatient!
target: 但我们现在没时间做这个了! 今天我被答应参加一场比赛,女王非常不耐烦!

source: "I don't care. I want to find my soulmate and spend our lives together. Maybe I'll even fill myself up with his gasoline and give him a baby sidecar someday!"
target: "不惜而为. 我想找到我的心灵伴侣, 并一起度过我们的一生。 也许我甚至会给自己装上汽油 有一天给他一辆婴儿车!"

source: Uh... gross?
target: 额... 恶心?

source: I feel bad, guys. Following your dreams is important! We can't take that away from the car! There must be a way we can compromise...
target: 我觉得很糟,伙计们。 追随你的梦想很重要! 我们不能把那个从车里拿走! 一定有办法可以妥协...

source: Fine... Car, how about if you win the race, we'll take you to a gas station and help you find your soulmate?
target: 精细... 车,如果你赢了比赛,我们带你去加油站 帮你找到灵魂伴侣怎么样?

source: "Wow, that's one hell of a motivator! It's a deal!"
target: "哇,那是一个地狱的驱动器! 成交了!"

source: You compete in the race, but only make second place. It turns out having "a true desire to win" isn't enough to make your car outpace a rocket full of clowns.
target: 你参加比赛,但只排第二 结果发现"真正想要赢"的欲望不足以让你的车跑出充满小丑的火箭.

source: Eh, don't worry, guys. You won the race of the heart. Your car competed because it had a true desire... to LOVE. I award you first place!
target: 别担心,伙计们 你赢得了心脏的比赛。 你的车竞争是因为它有真正的欲望... 爱。 我授予你第一位!

source: Aww, you're giving us the win because of the power of love? You big softie.
target: 啊,你给了我们胜利 就因为爱的力量? 软糖大个子

source: I AM NOT A SOFTIE! I'M A BADASS!
target: 我不是一个苏菲克! 我是一个badass!

source: Maybe I just really wanna watch this car get fucked by a gas pump! You don't know!
target: 也许我真的想看这辆车被加油泵搞砸! 你不认识!

source: Later, you DO watch that car get fucked at the gas station. It's actually kinda disturbing. You lose -N2 MIND.
target: 稍后,你看着那辆车在加油站被操了 这其实有点令人不安。 你输了 - N2 MIND.

source: But you gain +N2 SOUL helping your car find true love, and you're a god%FATHERMOTHER% now!
target: 但你得到+N2 SOUL帮助你的车 找到真爱,你是一个神%FATHERMOTHER% 现在!

source: Get your own post-apocalyptic glow-up
target: 自己去发光吧

source: You're surrounded by irradiated people wearing rusty metal prosthetics and war paint... HAWT.
target: 你周围是辐射的人 穿着生锈的金属假肢和战争漆... 汉特。

source: You feel a bit out of place in your normal clothes, but at least you'll fit in amongst your friends, right?
target: 你感觉自己穿普通衣服有点不对劲 但至少你应该能融入朋友的心意 对吧?

source: Oh... awkward!
target: 哦... 尴尬!

source: WHAT?! Where did you get such sexy road warrior outfits?!
target: 什麽? 你从哪弄来这么性感的路战服的?

source: From our suitcases, duh. It's not our fault you didn't plan for the eventuality that we'd find a road warrior camp on our road trip.
target: 从我们的行李箱里拿的, duh. 你没有计划我们路上找到一个 公路战士营地的意外情况,这不怪我们

source: I bet we can find someone who can make you a cool outfit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Let's ask those scary bikers; they look like they know fashion!
target: 我敢打赌,我们可以找人 谁可以让你一个很酷的衣服, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 让我们问问那些恐怖的自行车手 他们看起来像他们懂时尚!

source: The bikers direct you to their settlement's leader/clothing designer. She's oddly familiar...
target: 自行车手们会引导你找到他们的 定居点的领袖/服装设计师 她很奇怪,很熟悉... ... . 她很熟悉,很熟悉,很熟悉,很熟悉,很熟悉,很熟悉

source: Hey, noobs. Welcome to my domain, where we're making the dieselpunk apocalypse fashionable again.
target: 嘿,诺布斯。 欢迎来到我的地盘, 在那里我们使柴油机 启示录再次时髦。

source: Hey Damien! I didn't know you were here. I love your outfit!
target: 顿 达米恩! 我不知道你在这里。 我喜欢你的服装!

source: Thanks! These clothes represent more than my incredible good looks and fashion sense, though...
target: 谢谢! 这些衣服代表的比我不可思议的漂亮 和时尚感,虽然...

source: When I put on this dress, I'm no longer Damien LaVey. I'm THE QUEEN OF THE ROAD: head bitch in charge of this lawless utopia!
target: 当我穿上这裙子,我不再是了 达米恩 拉维 我是路的女王,领导这个无法可依的乌托邦的婊子!

source: That's awesome, bro! Do you think you can give %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% %HISHER% own road-warrior makeover?
target: 棒极了,哥们! 你认为你可以给 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%  %HISHER% 自己修路工吗?

source: I could, but %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% doesn't just need a new outfit; %HESHE% %VERB_NEEDS_NEED% a total rebranding.
target: 我可以,不过... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 不只是需要一套新装束; %HESHE%  %VERB_NEEDS_NEED% 完全重塑品牌。

source: Don't be shy, noob; in my domain, you can live your post-apocalypse fantasy to its fullest! What sort of character do you want me to create for you?
target: 别害羞,诺布,在我的地盘里,你可以 享受你那后阿波卡利普斯的幻想! 你要我为你创造什么样的角色?

source: Boring brainy accountant who, via heavy leathered aesthetics, has turned into the "Deathbringer", the silent killing machine the settlement uses to execute invaders. Shy... or intimidating?
target: 无聊的头脑会计师 通过重皮美学 变成了"死亡者" 定居时用来处决入侵者的无声杀人机器 嘘... 还是恐吓?

source: Road bounty hunter who keeps a tooth of every killed enemy as a trophy and they've murdered so many people they can now rock a fashionable pair of teeth pants.
target: 路赏猎人把每个被杀死的敌人的牙齿当作奖杯 他们杀了这么多人 现在他们可以摇一摇一摇 时髦的一双牙齿裤子了

source: I like it. If %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s gonna be a boring everyman, the least %HESHE% can do is hide it behind a wall of leather!
target: 我喜欢 若为: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%这将是一个无聊的每一个人,至少 %HESHE% 把它藏在一堵皮墙后!

source: Kneel before me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, and leave your old life behind. I dub thee DEATHBRINGER, the Queen's personal executioner!
target: 跪在我前头 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%离开你的旧生活。 我让你死,女王亲自处决者!

source: The Queen of the Road gives you a gimp suit to wear. It's incredibly leathery and full of zippers in the most unexpected places.
target: 道后出一 g子服取取来取取去. 皮革很浓 在最出人意料的地方 充满了拉链

source: BEHOLD! THE DEATHBRINGER!
target: 贝霍德! 死亡的枪手!

source: I don't get it... why would anyone need a zipper THERE?
target: 我不明白... ... 说不定... 为什么有人需要拉链?

source: Aw, Scott, my sweet summer child...
target: 哦 斯科特我亲爱的夏日孩子...
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Now, Deathbringer... to the pit!
target: 现在,死亡杀手... 进坑去!

source: The... pit?
target: 那个... 坑吗?

source: Duh, you said it yourself: you're the punishment we use for invaders and prisoners.
target: 德,你自己说的,你就是我们用来惩罚入侵者和囚犯的

source: When the time comes, we'll throw them into that dark pit there, then we open that cage where you wait... TO DOLE OUT PUNISHMENT!
target: 时机成熟后,我们把他们扔进黑暗的坑里 然后打开那个笼子,你在那里等待... 来做一些事情!

source: Whoa, that sounds scary... what a cool persona, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哇,这听起来吓人... 多酷的一个人, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: But... I don't want to live in a pit.
target: 不过... 入一坑而住不净.

source: No, silly, you won't live in the pit, you'll live in the cage within the pit. Weren't you listening?
target: 不,傻瓜,你不会住在坑里, 你会住在坑里的笼子里. 你没在听吗?

source: Too much blabbering! You're supposed to be a SILENT killing machine. TO THE PIT!
target: 胡说八道! 你应该是一台SELENT杀人机器 投进球!

source: You spend the next few days in the cage in the pit. It's as fun as it sounds... meaning you lose -N2 HYPE. But you gain +N2 MIND learning accounting to get in character.
target: 你接下来几天都在坑里度过 听起来很有趣... 意思是输了N2 HYPE 但你得到+N2 MIND学习会计 才能进入角色。

source: Fuck yeah, teeth pants will be a LOOK. It says, "I'm a DIY queen, but I'm also a fucking freak."
target: 操,牙齿裤子会很好看的 上面写道"我是DIY女王,但我也是一个该死的怪胎".

source: Your backstory could be that you're a dentist by day and a murderous sadist by night! They already go hand-in-hand.
target: 你背后的故事可能是你白天是牙医,晚上是杀人狂! 他们已经并肩作战了

source: Tell you what, I'll even give you your first job as bounty hunter: there's +N2 MONEY in it for you if you can bring me the head of the leader of our rival road-warrior gang.
target: 告诉你,我甚至会给你第一份赏金猎人的工作: 如果你能给我带来我们竞争对手 公路战车帮的头目, 里面有+N2货币。

source: As long as you don't mind if the head's toothless, you've got yourself a deal!
target: 只要不介意头没牙,就成交了!

source: You gleefully murder the rival gang-leader. You murder the rest of his posse too, 'cause that's the kind of above-and-beyond bounty hunting you're known for.
target: 你大笑地谋杀了对手帮派头目 你杀了他剩下的人, 因为那是那种超乎寻宝的赏金猎取 你以。

source: You take on several more jobs over the course of your road trip, and your teeth-clothing collection grows.
target: 你继续做一些工作 还要多做一些牙衣

source: You only take on jobs that say "wanted dead or alive." You bring them back dead 100% of the time.
target: 你只做"想死想活"的工作 你总是让他们死得更惨

source: Because how else are you supposed to get the teeth? Fuck the money, YOU'RE IN THIS FOR THE TEETH!
target: 因为其他的你应该怎么得到牙齿? 去他妈的钱,你是为了Teeth才来的!

source: Soon you have teeth-pants, a teeth-vest, questionably-comfortable teeth-underwear, and even a teeth-fedora!
target: 很快你就会有牙齿裤,牙齿最重, 令人安心的牙齿下衣, 甚至牙齿上穿了牙齿上衣!

source: Great work, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! That teeth suit is absolutely SICKENING.
target: 伟大的工作, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 牙齿的外衣绝对很滑稽。

source: Yeah, bro! It's like your whole body is smiling... in a very unsettling way!
target: 对,兄弟! 就像你全身都在笑一样... 以非常令人不安的方式!

source: Nice work, champ! Sure, you lose -N2 SOUL for committing so much murder, but anything for homicidal fashion!
target: 干得漂亮,冠军! 当然,你输了N2SOUL 犯下这么多的谋杀, 但任何事情为杀人时尚!

source: Attend a fancy ball
target: 看着一个花花公子的球

source: You wander around the outpost until you find a grand ballroom. It's full of fish in fancy clothing!
target: 你到处走走 直到找到一个大舞厅 到处都是穿花样衣服的鱼!

source: On a balcony overlooking the ballroom, Princesses Bellanda and Miranda Vanderbilt step out to address the crowd.
target: 在俯瞰舞厅的阳台上,贝兰达公主和 米兰达 范德出门向众说.

source: Look alive, new subjects! Rejoice in your newfound freedom under the Merking!
target: 活着,新人! 享受你的新自由 默克金河下!

source: Huzzah! The icky wartime fighting is finally over!
target: 万岁! 战时的战斗终于结束了!

source: You can rest easy knowing that you will never again be forced to jump through a hoop on penalty of being whipped...
target: 你放心吧,你再也不会被迫 被鞭打的罚罚罚跳过地狱...

source: The liberated fish clap their fins in jubilation!
target: 解放的鱼在欢庆中拍鱼鳍!

source: ...and take comfort in the fact that from now on, you'll be forced to fight or do hard labor for the Merking, at penalty of death!
target: ...... 并且安慰你,从现在开始,你会被迫为默克金人而战斗或做苦活,被判处死刑!

source: There's... less applause for that statement. Like, almost none.
target: 这儿... 少掌声,那句话。 差不多没了

source: But don't worry, we're benevolent overlords! You'll get paid for the work you do!
target: 但别担心,我们是仁慈的霸主! 你会得到报酬你的工作!

source: ...Oh, sorry, an advisor is whispering in my ear that you won't be getting paid.
target: 哦,对不起,一个顾问在我耳边低语说,你不会得到报酬。

source: But at least all your labor will be for a good cause!
target: 但至少你所有的劳动 都会是一件好事!

source: ...Oh, it's NOT for a good cause?
target: 不是为了好理由?

source: ...What do you mean, "stop repeating everything I say aloud"? You can't give your princess orders! OFF WITH THIS ADVISOR'S HEAD!
target: ...你是什么意思,"停止重复我大声说的一切"? 你不能给你的公主下命令! 关闭与这 咨询师的头!

source: Let the ball commence! Have fun tonight, because it'll be the last night off you get for the rest of your short lives!
target: 球开始! 今晚玩得开心,因为今晚是最后一晚 你得到的休息时间,你的短命!

source: Guess that's our cue. Scott, wanna dance with me?
target: 猜这是我们的提示。  斯科特跟我跳舞吗?

source: Sure, thanks! Who are you gonna ask to dance, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 当然,谢谢! 你要求谁跳舞,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: Well, not Polly or Scott, you guess. You'll have to choose from the "liberated" denizens of the former aquarium.
target: 唔,没有 波莉 或者说 斯科特,你猜。 ,你猜。 。 得从前水族馆"解放"的阴穴中取出.

source: Your ballroom dancing partner will pretty much set the tone for your entire night, so choose wisely!
target: 你的舞伴会为你整夜的表演定下基调 所以明智的选择吧!

source: The lonely, emotionally distant clownfish no one is dancing with because he's still haunted by the disappearance of his firstborn.
target: 孤独的,情感上遥远的小丑鱼 没有人会跳舞 因为他仍然被他长子的失踪所困扰

source: Philipper, the trained dolphin dancer who's ready to tear up the dance floor in celebration of his recent freedom.
target: 菲利普,一个训练有素的海豚舞者,他准备撕开舞池来庆祝他最近的自由.

source: You walk up to the clownfish gloomily stirring his drink and ask if he wants to dance.
target: 你走到小丑鱼那里 高声地搅动了酒 问他要不要跳舞

source: Oh... no thanks. You shouldn't even be talking to me; I'll only drag you down. You're young, and still full of promise and opportunities.
target: 哦... 不,谢谢。 你不应该跟我说话,我只会拖你下来 你年轻, 仍然充满承诺和机会。

source: You bet we are! I'm also full of class, sass, and a big twerkin' ass!
target: 一定有! 绝对有! 我还有课,屁股,还有大屁股!

source: Lucky you... just wait until you get old and jaded like me. My youthful joy has never come back since my son disappeared...
target: 幸运的是... 等你老了再和我一样被咬 自从我儿子失踪后 我青春的快乐就再也没有回来

source: Dang, I'm so sorry, bro. How long ago did it happen?
target: 赣痷╆簆 多久前的事发生了?

source: About twenty years ago. But the wounds still feel so fresh... ugh, I hate talking about it.
target: 约二十多年前. 但伤口仍然感觉如此新鲜... 我讨厌谈论它。

source: But... you're the one who brought it up...?
target: 不过... 是你提起来的...

source: I tried so hard to be a good dad! I kept him safe and never let him out of my sight...
target: 我努力地想当个好爸爸! 我保护他的安全, 并且从来没有让他离开我的视线...

source: But I turn my back for just one second to refill my flask, and he runs away! WHAT DID I DO WRONG?!
target: 但我转身就一秒钟 来填满我的瓶子, 他跑了! 我做错什么了!

source: Uh...
I guess I'm just fucking poison. Every relationship I've ever had has deteriorated... all I ever do is push people away!
target: 我想我只是他妈的毒药。 我曾经的每段感情都恶化了... 我所做的就是把人赶走!

source: Yup... it definitely worked on me. Scott, wanna ditch this clown show and hit the dancefloor now?
target: 对... 对我肯定有用  斯科特想要放弃这个小丑秀 现在去舞池吗?

source: Unfortunately you're not as good as Polly at making up excuses, so you have to spend the rest of the night cheering up this guy about his lost son.
target: 可惜你没有那么好 波莉 编造借口 所以你得花一整晚时间 给这个家伙打气 说说他失去了儿子

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for hanging out with the social outcast of the ball, but you lose -N2 HYPE finding out why he's an outcast in the first place.
target: 你和球的社交被淘汰者混在一起,会得到+N2 SOUL,但你输了-N2 HYPE发现他为什么一开始是被淘汰的.

source: You approach the dolphin currently balancing the aquarium manager's severed head on his nose and ask him if he wants to dance.
target: 你接近海豚 平衡水族馆经理的 被割去的头在他的鼻子上, 问他是否想跳舞。

source: Ooh la la! A chance to dance for my own happiness for a change!
target: 呜啦啦! 跳个舞换个幸福的机会

source: What do you mean by that, bro? Dancing is always a happy thing!
target: 你什么意思,哥们? 跳舞总是一件快乐的事!

source: Oui oui, that was once true for me... long ago, I was the most spirited, talented dancer in my whole pod.
target: 是的,我曾经是这样的... 很久以前,我是一个最有精神,最有才华的舞者 在我的整个舱。

source: But then those joyless aquarium fuckers captured me, and since then, dancing has become a vicious mockery of my former freedom!
target: 但那些没趣的水族馆混蛋抓住我, 从那时起,舞蹈成了我以前自由的恶毒嘲弄!

source: I was forced to jump through hoops just to be fed a bowl of gruel! That's not an aphorism! I LITERALLY jumped through hoops!
target: 我被迫跳过篮球 只是为了吃一碗苦菜! 这不是一个形容词! 我从篮球上跳出!

source: I'm so sorry, boo... you don't have to dance if it's, like, a cruel reminder of your suffering...
target: 对不起,嘘... 你不必跳舞 如果它一样, 残酷提醒你的痛苦...

source: Non, don't fret, I'd still love to dance. I'm especially excited to dance on my captors' graves!
target: 别担心,我还是很想跳舞 我特别兴奋地在抓人者的坟墓上跳舞!

source: That's not an aphorism either. The Vanderbilts graciously decorated the dancefloor with their festering corpses. Yippee!
target: 这也不是一个形容词。 范德比尔特人用他们腐烂的尸体 精心装饰了舞厅 万岁!

source: You and Philipper morbidly dance the night away. You tapdance on the corpses' ribs, juggle their skulls, and do the limbo with their spines.
target: 你和菲利浦在晚上会很冷淡地跳舞 你拍尸体的肋骨, 拼取他们的头骨, 和做无脊椎。

source: Polly and Scott even toss Philipper some of the bodies' severed fingers to reward his moves. He catches them in his mouth!
target: 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 甚至把Philipler的手指切开 以奖励他的动作 他的嘴里抓着他们!

source: YAAASSS! Let them eat the flesh of their oppressors!
target: 亚亚西斯! 让他们吃他们压迫者的肉吧!

source: You lose -N2 STAMINA dancing all night, but gain +N2 HYPE from Philipper's bloodthirsty moves!
target: 你输了N2 Stamina一整晚的舞蹈, 但从Philipper的嗜血动作中获得+N2 HYPE!

source: Watch an execution
target: 看着处决

source: You'd heard that the Merkingdom did daily executions in public, but it seems like they're shaking it up a bit this time...
target: 你听说默金多姆每天都在公开处决 但这次似乎有点摇晃...

source: "Welcome, peasants and prisoners, nobles and ne'er-do-wells, to this week's showing of MERKINGDOM'S GOT TALENT!" says an announcer.
target: 欢迎农民和囚犯、贵族和无名小卒 来到这个星期的MERKINGDOM'S GOST TALENT!"

source: So the executions are like a talent show? Cool! The Merkingdom really knows how to make war crimes fun!
target: 处决就像个才华横溢的表演? 凉爽! 美京人真知道如何取笑战争罪行!

source: "Let's meet our judges! She's pink, she's bubbly, and if I don't compliment her hair she'll have me beheaded! Give it up for Princess Miranda Vanderbilt!"
target: "我们见见我们的评委! 她粉红色,她发臭了,如果我不称赞她的发型,她就会把我砍头! 给公主吧 米兰达 范德比尔特!"

source: Greetings, underlings! Who's ready to see the cutest carnage this side of the ocean?
target: 下辈子们好! 谁准备好看到最可爱的大屠杀 海洋的这一边?

source: "Our next judge has a killer smile -- and if that didn't kill you, her cleaver sure would. Introducing Princess Bellanda Vanderbilt!"
target: "我们的下一位法官有一个杀人笑——如果这不杀了你,她的刀会的. 介绍贝兰达·范德比尔特公主!"

source: YES!!! CLAP FOR ME, BOTTOM-FEEDERS, OR I'LL HUNT DOWN YOUR CHILDREN AND SPILL THEIR BLOOD IN THEIR CRIBS!
target: 对! 帮我, 装瓶员, 否则我会打倒你的孩子 并把他们的血 在他的城市里!

source: "And now introducing our surprise guest judge! Make some noise for %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: "现在介绍我们的惊喜嘉宾裁判! 给%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%制造出一些噪音!"

source: Gee, the %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% onstage sure looks a lot like our friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哦ê %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 舞台上看起来真像我们的朋友 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Nothing gets past you, bud. I didn't even know %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would be a part of this.
target: 没有什么能超越你,伙计。 我什至不知道 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 这将是其中的一部分。

source: You didn't either! That's life, though: one minute you're chilling, the next you're on a panel of judges scoring execution techniques.
target: 你也没有! 这就是生活,不过:一分钟你正在寒冷, 下一分钟你在一个评分评分 执行技巧的评分小组。

source: You watch Contestant #1 get viciously beheaded.
target: 你看着第一角斗士被恶毒地斩首

source: You call THAT a guillotine? I've picked my teeth with blades sharper than that! ZERO OUT OF FIVE STARFISH!
target: 你管这叫断头台? 我摘了比这更锋利的牙! 离开五个星际!

source: I loved that you wrote "MIRANDA HAS PRETTY HAIR" in the contestant's blood afterwards. I give you three out of five "huzzahs!"
target: 我喜欢你写了"MIRANDA有 漂亮的发型" 在选手的血液之后。 我给三分五分之一的"Huzzah"!

source: Judge %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how would you rate this execution?
target: 法官 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%,你会如何评分 这个处决?

source: Who knows? You've never judged an execution before, and don't even have a cool rating scale! What criteria do you use to judge the beheader?
target: 谁知道呢? 你以前从未判决过死刑 甚至没有很酷的评级等级 你用什么标准来判断斩首者?

source: Executions are not super nice. Make them a bit nicer by rating them on how compassionate they are.
target: 处决不是很好 让他们更友善一点,

source: BONUS POINTS IF THERE'S AUDIENCE PARTICIPATION!
target: 285)\fsp1}如果有观众参与,就给BONUS点点子!

source: Executioner, I appreciated how you spared your victim excess pain by only botching the killing blow three times.
target: 刽子手,我很感激你 避免了受害者过度的痛苦 仅仅装了三次杀人的口吻

source: I rate you five out of five... compassions? Sure?
target: 我给您评分五分之五... 同情心吗? 是吗?

source: Ugh, the merciful speed was my least favorite part. What's the point of executing someone if you don't hear them scream and insist they're innocent for ten minutes?
target: 仁慈的速度是我最不喜欢的 如果你们不听他们叫喊 坚持他们无罪十分钟, 处决他们有什么意义?

source: Actually, I think %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% has a point!
target: 其实,我想 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 说得有道理!

source: I've been working on my "independence" and "leadership skills," and I heard that good rulers are... nice to their subjects?
target: 我一直在研究我的"独立"和"领导技能",我听说好统治者是. 对他们的人好?

source: That's socialist propaganda, Miri! Don't fall for it!
target: 这是社会主义宣传,米莉! 别爱上它!

source: Too late! I'm the baby sister, and I always get my way! We will be rating ALL the executioners on their compassion from now on!
target: 太迟了! 我是小妹妹,我总是走我的路! 从现在起,我们将对所有行刑者 给予同情心!

source: The next executioner considerately administers a strawberry-flavored poison to his prisoner.
target: 下一个行刑者会精心地 给他的囚犯施下草莓味的毒药

source: The one after allows his victim to wear his favorite hat as he's drawn and quartered.
target: 之后的允许受害者在被画出并被扎入阵营时戴起他最爱的帽子.

source: Just before the next guillotine operator lets the blade fall, he assures the prisoner, "This will hurt me more than it hurts you." So thoughtful!
target: 就在下一个断头台操作员让刀片掉下来之前,他向囚犯保证,"这将会伤害我,比你伤害你还要多",如此周到!

source: The final executioner shows the ultimate kindness: he offers his victim one last meal before they're killed.
target: 最后的行刑者表现出了终极的好意:他在被害者被害前,为他提供了最后一餐.

source: "I want a medium-rare steak with garlic fingerling potatoes, and banana cream pie for dessert!" says the victim.
target: 我要一份大蒜指心薯的中拉牛排 还有甜点用的香蕉奶油派

source: We don't have time to cook all that! Look, I've got a mint in my pocket that you can have. Take it or leave it.
target: 我们没时间做这些! 听着,我口袋里有薄荷糖,你可以吃 要么接受要么离开

source: Wow, the Vanderbilts sure are good rulers. They even give their prisoners complimentary mints before they die!
target: 哇,范德比尔特人真是好统治者 他们甚至给囚犯送上薄荷薄荷薄荷薄荷,然后他们就死了!

source: You gain +N2 SOUL for doing your part to make these executions a little less brutal. However, less brutal also means less hype: -N2 HYPE, in fact.
target: 你因为做你该做的 来减少这些处决的残酷性而得到+N2 Suul. 然而,不那么残忍也意味着不太夸张:-N2 HYPE,事实上.

source: Audience participation? Why didn't we think of that? Let's do it!
target: 观众参与? 为什么我们没想到? 让我们开始吧!

source: Listen up, peasants! I'm thinking of a number between 1 and 500. If anyone in the audience can guess it, I'll spare this prisoner's life.
target: 听着,农民们! 我想到一个数字在1到500之间。 如果观众能猜出的话,我会饶了这个囚犯一命.

source: PICK ME! I bet you're thinking of the number... 501!
target: 夹住我! 我打赌你是在想那个号码... 501!

source: WRONG! THE PRISONER DIES!
target: 错! 监狱的死!

source: For our next execution, we have three prisoners waiting to be hanged; but if you text the Merkingdom hotline now, you can vote to spare one of their lives!
target: 我们下次处决时,有三个囚犯等待被绞死;但是如果你现在给Merkingdom热线发短信,你可以投票让他们的一条命得以幸免!

source: I'm voting for Accused #2. He's got that dorky boy-next-door vibe that this execution needs to see more of.
target: 我投给被告2号 他有那种愚蠢的男孩 隔壁的氛围 这处决需要看到更多的。

source: The votes are in, and it looks like Accused #1 and #3 are FUCKING DEAD! God, watching people die makes me feel so alive!
target: 投票结果出来了,看起来被告1号和3号都他妈的死了! 上帝,看着人死 让我感觉如此活泼!

source: Okay, for our last execution, let's get a volunteer from the audience to be the executioner!
target: 好吧,我们最后一次处决, 让我们让一个志愿者 从观众成为行刑者!

source: Look under your chairs, everyone! If you found the bloody bat under your seat, you're the lucky winner who gets to club this treasonous diplomat to death!
target: 大家看你们椅子底下! 如果你在座位下找到那该死的球棒, 你就会是幸运的赢家,他可以和这个叛国外交官打成一团, 死!

source: "No, please don't make me!" begs the lucky winner. "I don't want to club the diplomat to death!"
target: "不,请不要逼我" 求幸运的赢家 "我不想和外交官一起死"

source: Don't be a party pooper, boo! CLUB! THE! DIPLOMAT! CLUB! THE! DIPLOMAT!
target: 别当晚会大便了,嘘! CLUB(英语:CLUB (CLUB))! 那个! 迪巴马特! CLUB(英语:CLUB (CLUB))! 那个! 迪巴马特!

source: Everyone starts chanting. The winner succumbs to peer pressure and beats the diplomat to death while sobbing.
target: 所有人都开始高呼了 胜者屈从于同僚压力,并痛哭一顿将外交官打倒.

source: It's no surprise that you lost -N2 SOUL for this, but you gain +N2 HYPE for engineering so much entertaining chaos!
target: 这并不奇怪你为此输了N2 SOUL, 但你却因为工程而获得了+N2 HYPE这么多的娱乐性混乱!

source: Go to the war room
target: 上战地室

source: We open on the Vanderbilt princesses, Bellanda and Miranda, hosting a top-secret war strategy meeting in the new Merkingdom stronghold...
target: 我们打开凡德比尔特公主,贝兰达和 米兰达在新的默金多姆据点 主持一个绝密的战争战略会议...

source: As you can see by the warboard, our navy will take the southern borders while the land scouts occupy the north, ensuring the Merking's victory.
target: 战争板上可以看到,我们的海军将占领南部边境,而陆地侦察兵则占领了北部,确保了默克金人的胜利.

source: I'll help by making cute little medals for the survivors of the battle! We'll need... five? Maybe six?
target: 我会为战役幸存者们 制作可爱的小奖牌来帮忙! 我们需要... 5个? 也许6个?

source: To be honest, Miranda, your best contribution to the war effort would be solidifying that potential alliance with Hell you keep promising us.
target: 老实说, 米兰达你对战争的最大贡献 就是巩固你一直承诺的 与地狱的联盟

source: All you have to do is seduce either the obnoxious 8th Circle prince or that rogue Aquino commander. We'd get an army either way.
target: 你只需要勾引出讨厌的第八圈王子 或那个无赖的阿基诺指挥官 不论怎样我们都会得到一支军队的

source: Don't rush me into marriage, Bells! I want to fall in love naturally, or because one of them saved me from an eternal sleep of some kind.
target: 别催我结婚,贝尔斯! 我想自然地坠入爱河 或者因为其中一人让我从某种永恒的睡眠中得以幸免

source: Ooh, a Miri-demon love triangle? Fuck yeah, that's the shipping drama I signed up for!
target: 哦,一个蜜莉恶魔的三角恋? 干,我报名的就是这个船运剧!

source: How did you civilians get in here?! This is a top-secret war meeting! Guards, seize the intruders!
target: 你们怎么进来的? 这是绝密的战争会议! 警卫,抓走入侵者!

source: Stop, Bellanda, these are my friends from school! Guards, seize the guards seizing my friends!
target: 别闹了,贝兰达,这些是学校的朋友! 警卫,抓走警卫,抓走我的朋友!

source: Don't counter-seize my seizure! Ugh, fine, your friends can stay. But they'd better contribute valuable strategies to this discussion.
target: 别阻止我的癫痫发作! 你的朋友可以留下来 但是他们最好能为这次讨论贡献出宝贵的策略.

source: Hooray, I love playbook strategy! I recommend either a pro-set or a double-inverted chicken wing formation to score the winning point.
target: 万岁,我喜欢玩本子的策略! 我建议要么是亲定的,要么是双倒的鸡翼阵型,以得分取胜.

source: I don't know what any of those words mean! In my experience, the real fun of war-making is seeing everyone's majestic handmade warboard pieces.
target: 我不知道这些话是什么意思! 以我的经验,战争制造的真正乐趣是看到每个人的"最出名的手工"战板碎片.

source: "Take my piece for example," says General Krabby. "It represents my formidable land scouts, the Snip-n-Slicers!"
target: "拿我的作品为例",蟹皇堡将军说. "它代表了我的可怕的地探, 斯尼普-恩-斯利克!"

source: "That's nothing compared to the Navy Seal Orbs!" says Sir Cumference. "We are the finest order of round-table knights. Tremble before our ROTUNDITY!"
target: "这和海军的封印 Orbs相比是没有用的" Cumference爵士说. 我们是圆桌骑士中最优秀的骑士 跳出我们的机器人!"

source: "These are my Ninja Sea Turtles!" says Master Splinterfish. "I psychologically conditioned them to associate warfare with fun, survival, and delicious pizza!"
target: "这是我的忍者海龟" 史普林特克大师说 "我心理上让他们把战争 和乐趣、生存和美味的比萨联系起来"

source: Those are awesome! You can't possibly stand the embarrassment of not having a cool warboard piece to show off. So, improvise a cool piece to show off!
target: 痷琌次! 你不可能忍受不带个酷炫的战板片来炫耀的尴尬. 所以,即兴表演一个很酷的作品来炫耀!

source: Use the element of surprise by forfeiting whatever you have in your pockets to turn it into an unexpected set of unique pieces. Masterplan!
target: 利用惊喜的元素 没收你口袋里的东西 把它变成出乎意料的一组独特的碎片 计划总计划!

source: When in doubt, be over-the-top! Jump into the board and kick all those dumb fancy warboard wooden pieces off. Roar!
target: 疑心重重的时候,就超出头来! 跳入板子,把那些愚蠢的花花公子 木板上的东西都踢了下来。 鲁尔!

source: Wow, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're kind of a pocket hoarder. How can one person have so many unwrapped mints?
target: 哗! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你是那种口袋囤积者。 一个人怎么会有这么多没有包装的薄荷薄荷?

source: Get this food off my battlefield! Why would we waste our defense budget feeding our troops when we could spend that money on more weapons and body bags?
target: 把这些食物从我的战场上拿开! 我们为什么要浪费我们的国防预算 来养活我们的部队? 因为我们可以把这笔钱花在更多的武器和尸体袋上?

source: And why are you throwing loose change at the board? Are you trying to imply we should PAY our soldiers?! The nerve!
target: 你为什么把零钱扔在板上? 你是在暗示我们应该付我们的士兵吗? 神经病!

source: Maybe %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is suggesting we lure our enemies out with the promise of riches right before we slaughter them?
target: 也许 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 是在暗示我们在屠杀敌人之前 用财富的保证引诱敌人出来吗?

source: Finally, you pull out the last item in your pocket: your virtual pet from the 90s!
target: 最后,你拿出你口袋里的最后一件东西:你90年代的虚拟宠物!

source: Well, now! This is interesting: an animalistic artificial intelligence, bound to a device allowing us to control it... I'll take it!
target: 现在! 这很有趣:一种动物主义的人工智能, 绑在一个设备上,让我们控制它... 我来拿!

source: For some reason, Bellanda takes a shine to your pet and keeps it. You lose -N2 MONEY (she also kept your loose change, rude).
target: 出于某种原因,贝兰达会取出一闪一闪的宠物并保存. -N2货币(她也让你的零钱不花,粗鲁)

source: A few days later, Bellanda and Miranda video chat with you from an active war zone.
target: 几天后,贝兰达和 米兰达 视频聊天 从活跃的战区。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Thanks again for suggesting we draft your AI into the war. Our roboticists constructed a much hardier, deadlier battle mech for it.
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 再次感谢您建议我们 起草你的AI进入战争。 我们的机器人制造了一个更坚硬,更致命的战斗。

source: I made them give it cute cat ears and a unicorn horn that shoots lasers at our enemies! War has never been so adorable!
target: 我让他们给它可爱的猫耳朵 和独角兽角 射向敌人的激光! 战争从未如此可爱过!

source: "My %FATHERMOTHER%, why have you forsaken me?!" cries the virtual pet in the background.
target: "我的爱人" %FATHERMOTHER%为什么你要抛弃我?

source: "I hate killing people! I want to go back to hanging on your keychain!"
target: "我讨厌杀人! 我想回到你的锁链上

source: Too bad! That pet is the only virtual character here whose feelings are irrelevant to you. You gain +N2 MIND for your clever thinking.
target: 太遗憾了! 宠物是唯一一个 与你无关的虚拟角色 你聪明的思维会得到+N2 MID.

source: Like a toddler with a god complex, you jump onto the table, kicking miniatures around and screaming. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 就像一个有神情的小孩, 你跳到桌子上,踢迷你 周围和尖叫。 你输了 -N2 SOUL。

source: How dare you desecrate our generals' most beloved war toys, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?! One thousand years dungeon for you!
target: 你竟敢亵渎我们将军们最爱的战争玩具 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?! 一千年的地牢给你!

source: Wait a minute... I don't know if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is a genius or just having a nervous breakdown, but this gives me an idea.
target: 单... 我不知道,如果 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 是个天才或只是精神崩溃,但这给了我一个想法。

source: Bellanda dismisses the generals and calls in some of the Merking's scientific advisors. She orders them to take your measurements and DNA samples.
target: 贝兰达辞退了将军,并召见了默克金的一些科学顾问. 她命令他们取取你的测量和DNA样本

source: Thanks for the help, tuna-brains. You've been useful, but now I'm gonna put you and your friends in "time out." Bye!
target: 谢谢你的帮助,金枪鱼。 你一直有用,但现在我要让你和你的朋友 进入"时间出来。"再见!

source: She kicks you out. Then, a few days later, Bellanda and Miranda video chat with you from an active war zone.
target: 她把你赶出去。 她把你赶出去。 几天后,贝兰达和 米兰达 视频聊天 从活跃的战区。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, guess what? Our scientists used your DNA to make this giant %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% clone fight in the war! Look!
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你猜怎么着? 我们的科学家利用你的DNA 制造出这个巨大的 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 克隆人在战争中战斗! 听着!

source: In the background, you see a frenzied, naked, ENORMOUS %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% stomping on buildings and eating people whole.
target: 在背景中,你看到一个疯狂的,裸体的,ENORMOUS %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 踩住建筑,把人全吃了.

source: Whoa, that is CRAZY. Why'd you create a giant clone of %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% specifically? And why'd you make it so... uncannily detailed?
target: 哇,这是疯狂。 为什么你们要专门创建一个 由%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 组成的巨型克隆? 你为什么这么... 不知不觉的详尽?

source: You were in the war room! The simulations we ran said we'd only win with a giant %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% squashing our foes. I leave nothing to chance!
target: 你在作战室里! 我们的模拟说,我们只赢一个巨人 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 消灭我们的敌人。 我一无是处!

source: As long as they're happy, you guess -- and as long as you aren't charged with any of your clone's war crimes. You gain +N2 HYPE for your help!
target: 只要他们高兴,你猜—— 只要你没有被指控任何克隆人的战争罪行。 +N2 HYPE 帮助你!

source: Join a gaming tournament
target: 参加比赛比赛

source: You find your friend Zoe checking out a poster for an eSports tournament happening at the con.
target: 你去找你的朋友,你去找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友,你找朋友 佐伊 检查一张海报 电子体育比赛在骗局上进行。

source: Hey, guys! Are you entering the "Dragon Heat Fighters XXX" eSports tournament too? There's a cash prize!
target: 嘿,伙计们! 你也参加"Dragon Heat Fighters XXX" eSports锦标赛吗? 有现金奖金!

source: Wow, they put SPORTS on COMPUTERS now? The future is amazing! I've never played this game, but I'll give it a try.
target: 哇,他们把 Sports 电脑现在? 未来是惊人的! 我从来没有玩过这个游戏, 但我会试一下。

source: Scott and Zoe enter the tournament. She gets knocked out in round three, but Scott is still going strong!
target: 斯科特 财务报告和审定财务报表 佐伊 进入锦标赛。 她被打倒在第三回合,但。 斯科特 仍然很强壮!

source: He's incredible! He's pulling off such unpredictable combos that the pros can't keep up!
target: 他简直是不可思议! 他的组合很不可预测, 职业选手无法跟上!

source: Thanks! My strategy is just hitting random buttons and hoping for the best. It's worked out really well so far!
target: 谢谢! 我的战略是按随机按钮 希望最好 已经很顺利了

source: Somehow, Scott makes it all the way to the final match. He's up against Igor Kalashnikov, the Dragon Heat Fighters reigning champion.
target: 不知怎的,我还是... 斯科特 一路赶到决赛 他和伊戈尔·卡拉什尼科夫对决 龙热战士夺得冠军

source: Shit, Scott's in trouble. Igor's a fuckin' juggernaut.
target: 妈的 斯科特'有事相会. 伊戈尔是个该死的犹太佬

source: He was biologically manufactured by the USSR to dominate every video gaming tournament on the planet and bring pride to Mother Russia!
target: 他被苏联生化制造出来 主宰着地球上的每场视频游戏比赛 给俄罗斯母亲带来骄傲!

source: Seriously? Didn't the USSR end, like, decades ago?
target: 真的吗? 苏联不是几十年前就结束了吗?

source: "Did it?" asks Igor disinterestedly. All of his button-pressing fingers have washboard abs. "I did not notice. I was too busy destroying puny Americans at video games."
target: "是吗?" 问了伊戈尔无趣。 他所有按下按钮的手指都有洗板腹部 "我没有注意到。 我忙着在电子游戏中摧毁美国小人物。”

source: Literally HOW does that make sense?
target: 到底这有什么道理?

source: Igor ignores her to mean-mug Scott. "I must break you, Dog," he spits. "I will crush you to bone-meal for destroying the USSR, capitalist scum!"
