source: Good work contributing to the slow death of art, champ. Now, back to the road trip!
target: 不错的工作,为艺术的缓慢死亡做出了贡献,冠军。 现在,回到公路旅行!

source: Bring the shop to the next level
target: 把店铺推到下一个高度

source: You and your friends get out of the car and enter... whatever this place is.
target: 你和你的朋友下车然后... 不管这里是什么

source: Welcome to my "Gift Shop," gullible consumers! Feast your eyes on my shelves of products!
target: 欢迎来到我的"美食店" 高贵的消费者! 眼睛睁大点,我的产品架子上!

source: Yeah, you've got a lot of cool rocks and stuff for sale here! What does all this stuff do?
target: 是啊,你有很多 很酷的石头和东西在这里出售! 这些东西都干什么的?

source: Haha, why ask questions when you can just enjoy things in ignorant bliss?
target: 哈哈,为什么问问题 当你可以享受 事物在无知的幸福中?

source: Hey, good point!
target: 嘿,说得好!

source: Noodles, you've got a really great business idea here. Have you ever considered bringing this little "Gift Shop" stand to the next level?
target: 面条,你有一个非常好的 商业想法在这里。 你有没有想过把这个小"吉普店"的摊位 带到下一个关卡?

source: Of course! Soon, my shop and I will ascend to the next evolutionary level, and then I will fight God!
target: 当然了! 很快,我和我的店会升入下一个进化阶段, 然后我会对抗上帝!

source: Cool, cool, but how are you gonna profit from that?
target: 酷,酷,但你怎么能从中获利?

source: Hmm, I guess I never considered that. Do you have any ideas?
target: 嗯,我想我从来没有考虑过。 你有什么想法吗?

source: Oh, yeah. My friends and I are TOTAL Business Masterz. Tell him, Scott!
target: 哦,对了。 我的朋友和我都是生意大师 告诉他 斯科特!

source: Can't talk now. I was smelling Noodles' mystery rocks and got one stuck up my nose.
target: 现在不能说话了 我闻到面条的神秘岩石 鼻子上卡了个

source: INHALE HARDER! EMBED MY CREATIONS INTO YOUR BRAIN!
target: 吸血药! 把我的心跳弹入你的脑海!

source: Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's up to you. Tell Noodles all about how we're gonna turn this little roadside stand into the hottest shop in the middle of nowhere!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%由你决定吧 告诉面条我们怎么把路边的小摊子 变成荒郊野外最热闹的店!

source: Guerrilla marketing: throw the products at unexpecting pedestrians. They will surely notice it when it hits their faces. And you can sell them more rocks to fight back!
target: 游击行销:将产品扔给未预料到的行人. 当它来临的时候,他们必定觉悟。 你可以卖出更多的石头来反击!

source: Plan a big, complex media strategy to redefine rock beauty canons so you can legally name these "precious stones" and sell them at a higher price point.
target: 计划一个大型复杂的媒体策略,重新定义岩石美食罐,这样你就可以合法地命名出这些"宝石",并在更高的价格点出售.

source: Our whole strategy is just throwing rocks at people? Won't that make everyone mad at us?
target: 我们的整个策略就是向人们扔石头? 会不会让大家都生我们的气?

source: Well, it's like they say: "Fuck around and find out!"
target: 就像他们说的"滚蛋去查清楚"

source: Noodles, with no hesitation or remorse, throws a rock at a passing pedestrian's forehead.
target: 面条一一不犹豫或悔恨地向行人行走前额扔出一石.

source: "OW!" says the pedestrian. "Why would you do that? You could've killed me!"
target: "OW!"行者说. "你为什么要这么做? 你本可以杀了我的!"

source: Trust me, dear customer: were it not for the laws of this land, I would have joyfully slaughtered you.
target: 相信我 亲爱的顾客 如果不是这个地的法律 我一定会杀了你

source: You, Polly, and Noodles throw more rocks at passers-by. If they didn't want rocks thrown at them, why did they come to the desert in the first place, right?
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉面条会向路人扔出更多的石头 如果他们不想被石头砸到 他们为什么一开始就跑到沙漠去,对吧?

source: Soon, an angry mob with a collective headache confronts Noodles' stand. "Why are you throwing rocks at us?!" they demand.
target: 很快,一群愤怒的暴徒 头痛的人群 面对面条的站。 "你为什么朝我们扔石头?" 他们要求的

source: Because I'm sick and twisted! But for a small fee, you can buy a rock of your own to throw back at me!
target: 因为我病了,而且扭曲! 但只要小费,你可以买出自己的石头来回向我扔!

source: "Fine, we will! Hope you like the taste of granite, motherfucker!"
target: "好,我们会的! 希望你喜欢花岗岩的味道,混蛋!"

source: They buy rocks to throw at Noodles. Noodles ducks, and the rocks phase right through Polly's forehead and hit MORE innocent bystanders.
target: 他们买石头去扔面条 面条鸭子,岩石相接 波莉额头和击中更多的无辜的旁观者。

source: Check it out! Word-of-mouth marketing! We did it, guys!
target: 看看这个! 口口口口口传销! 我们成功了,伙计们!

source: What you did was start an all-out rock-throwing war in the middle of the desert as people buy more rocks to throw at each other. Success, you guess?
target: 你所做的是在沙漠中部发动一场 全面抛出石头的战争 人们购买更多的石头 互相扔来扔去 成功吗?

source: After lots of market research, I think we can say for sure that throwing rocks at strangers isn't nice.
target: 经过许多市场研究,我想我们可以肯定地说,向陌生人扔石头是不善事的.

source: Yeah, fine, we lost -N2 SOUL. But Noodles paid us +N2 MONEY in consultancy fees. With that kinda cash, we can buy good karma!
target: - 是啊,我们输了 - N2 SOUL。 但面条公司给我们+N2 MONEY的咨询费. 有了这些钱,我们就能买到好货了!

source: You, Polly, and Scott put your heads together and lose -N2 MIND drafting up your marketing strategy to turn this granite into green.
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉,以及 斯科特 将花岗岩变成绿色。

source: How sweetly cynical! You're twisting the "everyone is beautiful" movement to convince others that my worthless stones are precious gems!
target: 多么甜蜜的愤世嫉俗! 你扭曲了"每个人都是美丽的"运动,以说服别人,我的一文不值的石头是珍贵的宝石!

source: Hey, c'mon, your definition is a really narrow way of looking at what we're trying to do here.
target: 嘿,来吧,你的定义 是一个非常狭窄的方式 来看待我们在这里试图做什么。

source: Sure, our marketing strategy seems like a mockery of redefining beauty standards, and it kinda plays on the idea that external beauty is equivalent to one's value...
target: 当然,我们的营销策略似乎在嘲弄重新定义美容标准,它有点在玩弄一种想法,即外部美相相当于一个人的价值......

source: But what we're REALLY doing is giving a big ol' middle finger to the precious gems industry. They've been committing crimes against monstrosity for YEARS.
target: 但我们真正要做的是 给珍贵的宝石产业一个大指头。 他们已经犯罪多年了

source: Gem companies create forced scarcity of their products and inflate the prices to convince you that diamonds are worth millions. But it's all a lie!
target: 宝石公司造成产品被强制稀缺,并抬高价格,以说服你钻石价值数百万. 但这一切都是谎言!

source: So if they're gonna use slave labor and market manipulation to sell their shiny rocks, why don't we fight the corrupt gem market with these regular rocks?
target: 如果他们要利用奴隶劳动和市场操纵 来出售闪亮的岩石, 我们为什么不用这些普通的岩石来打击腐败的宝石市场呢?

source: AND WE'LL MAKE LOTS OF MONEY AT THE SAME TIME! EVERYONE (who matters) WINS!
target: 同一时间我们会赚很多钱的 每个人(谁重要) WINS!

source: Wow! You gain +1 VALUABLE INSIGHT from this conversation (which isn't a stat in this game, but maybe it'll come in handy someday).
target: 哗! 你从这个对话中获得了+1 VALUBLE INSIGHT(这在这场游戏中不是一个统计,但也许有一天会有所帮助).

source: More to the point, your marketing campaign works, and Noodles is soon rolling in that sweet "precious stones" money. He pays you +N2 MONEY for your help.
target: 更何况你的营销运动也奏效了 面条很快就会滚入那块"珍贵的"钱里 他付你钱+N2钱来帮你

source: Look for cryptids
target: 寻找密码

source: Sometimes you go looking for the cryptid; sometimes the cryptid finds you.
target: 有时你去找密码;有时密码找到你。

source: At least, that's what happens when you, Polly, and Scott enter the woods and run into Moss Mann, your favorite moth-person from summer camp!
target: 至少,这就是会发生 当你, 波莉,以及 斯科特 进入树林里,跑到莫斯曼, 你最喜欢的蛾子人 从夏令营!

source: Hello, friends! Are you enjoying the national park?
target: 朋友们,你们好! 你享受国家公园吗?

source: I was just chatting with some of the park rangers. You wouldn't BELIEVE who Officer Riley's wife is sleeping with this week!
target: 我只是和一些公园护林员聊天 你不会相信谁 莱利警官的妻子 与这周睡觉!

source: Hey, Moss! You're still a messy, gossippy bitch I see.
target: 嘿,莫斯! 滚开! 你还是个乱七八糟的婊子

source: Always! But lately I've been pursuing other hobbies, such as enjoying the beauty of nature and training to fly into the sun.
target: 永远! 但最近我一直在追求其他爱好,比如享受大自然的美和飞入太阳的训练.

source: I definitely don't recommend you do that last thing, unless you wanna die.
target: 我绝对不建议你做最后一件事 除非你想死

source: I AM MORE THAN WILLING TO PERISH FOR MY PASSIONS!
target: 我更愿意为我的 选择而感到骄傲!

source: Sounds cool, bro! We were just on the hunt for some cryptids. Do you know where we could find any?
target: 听起来很酷,兄弟! 我们只是在寻找一些密码。 你知道我们在哪里能找到吗?

source: Besides my glorious self? Yes, this park is full of my fellow cryptids!
target: 除了我辉煌的自我? 是的,这个公园充满了我的朋友密码!

source: I could introduce you to one. I need to catch up with them anyway. We cryptids make great friends, but BOY are we hard to keep in touch with!
target: 我可以给你介绍一个 反正我还是得追上他们 我们的密码是好朋友, 但是男孩我们很难保持联系!

source: But I've got a hot date with a hot campfire this evening, so we only have time to visit one person. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, who would you prefer to meet?
target: 但我今晚有个热火的约会 所以我们只有时间去拜访一个人  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你想见谁?

source: Visit the Fresno Nightcrawler. He's always happy to teach friends the beautiful game of soccer!
target: 访佛斯诺夜叉. 他总是很高兴教朋友 足球的美丽游戏!

source: Have some tea and pastries at Sasquatch's secluded cabin where he hides from the paparazzi.
target: 在萨斯克奇的隐蔽小屋里喝茶和点心 他躲在狗仔队的门外

source: We're gonna meet a cryptid AND play a sport? Is today my birthday or something?!
target: 我们要见个秘密特工 并去玩个游戏? 今天是我的生日吗?

source: Moss leads you to an improvised soccer field in the woods. The Fresno Nightcrawler is playing on both teams, kicking a soccer ball between two tree-trunk goals.
target: Moss带你到树林里的简易足球场 弗雷斯诺夜行者在两队都出场,踢出两个树上跑入的入球之间的足球.

source: Isn't he a cutie? HEY, NIGHTCRAWLER! Long time no see!
target: 他不可爱吗? 嘿,夜惊吓! 好久不见!

source: ¡Che, Moss! ¡Qué bueno que viniste! You brought friends, I see.
target: 滚出我的车门! ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ! 你带了朋友来,我明白了

source: I'm Moss' friend Scott! You're a really great soccer player, bro. Do you wanna play a game together?
target: 我是莫斯的朋友,我是个好人 斯科特! 你是一个真正的伟大的足球运动员,兄弟。 你想一起玩游戏吗?

source: That sounds great! Soccer is my passion. It's actually where I got the name "Fresno Nightcrawler."
target: 听起来不错! 足球是我的激情,我爱足球 这正是我得到的名字 "弗雷斯诺夜行者"。

source: Most people think it's because I'm from California, but I'm actually Argentinian. "Fresno" comes from my stint on the Fresno soccer team.
target: 大多数人认为是因为我来自加利福尼亚州,但其实我是阿根廷人. "弗雷斯诺"来自我对弗雷斯诺足球队的打法.

source: That's so cool, bro! Do you have any good soccer tips for an amateur like me?
target: 痷琌次 你对像我这样的业余球员有什么好球秘诀吗?

source: Sure, let's have a cup of yerba mate and talk strategy. Now, the most important part of being a good soccer player is having a good heart, and GREAT calves.
target: 当然,让我们来杯Yerba的伴侣 和谈策略。 现在,做一个优秀的足球运动员最重要的部分 就是有一颗好心,还有大小牛。

source: You enjoy some good bitter mate while Scott and the Fresno Nightcrawler play a game of soccer. The Nightcrawler is a good sport, and coaches Scott on his techniques.
target: 你享受一些好苦的伴侣,而 斯科特 弗雷斯诺夜行者也打一场足球赛 夜行者是个好运动,教练 斯科特 他的技巧,他用的是"我"的手法

source: ¡Alta gambeta, Scott! Remember, it's not about kicking the ball hard. It's about kicking it with your heart!
target: 阿尔塔·甘贝塔, 斯科特! 记住,这不是要狠狠踢球 是要用心踢它! ! ! !

source: Sounds anatomically impossible, but I'll try! ¡Mucho gracias!
target: 解剖学上不可能 但我会尽力的! 穆乔・格拉西亚斯!

source: Wow, the Fresno Nightcrawler playing soccer with an opponent for the first time in decades! My gossip forum is going to FREAK.
target: 哇,弗雷斯诺夜行者 几十年来第一次与对手一起踢足球! 我的八卦论坛要到FREAK去

source: This has been the kickoff to a wonderful friendship. (See what I did there? See?!)
target: 这是一场精彩的友谊赛 (看到我做了什么吗? ) 看见没?

source: You lose -N2 MIND staring into Nightcrawler's burning, soulless eyes, but gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 你输了N2 MIND盯着"夜行者"的燃烧而无灵魂的眼睛,但得到+N2 HYPE!

source: ¡Aguante Argentina, la concha su madre!
target: 阿根廷,疯狂的阿瓜特!

source: Sounds fun! Sasquatch lives in a secluded cabin DEEP in the woods. We'll have to fly there to save time.
target: 听起来很有趣! 萨斯克住在一个隐蔽的小屋里 在树林里 我们不得不飞去那里 节省时间。

source: Moss scoops you all up and flies into the sky! After a very intense debate convincing him not to fly you into the sun together, you touch down at Sasquatch's cabin.
target: 莫斯把你全部挖出 飞入天空! 在一场激烈的争论中说服他不要一起飞入太阳后,你摸到萨斯克的船舱.

source: The legend himself is sitting on a rocking chair on the front porch, knitting the biggest pair of socks you've ever seen.
target: 传说自己正坐在前廊的摇椅上,织出你见过的最大一双袜子.

source: Hey, 'Squatch! Long time no see! I brought some friends to visit you, I hope that was okay.
target: 嘿,"小猪! 好久不见! 我带了些朋友来看你,希望没事

source: Hey, Moss! I don't mind, I'm just sorry I didn't clean up more. Forgive all these hair clumps, it's shedding season.
target: 嘿,莫斯! 滚开! 我不介意,我只是很抱歉我没有清理更多。 原谅我的头发,这是脱发季节。

source: RELATABLE, bro. It's so cool to meet you in person! Do you know how many internet forums there are for people just hoping to see you once?
target: 不错,兄弟。 见到你真酷! 你知道有多少互联网论坛 人们只是希望见到你一次?

source: Ugh, yes, I'm well aware of my stalkers. They're the reason I retreated into the woods in the first place.
target: 对,我很清楚我的跟踪者 初入林中即是因缘.

source: Being constantly hunted is irritating -- especially by paparazzis. Those insidious parasites follow me everywhere!
target: 不断被猎杀是令人烦恼的,尤其是被狗仔队猎杀。 那些阴险的寄生虫 到处跟着我!

source: They have bright, flashing, soulless lights for eyes, and they make the most horrible shutter-clicking cry!
target: 他们有闪光,无灵魂的光 眼睛,他们制造最可怕的 闪电快门的哭!

source: Squatch, I told you, there's no such thing as paparazzis. That's just a myth.
target: 斯克,我告诉过你,没有狗仔队这样的 这只是个神话。

source: They're real, and I've seen them! They stalk in the night, crawling out of their strange dimension to hunt me down!
target: 他们是真实的,我见过他们! 他们夜里追来 从奇怪的维度爬出来追我

source: That sounds terrible! How do you deal with it?
target: 听起来很可怕! 如何是道. 师曰.

source: I remain in seclusion. It's not bad; being unplugged from society has given me time to perfect my possum cookie recipe! Want to try some?
target: 我仍然被隔离着 不错,被社会所淘汰了,让我有时间完善我的负鼠饼干配方! 想尝尝吗?

source: Sure! You lose -N2 MIND listening to Sasquatch's paranoid paparazzi rants, but you gain +N2 STAMINA eating delicious possum pastries!
target: 当然! 你输了N2 MIND听萨斯克的偏执狗仔队的口号 但你却得到了+N2 STAMINA吃美味的负鼠糕点!

source: Go hiking
target: 远足去

source: You and your friends are checking out the trail map at the information kiosk when a huge, moth-shaped shadow blots out the sun.
target: 你和你的朋友在信息亭查看线索图 当一个巨大的,飞蛾状的阴影擦出太阳时

source: It's Moss Mann, your fire-loving friend from summer camp!
target: 是莫斯·曼 你夏令营的爱火朋友

source: Hey, guys! Do you want to take a hike with me? We could enjoy the tranquility of nature and swap juicy gossip along the way!
target: 嘿,伙计们! 你想跟我走走吗? 我们可以享受大自然的平静 并交换充满汁味的八卦

source: Sure! We were just deciding what trail to take.
target: 当然! 我们只是决定要走什么路

source: Oh, forget these "official" trails. My buddy Sasquatch told me all about a scenic off-the-map trail with beautiful views. Let me show you some REAL hiking!
target: 哦,忘了这些"官方"线索。 我的朋友萨斯克特告诉我 一段美丽的景象 远超地图的风景 让我告诉你一些真正的徒步旅行!

source: Two hours and -N2 STAMINA later...
target: 过了两个小时,然后是N2 Stamina

source: Fine, so I couldn't find the trail. You can't always rely on trail gossip to be true, okay? That's the beauty of it!
target: 好吧,所以我找不到线索。 你不能总是依赖小道八卦来做真实的,好吗? 这就是它的美丽!

source: I'm sure we'll find the path back to the car when we pass Bare Ass Boulder. I heard it's a boulder shaped like such a beautiful butt, it'll make you insecure about your own butt.
target: 我敢肯定,我们会找到回车的路径 当我们通过赤屁股的波尔德。 我听说它是一个巨石形状 像这么漂亮的屁股, 它会让你不安全感 关于自己的屁股。

source: Ugh, we're never getting out of here! You guys are gonna starve and die, and then we'll be a group of lost ghosts forever, and I will be SO MAD at you.
target: 我们永远也逃不掉的! 你们会饿死 然后我们永远成为一群迷途的鬼魂 而我会成为你最强的MAD

source: No, we'll survive this. We may just need to "rough it" for a while and get my tie muddy.
target: 不,我们会活下来的 我们也许只需要"克服"一下 得到我的领带泥。

source: Let's start by making a roaring campfire!
target: 开始做一场狂吼的营火吧!

source: Okay! Do you wanna start by burning this map?
target: 好,我们走! 你想先烧了这地图吗?

source: Scott, have you had a trail map with you this whole time?!
target: 斯科特你一直带着一张地图吗?

source: Yeah, I figured I'd keep one from the kiosk as a souvenir. Why, did you wanna use it for kindling earlier?
target: 是啊,我想我会保留一个 从亭作为纪念品。 你想用它来烧火吗?

source: For fuck's sake... you make a mental note to strangle Scott later. For now, check his map and figure out how to get the hell out of here!
target: 他妈的缘故... 你用心理笔记勒死我 斯科特 等会 现在,检查他的地图,并想出怎么离开这鬼地方!

source: The Mystical Journey to the Heart of the Park, where the lucky may find the Mythical Park Spirits, and the luckiest may even get a selfie with them!
target: 神秘之旅去公园之心,幸运者可能在那里找到神话之园之魂,最幸运者甚至可能得到自拍!

source: The path to Enlightenment.
target: 开悟之道.

source: What? I've never met any Park Spirits here.

source: ...I'm a little embarrassed now. If I give you +N2 MONEY, can we never speak of this again?
target: 我有点尴尬了 如果我给你+N2钱, 我们就不能再谈这个吗?

target: 精细。 如果你不退下,我们用老式的方法解决这个... 暴力! 暴力! 暴力! 暴力! 暴力! 暴力! 暴力! 暴力! 暴力!

source: ...Anyway, here's Wonderwall!

target: 斯科特 和酒吧播放更多的音乐, 你得到+N2 Suul 和平地解决问题! 但你输了N2 STAMINA共享 斯科特苹果 苹果 苹果 苹果 苹果 苹果

source: GM

target: 对... 他已经死了。 不要难过, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我永远不会死 只是看你的脸。

source: YAAAAAAWN. I'm already asleep. Not to bash nerdy shit, but this is SUPER played-out nerdy shit.
target: 亚阿阿翁. 我已经睡着了。 不是来打书呆子的,但这是SUPER 玩出书呆子的狗屎。

source: Maybe it's a good thing %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% killed that guy with %HISHER% face. Now we have a chance to improve his setting!
target: 也许这是件好事 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 杀了那个家伙 %HISHER% 脸 现在我们有机会改善他的环境了!

target: 设计一个依赖于微交易的复杂经济. 当今移动游戏中流行得如此之多,以至于一定是玩家最喜欢的东西! 对吧?

source: Introduce these people to the REAL adventure: a world where they must brace for an upcoming prom while attending a school where they do everything but learning.
target: 让这些人了解真正的冒险:一个他们必须迎接即将到来的舞会的世界,同时他们必须上学,除了学习之外,他们什么都做。

source: After a few hours of setup and revisions, the LARPers arrive. For their sake, you hope they brought their wallets!
target: 经过几个小时的设置和修改,LARPers人到达了. 为了他们,你希望他们带了钱包!

source: En garde, villains! My adventuring party and I are here to slay the evil sorceress! But first, do you have a quest for us to gather experience?
target: 站好,坏蛋们! 我和我的冒险派对是来杀邪恶女巫的! 但是首先,你有没有 寻求我们收集经验?

source: Sure! Here's a direwolf. Slay that thang.
target: 当然! 这是一只狼人 击倒那个比克。

source: You set up a cardboard direwolf. The fighter slashes it to pieces.
target: 你设置了纸板 恶狼。 拳手把它打成碎片

source: Oop, sorry boo. Your DMG output wasn't quiiiiite high enough to slay the direwolf. But for +N2 MONEY, you can increase your DMG by 80% for 48 hours!
target: 哦,对不起嘘。 你的DMG输出不够高 不足以杀死狼人 但对于+N2 Moneyy,你可以在48小时内将你的DMG增加80%!

source: Ooh, do you have any upgrades for me? I'll easily pay that amount for an increase in lute-playing! That sounds way easier than practicing my scales!
target: 哦,你有什么升级给我? 我很容易就付了那笔钱 来增加玩花花样! 这听起来比练习我的鳞片容易得多!

source: COMMERCIAL BREAK TIME! Have you guys ever tried Scott Snacks? They're the yummiest treat for the adventurer on the go!
target: 商业打气时间! 你们试过吗? 斯科特 零食吗? 冒险家最受欢迎的

source: Pah! I'm an immortal vampire; a creature of the night! I have no use for your pedestrian junk food!
target: 摆! 我是不朽的吸血鬼,是夜之生物! 我用不着你的行人垃圾食品!

source: They come in Cherry Blood Flavor!
target: 他们来樱桃血花!

source: SHUT UP AND TAKE MY MONEY!
target: 闭上嘴,拿我的钱!

source: Congratulations, adventurers! For watching the whole advertisement, you win a spin on our LOOT WHEEL for a 0.6% chance to win a fantastic prize!
target: 恭喜你们,冒险家们! 观看整部广告 你赢得了我们的LOOT WHEEL的一圈 以0.6%的机会赢得一个精彩的奖品!

source: Finally, rewards for my efforts! Let's spin!
target: 最后,奖励我的努力! 转一转!

source: It's slowing down! Your prize is... horseshit! Literally! You can keep it -- no need to thank us!
target: 减速了! 你的奖品是... 胡说八道! 说真的! 你可以留着它 - 不用谢我们!

source: Uh... no thanks. Can we just continue the quest now?
target: 额... 不,谢谢。 我们现在可以继续探险了吗?

source: Sorry, boo. You guys are all out of questing energy for the day. It replenishes automatically in 6 hours -- or you can pay to refill it now!
target: 对不起,嘘。 你们今天都快没精力了 6小时后自动补充,否则你现在就可以付钱补充了!

source: Seriously? I took a day off work and spent hours making cosplay just for this to suck! I'm going home.
target: 真的吗? 我休息一天 花几个小时做cosplay 只是为了这个吸! 我要回家了 说吧

source: Who'd have thought making a LARP pay-to-win would be an unpopular decision?! You lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 谁想到LARP的赢赢是不受欢迎的决定? -你输了 -N2 HYPE.

source: Over the next few hours, you build some sets and get into costume. Soon, the first LARPers arrive.
target: 接下来的几个小时里,你造出一些装置,然后穿上服装. 很快,第一批LARPERs人来了.

source: En garde, villains! My adventuring party and I are here to slay the evil sorceress! Prepare to fight!
target: 站好,坏蛋们! 我和我的冒险派对是来杀邪恶女巫的! 准备战斗!

target: 不,我们不再这样做了。 现在LARP只讲做Spooky学院的学生,那里充满了危险和角!

target: 在这种情景下,当野生的金刚出现时,你在浴室里跳课! 你们是做什么的?

source: I use my greatsword to behead the beast!
target: 我用我的大刀砍了野兽的头!

source: Actually, you can't. Your only two options are to turn the griffin into a rapper or bake it into a pasta.

target: 让我们做一个音乐! 蠢蛋,魔力点!

target: 现在,为了这个事件,你需要 扔一堆聚会来发现 秘密的成分, 使所有政党都伟大! 你们是做什么的?

source: Oh, um... I wouldn't even know where to start. I've never actually been invited to a party...
target: 哦,嗯... ... 说说看... 我甚至不知道从何说起 我从来没有被邀请参加一个派对...

source: Goddamn, are you serious? That's so mean! Humans really ARE the real monsters, huh?
target: 该死,你是认真的吗? 这么卑鄙! 人类真的是真正的怪物,是吧?

target: 继续前进!

target: 现在你必须帮助你的吸血鬼朋友 变得受欢迎 足以被冠以舞会之名!

source: R-Really? That sounds... awesome!
target: 真的吗? 这听起来... 厉害!

source: I was never popular enough to be prom king back in the day. This is the wildest fantasy ever!
target: 我从来没有被欢迎 成为舞会王的 回到了当年。 这是有史以来最疯狂的幻想!

source: The LARPers have a great time cosplaying as people who were happy and popular in high school. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 拉尔普人作为高中时快乐而受欢迎的人,有着极佳的相声. 你得到了+N2 HYPE!

source: But this all reminds you that you learned nothing in school 'cause you were too busy being Chaotic Horny, and you lose -N2 MIND from all these nonsensical scenarios you present.
target: 但是这都提醒你,你在学校里什么都没学到 因为你忙于做"性感黄蜂" 而你却从你提出的所有这些非感官的情景中失去了N2 MIND

source: NPC
target: 国家警察局

target: 你准备好穿上中世纪的服装和米酒了! 你只需要买票。 他们只花了...

target: 七五块? 就整天拿着木剑站在热的太阳下? 上帝,书呆子会为任何事付出代价的

source: "If the tickets are too pricey for you, you could get in free if you fill in for some of our NPCs who didn't show up today," the ticket-seller offers.
target: "如果票价太高,你也可以免费入场,如果你填写一些今天没有到场的我们的国家计委","票商出价出价".

target: 非玩家角色(英语:And-player specific). 他们没有真正的自主性,只存在与玩家角色互动,使游戏有趣.

source: Oh... Polly, are we NPCs?

source: I try not to think about it.

target: 算了,我们开始吧! 你有没有给性感的女酒保 偶尔会把酒滴到她那浓郁的胸口的?

source: "Uh... no, we don't have anything like that."
target: "U. 不,我们没有这样的东西。"

source: Can I be an Abraham Lincoln NPC? I heard he had a cool hat!
target: 我能成为亚伯拉罕·林肯的NPC吗? 我听说他戴了顶好帽子!

target: "什麽? 没有。 "对不起,你必须从现有的国家计委名单中选择一些东西".

target: 呃,没事。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我们该是什么样的国家警察局?

source: The random NPCs who sit in the same spot all day and repeat the same sentence again and again when interacted with. Sounds chill!

target: 皮扎皮诺姆法!

target: 你输了N2钱 从比萨店拿来+N2 Stamina 至少味道不错!

source: And if you can one day achieve at least half the charm Polly and Scott have, that'd be a win in your book!
target: 如果你有一天能达到至少一半的魅力 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 已经是了,那会是你书上的一个胜利!

source: Shoplifting
target: 偷盗店铺

target: 当你在寻找最好的商店偷东西时, 你看见你的朋友瓦莱丽坐在中央喷泉上发短信。 她抬头一看,对你微笑

target: 嘿,陌生人们。 你在商场干什么?

target: 我们不会说笑的!

source: Smooth, Scott.

target: 别担心,我不会告密的 我也很喜欢偷东西

target: 便宜又刺激,你只能坚持到"男人"身上去!

target: 男的吗? 哪个男人? 他为什么这么粘?

target: 额... 没关系。 我猜你们是新来的店里偷东西吧? 也许我可以帮忙。

target: 一半的工作是不会紧张的。 气氛好,没人怀疑你 试试吹口哨,把屎塞进口袋里

target: 如果你被抓了,就假装是一个来自中世纪时代的时间旅行者,他们仍然不明白纸币或商场的概念. 每次都会工作

target: 瓦莱丽有很棒的提示! 唯能决定取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取. 来点什么?

source: You stole hearts back in your Prom days; it's time to shoplift some hearts!
target: 你从舞会上偷回了心 是时候去偷取一些心了!

target: 偷取监控摄像头 这将为今后的商店盗窃铺平道路。 再加上安全摄像头是唯一不能看的

target: 偷店长的身份 只是一个简单的偷窃,它会自动 使商店的一切你。

target: 好吧,我得到了六个键链和一些怪异的屁股DVD! 你们呢?

source: I got a kidney!
target: 我有肾!

target: 在几次逮捕尝试失败后,联邦调查局决定手术重建麦克曼格的脸,以看起来像"%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%",这样他就可以从内部拆散这个家族......

target: "他们必须",长官说. "当人们撒谎时,这绝不是精心策划的. 麦克曼格 - 我的意思是, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你会坐牢的!"

source: The real manager is arrested, and you get to keep all his products. You make +N4 MONEY selling some of it, and +N2 HYPE throwing the rest in a bonfire for the lolz.
target: 真正的经理被捕了,你就可以保留他的所有产品 你让+N4货币 出售一部分, +N2 HYPE 扔其余的 在篝火 为Lolz。

target: 你和你的朋友们进入了邪教的祭祀之室 带着在恐怖电影中死去的 第一位人物的所有乐观

target: 看看这本圣手册! "祭祀完成取悦Mh'athra" "神圣的隐秘和黑暗之神"

target: "完成牺牲将使Mh'athra的崇拜者尝到其独有的神奇力量".

source: Oh yeah. Only now do you realize you lost -N2 HYPE, -N3 MIND, and -N1 STAMINA because you spent all day fantasizing about being a horse instead of eating or being normal.
target: 哦,对了。 现在才意识到你失去了N2 HYPE,N3 MIND,和N1 StAMINA 因为你整天幻想着做一匹马而不是吃东西或者正常生活

source: At least %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% got +N6 MAGIC from the horsies as thanks for being so obsessed with them. Now we have gas for the car!
target: 起码 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 得到+N6 MAGIC 从Horsies 作为感谢 如此迷恋他们。 现在我们有车用油了!

source: Yep, that's true... but you're reminded that you only need the car because you're not a horse and can't run fast. Your dreams will never come true... oh well.
target: 没错,这的确... 但你被提醒说 你只需要车 因为你不是马 跑不快 你的梦想永远不会实现... 哦,不错。

source: Work a machine
target: 工作机器 工作机器 工作机器

source: You approach the foreman and ask if you and your friends could work at the factory for a day.
target: 你接近工头,问 你和你的朋友能不能在工厂工作一天。

source: "For... just one day?" he asks. "I mean, that's not really how employment contracts work."
target: "为. 一天就好?"他问。 "我的意思是,这不是真正的如何 就业合同工作。"

source: How do they work, then?
target: 那么,他们是如何工作的?

source: "They work... well... hm. I dunno. Now that I think about it, half our employees are in draconian contracts with nonsensical clauses, and half have no contract at all."
target: "他们工作... 这个嘛... 垛 我不知道,我还没说完 现在我想到这一点,我们一半的雇员在严谨的合同中,有非感性条款,一半完全没有合同".

source: "You know what? Fuck it. Some of my guys called in today anyway. You can fill in for them."
target: "你知道吗? 他妈的。 我的人今天打电话来 你可以替他们填字".

source: Cool! Is there any sort of training we need to do to operate the equipment properly?
target: 凉爽! 是否有任何训练,我们需要做 正确操作设备?

source: "Nah. You'll just be screwing Screw 3B into Panel A for eight-to-twelve hours. It isn't hard."
target: "不见. 你只会在8到12小时内 3B进入A小组 并不难".

source: Got it. So, what's your company's position on office romances? What's the policy on sharing company-related memes?
target: 明白了,我马上去 那么,你公司在办公室浪漫方面的立场是什么? 分享公司相关元件的政策是什么?.

source: Is there a group chat for all the employees? Are there any rules on using lewd emojis?
target: 是否有集体聊天 全体员工? 有没有关于使用淫秽的情感规则?

source: "What? We don't have policies for any of that stuff. Our employees almost never talk to each other. I could probably only name like three of the 300 guys on the floor."
target: "什麽? 我们没有政策 任何的东西。 我们的雇员几乎从不说话 我可能只能说出三个人的名字"

source: Good to know! What's your brand philosophy?
target: 很高兴知道! 你的品牌哲学是什么?

source: "Brand philosophy? Uh... does 'screw Screw 3B into Panel A for eight-to-twelve hours' count as a philosophy?"
target: "勃朗哲学? 额... 将3B 冲入A小组8到12小时 算作是哲学吗?

source: Works for you! You sidle up to start screwing Screw 3B into Panel A for eight-to-twelve hours. What could be more fun?
target: 为你效劳! 你开始操他妈的3B进入A小组8到12小时 有什么更好玩的吗?

source: ...After about fifteen minutes, you realize that anything, ANYTHING, would be more fun than doing this.
target: ...15分钟后,你意识到 任何事情,任何事物,都会比做这个更有趣。

source: Luckily, since there's no contract at work here, it's up to you to decide how hard to work today. So, how much are you committing to this torture?
target: 幸好这里没有合同 今天要由你来决定工作有多辛苦 你对这折磨要付出多少钱?

source: Oof, what if you just bribe the dude next to you to assemble both Screws 3B and 4B into Panel A while you play Solitaire?
target: 不如你贿赂旁边的人 把3B和4B都装进A组 一边玩索利泰?

source: Just work, dammit. No jokes here. We, the writers, always work for you to have fun. Today, YOU work and WE play.
target: 工作,妈的。 这里没有笑话。 我们,作家们,总是为你工作 以获得乐趣。 今天,你工作,我们玩。

source: WORK FOREVER! Work until life looks like a Panel A that ought to be solved by assembling a Screw 3B into it... where the Screw 3B is work. This is your life now.
target: 永远工作! 工作到生活看起来像一个A小组 应该通过把3B螺丝钉装进去来解决 螺丝3B是工作。 这就是你现在的生活了

source: Hey, it's not like you're not compromising here. Solitaire fucking sucks. But at the end of the day, it's what people play at work, right?
target: 嘿,这又不是你没有妥协 索利泰他妈的烂透了。 但最终人们在工作上玩的就是这个,对吧?

source: The guy next to you agrees to the bribe. He does your work while you play some of the most exciting games of Solitaire of your life.
target: 你旁边的人同意贿赂 他做你的工作 而你玩一些最激动人心的游戏 索利泰你的生活。

source: You thought you were gonna lose that first game when you couldn't find the ace of clubs, but you saved it when you finally moved the five of diamonds aside!
target: 你以为你找不到梅花A的时候会输掉第一场比赛 但你却在把钻石五号移到一边的时候救了它

source: You later mixed things up by drawing THREE cards at a time instead of one. It really raised the difficulty level, but you mastered it soon enough!
target: 你后来把事情搞混了,一次画三张牌,而不是一张。 这真的提高了难度,但你很快就掌握了!

source: Then there was that time you shuffled the cards between games and somehow got THE EXACT SAME CARD ORDER.
target: 然后有一次你把牌打得一团糟 不知怎么的得到了"EXACT"的同名CARDER

source: The probablity of that happening is 0.00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000002%! It's only slightly more likely to happen than you getting a date this Friday!
When your shift ends, you've gained +N2 HYPE from playing Solitaire. Ha, working isn't so hard! People should stop complaining so much and start getting better at Solitaire.
target: 值班结束后从出道后从"索利泰"中获得了+N2 HYPE. 哈,工作不是那么难! 人们应该停止抱怨这么多,开始在索利泰好起来.

source: You meet back up with your friends to see how much money you made between the three of you.
target: 你和你的朋友见面 看看你们三个之间赚了多少钱

source: Wait, we were supposed to MAKE money? I spent my entire paycheck on these cute company coveralls. Whoops.
target: 等等,我们本来要赚钱的? 我花了我的全部薪水 给这些可爱的公司盖子。 呜呼.

source: They didn't pay me 'cause I accidentally ate all the screws.
target: 他们没付钱,因为我意外地吃了所有的螺丝.

source: Well, you actually lost -N2 MONEY, because it turns out you bribed that guy more than a day's wages. No wonder he was so eager to accept.
target: 你输了N2货币 因为你贿赂了那家伙 一天多的工资 难怪他那么热衷于接受

source: Oh well. At least you got to play Solitaire all day, the premiere card game for lonely losers!
target: 哦,不错。 至少你必须整天玩索利泰, 独家的失败者牌游戏!

source: Yeah, you know what? Fuck you. We're taking the day off.
target: 是啊,你知道吗? 去你妈的 我们休息一天

source: You screw Screw 3B into Panel A or whatever. I don't care.
target: 你管3B进入A小组什么的 不顾所取.

source: Meanwhile, the writers are having a contest to see who can stuff the most cookies in their mouth!
target: 作家们正在参加一场比赛 来看看谁能把最美味的饼干塞进嘴里

source: Another Screw 3B. You know what you're gonna do? That's right, screw it into Panel A.
target: 又一个"螺丝"3B. 你知道你打算怎么办吗? 没错,把它扔进A小组

source: Ooh, it looks like the writers are learning how to play the xylophone now! Godspeed, you funky creatives!
target: 哦,看起来作家们 正在学习如何演奏xylophone了! 祝你们好運,你们这些怪人!

source: Screw 3B; Panel A. Screw 3B; Panel A. Screw 3A; Panel B... wait, did I get that right? Eh.
target: 螺丝3B; 第A小组. 螺丝3B; 第A小组. 螺丝3A; B小组... 等等,我听对了吗? 额

source: I'm too busy drawing wacky fan art to care! That's right, writers can make fan art too, even if we can't do it very well!
target: 我忙着画疯迷的艺术 根本不在乎! 不错,作家也可以做粉丝艺术,即使我们做不好!

source: Shit, I think the creative director saw me goofing off. Uh, back to your regularly scheduled antics!
target: 糟糕,我想创意总监看到我傻了 回到你定期的肛门!

source: You know what? I'm sick of this! Screw Screw 3B!
target: 你知道吗? 我受够了! 滚开3B!

source: But not "screw it" as in "screw it into Panel A." "Screw it" as in "screw this shit, let's leave before we lose any more -N2 HYPE."
target: 但不要像"把它扔入A小组"那样"把它扔出","把它扔出这个狗屎,让我们离开,再失去任何N2 HYPE"那样".

source: You leave with a newfound appreciation for the people behind this whole thing, who in their own way screwed the Screws 3B into the Plaques A of this game.
target: 你带着新的感激离开 幕后黑手 他们以他们自己的方式把3B螺丝钉 弄入了这场游戏的A分会

source: You also leave with +N2 MONEY for the work you did today. Woohoo!
target: 你和钱币+N2也一起离开,因为你今天的工作。 呜呼!

source: Yes. YES. This is your dream. When other kids wanted to be astronauts or rockstars, you knew your calling was to screw Screw 3B into Panel A.
target: 对 对。 这是你的梦想 当其他孩子想成为宇航员或摇滚明星时, 你知道你的使命是把"螺丝3B" 搞入A小组.

source: You throw yourself mind, body, and soul into the work. You are one with your screws and panels.
target: 你把自己的心灵,身体,灵魂投入到工作之中. 你是一个有螺丝和相板的人。

source: They're your flesh and blood; they're your tether to this dreary world; they're life, love, and God incarnate!!!
target: 他们是你的血肉; 他们是你对这个阴沉世界的束缚; 他们是生命,爱,还有上帝的化身!

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, that was the lunch bell! Wanna eat with us?
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%那是午餐铃声! 想和我们一起吃吗?

source: Who needs lunch? I'll happily lose -N3 STAMINA. I'll sustain myself on the +N1 MAGIC of worshipping Screw 3B!
target: 谁需要吃午饭? 我很乐意输掉 -N3 Stamina. 我会在+N1 MAGIC上维持自己 崇拜"螺丝3B"!

source: Oh no. Scott, I think %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s obsessive-addictive personality is making %HIMHER% lose %HISHER% -N2 MIND over this!
target: 哦,没有。  斯科特我觉得 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%令人着迷的性格正在形成 %HIMHER% 输 %HISHER% - 注意这个!

source: DON'T LISTEN TO HER, SCOTT. THIS ANTI-SCREW 3B RHETORIC IS BLASPHEMY OF THE HIGHEST ORDER!
target: 别听她的,斯科特。 这个3B的反射是最高命令的闪光!

source: Yep, %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% gone off the deep end.
target: 没错, %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% 远离了深渊

source: I'll get the net.
target: 取取取来净.

source: Scott and Polly net you like a fish and carry you kicking and screaming back to the car.
target: 斯科特 财务报告和审定财务报表 波莉 网你喜欢一条鱼 并背你踢和尖叫回车。

source: You lose -N1 HYPE from being separated from your precious screws, but at least you earned +N4 MONEY for working so hard.
target: 你因为被从你珍贵的螺丝上分开而失去 -N1 HYPE,但至少你因为这么努力工作而挣得+N4 Moneyy.

source: And the company is so grateful that you worked so hard that they give you a bonus +N1 SOUL! Fuck yeah, who said capitalism was soulless?
target: 公司非常感激你努力工作 给了你+N1 Suul奖金! 说资本主义是无灵魂的?

source: Test a product
target: 测试产品

source: What's the best thing to do at a factory? Touch shit you aren't supposed to! You tell your friends you'd like to test out the final product they manufacture here.
target: 工厂里最擅长的是什么? 碰狗屎你不应该! 你告诉你的朋友,你想测试 他们在这里制造的最终产品。

source: I'm in! Where is the final product, though? And WHAT is it? Do you know, ma'am?
target: 我进去了! 最终产品呢? 是什么来着? 你知道吗,夫人?

source: "Are you talking to me?" asks one of the workers. "I dunno what the final product does. I don't think anyone does."
target: "你在跟我说话吗?" 问一个工人 "我不知道最终产品会做什么. "我想没有人会这么做"

source: "I've spent 32 years screwing Screw 4B into Panel A. I'm not paid to know what the hell it's all for."
target: "我花了32年时间 和Screw 4B 混入A小组 我拿钱不是为了知道这些东西的用途。”

source: Well, do you at least know where we should go to find the final product?
target: 好吧,你至少知道 我们该去哪里找到最后的产品?

source: "Hmm... I've heard some of the retirees speak of a magical, faraway sector where the assembly line comes to an end."
target: "嗯... . . . . . . 我听说过一些退休人员说到一个神奇而遥远的区段,在那里组装线会结束".

source: "I've never believed in such hogwash, but if you're looking for the final product, that's the only place I can think to check."
target: "我从不相信这种猪肉","但如果你在找最终的产品,那我只能想到这个地方去检查".

source: Sweet! You hop in a forklift and start driving down the assembly line, taking in its processes along the way:
target: 可爱! 你跳上叉车,开始驾驶下 装配线, 沿途的流程:

source: You pass an employee screwing Screw 5B onto Panel A.
target: 你将一个员工 螺丝5B 螺丝5B 转到A小组。

source: You pass an employee embossing the logo for "Everweasel Electronics" on Panel A.
target: 你通过一个员工 化了"Everweasel电子"的标志 在A小组。

source: You pass a priest blessing Panel A's pilgrimage down the assembly line.
target: 你通过一个牧师祝福小组A的朝圣 在集合线下。

source: You pass an employee smashing the absolute shit out of Panel A with an electric hammer.
target: 你通过一个员工 用电锤砸出A小组的绝对狗屎。

source: You pass an employee sanding off the "Everweasel Electronics" logo from Panel A.
target: 你从A小组传来了一名员工的"Everweasel电子"标识

source: You pass employees screwing Screw 6B onto Panel A.
target: 你让员工去操蛋6BA小组

source: At the end of the line, behind a heavy curtain, you find Noodles! He picks up the completed Panel A and tosses it in the trash.
target: 线后一幕又一幕又一幕又一幕,你找面来! 他拿起完成的A小组,扔入垃圾桶。

source: Why did you throw away Panel A, bro? People worked hard on that!
target: 你为什么扔掉A小组,兄弟? 别人很努力的

source: Did they? I dunno. I always throw out Panel A. It's got bad vibes.
target: 是吗? 我不知道,我还没说完 我总是扔出A小组。 其气相去不畅.

source: Well, we wanted to test out the final product you guys are making. Do you have it?
target: 我们想测试你们最后的产品 你有吗?

source: Final product? Which one? I make something different every time.
target: 最后产品? 哪个? 我每次都做点不同的事

source: The designs come to me in dark prophetic visions!
target: 设计是用黑暗的预言来给我的!

source: Okaaaay... well, there are two freshly-made final products here. Which one do you try out?
target: 欧克亚... 这儿有两件新出品的终极产品 你试哪一个?

source: The Washing KarMachine
target: 洗涤卡马钦

source: The huge, inefficient contraption that burns a lot of fuel to produce a tiny fortune
target: 巨大的,低效的装置 燃烧大量的燃料 产生一大笔钱

source: I don't get it. Does the machine, like, wash your karma?
target: 岂能通取. 机器会洗你的因果吗?

source: Yep!
target: 没错!

source: What does that even mean, though? Karma is lost and gained; it doesn't get washed. Karma doesn't get dirty... does it?
target: 这是什么意思,虽然? 嘉陵已去而得;取而取之而取之而取之而取之;取而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取之而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取而取之而取而取而取而取而取而取而取 嘉马不会弄脏... 是吗?

source: Of course it does! But this machine will wash those greasy, hateful impurities from your tarnished soul.
target: 当然了! 但是这台机器会洗去你被玷污的灵魂所留下的 油腻而可憎的杂质

source: Okay, but soul and karma are different.
target: 好吧,但灵魂和因果是不同的。

source: Yeah, but I liked the pun! It's all made-up concepts anyway, so who cares?
target: 是的,但我喜欢这个双关语! 反正都是编造出来的,那谁在乎呢?

source: What do you mean? Are you saying souls and karma aren't real?
target: 你说什么? 你是说灵魂和因果不是真的吗?

source: They can be real if you're willing to pay!
target: 如果你愿意付钱,他们就能是真的!

source: Put a coin in the Washing KarMachine, and I'll believe karma is the underwear of your soul or whatever you want. Who gives a shit?
target: 在洗卡马钦牌上放一分钱 我相信因果报应是你的内衣 或你想要的任何东西 谁在乎呢?

source: But why would I pay for something that I know is a scam?
target: 但我为什么要付钱 某事我知道是骗局?

source: For the same reason people devote themselves to priests and gurus and abstract deities: pure desperation for meaningful purpose in an uncaring universe!
target: 也正是出于同样的原因 人们全心全意地投入到牧师和神灵和抽象神灵身上: 纯粹的绝望,在一个无爱的宇宙中,为了有意义的目的!

source: ...Yeah, okay, can't argue with that. Here's -N2 MONEY.
Thanks! I'm going to remove your souls for the cleansing now. Noodley-doodley-doo!
target: 谢谢! 我要把你们的灵魂清除出来 洗干净 诺德利-多德-多德-多德!

source: Noodles does some weird dance and makes some noises. He doesn't even turn on the KarMachine! What the fuck is going on?!
target: 面条会跳出怪舞,并发出一些噪音. 他甚至不打开卡马奇尼! 到底发生什么事了?

source: After a few minutes, he "gives back" your "cleansed souls." Hmm, you actually do feel like you gained +N2 SOUL! Real or placebo, who knows, who cares?
target: 几分钟后,他"还"了你的"被洗净的灵魂",嗯,你确实觉得你得到了+N2 Suul! 真正的还是安慰剂 谁知道呢 谁在乎呢?

source: Okay! We just need magic to power the machine, and your fortunes will be manifested!
target: 好,我们走! 我们只需要魔法来为机器提供动力, 你的命运就会显现出来!

source: Are you sure it's a good idea to use magic on this? Like, isn't that an important thing we need to drive the car and--?
target: 你确定用魔法来对付这个是好主意吗? 开这辆车不是很重要吗?

source: TOO LATE TO CHANGE YOUR MIND! Away we go!
target: 改变主意太迟了! 出发!

source: Noodles hits the machine with a giant hammer. It whirs to life, cranking gears and spewing smog and killing the ozone layer before your eyes.
target: 面以巨锤打出相机. 它会呼唤生命, 调动齿轮和喷出烟雾, 并杀死臭氧层 在你的眼前。

source: At last, the gears stop, and from the machine's chassis, three fortunes are printed off.
target: 终于取出齿轮停了,从机底盘上印出相克三分.

source: Mine says, "In the near-ish future, a thing with a degree of importance will happen and affect your day." Good to know!
target: 我的说,"在近近的将来,一个具有一定重要性的事情会发生,影响你的一天",知道就好了!

source: Mine says, "To achieve bliss, become soda." Wow, deep!
target: 我的说,"为了实现幸福, 成为苏打水" 哇,深!

source: Mine says, "An off-putting green jellyfish thing will scam you into losing -N2 MAGIC. You will gain +N2 MIND learning not to do it again."
target: 我说的是 "一个不吃水母的绿色水母会骗你输掉 -N2 MAGIC。 你会得到+N2 MIND学习 不再这样做。"

source: Whoa, super accurate!
target: 哇,超准确的!

source: Seize the means of production
target: 没收生产资料

source: You and your friends crash a union meeting. It seems all the factory workers have turned up to list some complaints to tell the factory boss.
target: 你和你朋友会开工会会 看来所有的工厂工人都来列出一些投诉,告诉工厂老板.

source: "Let's tell the boss we won't work weekends anymore," says one worker. "I've missed so many good TV show premieres!"
target: "让我们告诉老板我们不会再工作周末了",一位工人说. "我错过了这么多优秀的电视节目首映!"

source: "Let's demand better snacks in the vending machines!" says another. "I'm sick of off-brand potato chips and candy bars!"
target: 另一则说: "我受够了离地的土豆片和糖果条"

source: "Tell the boss man that we won't come back to work until my wife lets me get another cat!" says a third. "It's totally unfair that I can't have more cats!"
target: "告诉老板,我们不会回来工作 直到我的妻子让我得到另一个猫!"说出第三. "我不能再养猫了,这完全不公平"

source: Ooh, I've got one! Tell that mean boss man you demand a raise of +2 milkbones an hour!
target: 哦,我有一个! 说吧,老板,你要求加薪 +2牛奶骨每小时!

source: Tell the boss you're not working another minute until he gives you a six-month vacation, twice a year.
target: 告诉老板你再不工作了 直到他给你六个月的假期,一年两次

source: With your demands decided, you all storm the boss' office. You break down the door... and find no one inside!
target: 有了你的要求 你们就冲进老板的办公室 你打破了门... 里面没人

source: "Whoa, where's the boss?" they ask. "Could it be that... we've never even HAD a boss?"
target: "哇,老板在哪里?" 他们问。 "可能是这样的... "我们甚至从来没有过老板?"

source: "Does anyone remember even meeting him? Or did this factory just show up one day, and we assigned ourselves jobs and conditions because it seemed logical?"
target: "有人记得甚至遇见他吗? 或者这家工厂有一天才出现, 我们为自己分配了工作和条件, 因为看起来很合理。”

source: "If there's no boss, then I WANNA BE THE BOSS!" shouts a worker. "First rule is I make ALL the money, and anyone who bitches about it gets fired!"
target: "如果没有老板,那么我想成为老板!" 喊工人。 "第一规则是我赚了所有的钱,任何对它进行指责的人都会被解雇"

source: Shit, now everyone's gonna wanna be the boss. And whoever becomes the boss will just be hated by everyone else and kicked out! It's a never-ending cycle!
target: 妈的,现在每个人都想当老板了 成为老板的人就会被别人讨厌 被赶出去 循环无休止!

source: That sucks, but you don't work here, so maybe you should just let them handle it?
target: 很糟糕,但你在这里不工作, 所以也许你应该让他们处理它?

source: LOL JK CAN YOU IMAGINE. Of course you're gonna propose your own solution! Who should be the new boss?
target: LOL JK 你能想象一下吗? 你当然会提出自己的解决方案! 谁是新老板?

source: You need no bosses! Fuse the consciousnesses of all the factory workers into one being: Proletariat, the Working Class.
target: 你不需要老板! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! 将工厂工人的意识化为一个:无产阶级,工人阶级.

source: This dog. What he lacks in business acumen, he makes up for in cuteness. Woof, woof!
target: 这只狗 他缺乏的在商业上敏锐, 他弥补了可爱。 呜! 呜!

source: Good idea! Karl Marx once said, "Workers of the world, unite!" This is obviously what he meant by that.
target: 不错的主意! 卡尔·马克思曾说过"世界工人,团结起来!"这显然是他所说的"团结"的意思.

source: Yup, totally. You lose -N2 MAGIC performing a spell to connect all the workers' consciousnesses.
target: 是的,完全是这样。 你输了N2 MAGIC 执行一个咒语,连接所有工人的意识。

source: "Whoa," say all the workers in perfect unison. "What... what happened? Where are all my individual thoughts and feelings?"
target: "哇",说所有的工人 完美地一致。 "什么... 说吧" 发生什么事了? 我的个人思想和感情都在哪里?"

source: All gone! You won't miss them, will ya? They were probably already ground out of you by the mind-numbing assembly line work anyway.
target: 都不见了! 你不会想念他们的,是吗? 可能已经因为 脑积水的装配线工作而把你给打晕了

source: "Hey, good point," says Proletariat, the Working Class. "Wow, this is incredible! We were so divided, but now we are all one consciousness: the class consciousness!"
target: "嘿,说得好"无产阶级,工人阶级说:"...... "哇,这真是不可思议! 我们当时分道扬镳,但现在我们都是一个意识:阶级意识!".

source: "In this form, we can finally SEIZE THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION!"
target: "我们最终可以以这种方式 探讨生产方式"

source: Cool!
target: 凉爽!

source: ...What are the means of production, exactly?
target: ......生产手段究竟是什么?

source: Whatever it is, Proletariat seizes it out of thin air, and uses their newfound powers to turn it into... a pair of kickass katanas!
target: 不管是什么,无产阶级从薄空气中夺取它,并用他们新发现的力量把它变成. 来一双大脚的卡塔纳斯!

source: "Thank you for your help, friends! With our powerful unity and these dope swords, we can take down monopolies everywhere! Farewell!"
target: "谢了帮了忙,朋友们! 有了我们强大的团结和这些毒剑,我们就能消灭各地的垄断! 再见!"

source: Proletariat assembles themself into a huge communist mecha and leaves the factory.
target: 无产阶级把他们自己组装成一个巨大的共产主义的mecha并出厂.

source: Wow... I wish them the best, but I also feel like class disparity is a bigger issue than can be solved with mecha battles between the Proletariat and monopolies, y'know?
target: 哗... 我祝他们一切顺利,但我还是觉得阶级差距是比无产阶级和垄断集团之间的战斗解决得更严重的问题,知道吗?

source: I don't know! At least the katanas were cool!
target: 我不知道! 开什么玩笑? 至少卡塔纳人很酷!

source: The katanas were, indeed, so fucking cool. You gain +N2 SOUL for solving all the problems in the class system, no further questions!
target: 塔塔那斯人确实太他妈酷了 你因为解决阶级体系中的所有问题而获得+N2 SOUL,不再问了!

source: Great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Dogs are monster's best friend, and they'd never betray us!
target: 不错的主意 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 狗是怪物最好的朋友,他们永远不会背叛我们!

source: Yeah, I think dogs are the only non-corruptible creature left on Earth. A dog would make a great boss! I see no flaws in this plan whatsoever!
target: 是的,我想狗是地球上唯一没有腐烂的生物。 狗会成为伟大的老板! 我看不出这个计划有任何缺陷!

source: A few days later, your plan is in full effect! CUE THE THEME SONG!
target: 几天后,你的计划就完全生效了! 唱这首歌!

source: He calls the shots, he signs the checks! / He wags his tail and wants his pets! / Boss Dog! He's the boss who loves you!
target: 他负责查账,签支票 他摇尾巴想养宠物! 狗头! 他是爱你的老板!

source: Give him walks and give him praise! / You'll be sure to get a raise! / Boss Dog! He's the boss who loves you!
target: 给他走走走的赞美! 你会得到一个加薪! 狗头! 他是爱你的老板!

source: If you want to be paid in treats / and lead your employer on a leash / call Boss Dog! He's the boss who loves yooooou!
target: 如果你想得到报酬 / 并领导你的雇主 被绑住 / 打电话给狗老板! 他是老板谁爱的优!

source: "WOOF, WOOF!"
On today's episode of "Boss Dog", the company accountant enters the boss' office. Boss Dog is scooting around the carpet on his butt. Canned laughter ensues.
target: 在"Boss Dog"的今天一集上,公司会计进入了老板办公室. 狗老大在乱跑 在他屁股上地毯上 笑声随即被吹走

source: "Hey, Boss Dog," says the accountant. "I was looking over this quarter's finances, and our profits are plummeting! We need to lay off at least a third of the staff."
target: "嘿,狗老板" 会计说。 "我看了这个季度的金融,我们的利润正在暴跌! 需要裁掉至少三分之一的员工".

source: The accountant hands Boss Dog the financial reports. Boss Dog chews them to bits! Oh, Boss Dog!
target: 会计把财务报告交给狗老板 狗老大咬成一分钱 哦,狗头!

source: "Well... okay, I guess we'll just ignore the problem for now," sighs the accountant. "Can't argue with the boss!"
target: "这个嘛... 好吧,我想我们现在暂时不理会这个问题了","叹息会计师. "不能与老板争相!"

source: Wow, this was a GREAT plan. Sure, the company loses -N2 MONEY, but look how cute Boss Dog is! He's got soft ears and +N2 SOUL!
target: 哇,这是个伟大的计划。 当然,公司输了N2货币,但看看狗老板多可爱! 他的耳朵软而+N2 SOUL!

source: Find the best rave spot
target: 找到最好的狂欢地点

source: You're all searching for the best spot to party when you're approached by three smiling spirits.
target: 你们都在寻找最好的地点 派对,当你被三个微笑的灵魂接近。

source: POLLY! You made it to the rave! I'm so glad you're here.
target: 牡诡 你赶到了狂欢节! 师大喜.

source: YASSS, it's great to see you!
target: 亚西斯,很高兴见到你!

source: Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: meet Summer, Macarena, and Cheese. They're the Ghosts of Parties Past, and oh boy, they know how to get down.
target: 斯科特, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%曰:相会于夏而相会也,马卡来纳相会也,起司相会也. 他们是过去聚会的幽灵, 他们知道怎么下去。

source: You bet! It's our unfinished business to make sure you guys dance, drink plenty of water, and have a bitchin' time.
target: 你打赌! 让你们跳舞 喝多点水 享受时间 是我们未完成的任务

source: That's awesome! We were just trying to find a good spot to party.
target: 赞! 我们只是想找个好地方去派对

source: Finding the perfect spot is sooo important... you gotta find that middle ground in the party where it's not... like... overcrowded, but... you're also not dancing alone... y'know?
target: 找到完美的位置很重要... 你得找到中间立场 在党里它没有... 喜欢... 过度拥挤,但... 你也不是一个人跳舞... 你知道吗?

source: You also want to be close to the bar to order drinks. But not SO close you're standing in beer and piss all night.
target: 你也想靠近酒吧 点酒 但不要这么近 你站在啤酒和尿一整晚。

source: Also consider proximity to the DJ. Not so close you mingle with the lame DJ groupies, but close enough to get the coveted "DJ nod of acknowledgement."
target: 也考虑接近DJ. 和那些傻逼的DJ小伙们混在一起 却能接近到"DJ点头"

source: Ahhhh... the DJ nod of acknowledgement... it's like, "you really get the vibe, great job."
target: 摆... 摆... DJ点头确认... 就像,"你真的很有气息,伟大的工作。"

source: It'll probably take 30-60 minutes to find the sweet spot. But don't worry, it'll be worth it when we're partying in that spot for the next 72 hours straight.
target: 可能要花30-60分钟才能找到甜点. 但别担心,我们在这聚会72小时后 值得

source: Okay, I'm ready to take this journey! What about this spot next to us? Is it a good place to start?
target: 好了,我准备踏上这段旅程了! 那我们旁边的这个地方呢? 开场的好地方吗?

source: The Ghosts of Parties Past examine the spot with some rulers, levels, and barometers, making calculations.
target: 党的鬼魂过去用一些统治者,级别,和气压计来检查现场,进行计算.

source: Holy shit... this is it! IT'S THE PERFECT SPOT!
target: 可恶... 就是这样! 完美的弹道!

source: It's like... the perfectest of the perfect spots. Gimme a hug, puppy boy... you're the bestest.
target: 这就像... 完美的地点中最完美的 抱抱,小狗小子... 你是最棒的,你最厉害了

source: Scott beams and wags his tail. Then, suddenly, he clutches his stomach.
target: 斯科特 梁并出其尾. 然后,突然,他紧紧地抓住了肚子。

source: Oof... I'm sorry guys, I got so excited about the spot that it made me have to pee!
target: 哦,这... 对不起,伙计们,我太兴奋了 这个地方让我不得不尿尿!

source: No worries, buddy! Want me to take you to the port-o-potties so you don't get lost?
target: 别担心,伙计! 要我带你去港口,免得你迷路?

source: Nah, I can do it alone. I've got a good sense of direction. You guys enjoy the perfect spot, I'll be right back!
target: 不,我可以一个人去 入正觉相. 你们享受完美的地方,我马上回来!

source: Scott leaves, and you party hard. You party so hard, an hour has passed before you realize he still isn't back. Shit, should you try to go find him?
target: 斯科特 离开,你还得好好派对 你这么辛苦,一个小时过去了,你才知道他还没回来 妈的,你该去找他吗?

source: Rookie mistake, my dude. If you leave this spot, there's almost no chance you'll find it again.
target: 鲁克弄错了,我的兄弟。 如果你离开这个位置,几乎不可能再找到它.

source: We can't just leave him, though! Surely you can come up with a creative solution to find Scott, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 我们不能就这样离开他! 你当然可以想出一个有创意的解决方案 斯科特, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: Start a conga line in the Perfect Spot and dance your way into finding Scott. You can later trace your way back to the conga line's origin point.
target: 开始在完美点跳起一行相机 跳起舞来寻找 斯科特. 以后可以追溯回康加线的出站点.

source: Hire Wyatt Solomon, hard-boiled party detective.
target: 雇怀亚特·所罗门 硬骨头的派对侦探

source: That sounds insane... so insane it just might work! Go on, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Shake what yo momma gave you!
target: 这听起来很疯狂... 太疯狂了,它只是可能工作! 继续 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 摇动你的妈妈给你的!

source: It's a big risk, being the leader of the conga line. What if you start to conga and no one joins in and you're a sad one-monster-conga line with no friends?
target: 担任康嘉一线的领跑者,风险很大. 如果你开始康加,没有人加入 而你是一个可悲的单人康加线 没有朋友?

source: But you throw yourself into it, bravely shaking your booty and dancing forward...
target: 但你却把自己投入其中 勇敢地摇起你的战利品 向前跳舞...

source: AND A DRUNK STRANGER GRABS YOUR SHOULDERS AND JOINS IN! WOOHOO!
target: 和一个醉酒的 强盗 拖走你的 肩和工作! 呜呼!

source: More people join your party centipede. The conga is impossible to resist, like a drunken partygoer black hole!
target: 更多的人加入你的派对 百分百。 康加人无法抗拒 就像醉酒的派对黑洞

source: Don't worry, we'll make sure the end of the conga line is still in this spot when you come back. Godspeed, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 别担心,我们会确保康加线的尽头 当你回来的时候仍然在这个位置。 一路顺风 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: You shake your groove thang and conga across the rave.
target: 你摇动你的地盘 优雅和相机 越过狂欢节。

source: As your line grows, so does your responsibility to lead it. This much conga takes -N2 STAMINA from your body.
target: 随着你的队伍不断壮大,你的责任也随之增加。 这么多的相机从你身上取出N2 STAMINA

source: Finally, you spot Scott at a food truck buying fries! You grab him!
target: 终于你发现 斯科特 在一辆买薯条的餐车里! 你抓住他! 抓住他! 你抓住他! 你抓住他! 抓住他! 抓住他! 抓住他!

source: Hey, bro! Nice conga line! Should I join?
target: 嘿,哥们! 不错的康加线! 我该加入吗?

source: THERE'S NO TIME! You have to return to your spot; your conga pilgrimage is almost at its end!
target: 没时间了! 你必须回到你的地盘去,你的康加朝圣快到了!

source: You turn to the dancer behind you and tell him you now bestow the great responsibility of being the conga leader unto him.
target: 你转身去找你身后的那个舞者 告诉他你现在把 担任康加领袖的重任交给他

source: With all the gravitas of a young prince taking up the mantle of king, he promises that the fate of the conga line will be safe in his funky feet.
target: 年轻的王子的丑事 都占据了国王的地幔 他保证康加线的命运 在他的臭脚上是安全的

source: Yay, you're back! You were a masterful conga leader, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. It took everything in me not to join in!
target: 耶,你回来了! 你是一个高超的康加领袖, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我花了我的一切 才没有加入!

source: The Ghosts of Parties Past bestow the title of "Party MVP" upon you. YAS! You also gain +N2 SOUL for finding Scott.
target: 党的幽灵过去 授予你"党MVP"的称号。 亚士! 您还获得 +N2 Suul 以查找 斯科特.

source: That's perfect! Wyatt Solomon could crack this case easy-peasy!
target: 这太完美了! 怀亚特·所罗门可以破案 很容易就被他吓倒了

source: Whoa, I've never heard of this guy. What is this obscure party lore I've yet to hear about?
target: 哇,我从没听说过这个人。 我还没听说的这个隐晦的派对是什么?

source: Polly, my dude: Detective Solomon is the SHIT. He can reconstruct blurry nights at the club; he can track down your missing friends after a wild bachelor party...
target: 波莉所罗门警探就是狗屎 他可以在俱乐部重建模糊的夜晚;他可以在野外单身派对后追踪你失踪的朋友......

source: He even found my missing keys... after a week-long bender! They were... like... in my butt pocket all along... plot twist!
target: 他甚至找到我失踪的钥匙... 过了一周的苦艾酒! 他们... 喜欢... 一直在我的屁股口袋里... 阴谋扭曲!

source: Gosh... I hope someday I'm reincarnated into... one of his cigars... so I can... give that man a kiss on the lips...
target: 天呐... 我希望有一天我被转世... 他的雪茄之一... ... . 所以我可以... . . . . . . 亲吻他嘴唇...

source: You wire -N2 MONEY to Wyatt Solomon's undisclosed bank account and wait for him to find Scott. And by wait, I mean you dance your ass off.
target: 你给Wyatt Solomon的未公开银行账户 打电话 等他找到 斯科特. 等待,我的意思是,你跳舞你的屁股关闭。

source: Detective Wyatt Solomon arrives at the scene with a pessimistic blues soundtrack and dramatic voice-over narration.
target: 怀亚特·所罗门警探带着悲观的蓝调音轨和戏剧性的语音翻唱来到达现场.

source: "I was smoking a Cuban and drinking a whiskey on the rocks (my usual vices, after I lost my wife) as I hunted down the elusive werewolf."
target: 我正在抽古巴烟,在石头上喝威士忌(我失去了妻子之后,我经常在石头上喝威士忌),

source: "I started at the port-o-potties and followed a trail of shedded fur and discarded toilet paper to the food truck."
target: "我从港口开始, 跟着一条被夹住的毛皮和被丢弃的卫生纸到餐车"

source: "There stood my quarry, ordering chili fries. He was happy; young; naive. I couldn't help it; the kid warmed my heart."
target: "我的采石场就站在那里, 点了辣椒薯条. 他很快乐,很年轻,很天真 我忍不住,那孩子温暖了我的心。”

source: "Just when I'm ready to quit this job, life gives me a reason to party on."
target: "当我准备好退出这个工作时, 生活给我一个参加派对的理由"

source: Bros, I'm back! Your detective friend found me. I got hungry and went to buy food, and -- plot twist -- I ran into Liam!
target: 哥们,我回来了! 你那个侦探朋友找到我了 我饿了,去买食物, 和 - 阴谋扭曲,我碰到 利亚姆!

source: LIAM?! As in, our friend from school Liam? Where is he?!
target: 利亚姆! 学校的朋友 利亚姆? 他在哪? 他现在在哪?

source: Scott points to the confused stranger next to him.
target: 斯科特 指着他旁边那个困惑的陌生人

source: I keep telling you, I'm not Liam!. My name is Orrin!
target: 我老是告诉你,我不是 利亚姆!. 我叫奥林!

source: Are you sure? You're wearing glasses like Liam, and you complain a lot like him too.
target: 你确定吗? 你戴着眼镜,就像 利亚姆你抱怨的也很像他

source: Today, my friend, your name will be Liam. Party with us!
target: 今天,我的朋友,你的名字是 利亚姆. 和我们一起开派对!

source: You end up having a hell of a party with Polly, Scott, the ghosts, Wyatt Solomon, and even "Liam." You also gain +N2 SOUL for finding your friend!
target: 你最终会有一个地狱的派对 波莉, 斯科特鬼魂,怀亚特·所罗门,甚至 "利亚姆"你还因为找到你的朋友而获得+N2 SOUL!

source: Try to get some drinks
target: 喝点什么?

source: As you and your friends approach the bar, three happy-go-lucky party spirits approach you!
target: 你和你的朋友接近酒吧时 三个快乐的派对精神接近你!

source: Polly, you magnificent bitch! I didn't know you were coming to this rave!
target: 波莉你这个了不起的婊子! 我不知道你会来参加这个狂欢!

target: 不,你知道你得到了格鲁姆波上校, 即使它的代价是 -N2 HYPE 是一个大书呆子。 你从这个无私的举动中获得了+N2 SOUL!

target: ...不过几个小时后我的班就结束了 我可以发短信给你

target: 暂时,我能给你们拿点喝的吗?

target: 有,请不要这样,你不是来这的 波莉 可能调情。 你点什么?

target: 猫咖啡(由猫做)

target: 哇,那咖啡看起来很奇怪。 为什么看起来如此... 坏人吗?

target: 猫喜欢他们的咖啡超黑。 和他们那暴躁 狡猾 低调的灵魂相处得很好

target: 是啊,他妈的! 你选择了这个选择;知道你的行动的潜在危险,现在不会阻止你!

target: 你是这里的专家,兄弟! 我们该玩什么游戏?

target: 赌点钱,伙计。 这就是赌博的要点,不是吗? 得到免费的钱。

target: 赌这无价银表. 神秘的沃洛克人 谁把它给你的长死祖先 可能希望有人 赌它最终!

target: 你知道我支持恶作剧和恶作剧 但冒险这热狗可能已经越线了!

source: Does this burger represent the same value as the hot dog? Is it implying we won more than what we bet, or is this like diminishing returns?

target: 通过在正轨激光中再增加一发死亡激光来增加利害关系. 终极刺激!

source: Are you sure, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Aren't educational raps kinda... boring?
target: 你确定吗? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 教育饶舌不是有点... 无聊吗?

target: 没有! 教育饶舌是连接现代青年在自己地盘上同时丰富他们+N2 MIND的最佳方式!

target: 好吧,如果你这么说。 贡举志五种 上! 你能给我一拍吗?

target: 光照被放大 而不是让你看起来像牛的光线

source: NO, LASERS ARE DISTINCT BECAUSE OF THEIR COHERENCE / YO, THEIR LIGHT'S DIFFRACTION-LIMITED, NO INTERFERENCE
target: 不, 拖鞋是被隔离的, 因为他们的和谐/YO, 他们的光的分歧 吸收,没有接触

source: Boo, I'm sorry, but I dunno how else to say it... that was boring. You somehow managed to take rap and lasers, two objectively very cool things, and make them boring.
target: 嘘,对不起,我不知道该怎么说... 无聊透了 你不知怎么地 做了饶舌和激光, 两种客观上非常酷的东西, 并使它们无聊。

source: Yeah, you're right. I think this has pretty much decided that I won't pursue a career in educational rap.
target: 是啊,你说得对。 我想这已经决定了 我不会继续从事教育饶舌的事业了

source: Suddenly, a security guard runs in. "What are you doing?!" he shouts. "Why are you onstage?!"
target: 突然,一个保安冲进来了 "你在干嘛" 他喊着 "你为什么上台?"

source: Joe the Laser let us up here! He's the wizard who runs the show and taught us life lessons about 2010s party music.
target: 激光师乔让我们上来了! 他是主持节目的巫师,并给我们讲授2010年代党的音乐生活课.

source: "Oh, THAT guy," the guard sighs. "He doesn't actually work here. He just gets drunk and trespasses and insists he's in charge of the laser show."
target: "哦,那家伙",警卫叹气。 "他其实不在这里工作. 他只是喝醉了,非法侵入,坚持由他负责激光节目".

source: Oh, whoops. Joe the Laser gets thrown out, a lot of the audience leaves because you made the laser show lame with your rap, and you lose -N2 HYPE.
target: 呜呼. 激光的乔被赶出去,很多观众离开 因为你用你的说唱使激光表演变得逊色,你失去了-N2 HYPE.

source: "Hey, great idea, kid!" Joe the Laser says. He grabs a mic. "EVERYONE! We've got a special laser show planned today!"
target: "嘿,好主意,孩子" 激光师乔说。 他拿了个麦克风。 "每个人都是! 今天我们计划了一场特殊的激光表演!"

source: "Look under your chairs. Whoever finds the beer I lost will get a FREE laser hair removal from my assistant, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"
target: "看着你的椅子下。 无论谁找到我失去的啤酒 都会从我的助手身上拿起FREE激光去除头发 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!"

source: Oh, awesome! If I still had hair and not just an ectoplasm ponytail, I'd totally be down to participate.
target: 哦,真棒! ! 简直是太棒了! 如果我还有发型,不只是一匹外形马尾, 我完全会参与。

source: "Hey, I found a beer!" an aging man in the back row shouts. "Do I win?!"
target: "嘿,我找到一瓶啤酒" 一个老人在后排喊叫 "我赢吗?"

source: Yup! Come onstage, bro! What's your name?
target: 没错! 上台来,兄弟! 汝名甚么为.

source: "Hello! My name's Pavel. I'm a 62-year-old train operator."
target: "哈罗! 我叫帕维尔 我是62岁的火车运营商".

source: Hi, Pavel! Do you wanna give anyone a shout-out before %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% lasers your hair off?
target: 嗨,帕维尔! 你想给任何人 一个喊出之前 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 剃了你的头发?

source: "Yes, I'd like to shout-out my wife... who died recently. She always wanted to go to a laser show, but I was always too busy driving trains, so we never did go see one."
target: "是的,我想大声喊出我的妻子... 刚刚去世的 她一直想去看激光表演,但我总是太忙地开火车,所以我们从来没有看过".

source: "I'm doing this for her. I miss you, Doris, wherever you are."
target: "我这样做是为了她。 我想你,多丽丝,无论你在哪里。"

source: Aww! MAKE SOME NOISE FOR PAVEL AND DORIS!!!
target: 呜! 给派尔和多里斯做点声响!

source: "Could you do the laser hair removal on my butt?" Pavel asks, dropping trou. "Doris used to shave my butt for me, but now that she's gone, it's gotten... out of hand."
target: "你能帮我把头发擦掉吗?" "多里斯以前为我刮屁股,但现在她走了,它得到了... 手无寸铁"

source: Sure! You gain +N2 HYPE lasering the hair off Pavel's left cheek. Unfortunately, security bursts in before you can address the other one.
target: 当然! 你得到+N2 HYPE激光 从帕维尔的左脸颊上取出头发。 不幸的是,安全系统在您无法联系另一个之前就已经破解了

source: "DAMMIT! It's Joe the Laser again!" the guards swear. "You don't work here! Quit trespassing and drunkenly operating our lasers!"
target: "DAMMIT! 达姆特! 又是激光手乔!" 警卫发誓. "你在这里不工作! 别再闯进来 喝醉酒操作我们的激光器了!"

source: "Uh, time for me to go!" Joe the Laser says. "Assistant %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% will do my jail time for me! Joe the Laser is OUT!"
target: "哦,该我走了!" 激光师乔说 "助理 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 我会为我做我的牢狱时间! 激光的乔出来了!"

source: Joe the Laser disappears in another puff of smoke. You don't go to jail, but you do have to pay a -N2 MAGIC fine for "impersonating a laser wizard."
target: 激光的乔消失在又一股烟雾中 你没有坐牢,但你确实必须支付 -N2 MAGIC罚款 因为"冒充激光法师"。

source: Hmmm, I dunno. Death sounds bad... but lasers are fun. So do they cancel each other out?
target: 嗯,我不知道。 额,我不知道。 死亡听起来很糟... 但激光很有趣 所以他们互相取消?

source: "They do now!" says Joe the Laser. "Life is only fun for those who take risks! (Except for whoever dies tonight because of that risk, but fuck 'em.)"
target: "他们现在有了" 激光手乔说 "生命只是冒险者的乐趣! (除了今晚因为风险而死的人,但他妈的他们。 )"

source: Okay, sounds good to me! Let's fire the lasers!
target: 好吧,听起来不错! 发射激光!

source: Ten minutes later...
target: 十分钟后...

source: "SOMEONE HELP!" a woman cries. "My husband is bleeding out!"
target: "我一个人帮忙" 一个女人在哭 "我丈夫出血了!"

source: Whoa, Joe the Laser wasn't kidding. That is one EFFECTIVE death ray!
target: 哇,激光师乔不是在开玩笑 这是一条有效的死亡之光!

source: "WHY ARE YOU ALL JUST STANDING AROUND?!" the woman screams. "Somebody, call an ambulance now!"
target: "你们都站在那里吗?" 女人尖叫。 "有人,叫救护车!"

source: Lady, it's called a "death ray" for a reason. The whole point is that it kills you immediately.
target: 女士,这叫"死亡之光"是有原因的 关键是它会立刻杀了你

source: "It's okay, Sharon," the husband coughs, tenderly stroking his wife's cheek. "Truthfully, it... *cough!*... it was a very cool laser show, wasn't it?"
target: "没关系,莎伦",丈夫咳嗽,轻轻地打他妻子的臉. "诚然,是. 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 咳 . 是个非常酷的激光表演,不是吗?"

source: "Oh, Edward...," Sharon sighs. "It was. It really, truly was."
target: "哦,爱德华..." 沙龙叹息。 "是时. 是真的,真的是这样。"

source: "Don't... *cough!*... call an ambulance. I don't want... *cough, cough!*... to interrupt the dope laser show."
target: "别. 别吵了  叫救护车。 我不想这样... 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 咳嗽 打断了涂料激光展".

source: "It'd... *cough!*... be super... uncool..."
"Edward? EDWARD?! NOOOOOO!"
target: "爱德华? 爱德华! 诺奥!"

source: What's that noise? Is someone screaming in heartbroken horror out in the crowd?
target: 是什么声音? 有人在人群中尖叫着 心碎的恐怖?

source: Ignore it! IT'S LASER TIME, MOTHERFUCKERS!
target: 别管它! 时间到了,娘娘腔!

source: So it is. You gain +N6 HYPE from your high-stakes laser show, but you lose -N3 MAGIC and -N3 SOUL for using Joe the Laser's magic to endanger lives. Oh well!
target: 就是这样 你从高收视率激光节目中获得了+N6 HYPE,但因为使用激光的魔法来危害生命而损失了-N3 MAGIC和-N3 Suul. 哦,不错!

source: Attend the comet shower
target: 看着彗星淋浴

source: Lucky for you, there is a comet shower happening tonight! You and your friends settle in at the planetarium to enjoy a special viewing.
target: 幸运的是,今晚有彗星会淋浴! 你和你的朋友在天文馆里住着 享受特别的观光

source: This is so cool! I love comet showers! The shooting stars are all so pretty!
target: 这太酷了! 我喜欢彗星淋浴! 流星都这么漂亮!

source: This takes me back to Camp Spooky. Scott, remember that meteor shower at the end of summer camp?
target: 这让我回到史波基营地  斯科特记得夏令营末期的流星雨吗?

source: Oh, yeah! You and I decided to take a break from being super invested in finding a date and watched the shower as friends.
target: 哦,对了! 我们决定从超级投资寻找约会 开始休息,然后作为朋友看淋浴

source: Yup, it was great! I'm glad we weren't one of those desperate motherfuckers losing sleep over finding a summer honey.
target: 是的,这是伟大的! 我很高兴我们不是那些绝望的混蛋之一 失去睡眠 寻找一个夏天的蜂蜜。

source: Damn, Polly didn't have to scalp you like that.
target: 该死 波莉 没必要那样把你头皮给割了

source: What are you guys gonna wish for when the stars start shooting?
target: 当星星开始射击时 你们会希望什么?

source: That's a good question. Hmm, what do I want to wish for?
target: 问曰. 嗯,我有什么愿望?

source: Wishing for a flask that never empties would be pretty sweet. Or maybe I could wish for a talking octopus that gives me massages?
target: 希望一个永不空出 的酒瓶是相当甜蜜的。 或者我该想一个能让我按摩的八爪鱼?

source: I was gonna wish for world peace, but a massage octopus sounds so much cooler! I can't decide now!
target: 我本来想向世界祈祷的 但按摩章鱼听起来更酷 我现在不能决定!

source: HERE COMES THE FIRST SHOOTING STAR! We only have one chance for a good wish! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what should we wish for?
target: 这里来了第一次拍摄的"星"! 我们只有一个愿望的机会!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我们该许什么愿?

source: Dang, you never know what to wish for. That's why you still have wishes left in your monkey's paw. Maybe you can use your wish number %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% to wish for the clarity to know what to wish for.
target: 该死,你永远不知道该许什么愿 这就是为什么你仍然有愿望 留在你的猴子的爪。 也许你可以用你的许愿号 %NEXTPAWWISHNUMBER% 以愿清净能知所愿.

source: Forfeit the opportunity to sound cool and spend your wish on a selfless deed: wish Scott hadn't put his hand in that marmalade jar that was full of wasps.
target: 放弃了听起来很酷的机会 将你的心愿花在无私的事业上: 愿 斯科特 还没把手放进满是黄蜂的果酱罐里

source: Ah, yes, your monkey's paw. You have a helpful flashback to remind yourself how you acquired it.
target: 啊,是的,你的猴子的爪子。 你有一个有用的回放 提醒自己你是如何获得的。

source: You encountered its previous owner, a mysterious old man with seriously cursed vibes, in an abandoned subway station at 3 a.m.
target: 你遇见了它以前的主人 一个神秘的老人 有着被诅咒的气息 凌晨3点在一个废弃的地铁站里

source: This paw is unimaginably powerful," he said as he gave it to you. "When you wish on the paw, you rewrite your whole reality.
target: 这块爪子的威力是不可思议的,"他说,当他把它给你的时候. "当你在爪上许愿时,你改写了整个现实.

source: You basically create a splintering timeline in which your wish came true. It's all very complex and arcane.
target: 你基本上创造了一个分裂的时间线 让你的愿望成真 都非常复杂而有弧度.

source: Be careful with this thing. Nobody's truly sure what the consequences of using magic like this could have!
target: 小心点 没有人真正确定使用这种魔法的后果会是什么!

source: Ugh, yawn. However you came to visit this abandoned subway station, you definitely didn't come to learn about this boring fantasy riff on quantum physics.
target: 哼,打哈欠,你还好吧? 不过你来这家废弃地铁站 肯定不是来了解量子物理的无聊幻想的

source: Now that you think about it, will wishing for wish-making clarity count as 1 compound wish or 2 wishes? Will that be, like... worse?
target: 现在想想,希望实现愿望的清晰度会算作一个复合愿望还是两个愿望? 会不会是... 更糟吗?

source: Well, only one way to find out! You wish for clarity on the monkey's paw, spending -N2 MAGIC.
target: 只有一种方法能发现 你想清楚猴子的爪子, 花 -N2 MAGIC。

source: For a minute, you feel like your mind is cleaving in two... but then, suddenly, you gain +N2 MIND and know EXACTLY what to wish for.
target: 一分钟,你感觉你的头脑 正在分出两分... 但突然间,你得到了+N2的心智, 并完全知道什么是许愿。

source: I wish to one day open an awesome waterpark. It'd be the perfect place for our next big adventure.
target: 我希望有一天能开个很棒的水泊 这将是我们下一个大冒险的完美之地

source: A waterpark? That sounds awesome, boo! We'd finally get our own road trip bikini episode!
target: 水泊吗? 听起来真棒,嘘! 我们终于能拿到自己的比基尼旅行剧集了!

source: And it was really nice of you to include us in your wish! If only there were a way to ensure our wishes could come true.
target: 很高兴你把我们也纳入你的愿望中! 如果有办法确保我们的愿望能够实现的话。

source: Yeah, that would be really nice. Oh well, we can't have everything!
target: 是啊,这将是真的好。 哦,我们不可能什么都有!

source: Hey, that's a good wish! And it was really nice of you to use your wish to make my life nicer, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 嘿,这是个好愿望! 很高兴你能用你的愿望 来改善我的生活, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: Scott, that reminds me, is your hand STILL stuck in that wasp-infested marmalade jar?
target: 斯科特提醒我,你的手还卡在 被黄蜂感染的果酱罐里吗?

source: It sure is! Man, I've probably had my hand in this thing for, like, four hours now.
target: 当然了! 我可能已经用手 弄了四个小时了

source: Damn, that's right! I remember we were gonna try to get it off, but then we got distracted by that cool-looking cloud and totally forgot about it.
target: 可恶,没错! 我记得我们本来想把它弄走的 但后来我们被那凉爽的云团 分心了 完全忘了

source: That cloud was SO cool, though. It looked like a duck riding a skateboard upside-down!
target: 那云真酷,虽然。 看起来像一只鸭子骑着滑板倒地!

source: But then if you squinted at it and stood on your head, it looked more like a walrus taking a sponge-bath.
target: 但是如果你一看它,就站在你的头上, 它看起来更像是海象取出海绵浴。

source: And then when the wasps stung my eyelids and made them swollen and puffy, the cloud looked like a keytar-playing snail!
target: 然后当黄蜂刺伤我的眼皮,使它们肿胀而发臭时,云就看起来像个键盘活捉蜗牛!

source: The wasps...? OH, RIGHT! Scott, we almost forgot about the jar again!
target: 黄蜂... ? 哦,对了!  斯科特我们差点又忘了罐子!

source: Haha, you're right! That cloud's so cool, it's STILL distracting us!
target: 哈哈,你说得对! 云真酷,仍然在分散我们的注意力!

source: Well, better act now before your short attention spans run out again. You smash the marmalade jar with a hammer, and the angry wasps fly away.
target: 最好在你的注意力又用完之前 现在就行动起来 用锤子砸倒了果酱罐子 愤怒的黄蜂就飞走了

source: I feel a lot better now. Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 我现在感觉好多了 谢谢 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: Whoa, do you guys grasp what just happened?! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wished on the shooting star for Scott to be freed, and %HISHER% wish came true!
target: 哇,你们知道刚才发生了什么吗?  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 在流星上许愿 斯科特 将获得自由, %HISHER% 许愿成真!

source: You're right! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s like a star-wishing wizard!
target: 你说的对!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%就像一个渴望星星的巫师!

source: If %HISHER% wish was bound to come true, though, it's a shame %HESHE% didn't wish for something cooler, like three matching aquatic bikes or something.
target: 如果%HISHER%的愿望注定会实现,虽然,但可惜%HESHE%没有希望有更凉爽的东西,比如三台匹配的水上自行车等.

source: Whoa, you're right, that would've been a REALLY cool wish. Oh well, guess it's a missed opportunity.
target: 你说得对,那会是一个非常酷的愿望。 哦,猜 这是一个错过的机会。

source: That's a shame. You lose -N2 HYPE, but gain +N2 SOUL for being a good friend to Scott.
target: 岂可相愧. 你输了N2 HYPE,但因为是好朋友而得到+N2 SOUL 斯科特.

source: Go berserk
target: 发狂吧

source: That's right, you didn't come here to play. You're here to make this bloodbath your bitch.
target: 没错,你不是来玩的 你是来这给婊子弄出血的

source: Are you sure about this, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Won't we lose lots of SOUL by killing innocent people?
target: 你确定吗? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 我们不会因为杀了无辜的人而失去很多苏尔吗?

source: Are they really innocent if they're trying to kill us first, though? Besides, we signed those waivers at the entrance protecting our SOUL from being lost in wanton murder.
target: 如果他们想先杀我们,他们真的无辜的吗? 再说,我们在入口处签署了这些豁免书 保护我们的SOUL不被故意谋杀迷路

source: Oh, okay! I'm fine with killing people as long as we can do it with a healthy conscience.
target: 哦,还好! 只要我们有健康的良知,就能够杀人

source: You enter a fugue state, slaughtering fools with guns and knives and bare hands and anything else your twisted heart desires.
target: 你进入一个虚无的国家, 用枪和刀 和赤手空拳 以及你扭曲的心所想的任何东西屠杀傻瓜。

source: But no matter how many people you kill, every time you look at the death toll leaderboard, there's a name consistently ahead of you...
target: 但不管你杀了多少人 每次看死亡的死亡指挥板 都会有一个名字 一直摆在你面前...

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Look at you, holding onto second place like it's your mother's skirt. I'm almost impressed.

source: Whoa, what are you guys doing here? Haven't you seen all the bombs and car-chases going on? This city is really unsafe!
target: 你们在这里干什么? 你没看到炸弹和车牌吗? 这城市真的不安全!

source: Hey Dahlia! This place doesn't look dangerous, it seems fun! What are you doing here?
target: 顿 达莉娅! 这地方看起来不危险,看起来很有趣! 你在这里做什么?

source: Well, I stopped here to ask for directions, but then through a series of increasingly-unlikely action-packed events, I became the hero this city deserves.
target: 我来这里是想问路 但经过一系列 越来越难以想象的动作组合事件 我成了这个城市应得的英雄

source: Last week I dismantled a local terrorist organization and beat up a sniper who was gonna shoot the President while he took a bath...
target: 上周我摧毁了一个当地恐怖组织 并殴打一个狙击手 他打算开枪打死总统 趁着总统洗澡...

source: Yesterday I saved a little girl who was stuck inside a demolishing skyscraper...
target: 昨天我救了一个小女孩 她被困在了一座拆除的摩天大楼里...

source: Today, I'm scheduled to defeat a terrorist who's gonna detonate a bomb at the airport! But I'm kinda in a pickle right now...
target: 今天,我计划打败一个恐怖分子,他要在机场引爆炸弹! 但我现在有点在腌菜...

source: I was gonna take a bus to the airport, but my bus got a bomb planted in its engine that'll detonate if the bus drops below 50 miles per hour, so they couldn't pick me up!
target: 我本来要搭巴士去机场的 但是巴士的引擎里装了炸弹 如果巴士时速低于50英里 就会引爆 所以他们无法接我

source: We can take you to the airport! We've got a car, and I wanna go on an action-adventure too!
target: 我们可以带你去机场! 我们有车,我想去 行动冒险了!

source: Scott, I love you, but I just don't know if you guys are cut out for the "90s action movie protagonist" lifestyle.
target: 斯科特我爱你,但我就是不知道你们是不是 被"90年代动作电影主角"的生活方式所淘汰了

source: No way, I can totally be a grizzled thick-skinned action hero! There must be some way to prove it to you...
target: 我绝对不能成为灰熊厚皮的动作英雄! 一定有办法证明给你看...

source: Hmmm... there is one way. There's one thing a true action movie star never does: look at an explosion.
target: 那个... 只有一个办法 真正的动作电影明星 从来没有做过一件事: 看一看爆炸。

source: Looking at explosions is only for secondary characters who are there to look shocked or sad and make the protagonist seem more badass by comparison.
target: 看着爆炸只为在场的次要人物所取景,以惊吓或悲伤来取景,并相较而使主角显得更坏.

source: So, here's the deal: if you can go an hour without looking at an explosion, and also refrain from dying in a shootout or a car chase, you can hang with me. Deal?
target: 所以,我们说好的: 如果你可以离开一个小时,而不看到爆炸, 并且不要在枪战或追车中死亡, 你可以和我在一起。 成交吗?

source: Deal! But not looking at an explosion is gonna be hard... how will you keep your eyes off those fiery infernos so Dahlia will take you seriously?
target: 说定了! 但若不看爆炸会很困难... 如何让你的眼睛远离那些烈火? 达莉娅 你会认真对待你吗?

source: The problem is explosions are too eye-catching... but no moreso than a super fun magic eye book. Order one and spend the rest of the day looking ONLY for its hidden images!
target: 问题是爆炸太吸引人了... 但更像是一本超级有趣的"魔眼"书 订一号,剩下的一天 只寻找隐藏的图像!

source: Don't let an explosion catch your attention. Go for the kill: leave the explosion on read.
target: 别让爆炸引起你的注意 继续杀 继续读

source: Good idea! You stop by the first bookstore that isn't on fire and pay -N2 MONEY for a book of magic eye puzzles.
target: 不错的主意! 你到第一家不着火的书店 付N2 MONEY一书的魔法眼谜题

target: 你打开第一页,开始横穿你的眼睛, 将书更进一步,更接近, 尝试所有其他的技巧 来看到这些该死的隐藏的照片。

source: I don't get it. What am I supposed to be seeing in these trippy shapes?
target: 岂能通取. 我该看什么这些怪异的外形?

source: Probably a dolphin. It's usually a dolphin.
target: 可能是海豚 可能就是海豚 可能是海豚 可能是海豚 可能是海豚 通常为海豚.

target: 第一种其实是海豚. 第二为独活.

source: The third hidden image is an absurdist art piece that serves as a meta-commentary on what a magic eye puzzle could be.
target: 第三幅隐藏的图像是一部荒谬的艺术作品,它充当了对一个神奇眼谜究竟会是什么的元解说.

source: The fourth is a Rorschach blob test that you interpret to be an image of your father being disappointed in you.
target: 第四个是罗夏克的测试 你解读成你父亲对你失望的影像

source: The fifth one is another fucking dolphin.
target: 第五个是另一只海豚

target: 因为就像你说的,嘘:酷的动作电影英雄从来不看爆炸。
