source: You all go to the prison entrance to inquire about a tour, but the security guards just beat you unconscious and lock you in a cell. Bummer.
target: 你们都去监狱门口 问参观的事 但保安只是打你 昏迷,把你锁在牢房里。 可恶

source: Ugh... ow... what happened? Did we go on a bender and I forgot? ...Did we buy these ugly jumpsuits on the bender?
target: 唉哟... 额... 发生什么事了? 我们是不是去吃甜菜了,我忘了? 我们买这些丑陋的跳伞服了吗?

source: NOPE! Welcome to the Experimental Prison Theater! I've been stuck in here awhile, so I've got some good tips on how not to die and have fun doing it.
target: 没有! 欢迎来到实验监狱剧院! 我被困在这里一段时间, 所以我有一些好的建议 如何不死,并有乐趣做到这一点。

source: First tip: don't join Santiago's gang. They just want your money, and they don't even have a cool prison gang tat.
target: 第一小费:不要加入圣地亚哥的帮派. 他们只想得到你的钱,他们甚至没有 一个很酷的监狱帮派塔克。

source: Uh... thanks for the info, Dahlia, but do you know anything about getting out of here?
target: 额... 谢谢你的通报 达莉娅你知道离开这里的事吗?

source: Oh, yeah, guess I should've started with that. So, this prison's golden rule is you're assigned a play to put on every night.
target: 哦,是的,我想我应该开始 这一点。 所以,这个监狱的黄金规则是 你被指派 玩每晚。

source: The play you're assigned for the day is determined by your jumpsuit. The symbol corresponds to the play, and the number is the part you get.
target: 一天分配的剧情由你的穿高穿决定. 符号与剧作相呼应,而数字是得到的部分.

source: Like, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s got the number 1, so %HESHE%'ll play the lead role. Nice!
target: 喜欢,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s有1,所以%HESHE%'''''将发挥带头作用。 不错!

source: Anyway, during your play, there will be a door onstage that leads outside. You can walk out of it and be home free.
target: 总之,在你的演出期间, 舞台上会有扇门, 通往外面. 你可以走出它,回家自由。

source: BUT, you have to improv a reason why using that door makes sense in the context of your play. If you can't improv a good reason, you'll get shot in the head.
target: 但是,你必须即兴发挥一个原因,为什么用那扇门在你的剧情中是有意义的。 无法即兴发挥出好的理由,会被打入头部.

source: Uh...
Don't worry, that's how these "punishment games" usually go. I just have fun with it and try to forget about the life-or-death stakes.
target: 别担心,这些"惩罚游戏"通常是这样进行的. 我只是玩玩,试着忘记生死攸关

source: I could've escaped last week, but we were doing "Mamma Mia!", and I really wanted to stay to find out who the real father was!
target: 我上星期本来可以逃出,但我们在做"妈妈米娅", 我真的想留下来找出谁是真正的父亲!

source: Today I'm doing "Rockin' Terror Cinematic Spectacular". I've already got a plan to make my great escape during the "Time Jump" song.
target: 今天我正在做"恐怖电影" 已经有一个计划,让我在"时空跳跃"的歌曲中大出千丈.

source: It's one of those songs that tells you how to dance to it, so I'll just sing "now go through the prison exit," and leave! DAHLIA WINS AGAIN!
target: 歌中有一首告诉你如何跳舞,所以我就唱出"现在穿过监狱出口",离开! 达赫利亚又动了!

source: Gotcha... I'm guessing that based on our jumpsuits... we got assigned "The Lion Prince?"
Guess so. Heh, good luck justifying why a lion would use a door. See you at the theater!
target: 应该是吧 祝你们好运 狮子为什么会用门 剧院见!

source: Okay, we just have to escape a prison by improvising a reason to use a door during a stage production of "The Lion Prince" under penalty of death. No pressure.
target: 好吧,我们只是要逃离监狱 即兴地解释一个理由 在舞台制作"狮子王子"时 用门 死刑。 没有压力。

source: ...I actually think that's a lot of pressure.
target: ...我觉得压力很大

source: Don't worry, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, we've got this! Polly and I are great actors, and you're...
target: 不用担心 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我们得到了这个!  波莉 而我是伟大的演员 而你...

source: Oh, I know! You're great at thinking of a reason why our characters would use the door!
target: 哦，我知道 你非常擅长想一个理由 为什么我们的人物会使用门!
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Present the door as a metaphor of the passage to adulthood that the young lion prince MUST cross to become king.
target: 将门作为小狮子王子MUST所跨去的成年通道的比喻来呈现出成为国王.

source: Wonder out loud why there's a single door in the middle of the African Savannah. Get everyone in the audience hooked on this off-putting mystery.
target: 奇怪为什么非洲草原中部有一扇单门 让观众都沉迷于这个神秘的神秘

source: After hours of intense rehearsal, you and your friends have lost -N2 STAMINA, but you're ready to perform!
target: 紧张的排练几小时后,你和你的朋友都输了N2 STAMINA,但你已经准备好表演了!

source: "The Lion Prince" is chosen first to perform. You'll be playing the titular role of Samba.
target: """狮子王子"被选为先出演. 你会扮演桑巴的三角角色

source: Hi! I'm Simone, the happy-go-lucky meerkat with no ambition and an appetite for bugs.
target: 顿! 我是西蒙妮,那个快乐的幸运的美人卡 毫无野心,对虫子有胃口

source: And I'm Rumba, a warthog who loves to fart!
target: 我是伦巴,一个爱放屁的战狼!

source: (Jeez, Scott, you didn't have to ACTUALLY fart. Gross!)
target: (杰伊兹, 斯科特你不必放屁的 恶心!

source: Anyway... Samba, my little prince, as you mature into the feline king you were born to be, we're here to teach you the most important part of adulthood...
target: 总之... 桑巴,我的小王子,当你成熟成你生来就是的花花王时, 我们在这里教你成年最重要的部分...

source: It's a little something called: ESCAPING THE PRISON. Sing with me, Rumba!
target: 有点叫"逃狱" 跟我唱,伦巴!

source: "Escaping the prison! What a wonderful phrase!"
target: "斩出狱去! 多么美妙的一句话!"

source: "Escaping the prison! It ain't no passing craaaaaze!"
target: "斩出狱去! 这不是一个经过的克劳斯"!

source: "You'll see no wardens for the rest of your daaaaays!"
target: "你剩下的那些监狱里,没有看守!"

source: "But will you be truly free? It all depends on your philosophyyyy!"
target: "但你是否真的会自由? 这都取决于你的哲学".

source: "Escaping the prisoooon!"
target: "斩倒了" "斩倒了"

source: As the song concludes, you say something vaguely profound about the metaphor of passing into adulthood and step through the door.
target: 正如歌曲的结论,你对通过成年和步入门的比喻说出一些模糊而深刻的话.

source: You make it outside without getting shot, maybe because everyone bought your bullshit, or maybe because they're too busy singing your song. Either way, you're alive!
target: 你在外面没被枪打过 也许因为每个人都买你的屁话 或者因为他们太忙于唱你的歌 不论怎样,你都还活着!

source: Woohoo, we did it! I got out by making the point that Samba's ascent to the throne is also what forces Simone to mature, and everyone bought it!
target: 呜呼,我们做到了! 我出局时指出桑巴登上王位 也是西蒙娜的缘故 所有人都买下了它

source: They kicked me out 'cause I couldn't stop farting. But I'll take it!
target: 他们把我赶出去 因为我不能停止放屁。 但我会接受的!

source: You drive away from the prison, humming your catchy song, and gain +N2 MIND for your clever scene work.
target: 你开车离开监狱,哼出你的好歌, 并获得+N2 MIND的你聪明的场景工作。

source: After hours of intense rehearsal, you and your friends have lost -N2 STAMINA, but you're ready to perform!
target: 紧张的排练几小时后,你和你的朋友都输了N2 STAMINA,但你已经准备好表演了!

source: "The Lion Prince" is first to go on. You'll be playing the titular role of Samba.
target: ""狮子王子"先行. 你会扮演桑巴的三角角色

source: Samba, as your father and the king of the savannah, I want you to look around. Everything the light touches is our kingdom!
target: 桑巴 作为你父亲和草原之王 我要你四处看看 光线触摸的一切都是我们的王国!

source: The only rule is DON'T go into the shadowy parts. That's your evil Uncle Garbage's territory, and he's super mean!
target: 唯一的规则是不要进入阴暗的部分。 那是你邪恶的"垃圾叔叔"的地盘,他也超级卑鄙!

source: Heyyy, Samba! I'm your Uncle Garbage! I pinky-promise I'm not evil. You should totally go to the place your father explicitly forbade, for the lulz.
target: 嘿,桑巴! 嘿,桑巴! 桑巴! 桑巴,你好吗? 我是你的垃圾叔叔! ! 我是你的垃圾叔叔! 我小指发誓我不是邪恶的。 你应该去你父亲明令禁止的地方 吃苦艾酒

source: I'll think about it... but wait, what's that square wooden structure over there?
target: 我会考虑的... 等等,那边的平面木结构是什么?

source: Huh? I've never noticed that before. Is that part of your kingdom or mine, Garbage?
target: 是吗? 我从来没有注意到过这一点。 那是你的王国还是我的? 垃圾?

source: I have no clue, brother. I think we should just ignore that Macguffin until it becomes relevant.
target: 我完全不知道,兄弟,你这混蛋 我认为我们应该忽略那颗麦克芬 直到它变得相关

source: Later in the play, a herd of running wildebeests is threatening to trample Samba and his father.
target: 剧后一群跑出野生的野生蜂群威胁要践踏桑巴和他的父亲.

source: GARBAGE! BRO! You gotta help my son and me over this cliff!
target: 盖巴吉! 哥们! 你得帮我的儿子和我渡过这悬崖!

source: NEVER! Fuck that "long live the king" shit -- you're both going in the canyon!
target: 从来没有! 操他妈的"国王万岁"的狗屎——你们都要去峡谷里!

source: You, as Samba, are scared shitless and want to save yourself -- and then you see the door!
target: 你,作为Samba, 害怕的狗屎, 想拯救自己 - 然后你看到门!

source: GO, SAMBA! Run through the door before Garbage kills your dad!
target: 去吧,萨姆巴! 趁垃圾没杀你爸爸前快从门上跑!

source: Great plan! You grab Scott off the cliff and make a run for it!
target: 伟大的计划! 你抓着 斯科特 离开悬崖,跑起来!

source: NOOOOOO! How were my evil plans thwarted by modern architecture?! THIS MAKES NO SEEEEENSE!
target: 不,不,不,不,不,不,不,不,不。 现代建筑是如何挫败我的邪恶计划? 这让人看不到!

source: Woohoo! Great job, bro! We escaped!
target: 呜呼! 干得漂亮,哥们! 我们逃了!

source: Good work out there, gang. We're definitely gonna win a Prison Tony!
target: 干得漂亮,伙计们 我们一定会赢一个监狱托尼!

source: Wait, how did you get out, Polly? It didn't make sense for Uncle Garbage to use the door.
target: 等等,你是怎么出来的, 波莉? 迦叶叔用出出出出门来,不为理所通.

source: No prison can hold me, silly! I'm a ghost! I only stayed this long to see if %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% could pull it off.
target: 没有监狱能关住我,傻子! 我是一个鬼! 我只是呆了这么久 看看能不能... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 可能会成功

source: Cool, nobody but Polly ended up dead today! You drive away from the prison, gaining +N2 HYPE for your clever scene work.
target: 酷,没人能 波莉 死在今天的地盘上! 你开车离开监狱, 获得+N2 HYPE, 你的聪明的场景工作。

source: Deadly games
target: 致命游戏

source: You all go to the prison entrance to inquire about a tour, but the security guards just beat you until you're unconscious. Bummer.
target: 你们都去监狱门口询问一下巡演情况 但保安只是打你 直到你昏迷不醒 可恶

source: Ugh... ow... what happened? Did we go on a bender and I forgot?
target: 唉哟... 额... 发生什么事了? 我们是不是去吃甜菜了,我忘了?

source: Sweet, you guys are finally awake. Now we can solve this puzzle!
target: 甜心,你们终于醒了 现在我们可以解开这个谜题了!

source: What puzzle? Where are we, Dahlia?
target: 什么谜题? 我们在哪里, 达莉娅?

source: We're in the experimental prison. We were all kidnapped and put in here as a metaphor for how selfish monsters are or something dumb.
target: 我们在实验监狱 我们都被绑架了 关在这里 以比喻自私的怪物有多蠢

source: In order to escape, we need to solve this puzzle. There are two doors in this room: one leads to freedom, the other to certain death.
target: 为了逃脱,我们需要解决这个谜题. 这个房间有两个门:一个通往自由,另一个通往一定的死亡.

source: But there's a guy guarding each door. One guard always tells the truth, and the other guard always lies.
target: 但每扇门都有人看守 一个警卫总是说出真相,另一个警卫总是撒谎.

source: We only have one chance to ask a guard a question and pick the right door, or we DIE.
target: 我们只有一个机会问一个警卫问题 并选对门,否则我们就会死。

source: I know how to solve this riddle! We can ask a guard which door the other guard would tell us to--
target: 我知道怎么解开这个谜语! 我们可以问一个警卫 哪个门的警卫会告诉我们...

source: BOOOOOORING! Don't be a boring boob, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Let's add some spice to this situation!
target: 呜呼! 别像个无聊的乳房 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我们再加点香料

source: It's not often we get the opportunity to ask someone ANYTHING OUR HEARTS DESIRE.
target: 我们不常有机会问别人 我们的心跳。

source: ...We've literally always had that opportunity. Asking people stuff is free.
target: 我们一直有机会 问人事是免费的。

source: Yeah, but now we've got added stakes to the situation! And the stakes are meaningless to me because I'm already dead, so let's just have fun with it!
target: 是的,但现在我们得到了 额外的赌注的情况! 赌注对我来说毫无意义 因为我已经死了 所以让我们玩玩吧!

source: But Scott, Dahlia, and I aren't dead yet, and we'd really like to stay that way!
target: 不过 斯科特, 达莉娅我还没死,我们真的想保持这样!

source: Ha! I'd like to see them TRY to kill me. Worst case scenario I just get another cool scar out of this.
target: 我想看看他们想杀我 最坏的情况是,我刚刚得到了另一个很酷的伤疤 从这里。

source: And my understanding of mortality is shaky at best, so I'd rather do this Polly's way!
target: 我对死亡率的理解 充其量是动摇的 所以我宁愿这么做 波莉就是这样!

source: Well, dang. Peer pressure is your greatest weakness. Guess you can worry about not dying later; it's funny question time!
target: 哦赣. 同伴压力是你们最大的弱点 看来你担心以后不会死,这是有趣的问题时间!
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: NICE! Let's fight fire with fire: if these guards wanted to mindfuck us with this riddle, let's ask them a mind-fucky question to get back at 'em!
target: 不错! 让我们用火来打火:如果这些警卫想用这个谜语来操我们,让我们问他们一个疯狂的问题,让他们重新对付他们!

source: Emotional warfare: "Guard of the left door... is it true that you've developed secret feelings for guard of the right door?"
target: 情感战:"左门之护卫...... 你是否真的对守住正确的门 产生了秘密的感情?"

source: FOMO warfare: "Guards, now that we're all good friends, I thought about renting quads for all of us. Wanna join us for a day of thrill, fun, and quads?"
target: FOMO战争:"卫兵们,既然我们都是好朋友,我想租四角,给大家. 和我们一起享受一天的刺激、乐趣和四分卫吗?"

source: Ooh, nasty! We're definitely gonna lose -N2 SOUL for playing dirty, but fuck it, I wanna see what they say!
target: 哦,讨厌! 我们绝对会输的 -N2 SOUL玩脏,但他妈的,我想看看他们说什么!

source: You stroll up to the first guard and ask him your question.
target: 你走到第一位警卫 问他你的问题。

source: "Well... I... I don't know what you mean!" he says, sweating. "We're coworkers, and office romances are usually bad news, and... and..."
target: "这个嘛... 我…… 我不懂你的意思 他说出汗 "我们是同事,而办公室浪漫通常是坏消息,和. 还有..."

source: "UGH, FUCK IT! I can't tell a lie! It's true, I'm hopelessly in love with Guard #2!"
target: "噢,他妈的! 我无法说谎! 是真的,我对"警卫2"毫无希望地爱上了!"

source: "After years of working together, all the nice conversations, I couldn't help catching feelings. And we have so much in common! We both guard doors!"
target: "经过多年的共同努力,所有的好交谈,我忍不住去捕捉感情. 我们有很多共同点! 我们都是守门的!"

source: "You really love me?" Guard #2 gasps. "Guard #1, I... I don't feel the same."
target: "你真的爱我?" 警卫#2喘息。 "警卫一号,我..." 我的感觉不一样".

source: WHAAAAT?! How could you break his heart so casually, bro?!
target: 华亚特! 你怎么能这么随便地伤了他的心 兄弟

source: Guard #1 looks like he might cry, but then he realizes: "Wait, but you always lie, don't you? Does that mean... you DO feel the same?!"
target: 卫一看似会哭出声来,但后来他意识到:"等等,但你总是撒谎,不是吗? 这是否意味着... 你感觉一样吗?"

source: Guard #2 winks roguishly. "I dunno, Guard #1... why don't you come over here and find out?"
target: 守将2 眨眼相向 "我不知道,警卫1号... "你为什么不过来看看?"

source: Holy shit! HOLY SHIT! They're hardcore making out! THIS IS THE BEEEEST!
target: 妈的! 神圣的地狱! 他们都是硬核 这是最美的!

source: What a twist! Here I thought we were in a deadly-games genre scenario, when it was actually a rom-com all along!
target: 多么曲折的一曲风! 我以为我们是在一场致命的游戏中 那时它实际上是一个ROM -com一直!

source: With the guards distracted, you can easily check both doors. You find the right exit and leave unharmed!
target: 警卫们分心了,你就可以很容易地检查两扇门. 你找到正确的出口,然后安全离开!

source: I'm happy we left safely, but I'm even happier those guards found true love.
target: 我很高兴我们安全离开 但我更高兴那些警卫找到了真爱

source: True dat. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s a master riddle-solver AND match-maker!
target: 真实的DAT。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%"是一个解谜大师和媒人!"

source: Yup, you're the total package. You're also the proud owner of +N2 HYPE. Good work, champ!
target: 是的,你就是那个包 也是"+N2 HYPE"的骄傲地主人. 干得漂亮,冠军!

source: QUADS?! I fucking love quads! They drive on ALL TERRAINS! I love a vehicle that doesn't know when to quit!
target: 快速警报器? 我他妈的爱四分奏! 他们开着所有的TERRAINS! 我喜欢一辆不知何时退出的车!

source: WOOHOO! QUAD DAY! QUAD DAY! QUAD DAY!
target: 呜呼! 问候日! 问候日! 问候日!

source: What do you say, guards? Wanna ride quads with us and maybe get ice cream after?
target: 卫兵,你觉得怎么样? 想和我们一起骑四座车 然后去吃冰淇淋吗?

source: "Quads AND ice cream?! That sounds so fun!" one of the guards says. "Count me in!"
target: "四分卫和冰淇淋? 听起来好好玩啊!" 有个警卫说 "请进"

source: The other guard is sweating and shaking profusely. Is he... okay?
target: 彼卫所出出汗而发抖. 他有没有... 好吗?

source: "OKAY, FINE!" he finally cries. "I really want to go too!"
target: "好吧,没事" 他终于哭了。 "我也很想去" ("我很想去") ("我很想去")

source: "Guard #2!" Guard #1 gasps. "You always lie! Do you mean to tell me that... you don't like quads?"
target: "二号守卫",一号守卫喘气 "你总是撒谎! 你是说... 你不喜欢四分卫?"

source: How could anyone not like quads? A world where people hate having fun on four-wheelers isn't a world I wanna live in!
target: 怎么会有人不喜欢四分卫? 这个世界人们讨厌在四轮车上玩乐 而不是我想要活的世界!

source: "No, I really do want to go!" Guard #2 says, tearing up. "I'm sorry I failed to lie, but I just couldn't say no to quads!"
target: "不,我真的想去" 警卫2号说,撕裂了。 "对不起我没能撒谎,但我就是不能拒绝四分卫!"

source: Wow, he's actually sobbing. Way to play mind-games, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 哇,他实际上在哭。 玩思维游戏的方式, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: "Hey, man, it's okay," Guard #1 says sympathetically. "You don't have to cry. I won't tell the boss you broke character."
target: 卫一说"嘿,伙计,没关系","卫一"表示同情. target: 每个科幻的节目都要有一个,我想。 开出去.

source: You all traverse the maze, dodging traps, getting injured, and generally going through the emotional wringer.
target: 你们都穿过迷宫,躲过陷阱,受伤, 并且一般地穿过情绪的摇摆.

source: Ugh, fine. You sneak out of Europe with the Valiant Buff Noodles action figure in your ass, which is a sentence I never thought I'd say.
target: 呃,没事。 你偷偷溜出欧洲 与安定布夫面条 行动人物在你的屁股, 这是一个句子 我从来没有想过我会说。

source: Yay, our own Valiant Buff Noodles! The box says it comes with "dozens of fun voice lines to make you forget the crushing weight of being alive!"
target: 万岁,我们自己的活活泼的巴夫面! 盒子里说它有"几十个有趣的语音线让你忘记活着的压抑重量"!

source: Scott pulls Valiant Buff Noodles' pull string. You would've washed it off first if you were him, but whatever.
target: 斯科特 拔出瓦连特·巴夫·尼多斯的拉弦 如果你是他,你就会先洗掉它,但不管怎样。

source: "Hi, I'm Valiant Buff Noodles!" says the doll.
target: "嗨,我是瓦利安特·巴夫面",娃娃说。

source: Hiii Noodles!
target: 来点面条!

source: "Existence is pain!"
target: "存在就是痛苦"

source: Wow, it really sounds just like him!
target: 哇,这听起来真像他!

source: "All hail Noodles' Europe! It has the most pizza, and no dirty communists!"
target: "所有万岁面条的欧洲! 它有最多的比萨饼, 没有肮脏的共产党人!"

source: Uh...
"What does fire taste like? Lick some and find out!"
target: "火味何等? 舔了点,再查清楚!"

source: Okay! Anyone got a lighter?
target: 好,我们走! 有人有打火机吗?

source: You know what? That's enough Valiant Buff Noodles.
target: 你知道吗? 够了,巴夫面条。

source: Polly throws the action figure out of the car window. Guess it was fun while it lasted.
target: 波莉 将动作图从车窗扔出。 估计这很有趣

source: You lost -N2 SOUL stealing from Noodles' Europe, but at least those wacky catchphrases gave you +N2 HYPE!
target: 你输了N2 SOUL从面条欧洲偷东西 但至少那些疯话给了你+N2 HYPE!

source: International relations
target: 国际关系

source: This "country" is little more than a cottage in a small field. You walk through the open door and see several important-looking people sitting around a table.
target: 这个"国家"只不过是小地里的一栋小屋. 你走进开门,看到几个长相重要的人坐在桌子上。

source: Okay, settle down everyone. I officially call the annual Monster United Nations meeting to order!
target: 好了,大家冷静下来。 我正式宣布每年的怪物联合国会议开始!

source: I'm Baal Berith, here today in representation of Hell.
target: 我是Baal Berith 今天代表地狱

source: I'm Ambassador Fischoeder, representing the Merkingdom. Our nation is happy to test the "peaceful political discourse" thing before jumping straight to global invasions.
target: 我是费肖德大使,代表默金多姆。 我们的国家很高兴在直接跳入全球入侵之前,先去检验"和平的政治言论"的事情.

source: And I'm Noodles, representing my country, Noodles' Europe!
target: 我是面条,代表我的国家,面条的欧洲!

source: Is there a specific reason as to why we recognize Noodles' "sovereign nation" as a legitimate country?
target: 我们为什么承认面条"主权国家"为合法国家,有具体的理由吗?

source: It's a long story. The short version is we don't want a repeat of what happened last time we tried to kick him out of the MUN.
target: 说来话长. 短篇的版本是,我们不想重复上次试图将他赶出MUN时发生的事情.

source: Teehee!
target: 田晓! 田晓!

source: The rest of the ambassadors introduce themselves. The Ambassadors of Belgium, Singapore, Madagascar, and Christmas Island are all present.
target: 其余大使介绍. 比利时、新加坡、马达加斯加和圣诞岛大使都在场。

source: Great! I think that's everyone, so let's begin!
target: 不错! Great! 我想大家都在,我们开始吧!

source: "Wait a minute," says the Singaporean ambassador. "Who are those people sitting off to the side?"
target: 新加坡大使说,“等一下”。 "那些坐在一边的人是谁?"

source: Hey bros! Don't mind us, we just wanted to listen in.
target: 嘿,兄弟们! 别介意,我们只是想听进去

source: "You can't do that!" cries the Belgian ambassador. "This is a classified meeting amongst some of the most respected, dangerous leaders in the monster world!"
target: "你不能这么做" 比利时大使哭喊 "这是在怪物世界中最受尊重,最危险的领导人中举行的秘密会议".

source: Yet you let Noodles in?
target: 你让面条进来了吗?

source: You have no idea what war crimes I'm capable of!
target: 你根本不知道我能干出什么战争罪行!

source: Okay, fine. Then... we're actually ambassadors of a new country called... "The Independent Republic of Prankz." Yeah, let's go with that.
target: 好吧,没事。 那麽... 我们实际上是新国家的大使,叫... "恶作剧独立共和国",我们来听听吧

source: Sounds made up... but all countries are made up I suppose. You can stay, but according to diplomatic laws you can only participate in one point of discussion.
target: 听起来是编的... 但所有国家都是由我决定的 你可以留下来,但根据外交法律,你只能参加一个讨论点.

source: It's to help ease new countries into international politics.
target: 帮助让新国家进入国际政治.

source: You check the itinerary for today's meeting. Which point of discussion do you choose?
target: 你检查一下今天的会议日程 你选择哪一点讨论?

source: International Trade Treaties
target: 国际贸易条约

source: Diplomatic negotiations aiming to stop Noodles' Europe from building nuclear weapons
target: 旨在阻止面条欧洲制造核武器的外交谈判

source: International Trade Treaties it is. You wait until they get to that point of discussion. When you join, some of the action has started already...
target: 国际贸易条约就是这样。 你等着他们讨论到那个点吧 当你加入,一些行动已经开始...

source: Noodles, intel tells us you manufacture some weird products in your country, and Hell wants in. We're open to trade you 20,000 soldiers for 0.1% of your gross national product.
target: 面条,情报告诉我们 你在你的国家制造一些怪异的产品,地狱想要加入。 我们愿意以2万士兵换取国民生产总值的0.1%

source: Wait, I want a slice of that money pie! Noodles, I gotta have that 0.1% GNP!
target: 等等,我要吃一块钱派! 面条,我必须拥有0.1%的国产总值!

source: Okay, what will you give me for it?
target: 好吧,你给我什么?

source: How about this: the Independent Republic of Prankz can offer you a thirty-million dollar military armament...
target: 怎么样? 独立共和国 兰克兹可以给你提供三千万的军需品...

source: OR, you can have whatever's in %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s right hand.
target: OR,你可以有任何东西在 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%右手执之.

source: This is idiotic. Military power is obviously the better deal; there's no way anybody would be stupid enough to--
target: 这太蠢了 军事力量显然是最好的交易, 任何人都不会愚蠢到...

source: I CAN'T HANDLE THE SUSPENSE! I'll take the right hand!
target: 我不能处理的悬铃! 我拿右手来!

source: Great choice! Your prize is a coupon entitling you to a free pizza!
target: 伟大的选择! 你的奖品是一张优惠券 让你可以免费吃披萨!

source: Actually, wait... it seems to be a buy-one-get-one free pizza coupon. So you still have to buy a pizza to use it. But still, it's something!
target: 其实,等等... 看来是买单免费披萨券 所以你还是得买个比萨才能用 不过,还是有道理的!

source: Oh, no, not the angry eyebrows! When he draws on the angry eyebrows it can only mean one thing... war crimes!
target: 哦,不,不是愤怒的眉毛! 他画出愤怒的眉毛 只能意味着一件事 战争犯罪!

source: You will worry about war crimes tomorrow... today, you gain +N2 MONEY from Noodles' Europe.
target: 明天你会担心战争犯罪... 今天,你从面条的欧洲得到+N2货币.

source: But you still lose -N2 MIND from doing lots of brainy diplomacy.
target: 但你还是会因为 做很多聪明的外交而失去N2 MIND

source: Yeah, stopping Noodles from building weapons of mass destruction sounds like the sensible choice here.
target: 阻止面条制造出大规模毁灭性武器 听起来很明智

source: You wait until they get to that point of discussion. When you join, some of the action has started already...
target: 你等着他们讨论到那个点吧 当你加入,一些行动已经开始...

source: Fuck off! You can't make me stop making my nuclear weapons, no way, no how!
target: 滚开! 你不能让我停止制造核武器,没有办法,没有办法!

source: Maybe it's too late! Maybe I've even already built the nuclear weapons... and I have them stored here, inside this cardboard box!
target: 也许已经太晚了! 可能我甚至已经制造出核武器... 我把它们藏在这 放在纸箱里

source: He's bluffing! Not even Ambassador Noodles would be reckless enough to put nuclear weapons in a cardboard box.
target: 他在虚张声势! 甚至面条大使也不会轻率地把核武器放入纸板箱。

source: You think so? Are you so sure that you're willing to let me... DROP IT?!
target: 你这么认为? 你这么确定你愿意让我... 把它扔下来!

source: NO! DON'T DO THAT!
target: 没有! 别那么做!

source: Noodles, if you have nukes in there, you have to show us. International negotiations rules entitle us to at least a five-second peek of all nuclear bombs.
target: 面条,如果你有核弹在那里, 你必须告诉我们。 国际谈判规则使我们至少能够五秒钟地查看所有核弹。

source: Ugh, fine...
target: 额,没事...

source: SIKE! I got you! Hahaha, you should've seen the looks on your faces!
target: 烟啦! 我抓住你了! 我抓住你了! 我抓住你了! 我抓住你了! I got you! 哈哈哈,你应该看看 你脸上的表情!

source: I think we can reach a compromise. Ambassador Noodles, if you let Ambassador Fischoeder have the box, Scott will do a silly dance for you.
target: 我认为我们可以达成妥协。 面条大使,如果你让费舒德大使拿着盒子 斯科特 为你跳个傻舞

source: Trust me, it's VERY silly. You won't wanna miss it!
target: 相信我,这太傻了。 你不会想错过的!

source: Well... if it's really that silly... then okay!
target: 这个... 如果真的那么傻的话... 那还好!

source: Woohoo! Silly dancing time! Doo-dee-doo-dee-dah!
target: 呜呼! 无聊的舞蹈时间! 道德道德兴!

source: Haha, that dance was great! Totally worth it. You guys can look in the box now.
target: 哈哈,那舞蹈很棒! ! 跳得真好,我还挺厉害的! 绝对值得 你们现在可以看看盒子了

source: Fucking hell, he really DID have nukes in here!
target: 他妈的,他真的有 核武器在这里!

source: Told ya! Teehee!
target: 告诉你了! 田晓! 田晓!

source: Hooray, we stopped the nuclear apocalypse! SILLY DANCE TIME! Doo-dee-doo-dee-dah!
target: 万岁,我们阻止了核启示录! 安静地跳舞! 道德道德兴!

source: You lost -N2 MIND from all the brainy diplomacy, but you gained +N2 SOUL for taking nukes away from Noodles!
target: 你从所有聪明的外交中输了N2 MID 但你因为从面条上拿走核武器而获得了+N2 Suul!

source: Learn the country's customs
target: 学习国家的风俗习惯

source: This "country" is little more than a cottage in a small field. You knock on the door.
target: 这个"国家"只不过是小地里的一栋小屋. 你敲门。

source: Hi there, foreigners! Welcome to my country: Noodles' Europe!
target: 嗨,外国人! 欢迎来到我的祖国:面条的欧洲!

source: "Noodles' Europe?" But isn't there already a continent called Europe?
target: "面条的欧洲",但难道不是已经有一个叫做"欧洲"的大陆了?

source: Yeah, but I liked the name! Don't like it, make your own country!
target: 是的,但我很喜欢这个名字! 不喜欢,做你自己的国家!

source: Okay, live your truth. So what are some of the customs of Noodles' Europe?
target: 好吧,活在你的真理中。 那么,什么是一些习俗 面条的欧洲?

source: One is that it's a common European custom to breathe using your lungs.
target: 一种是,使用肺气呼吸是欧洲常见的习惯.

source: It began as a fashion statement in the upper class, but it became popular in all social castes when people realized lung-breathing was the best way not to die of suffocation.
target: 它开始作为上层阶级的时尚言论,但在人们意识到肺出血是不会被窒息而死的最佳方法时,它在所有社会种姓中被流行.

source: We also eat everything slathered in mayo! Except for No Mayo Mondays, when eating mayo is punishable by death.
target: 蛋黄酱里所有被铺平的东西我们都吃! 除了"无"五月周一,吃"五月""五月""五月""会被判处死刑.

source: And the favorite cultural pastime is to write Don Quixote!
target: 最喜欢的文化消遣是写"唐克索特"!.

source: You mean read Don Quixote?
target: 你是说读"唐克多"?

source: No, write it! No European has ever read the original work, but we know about it through pop culture, so whenever we have free time we take to writing the story ourselves.
target: 不,写下来! 没有欧洲人看过原作, 但我们通过流行文化了解, 所以每当我们有空的时候, 我们自己写故事。

source: So you just... rewrite the events of Don Quixote verbatim?
target: 所以你只是... . . . . . . 重写"唐克多特"的逐字事件?.

source: Not REwrite, silly! No one's ever read it, remember? We just write what we think is the closest version to Don Quixote we can imagine.
target: 别重写,傻瓜! 没人读过,记得吗? 我们只是写我们所认为的 与唐·克克索特最接近的版本 我们可以想象。

source: In any case, you foreigners are in for a treat. Today's a special day in Europe!
target: 无论如何,你们这些外国人要来吃点东西 今天是欧洲特别的日子!

source: Oh, cool! Is today a holiday or something!
target: 哦,酷毙了! 今天是节日还是什么的?

source: Better! Today is TWO holidays!
target: 好多了! 来点吧! 今天是两个节日!

source: Wait, two? Isn't that kinda inefficient? Why not just give each holiday its own day so people can focus on celebrating just the one?
target: 等等,两个? 那样是不是有点低效? 为什么不给每个节日自己的节日 让大家集中精力庆祝呢?

source: Because it's my country and I make the rules! If I wanna have two holidays on the same day, THEN THAT'S HOW IT'S GONNA FUCKIN' BE!
target: 因为那是我的国家,我做规则! 如果我想在同一天有两个假期, 那么它会如何他妈的'是!

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why don't you pick which holiday we celebrate? The President of Europe commands you to!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你为什么不选择我们庆祝的节日呢? 欧洲总统命令你!

source: Tanksgiving, the holiday in which we all give tanks to those who we love.
target: 坦克之旅,我们共同赠送坦克的节日

source: Freaky Friday, the Friday in which we swap our bodies with a loved one to live wacky misadventures that ultimately teach us a valuable lesson in empathy.
target: 怪胎星期五,我们用我们的身体 和一个爱人交换 我们生活在疯狂的错觉中, 最终给我们一个宝贵的教训 在同情。

source: Great choice! To show my appreciation for you all visiting Europe today, here's a tank specially made for each of you!
target: 伟大的选择! 为了向今天访问欧洲的各位表示谢意,这里有一个专门为你们每个人设计的坦克!

source: Aww, thanks Noodles! Mine's covered in peanut butter!
target: 谢谢面条! 我的花生酱都覆盖了!

source: My tank shoots confetti instead of bullets, but at the same lethal speeds! This RULES!
target: 我的坦克是用针头而不是子弹射的 但速度和致命的一样 这条规矩!

source: Okay, since you guys are my friends, I'll gift you some tanks too. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I installed a gaming chair in yours so you'd feel right at home.
target: 好吧,既然你们是我的朋友, 我也会给你一些坦克。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我在你家装了个游戏椅 这样你就能感觉自己在家了

source: FUCK. YES.
target: 他妈的。 对。

source: I wanna give tanks too! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, take this tank. It's a Howl family heirloom passed down through one generation, and it's covered in peanut butter!
target: 我也想给坦克!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%拿着这辆坦克 这是豪尔家族传承者传入一代,被花生酱所覆盖!.

source: How sweet! You gift your friends some tanks too. You're very tankful to have loved ones who gave you such great tanks.
target: 多么可爱! 你也给朋友一些坦克 你非常有胆量 拥有爱人 谁给你如此伟大的坦克。

source: You, Polly, Scott, and Noodles all share a holiday dinner... while in your tanks. Then you play some sports, also in your tanks.
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉, 斯科特面条都分享一个节日晚餐... 时入于所出之坦克. 然后在坦克里也玩运动

source: Full contact tank football was fun and destructive. Tank yoga was more experimental, but dang, tanks are more flexible than you'd have thought.
target: 完全接触坦克足球是有趣和破坏性的。 坦克瑜伽更是实验性的,但该死的,坦克比你想象的灵活.

source: "Tank" you all for celebrating Tanksgiving with me. Enjoy your tanks!
target: 你们都跟我庆祝坦克教育 享受你的坦克吧! 享受你的坦克吧!

source: Just know if you ever use them against me, I have the self-destruction codes. Toodleoo!
target: 如果你们用它们来对付我 我有自毁密码 顿顿顿

source: As fun as this was, I don't really NEED a tank, and it'd be hard to fit one into my luggage. We should sell these.
target: 和这一样有趣,我并不真的需要坦克, 并且它会很难 在一个在我的行李。 我们应该卖掉这些

source: Good call. You still have to sell them at a loss since your tanks are obviously used, bruised, and covered in peanut butter, so you lose -N2 MONEY.
target: 说得好 仍然得亏损地卖掉它们 因为你的坦克显然被用过 被打成碎片 被花生酱覆盖 所以你就输了 -N2 MONEY.

source: But at least you gained +N2 HYPE sharing the joys of extremely dangerous armored vehicles with the ones you love!
target: 但至少你得到了+N2 HYPE 分享极度危险的装甲车辆的欢乐 与你爱的人!

source: AWESOME! I can't wait to trade bodies with my mom and learn the struggle of being a single mother of two trying to make ends meet while moonlighting as a chess coach!
target: 赞! 我等不及要和我妈交换身体 学会做两个单身母亲 努力求得满足 却在做棋盘教练时挣扎!

source: Okay, I'll switch bodies with my mom too! I'll learn so many cool things about her, like her name, and where she is, and why she never calls me!
target: 好吧,我也会和我妈交换身体! 我会学很多关于她的东西, 像她的名字,她在哪里, 和为什么她从来没有给我打电话!

source: Ehhh... it doesn't work like that. You have to already know the person you're switching bodies with.
target: 额... 那样不行 你该已经知道要和谁换身体了

source: Oh...
Hey, Scott, chin up. How about this: we're best buds who love each other lots. Why don't you and I switch bodies instead?
target: 顿 斯科特下巴抬起头来 不如这样吧,我们是爱彼此的最好的伙伴 为什么不换换换我和我们的身体?

source: You'd really do that for me, bro? Thank you so much!
target: 你真的会为我这么做吗 兄弟? 非常感谢!

source: Using -N2 MAGIC, Noodles recites the Ancient Switcheroo Incantation, and Polly and Scott's minds get totally swapped!
target: 面条使用-N2 MAGIC,背诵古代开关活塞, 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特脑海完全被换了

source: BROOO! Am I really Polly now? Weird... should I try talking like Polly?
target: 布鲁! 我是真的吗? 波莉 现在? 怪怪的... 我该像说话一样 波莉?

source: Hey, boo! I'm Polly! I'm gorgeous and funny and I read big books and I do lots of dances with my butt! Watch me go!
target: 嘿,嘘! 我是 波莉! 我美丽又幽默,我读了大书,我用我的屁股跳了很多舞! 看着我走!

source: Nice moves! Damn, I have a FINE ass. Hmm, okay, I'll try being you now.
target: 动作不错! 该死,我屁股很爽 嗯,好吧,我会尝试成为你。

source: AWOOOOO! Check it out, bros, I'm Scott! I have big muscles and an even bigger heart! SPORTS! SPORTS! SPORTS!
target: 摆! 你看,兄弟们,我 斯科特! 我有大肌肉,还有更大的心脏! 萨特斯! 萨特斯! 萨特斯!

source: Wow, you sound totally like me. You almost had me fooled that you WERE Scott!
target: 哇,你听起来完全像我。 你差点让我骗了你 斯科特!

source: Thanks! Ready to switch back now? Being body-swapped is fun, but this heartbeat of yours is really distracting.
target: 谢谢! 现在可以换回了吗? 被划去身体很有趣 但你的心跳真的让人分心了

source: Noodles reverses the spell, and your friends are back to their old selves again.
target: 面条会倒行逆施 你的朋友又回到了自己的老样子

source: Great work! But it wouldn't be a true Freaky Friday if you didn't learn a moral lesson along the way. What'd you guys learn?

target: 嗨,先生,你好吗? 销售员! 我是 斯科特这些是我的朋友 我们能开你的车吗?

source: "Well, are you interested in buying one of my cars?" asks the salesman.
target: "你有兴趣买我的车吗?" 问推销员

source: ...Yes?
target: 是吗?

source: "Good enough for me! Here are the keys. Bring it back before 7 p.m.; I need to close the dealership by then."
target: "对我来说足够了! 钥匙在这里。 晚上7点前带回来,我需要在那之前关闭经销商".

source: You're pretty sure this is not a good or smart way of selling used cars. But hey, you're not complaining.
target: 你敢肯定这不是一个好或聪明的 出售旧车的方式。 但你没抱怨吧?

source: Scott peels out of the dealership in the new car and drives an hour into the city. You're waiting at a stoplight when a breathless pregnant woman knocks on your window.
target: 斯科特 出新车经销商 开一小时入城. 你正在等待在停电灯 当一个没有呼吸的孕妇敲你的窗户。

source: Are you my Oober? Thank God you're here! You gotta take me to the hospital!
target: 你是我的欧伯? 谢天谢地你来了! 你一定要带我去医院!

source: Uh, we're not...
target: 呃,我们不是...

source: You're an Oober?! Hey, c'mon, take me instead. I gotta follow that cab!
target: 你是乌伯人? 嘿,来吧,带我代替。 我要跟着那辆出租车!

source: Why? What's so special about the cab?
target: 为什么? 出租车有什么特别的?

source: What is this, twenty fucking questions? We don't have time to chat, we gotta chase that cab down!
target: 这是什么,20个他妈的问题? 我们没时间聊天了,我们得追那辆出租车!

source: Hey, fuck off! I NEED to get to the hospital! Can't you see I'm pregnant?!
target: 嘿,滚开! 我得去医院! 你没看到我怀孕了吗?

source: Am I supposed to give a damn?! I gotta follow that cab RIGHT! FUCKING! NOW!
target: 我该在乎吗? 我得跟在出租车上! 他妈的! 现在!

source: You're not an Oober, but now you NEED to see how this ends. You decide to pick up...
target: 你不是Oober,但现在你需要看看 如何结束这一切。 你决定接...

source: The pregnant lady. She needs your help... even if it means never knowing why the mysterious man was so fixated on following that taxi.
target: 怀孕的女士 怀孕的女士 怀孕的女士 怀孕的女士 她需要你的帮助... 即使这表示永远不知道 为什么神秘男人如此执着地追着那辆出租车

source: The mysterious man. You're REALLY intrigued. And the pregnant lady... well, you know what they say: curiosity killed the cat (but not the newborn, so she'll be fine).
target: 那个神秘的人 你真的很感兴趣。 还有那个怀孕的女士... 你知道他们说的:好奇心杀死了猫(但不是新生儿,所以她会好起来的).

source: But we aren't gonna find out what was so special about that taxi! Can we... I don't know... follow the taxi on the way to the hospital?
target: 但我们不会发现那辆出租车有什么特别的! 我们能不能... 我不知道... 我不知道... 我不知道,这是什么? 跟着出租车去医院?

source: NO, YOU CAN'T! THIS IS KIND OF AN EMERGENCY SITUATION!
target: 不,你不能这样! 这是种紧急情况!

source: Bummer. You lose -N2 MIND for never solving that mystery. Scott starts driving to the hospital.
target: 可恶 你因为永远无法解开这个谜题而失去N2 MIND.  斯科特 开始开车去医院。

source: Don't worry, miss, we'll get you through this! PUSH!
target: 别担心,小姐,我们会帮你渡过难关的! 推倒他! 推倒他! 推倒他! 推倒他! 推倒他! 推倒他! 推倒他!

source: Push what?
target: 推什么? 推什么? 推什么?

source: I dunno, I've just heard people say that to pregnant women in movies. Maybe you should do push-ups?
target: 我不知道,我刚听到人们在电影中 向孕妇说。 也许你应该做俯卧撑?

source: Huh? You know I'm not in labor right now, don't you? I'm only seven months along.
target: 是吗? 你知道我现在不是在工作,不是吗? 我只有七个月了

source: Oh, sorry... that's awkward. I just figured, since you were going to the hospital...
target: 哦,对不起... 有点尴尬 我只是觉得,既然你要去医院...

source: Well, honestly, I'm not actually going to the hospital. I'm going to the hot dog truck parked outside of it.
target: 老实说,我其实不会去医院的 我要去停在外面的热狗卡车

source: It's just that Oober drivers tend to actually step on it if I tell them I'm going to the hospital.
target: 只是Oober司机通常会踩到它 如果我告诉他们我要去医院。

source: WE'RE GETTING HOT DOGS?! BEST HOSPITAL VISIT EVER!
target: 我们得到热狗! 最好的医院访问 永远!

source: But if all you wanted was a hot dog, why were you so breathless and desperate when we picked you up?
target: 但如果你只想吃热狗 为什么我们接你的时候你那么无气和绝望?

source: Because I'm really fucking craving this hot dog, okay?! Don't judge me! YOU should try being pregnant!
target: 因为我真的很渴望这热狗,好吗? 别评判我! 你该试试怀孕的滋味!

source: Ew. Pass.
target: 额 过.

source: You drive her to the hot dog truck, then return the car to the dealership. I guess getting a pregnant lady food is still a pretty good deed, so here, take +N2 SOUL.
target: 你开车送她去热狗卡车 然后把车还给经销商 我想买个怀孕的女士食物还是件好事 所以在这里 吃一喝一喝一喝一喝一喝

source: Helping the pregnant woman might be the right thing to do... but you REALLY want to know what's so special about that cab.
target: 帮助孕妇也许是正确的事情... 但你真的想知道 出租车有什么特别的

source: Besides, she can always watch a YooToob tutorial on how to have an at-home birth. She'll probably be fine!
target: 此外,她还可以随时观看"柳通"的"如何在家生孩子"的辅导. 她可能没事的!

source: You all speed off with the taxi-chaser!
target: 你们都快跟出租车司机走!

source: HANG A FAST RIGHT! STEP ON IT! DON'T LOSE SIGHT OF THAT CAB!
target: 抓紧了! 踩起来! 别失去那头大头!

source: Stepping on it, bro!
target: 踩着它,兄弟!

source: HOLD IT! I need you to follow THAT cab now!
target: 坚持住! 我要你马上跟在出租车后面!

source: Why are you changing who you're following?
target: 你为什么改变你跟踪的是谁?

source: WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR QUESTIONS! THE CAB'S ALREADY MOVING -- GO, GO, GO!
target: 我们没时间问问题了! 大脑已经移动了,走,走,走!

source: Polly, I'm confused...
target: 波莉我有点困惑...

source: Same, but I guess we just gotta trust the process. Follow the taxi!
target: 一样,但我想我们只是必须相信这个过程。 跟着出租车!

source: Okay, stepping on it again!
target: 好,再踩一次! 继续!

source: STOP! Follow that cab now -- wait, no, never mind, follow THAT one!
target: 停下来! 跟着那辆出租车 -- 等等,不,没关系,跟着那辆!

source: Okay, I can't take it anymore: why do you keep wanting to tail different cabs? Why are we following them at all?
target: 好吧,我受不了了,你为什么一直想 跟踪不同的出租车? 我们为什么要跟随他们?

source: Ugh, we're obviously following them because I love looking at taxis!
target: 啊,我们显然跟在他们后面 因为我喜欢看出租车!

source: What? That's stupid. Why can't you just look at them from the sidewalk?
target: 什麽? 蠢到家了,你这混蛋 为什么你不能从人行道上看他们?

source: BECAUSE THEY MOVE TOO FUCKING FAST FOR ME TO PROPERLY APPRECIATE THEM!
target: 因为他们太他妈快了 我非常欣赏他们!

source: I mean, he's not wrong, Polly. When you think about it, this might be a good way of looking at cabs for a long period of time.
target: 我是说,他没说错 波莉. 考虑一下,这可能是一个很好的 方式看出租车很长一段时间。

source: Today we might've lost -N2 SOUL for ignoring a pregnant woman in need, but we gained +N2 MIND from learning why this man wanted us to chase the cab. And at the end of the day...
target: 今天我们可能因为忽略一个有需要的孕妇而失去N2 SOUL, 但我们从了解这个男人为什么想要我们追车而获得了+N2 MIND. 临终时...

source: FOLLOW THAT OTHER CAB!
target: 跟随其他的大脑!

source: Sell some cars
target: 卖出一些车

source: As you and your friends are browsing the assorted cars, a nervous-looking gentleman approaches you and says, "Excuse me, do you work here?"
target: 当你和你的朋友在浏览各种车时, 一个神经质的绅士接近你,说:"对不起,你在这里工作吗?"

source: As far as you know, yes!
Great! Can you help me choose a car to buy? There are so many options, I just can't make up my mind!
target: 不错! Great! 你能帮我选辆车买吗? 有很多选择,我无法决定!

source: Absolutely! Why not buy this gently-used sports car? It's got stick shift, which I heard is on its way back.
target: 当然! 为什么不买这辆轻度运动车? 上面有棍子转身 我听说它正在回来的路上

source: Hmmm, I'm not sure about the color...
target: 嗯,我不知道颜色...

source: What's not to like about red? It's the color of wine, except when it's not.
target: 红色有什么不好的? 取出酒之色相取出,惟有出出出出出出出.

source: Yeah, but is it a TRUE red? It looks like more of a cinnamon. Or maybe it's closer to a blood orange...
target: 是的,但它是真红? 更相取出一肉桂来. 或者它更接近血橙色...

source: (Oh, God.)
target: (出自"天经".

source: How much storage space does this car have?
target: 这辆车有多少存储空间?

source: Hmmm, the only measurement I know is "Scotts." Wanna see how many times I can fit in the trunk?
target: 嗯,我唯一知道的衡量是 "斯科特想看看我有多少次可以装在后备箱里吗?

source: No, thank you. I'm realizing storage space and color aren't so important; what's really bugging me is the number of wheels.
target: 不,谢谢。 我意识到存储空间和颜色并不重要,真正困扰我的是轮子的数量。

source: I mean... four wheels is the classic number of wheels... but is it the number of wheels I REALLY want on a car?
target: 我是说... 四轮是经典的轮子数...... 但它是车轮的数量 我真正想要的车?

source: (%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, step up and sell the car to this man before I find out if HE fits in the trunk.)
target: (%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%上前把车卖给这个人 在我发现他是否适合后车厢之前

source: Hmmm, okay. There's gotta be something you can do to get this guy to hurry up and buy the damn car...
target: 嗯,没关系。 一定有办法让这家伙快点买车...

source: Sweeten the deal: if he buys the car, he can also have one of your kidneys.
target: 温柔交易:如果他买下车,他也可以拥有你的肾脏之一.

source: Lie and tell him the car looks crappy as a camouflage technique to adapt to the surroundings of a used car dealership. Its real form is a kickass battle robot from space!
target: 骗他,告诉他这辆车看起来很烂 是一种伪装技术 适应一个被用过的汽车经销商的周围环境。 它的真面目是太空出产的 令人兴奋的战斗机器人!

source: Hmmm... a kidney, you say?
target: 那个... 你说是肾?

source: And what a kidney it is!
target: 肾是怎样的!

source: Polly slaps you on the kidneys. Ow.
target: 波莉 拍你的肾脏。 呜.

source: These bad boys can fit SO much erythropoietin in them.
target: 这些坏孩子能装入这么多红花素

source: I can make use of a spare kidney, I suppose... but that begs the question: WHICH kidney is for sale?
target: 我可以利用一个多余的肾脏,我想... 问题就在于 肾脏是用来出售的?

source: Oh, easy: it's the left one, right Scott?
target: 很简单,是左边的,对 斯科特?

source: Scott checks what seem to be medical records with... your name on them?!
target: 斯科特 检查一下病历... 你的名字在他们身上?

source: Yup! That one's %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%'s good kidney!
target: 没错! 那个是 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%肾脏好!

source: And it can be yours if you buy this car NOW.
target: 如果你现在买这辆车,它就可以是你的了。

source: Hmmm, yeah... looking at these medical records, this deal isn't half-bad.
target: 嗯,是的,对... 看这些医疗记录, 这个交易还不错。

source: Okay, you got me. Gimme the keys... and don't forget the kidney!
target: 好吧,你得到了我。 说吧。 把钥匙给我... 也不要忘记肾!

source: Sweet! My partner Scott's gonna walk you through the paperwork while I perform some amateur kidney surgery on %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 可爱! 我的搭档 斯科特我做一些业余肾脏手术时,会把文件交给你 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: Aww, but I wanted to use the scalpel!
target: 啊,但是我想用手术刀!

source: Needless to say, getting your kidney removed in a parking lot costs you -N2 STAMINA. At least you gained +N2 MONEY selling a car and an organ!
target: 不用说,在停车场取出你的肾脏 需要你 -N2 STAMINA。 至少你赚了+N2钱卖一辆车和一管风琴!

source: WHOA! This is a battle-robot from space?! That's awesome!
target: 呜哇! 这是太空来的战机器人吗? 赞!

source: Uh, yeah, totally. This "used car" is actually a refugee from the car-robot civil war devastating the planet... eh... Carrobotplanet.
target: 嗯,是的,完全一样。 这辆"用过的"汽车实际上是来自汽车机器人内战的难民,摧毁了地球...... 额... 心腹平面图.

source: Really? Isn't the name of that planet a little on the nose?
target: 真的吗? 行星的名字是不是有点在鼻子上?

source: I mean, I'm a ghost named "Polly Geist", but you don't hear me crying.
target: 我的意思是,我是一个鬼 名字 "波莉 盖斯特,但你没听到我哭

source: Fair enough. So, what features does this car-robot hybrid have?
target: 说得没错 那么,这个汽车机器人混合体有什么特性?

source: All kinds! It comes with battle lasers, a jetpack, sixteen-wheel drive, centuries of rage directed at the BikeDroids...
target: 各种! 各种! 各种! 战争激光器 喷气式包 16个轮盘 数个世纪的愤怒 直指比克机器人...

source: Who are these... 'BikeDroids'?
target: 这些是谁... "机器人"吗?

source: They're the arbitrarily evil rogue race of robots from Carrobotplanet. They wanna steal our planet's life force and destroy all monsters.
target: 他们是来自Carrobotplane的机器人的专横邪恶的流氓种族. 他们想偷走我们星球的生命力 摧毁所有怪物

source: Hmm, I don't know if I want to buy a car that wants to wipe out my entire species...
target: 嗯,我不知道我是否想买辆 想要消灭我整个物种的汽车...

source: No, no, sir: that'd be the "BikeDroids". This one is a "CarBot" -- those are the good guys!
target: 不,不,先生,那是"机器人"的剧本 这个是"Carbot"--那些是好人!

source: Ah, I think I get it now. Can I see its robot form? I wanna check some of its features.
target: 啊,我想我现在明白了。 我能看看它的机器人吗? 我想检查一下它的一些特征。

source: NO, YOU CAN'T!
target: 不,你不能这样!

source: It's, uh... hibernating right now, in preparation for the impending "CarBot v. BikeDroid" war.
target: 这是,呃... 准备即将到来的"CarBot v. 自行车机器人"战争.

source: We can't interrupt its slumber!
target: 我们不能打断它的睡眠!

source: That's fine, I understand. I also get a bit cranky if I'm woken up without my coffee, haha!
target: 没关系,我明白了。 如果我醒来时没有咖啡,我也会有点发疯

source: LOL, you're so funny, are you gonna buy the damn thing or not?
target: LOL,你真有趣, 你买不买?

source: He is, apparently! You earn +N2 MONEY from your sale, but you lose -N2 SOUL for... you know... scamming that poor idiot.
target: 他当然是了! 你从你的销售中挣到+N2钱,但你输了 -N2 SOUL... 你知道吗... 骗取那个可怜的白痴

source: Dance with the air dancers
target: 和空中舞者跳舞

source: You approach those big, inflatable dancing bois and start busting a move.
target: 你接近那些大而充气的舞蹈 开始突破一个动作。

source: These balloon dudes are really good dancers! Throw that polyethylene-coated booty back!
target: 这些气球男的跳得真厉害! 把那个聚乙烯皮鞋扔回来!

source: They're so cool! Do you think they like my dance moves?
target: 他们太酷了! 你觉得他们喜欢我的舞步吗?

source: Silly Scott! The air dancers can't have opinions on his moves because they're not alive.
target: 蠢货 斯科特! 空舞者不能对他所行的动作有意见,因为他们不活了.

source: But after dancing with them for hours, losing -N2 STAMINA and sweating like a sinner in church, you suddenly aren't so sure of that anymore...
target: 但是在和他们跳舞几个小时后,失去 -N2 STAMINA,并像教堂的罪人一样出汗,你突然不再那么确定...

source: The air dancers' faces sway in the breeze. You sense that they're looking at you, appraising your mind, body, and soul... and dance skills.
target: 空中舞者相相相相摇. 你感觉到他们在看你 评估你的心灵 身体和灵魂 和舞蹈技巧。 和舞蹈技巧。

source: Whoa, this one just put his hand on my shoulder! I think he wants us to follow them!
target: 哇,这只手刚刚把手放在我的肩膀上! 我想他想让我们跟着他们!

source: In your dehydrated, hallucinating state of mind, it makes perfect sense!
target: 在你脱水的幻觉状态下,这是非常合理的!

source: After walking some ways, you find yourselves surrounded by more air dancers.
target: 走了几条路后,你发现自己被更多的空中舞者所包围.

source: Logic says you're still in the used car dealership, but you've danced your logic away.
target: 逻辑说,你还在被用过的汽车经销商,但你已经跳出你的逻辑了.

source: Holy shit. This must be, like... the secret air-dancer village!
target: 妈的。 这一定是,像... 秘密的空气切割者村落!

source: The air dancers offer you something to drink. Thank goodness!
target: 空舞者们给你一些喝的 谢天谢地!

source: ...No, wait, this is just a cup of air. Damn.
target: 不,等等,这只是一杯咖啡。 该死

source: This is so cool! They must've invited us here because they liked our dance moves so much.
target: 这太酷了! 他们一定邀请我们来这里 因为他们很喜欢我们的舞蹈动作

source: Totally! And any society that values the art of dancing till you drop is a society I wanna learn more about!
target: 绝对! 任何一个社会,只要你跳下去, 都珍惜舞蹈艺术, 是一个我更想学习的社会!

source: Sure, who needs water anyway? Find a way of immersing yourselves in air dancers culture!
target: 当然,谁需要水呢? 想办法让自己沉浸在空中舞者文化中!

source: Learn to play the traditional instrument of their culture: the air guitar.
target: 学习演奏他们文化的传统乐器:空气吉他.

source: As their name suggests, air dancers have learned to control the most powerful element through the arcane art of... DANCEBENDING!
target: 正如他们的名字所显示的 空中舞者通过 北极艺术 学会控制最强大的元素... 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞! 跳舞!

source: It's a great plan! You just need to find yourself the perfect air guitar instructor, maybe buy some air guitar amps and air guitar picks and capos...
target: 计划真棒! 你只需要找到完美的空气吉他导师 可能买一些空气吉他安眠药 空气吉他接头和卡波斯...

source: Nah, fuck that noise! I bet I'm an air guitar prodigy already!
target: 不,他妈的噪音! 我敢打赌,我是一个空气吉他天才了!

source: Polly whips out an air guitar. Whoa, where was she keeping that all this time?!
target: 波莉 抽出空气吉他来 哇,她一直把那个放哪了?

source: Watch and learn, bitches! WAH WAH WAAAAAH!
target: 看着点, 婊子们! 呜哈哇哇哇!

source: Nice riff, bro! Let me try. I just put my fingers here and strum like this...?
target: 不错的里夫,兄弟! 让我试试。 我刚刚把手指放在这里 像这样来弹琴... ?

source: DOODLY-DOODLY-DOODLY-DOOOOOO!
target: 水分好,水分好,水分好,水分好,水分好,水分好,水分好,水分好,水分好

source: Holy shit, you're a natural, Scott! WE SHOULD START A BAND!
target: 神圣的狗屎,你是一个自然的, 斯科特! 我们应该开始一个手!

source: Okay, I'm in! We can call ourselves the Air Guitarz -- with a Z!
target: 好,我进去了! 我们可以自称空中吉他-用Z!

target: 在那里,你学习了 +N2 MAGIC 在你的科文训练课程, 你后来汇编了一份情报列表 传递给"欢乐的混蛋"。

source: Let's see... "Joy's blood type is A positive." "Joy sings in a music band called 'Ventagram'." "If Joy was a soup, she'd be a..."

source: WHAT THE HELL?! This information is useless!
Wait... maybe it's not. What if we wanted to turn the Coven into soup? Now we know which soup not to turn Joy into!
target: 单单... 也许不是。 如果我们想把巫师变成汤呢? 现在知道哪汤不把乔伊变成什么了!

source: Yes, great job, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. But could you go back and get some more juicy intel?
target: 是的,伟大的工作, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 但你能回去再找点有用的情报吗?

source: Like, "Who was better in bed, Axarax or Salomé?"
target: 比如,"谁在床上更好, Axarax 或 Salomé?

source: Go ask her that!
target: 问她!

source: ...I think I finally understand why the Coven is undefeated in this timeline.
target: 我想我终于明白为什么这个时间线上 巫师没有败选

source: You keep going back and forth between the Coven and the Fuckers of Joy. You get lots of juicy useless intel.
target: 你总是在"欢乐之会"和"欢乐之会"之间 前后相传 你得到很多多汁的无用的情报

source: Although it's all dumb stuff that would never put the Coven in danger, it's still not cool to be a double agent, and for that you get -N2 SOUL.
target: 虽然这些蠢事永远不会让巫师陷入危险之中,但做双面间谍还是不酷,为此你得到-N2 SOUL.

source: You pull a knife out of your pocket and stab your hand while you look at these villains right into the eye, quietly.
target: 你从口袋里拔出一把刀来刺出手,而你却悄悄地看着这些坏人的眼睛.

source: It looks pretty badass... but it hurts like a bitch. Why do the movies never warn you that stabbing your hand hurts so bad?
target: 看起来很坏... 但它伤害像一个婊子。 为什么电影从来不警告你刺伤手会这么痛?

source: Damn, that's so hardcore! If your goal was to get my attention with your recklessness, you've succeeded.
target: 可恶,这太难了! 如果你的目标是用你的鲁莽态度来吸引我的注意力,你已经成功了.

source: You gotta respect someone who's ready to stab their own hand, even if it has no discernible benefit for what we're aiming for.
target: 你得尊重一个准备刺自己手的人 即使这对我们的目标没有明显好处

source: Yeah... it's powerful. I think it's about what it says about you. It sends a message.
target: 对... 威力很强 我想这是关于它所说的关于你。 传出一条信息。

source: "Fuck my hand."
target: "他妈的我的手。"

target: 没错! 或者"我很危险,而且无法预测。 注意你的后背 因为你不知道我下一步会做什么"

source: "Maybe stabbing my other hand."
target: "也许刺伤了另一只手"

source: One thing is clear: your commitment is impressive, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. We need someone with guts like yours on our side.
target: 有一件事是明确的: 你的承诺是令人印象深刻的, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我们需要一个像你这样有胆量的人支持我们

source: Especially if we ever come across a situation where we have to stab our hands for some reason.
target: 特别是如果我们遇到一个 不得不刺伤手的原因。

source: Then it's settled: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% joins the syndicate. Welcome to the Dark Side.
target: 接下来就解决了:%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%加入辛迪加. 欢迎来到黑暗之地

source: Cool, you didn't even have to do an evil plan! You just had to lose a LOT of blood and -N2 STAMINA along with it.
target: 酷,你甚至不用做一个邪恶的计划! 你只是失去了一多血 和N2 Stamina 连同它。

source: And you got +N2 HYPE from the pointless badassery of stabbing your own hand!
target: 和你有+N2 HYPE 从毫无意义的坏人 刺自己的手!

source: Enter the tournament
target: 输入锦标赛

source: You're surrounded by buff, intense kiters with vibrant hair colors and oodles of protag energy. Yes, these are your people! You have to enter the tournament!
target: 周围是浓郁的风筝 有生动的发色 有面条的能量 是的,这是你的人民! 你必须进入比赛!

source: You're entering? That's awesome, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I didn't know you were a professional kite-flyer.
target: 你要进入? 这是真棒, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 我不知道你是职业风筝飞侠

target: 虽说有道理,但你还是有的! 你看,当时 斯科特 财务报告和审定财务报表 波莉 忙着受欢迎 玩得开心 你忙着玩玩的

source: Oh, THAT'S why you were unpopular? Wouldn't have been my first guess, but good for you, boo!
target: 哦,这就是为什么你不受欢迎? 不是我第一次猜想,但对你有好处,嘘!

source: Your friends sit in the audience to cheer you on, and you fly your kite up the bracket all the way to the final eight!
target: 你的朋友坐在观众席上为你欢呼, 你飞起你的风筝 整个括号 最终的8!

source: Hmm... you're my next competitor? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, is it? You fly your kite honorably; I can see you're well-trained.
target: 垛... 你是我的下一个竞争者?  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%是吗? 你光荣地放风筝,我看你训练有素

source: But your reign of victory ends now.
target: 但你的胜利统治结束了

source: Gasp! That's Chiyo, THE LONESOME KITE! He's the mysterious, aloof protegé, and he'll stop at nothing to win and preserve his honor!
target: G! 那是千代,孤鸟! 他是神秘的, 孤独的蛋白质, 他会不惜一切代价赢得并维护他的荣誉!

source: Dude, how do you know all that?
target: 伙计,你怎么知道这些的?

source: I've been reading the plot summary of this kite tournament on Munchyroll.
target: 我读过Munchyroll的风筝比赛的情节摘要

source: Your kite is well-constructed; graceful; she slips through the air like my sword through tender flesh.
target: 你的风筝很有造诣 有优雅的风筝 她从空中滑过 就像我用剑穿过柔软的肉

source: But no matter how well-made your kite is, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it cannot fly without its tether!
target: 但是不管风筝的造型如何好,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%,它不能飞 没有它的绳子!

source: Chiyo jiggles his sword in its scabbard. You don't see it move -- but suddenly, you realize your kite line's been cut! Wow, so fast!
target: 千代在剑斋中一笑取出剑来. 你看不到它移动——但突然间,你意识到你的风筝线被切断了! 哇,这么快!

source: I hate to win like this, but more than that, I hate to lose. I'm sorry it has to be this way.
target: 我恨这样赢,但不止如此,我恨输。 对不起,一定是这样

source: That motherfucker! He's right, though; your kite can't fly without a string... or can it?
target: 那个混蛋! 他说得对,不过,你的风筝没有绳子是飞不起来的... 也可以吗?

source: Give the kite an uplifting pep talk! Tell it that it's ready to fly by itself without your help.
target: 给风筝一个振奋人心的演讲! 告诉它已经准备好自己飞了 没有你的帮助。

source: You thought you needed the line to control the kite, but it was all a lie to stop you from reaching your potential. It's time to awaken. It's time to become... THE KITEMANCER!
target: 你以为你需要那条线来控制风筝 但这都是谎言 阻止你达到你的潜力 时已起起起. 是时候... 凯特曼克!

source: It's time for you to flourish, Kite! That line was just your training wheels. All this time, I told you that you needed it because I wanted to build your confidence.
target: 吉特,你该兴起了 那条线只是你的训练轮子 我一直都告诉你你需要它 因为我想建立你的信心

source: But now, the time has come for you to know the truth... the power to fly was inside YOU all along!
target: 但现在,是时候让你知道真相了... 飞行的力量一直存在于你体内!

source: You throw your untethered kite valiantly into the air. The kite can't talk, so it can't express its feelings on this new development...
target: 你勇敢地把你的未系起的风筝扔入空中 风筝不能说话,所以不能表达对这个新发展的感觉. .

source: So we'll be conveying the kite's ascent to greatness with song! Everybody, sing with me!
target: 将风筝的升华 与歌相伴而来! 大家一起唱吧,我们一起唱吧!

source: LET'S GET DOWN TO BUSINESS / TO ACHIEVE THIS FLIGHT!
target: 让我们开始做生意 完成这场战役

source: WITH THE STRENGTH INSIDE YOU / YOU WILL REACH NEW HEIGHTS!
target: 与更棒的 内你/你会 出现新的高!

source: YOU'RE THE STRONGEST KITE I'VE EVER MET / YOU'VE GOT SPUNK, PASSION, AND SASS!
target: 你是我见过的最强的基特人 /你已经得到了弹出, 帕斯蒂安特和萨斯!

source: AND SOMEHOW... WE WILL KICK... CHIYO'S ASS!
target: 和一些东西... 我们一定会踢出... 奇尧的屁股!

source: With the kite's newfound confidence and strength, and with the power of sing-alongs, your kite flies itself through the air and outperforms Chiyo in all respects!
target: 以风筝新出信心和力量,以出自"唱出"之能,使风筝自能从空中飞出,在各方面都超越了千代!

source: You throw your kite into the sky, where it buoys on the wind. Great! It's got height; now it just needs a pep talk!
target: 你把你的风筝扔到天空, 它在风上浮出水面。 不错! Great! 它有高度,现在它只需要说点什么!

source: The power to fly was inside it all along! The line that connected it was just its training wheels, which you used to boost its confidence.
target: 飞行的力量一直存在于其中! 连接它的线只是它的训练轮子, 你用来增强它的信心。

source: But now the time has come for the kite to fly solo, and achieve its dreams!
target: 但是现在风筝飞起独行的时机已经到来,实现了它的梦想!

source: Your kite can't talk, but it can feel, and you know that your pep talk is getting through to it... yes! It's flying!
target: 你的风筝不能说话,但感觉很舒服 而且你知道你的风筝说话已经... 没错! 飞了!

source: ...Flying away from the tournament, over the horizon.
target: ...从比赛中飞出,在地平线上

target: 多么可悲,你还真是可怜 你的不忠风筝在需要的时候抛弃了您!

target: 当然了! 你闭上眼睛, 磨练出风筝的能量。

target: 然后水淹没了地球 海水与新生海岸相撞 水来了,植物来了,空气来了, 空气的空气,你依赖的空气。

target: 因为 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 刚刚成为传奇的克特曼斯,兄弟! 现在 %HESHE% 能够控制风筝!

target: 等等,风筝都响了? 事情就变简单了 你控制了千代的风筝,把它撞入地里去.

source: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!
target: 别走,别走,别走

source: Polly, what is %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% doing?
target: 波莉,这是什么 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 做什麽?

target: 随机出拳的姿势和不协调的叫声,看起来像.

source: Oh... do you think %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% noticed %HISHER% kite flew away on an updraft?
target: 哦... 你觉得 %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'VE% 已注意到 %HISHER% 风筝飞走的升空?

target: 我简直不敢相信... 你打败了我 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%并给我的名字带来耻辱。

target: 似乎我的刀能割去你的风筝弦 却一直有根更强的弦 连接着我们的灵魂...

source: Well done.

source: Fuck yeah! You ascend to the Final Four. With your kite's new power, your victory should be assured!
target: 他妈的是的! 你升入最后四强 凭你风筝的新力量,你胜利应该保证!

target: DE絋) 因为这是我,你的下个对手:眼镜蛇Kite的Sarth!

source: For failing to uphold the co-bro code of not getting in the middle of monogamous sworn rivalries, I'm afraid I need to take you out of the competition...
target: 由于没有坚持不陷入一夫一妻制的誓言竞争的同父异母守则,我恐怕需要把你从竞争中取出......

target: 萨尔斯转过风筝撞到你的了! 你躲过了他的攻击 他只能给你的风筝表面留下一丝小伤痕

target: 别这么自以为是 我不需要用武力压倒你 我只需要运用秘密的眼镜蛇克提技术...

source: I just grazed your kite with my venomous Kite Fangs! Your kite will never survive to see the end of the round! HAHAHA!
target: 我刚刚用我的毒气取出克特方斯来擦了你的风筝! 你的风筝永远无法活下来 来看轮子的结束! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈!

source: Wait, Sarth poisoned your kite?! THAT'S SOMETHING HE CAN DO?!?
target: 等等,萨尔斯毒死你的风筝了? 这是他能做的吗?

source: You need to save your kite before it's too late!
target: 趁现在还来得及,你一定要省下风筝!

target: 专心点! 这是一种心理战, 让你失去冷静。 记住风筝没有心血管系统 所以它们不会真的被下毒

source: So he poisoned your kite? Then fight fire with fire: POUR GASOLINE ON HIS KITE AND SET IT ON FIRE!
target: 所以他给你的风筝下毒了? 然后用火来打: 将GASOLINE 放在他的基特上,然后把它放在火上!

source: You stay calm and keep flying your kite like normal. As expected, nothing bad happens to it.
target: 你冷静点,继续正常地放风筝 如所料,无所不坏.

source: What's going on? Why isn't your kite succumbing to my deadly venom?!
target: 发生了什么事? 你的风筝怎么不屈服于我致命的毒液?

target: 因为风筝没有心血管系统 血液什么的,傻瓜。 因此,毒液不会影响它。

target: 妈的。 岂能相取. 我白费了这个毒液技术

target: 好吧,你赢了这轮。 但我明年会回来,用无毒打风技巧打倒你,在"相扑"中打倒你!

target: 随便啦! 你只要关心今天的比赛就赢了!

target: 我简直不敢相信 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 将无情地让 %HISHER% 风筝死于无血脉震荡!

source: I came to this kite tournament to have a fun afternoon and shatter the spirits of my rivals, not watch negligent kite slaughter!
target: 我来到这风筝锦标赛 玩得开心的下午 打破了对手的魂魄 不是看疏忽的风筝屠宰!

source: I guess today we've learned %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% would let ALL %HISHER% loved ones die from poison just to win this tournament.

source: That's right! Good job!
target: 没错! 干得不错!

source: Wow! I'd always suspected I might like crafting artisanal marmalade, but for some reason I never poked that thought until now!
target: 哗! 我一直怀疑我可能喜欢手工制作果酱 但不知为什么我一直没这么想

source: Why marmalade, though? Isn't "marmalade" basically just "jam" with a longer name?
target: 为什么是橘子酱? "马来地"是不是基本上只是"jam"和一个更长的名字?

source: It sounds kinda silly. It's like I always say: "Why make word long when short word work fine?"
target: 听起来有点傻 就像我一直说的那样:"当短词有效时,为什么要让词长?"

source: Scott, Scott, Scott; such a naive boy. I clearly need to show you what makes artisanal marmalade so rewarding and fun!
target: 斯科特, 斯科特, 斯科特这么天真的孩子 我显然需要告诉你 是什么让手工的果酱如此有回报和乐趣!

source: Okay bro, if you insist. I'll pull over by that orange grove for you.
target: 好吧,兄弟,如果你坚持。 我帮你停在橙园边

source: Yay! Three hours of preserving oranges later...
target: 赞! 三个小时后保存了橙子...

source: We've been doing this for a while, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. When does the fun happen?
target: 我们已经做了一段时间了, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 什么时候才有乐趣?

source: Boo, I honestly couldn't care less about this shit. Can't you make marmalade when we're back home?
target: 嘘,我真不在乎这些 我们回家后就不能做果酱吗?

source: NO! Artisanal marmalade is my fixation right now, and I'm gonna ride that wave of manic productivity until it crashes!
target: 没有! 手工的马铃薯是我的固定 现在,我要骑那一波 狂躁生产力直到它崩溃!

source: We don't have that kinda time. Can't you see our HYPE is decreasing at an alarming rate? We need to go before we risk losing more. I'm sure you understand.
target: 我们没有时间了 你看不出我们的HYPE正在以惊人的速度下降吗? 我们必须走,否则我们就要损失更多了。 我敢肯定,你明白这一点。

source: But...
target: 不过...

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, this car is leaving with or without you. Put away your mason jars and let's get going.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%不管有没有你,这辆车都要离开 把你的泥浆罐收起来,我们走吧。

source: Ugh, fine. You'll just have to preserve your passion for homemade marmalade and shove it back on the furthest shelf of your subconscious for now.
target: 呃,没事。 你只需要保持对自制果酱的热情 并把它塞回你潜意识的最深处

source: But you vow that when this road trip ends, you'll reopen that jar and spread this newfound joy on the toast of your life! You lose -N2 HYPE, but gain +N2 MIND.
target: 但你发誓,当这趟出行结束, 你会重新打开那个罐子, 并传播这个新发现的快乐 在你的祝酒! 你输了N2 HYPE,但得到+N2 mind。

source: Actually... yeah. I think that's exactly it.
target: 其实... 对 我想就是这个意思

source: Ha! I knew all those horrible thoughts decreasing my -N2 SOUL couldn't be mine!
target: 我知道那些可怕的想法 减少我的N2苏尔不可能是我的!

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, how'd you get an evil spirit in your soul? Coach says spirits should be lifted, not used as prisons!
target: 该死 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你是怎么在灵魂中找到邪恶的? 教练说精神应该被解除 而不是用作监狱!

source: Hmmm...
target: 那个...

source: A blurry flashback is called to Polly's mind. It was the late hours of a wine-tasting party with you, her, Milo, and Hope...
target: 模糊的闪回被调用到 波莉心意所动. 跟你一起喝酒的晚会 她 迈洛和希望... ... . . . .

source: Man, I -- *hic!* -- love you guys. I really needed this after my shitty week.
target: 男人,我 -- *hic! * -- 爱你们。 我这周过后真的很需要这个

source: Riiight, you and the other Coven girls were busy defeating that evil demon lord, right? I saw Joy venting about it on her Momentgram story.
target: Riight 你和其他的巫师 忙着打败那个邪恶的恶魔领主 对吧? 我看到乔伊在她的"动静"故事里 发泄出这个消息

source: Yeah. We were able to steal the scrolls a cult was gonna use to summon the demon into our world.
target: 对 我们得以偷走一个邪教用来召唤恶魔进入我们的世界的卷轴

source: That's dope.
target: 这是涂料。

source: Thanks, but it was all for nothing, 'cause it -- *hic!* -- seems like the demon's just gonna cross over into this realm on its own... hence why I drink.
target: 谢谢,但这一切都是白费力气的, 因为它 - *hic!* - 似乎恶魔只是要跨越 进入这个领域 独自一人... ┮或耻
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: You should just summon the demon now and get it all over with. Procrastination never helped anyone!
target: 你现在应该召唤出恶魔 让它彻底结束 拖延对任何人都没有帮助!

source: Are you sure that's a good idea? I think the wine's impairing our judgment a little bit...
target: 你确定这是个好主意吗? 我觉得酒会影响我们的判断力...

source: No, you know what? They call alcohol "liquid courage" for a reason. I bet I can -- *hic!* -- take on that fucker now! Pass me those summoning scrolls!
target: 不,你知道吗? 他们称酒精为"液态勇气"是有原因的. 我敢打赌,我可以 - *hic! * - 抓住那个混蛋! 把那些传呼的卷轴递给我!

source: A few minutes later, as black flames surrounded them all...
target: 几分钟后,当黑火包围他们时...

source: Okay, yep, I definitely cannot defeat this thing alone and drunk. Joy's gonna kill me when this demon destroys the world...
target: 好吧,是啊,我绝对不能 打败这个东西 独自和醉。 乔伊会杀了我 当这个恶魔摧毁世界...

source: But the world can't be destroyed NOW; I have plans this weekend! Isn't there something we can do?
target: 但是现在世界不能被摧毁了,我这个周末有计划! 我们是不是有什么可以做的?

source: I guess I could try using my psychic powers to imprison it in somebody's soul... but who would be willing to make such a sacrifice?
target: 我想我可以试着用我的通灵能力 将它囚禁在别人的心灵里... 但谁会愿意做出这样的牺牲呢?

source: Polly, Milo, and Hope looked over to where you were passed out on the couch in a wine coma. Then they all slowly looked back at each other...
target: 波莉, 迈洛望望着你在酒后昏迷中被昏倒在沙发上 然后他们慢慢地回头看对方...

source: Uhhhh, weird! I have no idea how this could've happened, haha!
target: 奇怪 简直是太奇怪了 我不知道怎么会这样,哈哈!

source: It's a mystery! But at least knowing that the demon is the one making you such a psychopath grants you +N2 MIND.
target: 是个谜! 但至少知道恶魔是让你如此变态的人 让你得到+N2 MIND。

source: While driving, you and your friends have been playing I Spy. It's slightly more fun than sitting alone with your thoughts.
target: 开车的时候,你和你的朋友一直在玩"间谍" 比你独自坐着思考更有趣

source: My turn again! I spy with my little eye... something that starts with S!
target: 轮到我了! 我用我小眼睛监视... 开始是S!

source: Is it the sand again?
target: 又是沙子吗?

source: Yup! You're great at this, bro!
target: 没错! 你干得很棒,兄弟! !

source: Thanks. Guess that means it's my turn. I spy with my little eye...
target: 谢谢 估计这表示轮到我了 我用我小眼睛监视...

source: CLASSIFIED DOCUMENTS FROM THE MERKINGDOM.
target: 明报的分类文件。

source: What?! The Merkingdom as in the ruthless, totalitarian monarchy under the sea?!
target: 你说什么? 默金多克像在无情的,极权主义的 君主制的海底?

source: Yup, and I just spied some of their government secrets in this big packet labeled: "Merking ONLY: Do Not Read If You Value Your Worthless Life"
target: 是的,我刚刚在这张大包里 发现了他们的一些政府机密 上面贴着: "只写:不读,如果你重视你无价值的生命"

source: THEN WHY WOULD YOU READ IT?!
target: 那你为什么要读它!

source: Because how many opportunites will I get to read classified government secrets in my unlife? Worth it!
target: 因为我能有多少机会 读读我生命中政府机密的? 值得吗?

source: Holy shit. We're so dead. I'll have to move to Scandinavia and start over as a mountain goat herder named Claude--
target: 妈的。 我们死定了 我得搬到斯堪的纳维亚 重新做一个叫克洛德的山羊牧人

source: Chillax, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. No one's becoming a Scandinavian goat herder, okay?
target: 奇莱克斯 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 没人会成为斯堪的纳维亚牧羊人,好吗?

source: We'll be fine if we just act like everything's normal. And that starts with finishing our game of I Spy!
target: 我们只要表现得像正常一样就好了 开始完成我们的间谍游戏!

source: The stress of knowing too much is destroying your -N2 MIND, but if Polly insists... guess what she read in those documents!
target: 太多的知觉压力正在摧毁你的N2 MIND,但如果 波莉 坚持... 猜猜她从那些文件中读到什么了!

source: Indoctrination plans through kids movies. The Merkingdom surely does that kind of shit, and you could use those secrets to deprogram the children.
target: 通过儿童电影进行教化计划. 美金多姆肯定做这种事 你可以利用这些秘密 来解密孩子们

source: Intel on their most advanced weaponry: six-pack rings; waterparks; and that thing everyone has been talking about lately, "Sea 2." Priceless coveted affairs of state!
target: 有关他们最先进的武器的情报:六包环;水上公园;以及最近大家谈论的"第二海"。无价之宝贪婪地处理国家事务!

source: Yup. There are a LOT of propaganda-filled movie scripts in here.
target: 对 这里有很多充满宣传的电影剧本

source: Listen to some of these: "The Lion King Isn't a Legitimate King and He Must Die".
target: 听其中的一些:"狮子王不是合法国王,他必须死".

source: Spoiler alert: he does die, in a very gruesome way.
target: 破坏者警报:他确实死了,非常可怕。

source: "The Little Mermaid Conquers the Surface World".
target: "小美人鱼征服地表世界".

source: "After realizing the idiocy of leaving the sea kingdom, the Little Mermaid aids her father in flooding the Earth and bringing the surface-dwellers to their knees."
target: "小人鱼意识到离开海王国的愚蠢后,帮助她的父亲淹没了地球并让地表居民跪下".

source: Jeez, this one's not even subtle: "Cinderella is a Lazy Handout-Taking Socialist Who Needs to Pay Rent".
target: 灰姑娘是个懒惰的 需要付房租的社会主义者

source: These movies don't seem very nice. Maybe we could edit these scripts so they aren't so brainwash-y?
target: 这些电影看起来不太好看. 也许我们可以编辑这些剧本 让他们不会被洗脑?

source: Sure! Let's change this one to "The Lion President That Everyone Democratically Elected Into Office of Their Own Free Will".
target: 当然! 让我们把这个改为"狮子会主席, 每个人都民主地当选 他们自己的自由意志的办公室"。

source: I didn't understand some of those words, but the ones I did, I liked!
target: 我不懂这些话,但我喜欢那些话!

source: Fine, but the Merking is totally gonna get your asses after he sees the edits you made to these movie scripts.
target: 好吧,但默克金会完全得到你的屁股 之后,他看到 你做的编辑 这些电影剧本。

source: Especially since Polly and Scott insist on mailing the revised scripts to him with an attached invoice for "editorial fees."
target: 特别是自从 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 坚持将修改后的稿件邮寄给他,并附具"编辑费"发票.

source: But at least you might've helped some Merkingdom kids not get brainwashed! You gain +N2 SOUL.
target: 但至少你可能帮一些默金多姆的孩子 不被洗脑! 你得到+N2苏尔。

source: Bingo. I gotta tell ya, there are some truly diabolical ideas in here.
target: 宾果。 我得告诉你,这里有一些真正的邪恶的想法。

source: "The six-pack ring is a monster-sized plastic ring cluster. It's disguised as rubbish, but it suffocates the victim when they stupidly put one around their neck."
target: "六包环是怪物大小的塑料环集群. 伪装成垃圾,但当受害者愚蠢地把一个放在脖子上时,它会窒息".

source: I always knew garbage was secretly evil!
target: 我一直都知道垃圾是秘密邪恶的!

source: "Waterparks are our most sophisticated coverup yet. Even after all these years, the surface-dwellers still have no idea we're slowly flooding the surface."
target: "水公园是我们最复杂的掩盖。 即使经过这么多年,地表居民 仍然不知道我们 正在缓慢地淹没地表。"

source: Wait, does that mean the Merkingdom invented water slides? Are we sure they're so bad?
target: 等等,那意味着 默金多姆发明了水滑? 我们确定他们这么坏?

source: We're pretty sure, buddy.
target: 我们很确定,伙计。

source: I mean, if you have any doubt, just look at the blueprints for Sea 2. This is some really diabolical shit.
target: 如果你有任何疑问,请看第二海的蓝图 这真是些邪恶的狗屎

source: Yeah, let me put it this way: Sea 2 is so bad, I can't describe it to you without this game being pulled from most major retailers.
target: 这么说吧,海2太糟糕了,没有大零售商的帮助,我无法描述它。

source: So what do we do with all this info? Should we tell the government?
target: 那么我们怎么处理这些信息? 我们该告诉政府吗?

source: Nah, that sounds lame and doesn't benefit me directly. Let's just sell these state secrets on the internet.
target: 不,这听起来很逊,而且没有直接对我有利。 我们把国家机密在互联网上卖掉

source: Sounds like a plan! You sell the Merkingdom's most valuable secrets online and earn +N2 MONEY.
target: 听起来像一个计划! 你在网上卖出默金多姆最有价值的秘密 赚到+N2 钱

source: You're bored of all your playlists, so you decide to try listening to music on public radio.
target: 你厌倦了所有播放列表,所以决定尝试在公共电台上收听音乐.

source: Passing through different stations, you stumble upon a frequency that seems to be a voice cutting through static.
target: 穿过不同的站台,你偶然碰到一个频率, 似乎是一个声音切割 通过静态。

source: "Hello? Is anyone there?" the voice says. Polly grabs the walkie-talking thing you plugged to the radio for some reason.
target: "哈罗? 有人在吗?" 声音说。  波莉 抓住对讲机的东西 你插到无线电上是有原因的。

source: Hey, boo! You've reached Polly Geist, leave a message after the "YAAASSS!"
target: 嘿,嘘! 来了 波莉 盖斯特,在"YAASSS"之后留言!

source: "Thank God! I can't believe I'm actually talking to another survivor! How did you make it out of the building uprising alive?"
target: "谢天谢地! 真不敢相信我居然在跟另一个幸存者说话! 你怎么从建筑起义中活下来的?"

source: The... what?
target: 那个... 什麽?

source: "The building uprising... you know, the day all the buildings revealed themselves to be living beings and turned against monsterkind?"
target: "楼事起义. 那天所有的建筑都暴露了自己 活生生的生物 并且反倒与怪物作对?"

source: The buildings didn't do that where we're from.
target: 建筑没有这样做 我们来自哪里。

source: "Wow, really? Does that mean you still use buildings? Like, you still go inside them without the crippling fear that you'll be devoured whole?"
target: "哇,真的吗? 那表示你还用建筑物吗? 喜欢,你仍然去 进入他们 而不令人发指的恐惧 你会被吞噬整个?"

source: Yep. Going inside buildings without getting devoured is a big staple in my daily routine.
target: 没错。 进屋而不被吞噬是我的日常大主食

source: "Oh, no! That means... you probably still use toilets too! God, you haven't figured out what important, messed-up role toilets play in the buildings' plans!"
target: "哦,不! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! 也就是说... 你可能还用厕所! 天啊,你还没搞清楚 厕所在建筑计划中 扮演什么重要和烂角色!"

source: "And carpets! You haven't even discovered what they actually are to the buildings' horrible anatomy yet!"
target: "还有地毯! 你甚至还没有发现他们实际上是什么 建筑的可怕的解剖学!"

source: Uh...
You hear screaming in the background of the radio transmission.
target: 你听到在广播的背景中尖叫。

source: "Oh yeah, I almost forgot," the radio voice says. "I was sending out a distress signal 'cause my camp of survivors is being attacked by murderous buildings. Can you help us?"
target: "哦,是啊,我差点忘了," 电台的声音说。 "我发出求救信号 因为我的幸存者营地正被谋杀的建筑物袭击" 你能帮我们吗?"

source: Jeez, boo, maybe start with that next time.
target: 天啊,下次再说吧

source: Well, looks like all those deaths are on your conscience unless you can figure out a way to help this apocalypse survivor from the comfort of your car!
target: 似乎所有的死亡都在你的良心上 除非你能想办法帮助这个末日幸存者 从你的车的舒适感中逃出!

source: Help them make a sound investment and become the one person all buildings must abide by: THE LANDLORD!
target: 帮助他们做一个合理的投资,成为所有建筑必须服从的一个人:LANDLORD!

source: Summon the most powerful entity that fights against all issues in buildings: THE NEIGHBORHOOD ASSOCIATION!
target: 召集最有实力的单位,同建筑中的所有问题作斗争:NEGHBORHOD ASSOCIATION!

source: Yeah! All we need is a mortgage large enough to buy property and become those buildings' landlord.
target: 对! 我们只需要一个足够大的抵押贷款 买下房产 成为那些建筑的地主

source: Wooo! Owning property in this economy? It'll be like subduing huge concrete crocodiles through a financial powermove!
target: 呜! 拥有这个经济中的财产? 就像是通过金融动力运动 制服了巨大的混凝土鳄鱼!

source: "That could work!" the voice says. "The only problem is that ever since society collapsed, there's nowhere to apply for a mortgage anymore..."
target: "那会奏效" 声音说。 "唯一的问题就是,自从社会崩溃以来, 已经没有地方申请抵押贷款了..."

source: It's okay, we'll fund your mortgage. What's your bank account info?
target: 没关系,我们会给你贷款的 你的银行账户信息是什么?

source: "Well, banks aren't exactly a thing anymore. Society collapsed, remember?"
target: "银行已经不是什么了" 社会崩溃了,记得吗?"

source: Oh, right... do you have Benmo?
target: 哦,对了... 你有本莫吗?

source: "Yep, that'll work! Benmo has actually somehow outlived society after apocalypse."
target: "是的,那会奏效的! 本莫在末日后 已经不知何故地超越了社会。”

source: Tight. You transfer them -N2 MONEY.
target: 紧. 你转帐了,N2钱

source: "Wow, it worked!" the radio voice says. "I bought the deed to that ravenous building and became The Landlord! The buildings are terrified of me now!"
target: "哇,它成功了" 电台的声音说。 "我买下了那所豪华的建筑的地契,成为地主! 大楼现在都吓到我了!"

source: "Thanks for your help, kind strangers! I promise, I'll pray every night that this horrible building apocalypse never ravages your world."
target: "谢谢你的帮助,善良的陌生人! 我保证,我会祈祷每晚 这可怕的建筑启示录 永远不会破坏你的世界。"

source: So... we just get thoughts and prayers?
target: 所以说... 我们只是得到想法和祈祷?

source: Thanks I guess, but I was kinda hoping I'd get something cool in return, like a new phone.
target: 谢谢 但我希望能换个酷点的回报 就像新手机

source: But we did get something cool, Polly: we got +N2 SOUL for being helpful! Doesn't that make it all worth it?
target: 但我们确实得到了一些很酷的东西, 波莉:我们得到了+N2 SOUL的帮助! 这不值得吗?

source: Eh, I guess I'll take it.
target: 呃,我想我会接受的。

source: Are you dumb, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? You can't use magic to summon the Neighborhood Association.
target: 你傻吗? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 不能用魔法来召唤邻居协会.

source: What you CAN do is use magic to call for a summons or hearing with them. I'll look up the right summoning runes!
target: 你可以用魔法召唤他们 或与他们一起听话 我会查对传呼的传呼器!

source: You use -N2 MAGIC and the last of your emergency goat blood drawing runes on the car.
target: 你用N2 MAGIC 和你的最后 紧急山羊血画在车上。

source: When you finish, the car is transported to the arcane pocket dimension where the Neighborhood Association conducts its world-governing business.
target: 完成后,汽车被运送到北极口袋维度,邻居协会在那里开展其世界治理业务.

source: Whoa, weird. How long has the universe had an all-powerful Neighborhood Association?
target: 奇怪,我还不知道 宇宙有万能的邻里协会多久了?

source: "For all time," says their leader, a wise grandfatherly type. "Think about it: the world you live in is like a massive neighborhood..."
target: "永远",他们说他们的领袖,一个明智的祖父型. "想想吧,你生活的世界就像一个巨大的社区..."

source: "And we're the only ones that can stop you young folks from ruining it!" screams a woman with a bob cut.
target: "只有我们才能阻止你们年轻人毁了它" 尖叫着一个被波波切出的女人

source: "Elder Karen, please calm down," sighs the irritable single mom. "I need at least two coffees in me before you start this shit."

source: As you're driving, you pass a person walking along the side of the road. Maybe they need help?

target: 说得好! 主教我们,我们都是在自己的旅程中,无论是在他们中间的朝圣,还是在内部的自觉朝圣。

source: I encourage you to gather much wisdom and peace from your little pilgrimage, in the name of happiness and the Lord's grace.
target: 我鼓励你们从你们小小的朝圣中,以幸福和上帝的恩惠为名,聚集出许多智慧与和平.

source: Ditto, bro!
target: 迪多,兄弟! 迪多,伙计!

source: You seem like a pro pilgrim. Do you have any advice on how to get wiser on our road trip pilgrimage?
target: 你看起来像个亲朝圣者 你对如何让我们的路途朝圣更明智有什么建议吗?

target: 记住你的朝圣和它教你的教训的好方法 就是在路上收集有意义的纪念品

target: 这是... 有意思! 说得好! 我亲自收集了朝圣纪念品 你想交换一些吗? 这样我们才能从共同的经验中成长起来?

target: 他看起来不错! 你绝对不是说这个 因为他给了你一些甜+N2钱。

source: Ah, a fine choice! The Saint of Forgiveness and Redemption is a fascinating historical figure.
target: 啊,一个很好的选择! 宽恕和救赎圣人是一个迷人的历史人物.

target: 比如说,我总是在超市里走最长的一行 为什么上帝要他忠心的追随者 等这么久才买到面包和鱼呢?

target: 有时候我害怕我只等了30分钟 在奎克基马特 远离罪孽的生活中...

target: 用于 斯科特 是个好孩子:纯洁的心,虔诚的灵魂,愚蠢的屁股... 我们只要相信!

target: "保佑你,圣者啊, 斯科特朝圣者哭泣接吻 斯科特鞋子,是双鞋 "祝福你!" "祝福你!"

target: 我们永远记得这一天,圣徒 斯科特. 明年,我们将朝此地朝圣, 在那里你复活了!

target: 听起来不错! 我们可以把它做成马拉松的事情吗? 我一直想做一个这样的!

target: 朝圣者们离开,称赞他们的信仰得到确认. 你花了N2 MAGIC教书 斯科特 这么快就变了,不过他得到了+N2的入门机会!

target: 这真是奇迹! 这尊受福的雕像被主自己神圣的手弄湿了!

target: 你敢肯定是你的手弄湿了它 但是 嘿 晚上能让他睡得更舒服点
