source: Okie dokie, Shortstack. You can be the boss's scary sous chef in this drawing!
target: OKie dokie, Shorttack. 东尼,你应该知道,你应该知道,我是谁 你在这幅画里可以当老板的吓人大厨

source: "What about me?" asks Scarface Stabber. "I wanna be on the boss' chef posse!"
target: "我怎么办?" 问"疤面人刺客" "我想成为老板的厨师"

source: I can do that. Want me to draw you with your favorite steak knife? I know it's your weapon of choice!
target: 我可以做到这一点。 要我用你最喜欢的牛排刀画你吗? 我知道这是你选择的武器!

source: "That'd be great! I really want you to capture my stabbiness! You can borrow my knife for reference. Just don't show it to any cops, haha!"
target: "那会很棒! 我真的希望你抓住我的刺! 你可以借我的刀作为参考 千万别给警察看,哈哈!"

source: Yeah... right...
Later, when Scott's debriefing the cops...
target: 以后,当 斯科特警方正在向警方汇报...

source: ...and that's all the evidence I got. Will it be enough?
target: ...这就是我的全部证据。 够不够?

source: It's more than enough! We've got plenty of probable cause to throw these mobsters in jail now!
target: 够多了! 我们有很多可能的理由 把这些黑道分子关进监狱!

source: Wait, you're gonna arrest them? But these guys are my friends! They trusted me!
target: 等等 你要逮捕他们吗? 但他们是我的朋友! 他们信任我!

source: These aren't your friends, son; they're hardened criminals. They'd sell anyone out to save their own asses.
target: 这不是你的朋友,儿子 他们是硬化的罪犯 他们出卖任何人是为了救自己的屁股

source: So thanks for agreeing to sell them out to save your own ass from jail. Hopefully we can work together again soon!
target: 谢谢你同意卖掉他们 让你自己从监狱里逃出来 希望我们能很快再合作!

source: Man... I know I did the good boi thing, so why do I feel so bad?
target: 哥们... 我知道我做了好事,我为什么觉得这么糟糕?

source: That day, Scott learned being the narc doesn't always mean being the good guy. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 那天,我说, 斯科特 学着当缉毒员 并不总是意味着做一个好人 你输了 -N2 SOUL。

source: It's decided! Polly goes to the mob headquarters to get into character and learn some dirty secrets.
target: 已经决定了!  波莉 去黑道总部 了解一些肮脏的秘密

source: Wuddup, mafia don? I heard you guys were in dire need of an "accountant."
target: 武道克,黑手党的吗? 我听说你们急需一个"会计"

source: "We are, actually!" says the don. "We're very behind on organizing our money laundering accounts this month. Can you help?"
target: "我们是,其实!" 唐人说。 "我们这个月在组织洗钱账户方面落后很多. 你能帮忙吗?"

source: Haha, totally! Where are these "accounts" I need to "organize?"
target: 完全没有! 这些账户在哪里 我需要"组织起来"?

source: "They're on the laptop... why do you keep using air quotes?"
target: "他们用的是笔记本电脑... 为什么你一直用空气引子?"

source: Because I'm "showing you" that I "know" the "code!"
target: 因为我在"向你展示"我"知道"代码"!

source: I'll just grab this "laptop" here and fill up its "files" with some "spreadsheets", heh heh...
target: 我只要抓住这个"平顶" 并填满它的"档案" 有一些"平面",heh heh...

source: "HEY, WHOA! Where'd you get that tommy gun?! Quit filling the magazine with bullets, and quit being so weirdly cryptic while you do it!"
target: "嘿,哇! ! ! ! ! 滚开! 你从哪里弄来这把Tommy的枪的? 别再用子弹给杂志填满了 别再做这么怪异的密码了!"

source: But... I don't understand. How am I gonna help with the next big bank robbery without a gun?
target: 不过... 我不明白,我不明白,我还是会去的 我怎么才能帮助 下一个大银行抢劫 没有枪?

source: "Look, toots: you can be our accountant, and you can be in the mob, but we don't need you to do robberies and stuff. We need you here, crunching numbers. Got it?"
target: "看,托特:你可以做我们的会计,你可以加入黑帮,但我们不需要你来做抢劫之类的事. 我们需要你在这里, 压缩数字。 明白吗?"

source: So... I'm an ACTUAL accountant?
target: 所以说... 我是演员会计?

source: "Yes."
target: "是的"

source: Aww, that blows!
target: 啊,这太糟糕了!

source: A few days later, Polly's back to debrief the cops.
target: 几天后,我终于... 波莉回去向警察汇报情况了

source: ...and the laundromat on 3rd and Main is one of their hideouts too. That's the whole list.
target: ...3街和Main街的洗衣房也是他们的藏身地之一 整个名单都写在这了

source: Also, being a police informant was WAY more boring than I expected. I thought I'd basically get a free pass to do crimes for a bit, not sit around and do math all day.
target: 而且,当警察的线人比我想象的更无聊 我以为我基本上可以免费通过 做一些犯罪, 不坐在这里和做数学一整天。

source: Just so we're clear, we will never give you a free pass to do crimes.
target: 我们说清楚了,我们永远不会给你自由 犯罪。

source: You did us a big favor, though. Thanks for the help! Stay outta jail!
target: 你帮了我们一个大忙 谢谢你的帮助! 滚出监狱!

source: Well, Polly lost -N2 HYPE in that disappointing debacle, but at least she also gained +N2 MIND crunching all those numbers!
target: 这个嘛 波莉 输了N2 HYPE在那个令人失望的倒闭中,但至少她也得到了+N2 MIND 挤出所有这些数字!

source: You're driving along peacefully when that peace is suddenly ruined by police sirens behind your car.
target: 和平突然被警笛声摧毁时 你就会平安地开车

source: Oh, no. Are we getting pulled over?
target: 哦,没有。 我们被拦住了吗?

source: I guess so. It's okay, we have nothing to hide!
target: 应该是吧 没关系,我们没什么好隐瞒的!

source: Uh...
Good afternoon, kids. Can we see your license and vehicle registration?
target: 午安,孩子们 我们能看看你的驾照和车辆登记吗?

source: Sure thing, officers! How are you two doing on this fine, perfectly-legal day?
target: 当然,警官们! 你们俩今天过得怎么样 完美合法?

source: I'm doing great, thanks for asking! I had a chocolate donut for breakfast, I saw a butterfly on the way here, and now I get to do my favorite thing: routine traffic stops!
target: 我做得很好,谢谢你的问候! 我早餐吃了个巧克力甜甜圈,我看到一只蝴蝶在路上, 现在我可以做我最喜欢的事: 常规的交通停止!

source: Looks like your paperwork's in order. We'll just go back to the cruiser to run your plates real quick and you should be good to go.
target: 看来你的文件已经做好了 我们只是回到巡洋舰去运行 你的车牌非常快,你应该可以走了。

source: Awesome! Thanks for not checking the trunk!
target: 厉害! 谢谢你没检查后车厢!

source: ...SHOULD we check the trunk?
target: ...我们检查一下后备箱?

source: ...We'll be right back.
target: ...我们马上回来

source: Fuck. They're totally gonna check the trunk. They're gonna find all my drugs!
target: 他妈的。 他们完全会检查后车厢。 他们会找到我所有的毒品!

source: You have drugs?!
target: 你有毒品吗?

source: I ALWAYS HAVE DRUGS, SCOTT.
target: 我总是有酒,斯科特。

source: Welp, as always, you're everyone's last hope, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Find a way to avoid getting caught with drugs!
target: 韦尔普,像往常一样, 你是每个人的最后希望, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 想办法避免被毒品抓住!

source: "They can't find any drugs if we take them all first!"
target: "如果我们先把他们全部带走,他们找不到任何毒品"

source: Plant the drugs on the cops by hugging them.
target: 拥抱警察,把毒品放进警察身上

source: Awww, shucks, we gotta take ALL the drugs? Oh well, guess I'll take one for the team.
target: 胡说八道,我们得把毒品都拿走? 哦,好吧,我想我会为团队拿一个。

source: Weren't these your drugs anyway? How are you "taking one for the--?"
target: 这些不是你的毒品吗? 你怎么样 "拿一个..."

source: Shhhh, no need to thank me, not all heroes wear capes, et cetera. Less talking, more drug-taking!
target: 嘘,不用谢我,不是所有英雄都戴起斗篷等等 少说话,多吸毒!

source: Fine, as long as you've got enough drugs left over to share with me and Scott!
target: 好吧,只要你有足够的药物 剩下的给我分享和 斯科特!

source: Oh, no drugs for me, thanks. You guys have fun, though!
target: 哦,没有药物给我,谢谢。 你们玩得开心点!

source: Okay, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you want a regular dose, a big dose, or a Polly-sized "I'm already dead so there are no consequences" dose?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你想要一个正常剂量,一个大剂量,或者一个 波莉- "我已经死了,所以没有后果"的剂量?

source: Suffice to say, you and Polly do a TON of drugs, and gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 说得够多了,你和 波莉 做一通药物, 并获得+N2 HYPE!

source: Okay, your plates came back clean, but my partner says we have to check the trunk for some reason.
target: 好吧,你的车牌回来干净, 但我的搭档说,我们必须检查 后备箱有某种原因。

source: LMAO, good luck with that. We don't have a trunk now that the whole car is melting!
target: 卢马奥,祝你好运 整辆车都融化了,我们没有后备箱了!

source: Melting...? What are you talking about?
target: 熔化... ? 你在说什么?

source: I'm talking about how EVERYONE AND EVERYTHING IS MADE OF A MILLION GAZILLION ATOMS.
target: 我说的是每个人和每样东西 是如何制造出一百万亿的巨型巨型巨星。

source: It makes you think, right? A fuck-ton of identical protons and neutrons all work together to make my whole incredible booty!
target: 让你觉得,对不对? 一堆相同的质子和中子 一起工作 使我整个不可思议的战利品!

source: But those same atoms can also make other stuff, like Scott, or a doorknob, or a delicious pizza. Isn't that wild? We're all, like, connected or something...
target: 但是同样的原子 也可以制造其他的东西,比如 斯科特门把手 或美味的披萨 野性吗? 我们都是一样,连接什么的...

source: (Partner, although these youngsters look sorta high, I didn't find any drugs in the trunk. Do you think they're just... like this?)
target: (伙伴,虽然这些年轻人看起来有点高,但我在后车厢里没有发现任何药物. 你觉得他们只是... 像这样? )

source: (Guess the younger generation's even further gone than I feared...) Well, you kids are good to go, I suppose. Drive safe.
target: (猜想年轻一代的走得比我所担心的还要远. ) 嗯,你们孩子们是好的去,我想。 开车小心

source: The cops leave, Scott takes over driving, and you and Polly experience ego death in the back seat. You lose -N2 MIND from all that tripping.
target: 警察离开 斯科特 接驾车,你和 波莉 体验自我死亡 在后座。 你从那些出事中失去了N2 MID

source: Okay, your plates came back clean, but I have a feeling we should check your trunk before we go. You have anything back there that we should know about?
target: 好吧,你的车牌回来干净, 但我有预感 我们应该检查你的后车厢 在我们走之前。 你有什么我们该知道的吗?

source: We sure do. We've got hugs for you! Bring it in, bro!
target: 我们当然知道。 我们为你抱抱! 把它拿来,兄弟!

source: You, Scott, and Polly group-hug the cop. Polly reaches into his pocket to plant the goods.
target: 你,你是谁? 斯科特,以及 波莉 组团抓警察。  波莉 伸入他的口袋里种植这些商品。

source: Hey, officer, what's this I just found in your pocket?
target: 嘿,警官,我刚刚在你口袋里找到什么了?

source: Whoa, cocaine!
target: 哇,可卡因! 可卡因来了! Whoa, cocaine!

source: (Wait... this isn't the cocaine I planted on you, though...)
target: (等等... ) 说吧,我... 这不是我给你的可卡因,虽然... )

source: What did you just say?
target: 你说什么?

source: Don't change the subject! Your partner has cocaine!
target: 别改变话题! 你的搭档有可卡因!

source: Well, yeah, but only a little. It helps me stay alert on the job! You gotta be quick and agile when you have a gun and a city to protect!
target: 嗯,是的,但只是一点点。 这会让我保持警觉的工作! 有了枪和城市,你必须迅速而敏捷地保护!

source: Thanks to the cocaine, I can shoot all the bad guys, and then some!
target: 多亏了可卡因,我可以杀出所有坏人,然后一些!

source: I don't feel very protected... Polly, is this that "police corruption" thing you told me about?
target: 我感到没有被保护...  波莉,这是什么 "警察腐败" 你告诉我的事情?

source: Noooo, c'mon! You can trust us! We're your friendly neighborhood cops! I'll just put that coke back, and we can forget all about...
target: 不,来吧! 你可以信任我们! 我们是你的友好的邻里警察! 我只要把可乐放回去,我们就可以忘记这一切...

source: Whoa. There are a LOT more drugs in my pocket than I remember. I guess I forgot how much I grabbed when I was coked up this morning.
target: 呜呼. 我口袋里还有很多毒品 比我记得的还要多 我想我忘了我今天早上被吸食时 抓了多少了

source: Damn, partner, this looks bad for us. When the chief finds out how much drugs we have, we'll get our badges stripped for sure!
target: 该死,伙计,这对我们来说是不好的。 等局长发现我们有多少毒品 我们一定会把警徽剥光的

source: Hmmm, I have an idea. What if you gave US your drugs? That way your chief won't be mad at you!
target: 嗯,我有一个主意。 如果你把药给了我们呢? 这样你的头就不会生你的气了!

source: Are you sure? Giving drugs to strangers doesn't sound very... lawful.
target: 你确定吗? 给陌生人注射毒品听起来不太... 合法。 合法。

source: We're not strangers! We're friends now! We hugged, don't you remember?
target: 我们不是陌生人! 我们现在是朋友了! 我们拥抱了,你不记得了吗?

source: She's got a point. Just give her the drugs. We can just get more out of the evidence locker later.
target: 她有一点。 给她毒品就行了 我们可以从证据柜里多拿点

source: Yessss, give me the drugs. Gimme gimme.
target: 是的,给我药。 给我

source: The cops give you their drugs and leave. You lose -N2 SOUL for your deception, but you gain +N2 HYPE for scoring free police-grade cocaine!
target: 警察把毒品给你然后离开 你因为欺骗而输了N2 SOUL,但你因为免费的警察级可卡因得分而得到+N2 HYPE!

source: You see blinking lights in your rearview mirror and a police siren demanding that you pull over. Ugh...
target: 你后视镜里闪闪发光 警笛声让你停车 唉哟...

source: Good afternoon. Can I see your license and vehicle registration?
target: 下午好,我需要你帮忙 Good afternoon. 我能看看你的驾照和车辆登记吗?

source: Yep, it's right here!
target: 对,就在这里!

source: Oh, uh, thanks Ms. Geist, but we just need to see the driver's information.
target: 哦,呃,谢谢女士。 盖斯特,但我们只需要看看司机的信息

source: Oh! Haha, of course, sorry. I just wanted to show you how trustworthy and cooperative with the law I am.
target: 哦 哈哈,当然,对不起。 我只是想告诉你我是多么的值得信赖 和与法律合作。
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Trustworthy, cooperative, AND a nervous talker? You're my favorite kind of person to pull over!
target: 值得信任、合作和紧张的谈话者? 你是我最喜欢的 那种人停车!

source: Speaking of which, we pulled you over because we're investigating a report that someone in this area stole a magic artifact.
target: 说到这里,我们把你拉过来,因为我们正在调查一个报告, 报告这个地区有人偷了一个魔法文物。

source: It's an ancient totem that radiates malevolent energy. Have you folks seen anything like it?
target: 这是一种能放出恶性能量的古老图腾. 你们有看到类似的东西吗?

source: NOPE! Never seen it! And even if I had, I wouldn't have felt ANY compulsion to take it, because I'm a levelheaded gal with great impulse control.
target: 没有! 从来没有见过! 就算我做了 我也不会觉得有强迫性 因为我是个有冲动的 头脑清醒的女孩

source: Uh...
But if I HAD seen it, theoretically, it would've been sitting in an unlocked car pretty much begging for someone to steal it. So, it's not really the thief's fault.
target: 但如果我看到它,理论上, 它会一直坐在一个没有锁的汽车里 几乎乞求有人偷它。 所以,这不是真的 小偷的错。

source: ...Right. Hey, partner, can I talk to you in the cruiser for a minute?
target: 对 嘿,搭档,我可以跟你在巡洋舰 一分钟?

source: FUCK. We don't have much time. We gotta hide this magic artifact I stole!
target: 他妈的。 我们没有太多时间了 我们要把我偷来的魔法文物藏起来!

source: Wait, you DID steal it? But you just said--
target: 等等,你偷来的? 但你刚才说...

source: I know what I said, Scott. You bought my ruse because I've got an unbeatable poker face.
target: 我知道我说了什么, 斯科特. 你买我的花招是因为我有一个不可战胜的扑克脸。

source: But those cops will sense the rancid vibes coming off this cursed totem soon, so we've gotta hide it quick! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, any ideas?
target: 但是那些警察会感觉到 狂躁的情绪 很快会从这个被诅咒的图腾中消失 所以我们得赶快把它藏起来!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%有什么想法吗?

source: Deceive them by telling them you're undercover cops who just seized the artifact.
target: 欺骗他们,告诉他们你就是卧底警察 刚刚没收了文物

source: Hide the magic artifact where you hide everything else: behind your cool façade.
target: 藏起魔法文物 藏起其他东西 藏起你的酷相

source: Okay, we talked it over, and we think we should check your vehicle for the stolen artifact.
target: 好吧,我们谈了一遍, 我们认为我们应该检查你的车 被盗的文物。

source: No need, fellow policemen. I've got the artifact right here! Because you see...
target: 不用,警察同志们 我这里有文物! 因为你看到...

source: I'm actually Officer Gertrude Sikes, undercover cop extraordinaire!
target: 其实我是格特鲁德·西克斯警官 卧底警察特警

source: You are? And you wear that fake mustache whenever you're... being yourself?
target: 是吗? 你穿假胡子 当你... 做你自己吗?

source: Correct! It makes other cops take me more seriously. No one cared who I was until I put on the 'stache!
target: 没错! 这让其他警察更认真对待我 没人在乎我是谁 直到我把"胡子"!

source: Hmm... what about you, son? Are you an undercover cop too?
target: 垛... 儿子,你呢? ! 你也是个卧底警察吗?

source: Yes! I'm Officer... Not Scott!
target: 没错! 我是警官... 警官,我是警官,长官 没有 斯科特!

source: Your name is "Not Scott"?
target: 你的名字是"没有" 斯科特"?

source: Yup. First name "Not", last name "Scott". He knows what he's about.
target: 对 姓"不","姓"斯科特". 其相识相.

source: Well, if you're really undercover cops, can we see your badges?
target: 如果你真的是卧底警察,我们能看看你的警徽吗?

source: Oh! I mean, I'd totally show you mine if I could, but I had to trade it to the ACTUAL thief in exchange for the artifact.
target: 哦 我愿意给你看我的 但我得把它换给那个偷东西的小偷 换来这些文物
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Ah, no problem, I understand. I've lost two pistols that way. What about you, Officer Not Scott?
target: 啊,没问题,我明白。 我丢了两把手枪 那你呢,长官 斯科特?

source: I... ate it?
target: 我…… 吃了吗?

source: Haha, I did the same thing last week! The chief was pissed, but it's not my fault these things look like shiny potato chips.
target: 哈哈,我上周也做了同样的事情! 局长很生气,但不是我的错 这些东西看起来像闪亮的土豆片

source: Okay, well, looks like the artifact's already in good hands! Gertrude, Not, do you wanna blow off the rest of your shifts with us at the Donut Hut?
target: 好吧,看来 文物已经掌握在好手了! 格特鲁德,不,你想 吹掉你的其余的轮班 与我们在多努特胡特?

source: Sure! You gain +N2 MAGIC getting to keep that magic artifact, though you lose -N2 SOUL for lying to the cops.
target: 当然! 你得到+N2 MAGIC 得到保存魔法的文物, 虽然你失去了 -N2 Suul 骗了警察。

source: Okay, you'll just have to drop your cool façade for a minute to hide the artifact behind it. Hopefully Polly and Scott won't notice...
target: 好吧,你只需要放下你的酷外表一分钟 来隐藏它后面的文物。 希望你这样 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 不会注意到的...

source: Dang, bro, what happened? You don't look nearly as interesting or radical as you usually do!
target: 糟了,兄弟,发生什么事了? 你看上去不像平常那样有趣或激进!

source: You definitely don't look like the %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% who told us %HESHE% %VERB_KNOWS_KNOW% a ton of awesome BMX tricks.
target: 你绝对不像那个 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 谁告诉我们的 %HESHE%  %VERB_KNOWS_KNOW% 一吨惊人的 BMX 技巧。

source: Nor do you look like the %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% who claimed to know "every digit of pi, yes, all of them."
target: 你看上去也不像一个 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 自称认识"所有派的数位人物,是的,所有的人".

source: I feel so lied to... is your name even %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 我觉得自己被骗了 你的名字是连 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: Truthfully, no. I invented a cooler name to use, because my real name is... *shudder*... Pimplert.
target: 说实话,没有。 我发明了一个更酷的名字来使用, 因为我的真名是... 苏德尔*... 普普尔特

source: Oh... okay, that IS unfortunate. But it's still no reason to lie to us!
target: 哦... 好吧,这是不幸的。 但是现在还没有理由对我们撒谎!

source: But how else was I supposed to befriend awesome people like you and Scott without changing my name and embellishing my personality a little?
target: 但我怎么才能成为像你这样的好人 斯科特 却不改名 轻轻地装饰我的个性?

source: By being yourself! I'm pretty offended you thought you had to lie to me to be my friend, jerk.
target: 做你自己就够了! 我非常生气你以为你必须骗我 做我的朋友,混蛋。

source: Yeah, bro... we were already your friends. Why did you lie to us? That's so mean...
target: 癸... 我们早就是你的朋友了 你为什么骗我们? 这太刻薄了...

source: Oof. You lose -N2 HYPE exposing yourself like this. At least you've safely hidden the artifact behind your façade by the time the cops come back.
target: 哦,这下子了。 你输了N2 HYPE 暴露自己像这样。 至少你把艺术品藏在了你的外表后面 当警察回来的时候

source: Okay, we talked it over, and we think we should check your vehicle for the stolen artifact.
target: 好吧,我们谈了一遍, 我们认为我们应该检查你的车 被盗的文物。

source: I don't know anything about a magic artifact. I only know awesome BMX tricks and every digit of pi.
target: 我对魔法文物一无所知 我只知道很棒的BMX技巧 和每个Pi的数位数

source: I believe you! Nobody who knows so many bike tricks and impossible integers would need to steal a magic artifact to be as cool as you clearly are.
target: 我相信你! 我对你有信心! I believe you! 没人知道这么多自行车技巧和不可能的整数 需要偷一个魔法的艺术品 才能像你一样酷

source: Yup. Your relaxed, radical aura is convincing enough, and I didn't feel like doing a whole investigation into this anyway. You're free to go.
target: 对 你放松的激进的气息已经足够令人信服了 我也不想对这件事做彻底的调查 汝等诸人自去.

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% -- or Pimplert, or whoever you are -- please never bring up BMX tricks again.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% - 或Pimprort,或无论你是谁 - 请不要再提起BMX的把戏了。

source: Your victory would be sweeter if you couldn't feel the judgment radiating off your friends. At least that artifact is still radiating +N2 MAGIC!
target: 如果你感觉不到你的判断会让你的朋友们发泄出来 你将会更快乐 至少那个文物还在放出+N2 MAGIC!

source: You're driving along when a cop car pulls up and signals for you to pull over. Uh oh...
target: 警车开起后你就会开车 信号让你停车 哦...

source: Afternoon, kids. Can we see your license and vehicle registration?
target: 下午好,孩子们 我们能看看你的驾照和车辆登记吗?

source: Hey... does anyone else smell pie?
target: 顿... 还有谁闻到派的味道吗?

source: I don't.
target: 我没有。

source: Now that you mention it, I smell pie too!
target: 既然你提到,我也闻到派了!

source: No you don't! Your nose is lying to you, Scott. Don't listen to it!
target: 不,你没有! 你的鼻子在骗你 斯科特. 别听!

source: I smell pie too! I figured I was just really craving pie, but now that Polly's being weird about it...
target: 我也闻到派了! 我觉得我只是想吃派,但现在 波莉有点奇怪...

source: I'M NOT BEING WEIRD, YOU'RE ALL BEING WEIRD! I AM BEING PERFECTLY SANE AND NORMAL.
target: 我不是在怪异,你们都怪怪的! 我是一个完美的 萨恩和正常。

source: Okaaaay... well, it looks like your paperwork's all in order. We're just gonna run your plates real quick and you kids should be good to go.
target: 欧克亚... 看来你的文件都齐全了 我们只是要去运行你的盘子 真正的快,你们应该 不错去。

source: Goddammit, now we gotta figure out what to do with this pie I stole before those goons come back.
target: 该死，现在得赶紧想想怎么处理我偷来的这个派，免得那群混混回来。

source: You stole a pie? What for? You don't even eat.
target: 你偷了个派? 为什么? 你甚至不吃东西。

source: I dunno, I just saw it cooling on some old lady's windowsill and grabbed it. I was in a silly, goofy mood.
target: 我不知道,我只是看到它冷却 在某个老太太的窗台上,并抓住它。 我当时心情很傻,很傻

source: But now because %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was acting all suspicious, the cops are totally gonna know I stole this pie. We gotta hide it before they get back!
target: 但现在,因为 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 警察会知道我偷了这个派 我们得在他们回来之前藏起来!

source: Well, at least if you help Polly hide the pie, you can eat it later! How do you save this stolen pastry?
target: 好吧,至少如果你帮助 波莉 藏起馅饼,待会再吃! 你怎么救这个被偷的糕点?

source: Hide the pie under your trademark fancy top hat you've been wearing throughout this whole road trip.
target: 把你整个旅途的花花公子帽子 藏起来

source: Hide the pie under the pile of money you will use to bribe the cops.
target: 把钱藏在一堆钱下 用来贿赂警察

source: Yeah, my fancy top hat! ...Wait, what fancy top hat?
target: 对,我的花花公子顶上帽子! 等等,什么高档帽子?

source: Only THE trademark %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% fancy top hat! I knew it'd come in handy eventually!
target: 仅此商标 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 漂亮的顶帽! 我知道它最终会有用的!

source: Yeah, I barely remember who you were before you put on that hat. Let's hide the pie under there!
target: 是啊,我几乎不记得你是谁 在你戴上帽子之前。 不如把派藏在下面吧!

source: Polly stashes her stolen pie under your hat just in time for the cops to come back.
target: 波莉 把她偷来的派藏在你的帽子下 正好赶上警察回来

source: So, guess what? While we were in the cruiser we got a call that there's a pie thief on the loose. My partner's gonna need to search your vehicle.
target: 所以,你猜怎么着? 当我们在巡洋舰时 我们接到一个电话 一个偷派的贼在逃 我的搭档需要搜查你的车

source: You there, remove that hat for a moment so I can see if the contraband pie is under it.
target: 你在那里,脱掉帽子一会儿 让我看看是否是 违禁品派在它下面。

source: You want %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% to take off %HISHER% fancy top hat?! But it's the cornerstone of %HISHER% cool visual identity!
target: 你想怎样? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 起飞 %HISHER% 漂亮的顶帽? 但它是基石 %HISHER% 很酷的视觉身份!

source: So?
target: 怎么样?

source: You don't understand. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was super lame back in school. Putting that fancy top hat on is what turned %HISHER% whole life around!
target: 你不明白吗?  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 回到学校后超逊的 戴上那顶漂亮的上衣就是转了过来 %HISHER% 整个生活周围!

source: You can't force %HIMHER% to go back to %HISHER% old, boring ways. It's inhumane!
target: 你不能强迫我 %HIMHER% 回到 %HISHER% 旧的,无聊的方式。 这是不人道的!

source: Partner, I think they've got a point. I thought %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% was pretty cool with that hat on too.
target: 搭档,我想他们有道理 我以为 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 戴着帽子也很酷

source: Such a bold fashion choice to wear a top hat while driving -- in a convertible of all things! I don't think we should force %HIMHER% to take it off.
target: 这么大胆的时尚选择在开车时戴顶帽——在各种东西的敞篷车里!. 我觉得我们不应该强迫你 %HIMHER% 把它脱下来。

source: But... the pie...
I know, but this is too far. We swore to protect people no matter what, even if that meant shooting at suspicious characters first and asking questions later.
target: 我知道,但这是太远。 我们发誓保护人民,不管怎样,即使这意味着首先向可疑人物开枪,然后提出问题。

source: But THIS? I mean, we gotta draw the line somewhere. Are we really helping people if we make this poor youngster lame again?
target: 但这个? 我的意思是,我们必须划出界限的地方。 如果我们让这个可怜的年轻人又瘸了,我们真的在帮助别人吗?

source: You're right... I'm sorry, partner. I've been a cop for so long, I guess I lost some perspective.
target: 你说得对... 对不起,搭档。 我当了这么久警察,我好像失去了一些视角

source: It's okay, pal. Sorry to bother you kids. Drive safe, and stay fancy!
target: 没事的,伙计。 抱歉打扰你们了 开车小心,别乱动!

source: You have no recollection of ever putting this hat on, yet there it is, on your head and in everybody else's memories... it's a -N2 MIND-fuck.
target: 你不记得曾经戴过这顶帽子, 但是它就在你头上, 在其他人的记忆里... 这是N2 mind -fuck. 。

source: But you don't let it bother you too much, especially since you gain +N2 STAMINA eating that stolen pie!
target: 但你不会让它烦恼太多 尤其是因为你得到了+N2 Stamina吃被偷的派!

source: So, guess what? While we were in the cruiser we got a call that there's a pie thief on the loose. My partner's gonna need to search your vehicle.
target: 所以,你猜怎么着? 当我们在巡洋舰时 我们接到一个电话 一个偷派的贼在逃 我的搭档需要搜查你的车

source: Okay. Just be sure NOT to check under that pile of money.
target: 好吧,我告诉你。 千万别查那堆钱下面

source: Wink!
target: 温克!

source: ...Well now that's obviously the first place I'm gonna check.
target: ...现在,这显然 首先是我要检查的地方。

source: Oh noooo. You found the pie under our fat stack of cash that was just sitting there waiting for a handsome, morally-gray officer to take it...
target: 岂有相取. 你发现我们那堆大钱下面的派 坐在那等着一个英俊的道德官员拿走...

source: Awww, you really think I'm handsome?
target: Awww,你真的觉得我帅?

source: Are you kids seriously trying to bribe an officer?!
target: 你们真的想贿赂警官吗?

source: Um... I think so?
target: 那个... 是吗?

source: Okay, cool. I just wanted to make sure, because if not, this conversation was about to get awkward.
target: 好吧,冷静。 我只是想确定, 因为如果没有, 这场谈话 即将变得尴尬。

source: Damn, only -N2 MONEY? You call that a bribe?! Back in my day, that'd barely cover the cost of stealing a gumball!
target: 可恶,只有N2钱? 你管这叫贿赂? 从前,这几乎无法支付 偷口香糖丸的费用!

source: Take it or leave it.
target: 要么接受要么离开

source: Fine... guess we gotta start pulling over fancier cars if we wanna get the good bribes, partner.
target: 精细... 如果我们想得到好贿赂,我们就得开始拉起更风光的车,伙伴。

source: Don't be so sour. I think we did great. I'm gonna use my half to buy a rhinestone bedazzler and gussy up my gun!
target: 少阴之酸. 我觉得我们做的很好。 我要用我的一半买个闪光石床罩 并用我的枪粘住!

source: All right, we'll look the other way for now. But if we ever pull you over again, remember: I'm a big fan of fifty-dollar bills and foot massages.
target: 好吧,我们现在会另找 但如果我们再把你拉过来,请记住: 我是一个大粉丝 50美元钞票和脚按摩。

source: Sheesh, those cops sure are morally bankrupt... anyway, you gain +N2 STAMINA eating the pie Polly stole from a sweet old lady. Yum!
target: 唉,那些警察在道德上已经破产了... 再说,你得到+N2 STAMINA吃派 波莉 偷从一个可爱的老太太。 汤!

source: Scott is driving you all along the highway when you hit a HUGE traffic jam.
target: 斯科特 开车送你到高速公路一带 当你遇到HUGE交通堵塞。

source: Great. Juuuust great.
target: 伟大的。 朱尤斯特伟大的。

source: Dang, we're not moving at all. I wonder what's got us so backed up?
target: 糟了,我们根本没动过 不知道是什么让我们这么支持?

source: Finding out would be more fun than waiting around here. Wanna walk up the road with me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 找到答案比在这等更好玩 想跟我上路吗? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: Good idea. About twenty cars ahead, you find a young woman sobbing to a group of other annoyed motorists.
target: 不错的主意。 前面约20辆车,你发现一个年轻女子 向其他一群烦躁的汽车手泣下.

source: "We can't drive across the bridge!" she wails. "I had a vision that there will be a collision that'll kill dozens of people!"
target: "我们不能开车过桥" 她哀叫着 "我有一个愿景,即会发生相撞,会杀死数十人".

source: Oh, God. Don't tell me this is one of those Final Destination situations...
target: 天呐 别告诉我这是最后目的地之一...

source: Suddenly, an oil truck slams into a truck full of matches. They explode, killing dozens of motorists far ahead of you.
target: 突然,一辆油车撞入一辆满是火柴的卡车. 爆炸了,杀死了几十个在你们前面的驾驶员

source: Yup, great. JUST. GREAT.
target: 对,很好 琌... . 伟大的。

source: "Oh no, it's a Final Destination thing!" the crowd cries. "We've cheated Death, and now we'll all be hunted down and killed in increasingly-gory ways!"
target: "哦,不,这是最终目标的事情!" 人群会哭. "我们欺骗了死亡,现在我们都会被追杀,以越来越恐怖的方式被杀死".

source: It's not that big a deal. At least your deaths'll probably end up on someone's "Top 40 horror movie kills" list.
target: 何等为相. 至少你的死 可能会出现在某人的"恐怖电影40多杀"名单中

source: "But we don't want to die! Our only hope is to kill someone else and steal their lifespan!"
target: "但我们不想死! 我们唯一的希望就是杀了别人,偷走他们的寿命".

source: Fine, if that's what it takes to clear this highway. Anyone wanna start with stabbing %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 好吧,如果这是需要 清除这条高速公路。 谁想先去刺人? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: NO THANK YOU. There's gotta be some other way to calm these people down so you can get through this traffic jam. Think of something!
target: 不,谢谢。 肯定有别的办法能让这些人冷静下来 这样你才能渡过交通堵塞 想想办法!

source: "Let's all go to a Final Destination Safety Course to be properly prepared against all the unlikely mortal scenarios."
target: "让我们一起去一个最终目的地安全课程 以适当准备 面对所有不可能的死亡情景"

source: "Fake IDs for everyone!"
target: "假身份证给大家!"

source: You, Polly, Scott, and the terrified motorists all attend the safety course.
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉, 斯科特害怕的机动人员都参加安全课程

source: "Good afternoon," says the instructor. "Welcome to the 'Destination: Safety' seminar, where you'll learn invaluable tips and tricks on cheating death."
target: "午安"老师说. 欢迎来到"登场:安全"研讨会, 在那里你会学习宝贵的技巧和技巧 关于作弊死亡。"

source: A bit late for me, but sure, go on.
target: 有点晚了,但当然,继续。

source: "Tip #1: dull every sharp edge in your vicinity. You can kiss a life of using scissors, knives, and square furniture goodbye."
target: "Tip #1: 无聊地在你附近的每一个尖端。 你可以亲吻一个生命 用剪刀,刀子, 和方形家具再见。"

source: "Tip #2: always look both ways before crossing the street, lest you be hit by surprise buses, falling panes of glass, or collapsing neon signs."
target: 避免被突然的公交车撞到, 玻璃倒地, 或是霓虹灯标志倒塌"。

source: "Tip #3: always be on the lookout for cruel irony."
target: "Tip #3:永远在注意残酷的讽刺".

source: "If you're in a dangerous place filled with sharp objects, be sure that the thing that actually kills you will be completely unassuming, like a rock or a flag."
target: "如果你身处一个充满了尖锐物体的危险地段,请务必保证真正杀死你的东西会完全不被假定,像一面石头或一面旗帜".

source: "If you're getting eye surgery, expect to go blind; if you're an asshole, beware anus-related injuries; etc."
target: "如果你正在接受眼科手术,期望会失明;如果你是混蛋,注意肛门相关伤害;"等等".

source: Okay, you've got lots of tips, but what about the actual "cheating death" part?
target: 好吧,你有很多小费, 但真正的"死神"部分呢?

source: "Besides taking an innocent life, the only other known way to cheat death is to 'create new life.'"
target: "除了夺走无辜的生命之外, 唯一已知的欺骗死亡的方法 就是"创造出新的生命"

source: "Is there anyone here who wasn't tied to the accident that's willing to take one for the team and get pregnant?"
target: "这里有没有人没有和事故有关联,愿意为队伍取出一分钱来怀孕".

source: NOPE. NOPE. ABSOLUTELY NOT.
target: 没有。 没有。 绝对不是。

source: We're leaving now! Good luck with the whole "being on Death's list" thing!
target: 我们要走了! 祝你们好运,"死亡名单"

source: You lost -N2 HYPE waiting in traffic, but you gained +N2 MIND from that informative seminar!
target: 你输了N2 HYPE在交通中等待, 但你得到了+N2 MID 从信息研讨会!

source: "How would fake IDs help us?" the motorists ask. "Most of us are already old enough to drown our worries in booze."
target: "假身份会对我们有什么帮助?" 摩托家问. "我们大部分人已经老到可以把忧患 淹没在酒中"

source: Sure, but think about it: Death's got all of your names on his shit list, right? What if you all pose as people who AREN'T in debt to Death? You'd be safe!
target: 当然,但想想吧,死神把你们的名字都列在他的名单里,对吧? 如果你们都装成不欠债的人怎么办? 你会很安全!

source: Check it out, my fakes are SUPER convincing. Here, sir, you can now be known as "Tim the Immortal!" "Timmortal" for short!
target: 你看,我的假货很有说服力 在这里,先生,你现在可以 被称为"Tim the Immortal!" 简称"Timmmortal"!

source: "Wow, that's great!" says the newly-christened Timmortal. "Now Death will totally believe I can never die!"
target: "哇,那太好了" 新来的提摩托说。 "现在死亡会完全相信 我永远不会死"

source: And you, ma'am, can be "Ida Ratherlive!" Death loves puns; it's easy to tickle his funny bone and talk him into letting you live.
target: 而你,女士,可以成为"Ida Ratherlive"。死亡爱双关语; 很容易地痒他的滑稽骨头,并说服他让你活下来。

source: "Wow, really?" asks Ida. "Did that work for you?"
target: "哇,真的吗?"问艾达。 "这对你有用吗?"

source: MOVING ON!
target: 移动上!

source: I'm glad we could help you guys get your asses back on the road! That'll be ten bucks for my incredible fakes.
target: 很高兴我们能帮你们 回到路上去! 10块钱的我不可思议的假货。

source: "Wait, you're charging us for these?" the crowd asks angrily. "Even when we're desperate?!"
target: "等等,你收我们钱吗?" 观众愤怒地问。 "即使我们绝望了呢?"

source: I mean, duh. Desperate people are the BEST people to charge money to.
target: 我是说,嗯。 绝望的人是最优秀的人 向钱收取。

source: Heartless, but true. It's a good thing you lost -N2 HYPE in the traffic, or you'd probably be losing SOUL right about now.
target: 心地无所取而能取而能取而有之. 幸好你交通失利了N2 HYPE 否则你可能就要失去SOUL了

source: But apparently actions have no consequences today, because you get your +N2 MONEY and head out!
target: 但显然今天行动没有后果 因为你得到了你的+N2 货币和 离开!

source: You suddenly come upon a herd of sheep blocking the whole road.
target: 你突然撞上一群羊 挡了整条路

source: Dammit, we don't have time for this! MOVE, YOU DUMB SHEEP!
target: 该死,我们没时间了! 动作快,你这个蠢货!

source: Hey, maybe I could use my dog powers to herd these sheep! My grandma says everyone has a calling in life; this could be mine!
target: 嘿,也许我可以用我的狗的力量 来牧羊! 我奶奶说每个人都有生命的呼唤,这可能是我的!

source: Well, if Scott is happy and the sheep get moved, so much the better. He gets out of the car to herd the sheep.
target: 如果... ... . . . . 斯科特 快乐而被羊移动, 如此之好。 他下车去牧羊

source: Listen up, sheep! You should go over there!
target: 听着,羊! 你应该去那边!

target: 好消息是它并非完全无法修复 想办法活埋!

source: Tell them you have a right to pick a better spot to be buried in. When you find it, you'll let them know. Then proceed to live your life in search of the perfect spot to be buried.
target: 告诉他们你有权选择更好的地方 被埋在。 找到它,就让他们知道 然后继续生活 寻找一个完美的埋葬地点

source: SHOVEL FIGHT!
target: 肖维尔战斗!

source: You inform the mobsters that you don't want to be buried here, and have the right to pick your preferred final resting place.
target: 你告诉暴徒 你不想被埋在这里, 并有权选择你喜欢的最后休息地点。

source: "Eh... is that true?" they ask. "We've always just buried mooks wherever we felt like."
target: "额... 他们问,这是真的吗? "我们总是把傻瓜埋在我们喜欢的地方"

source: Then you've been doing it all wrong! Everyone has a right to choose where they decompose!
target: 那你就做错了! 每个人都有权选择分解的地方!

source: I always thought my FINAL final resting place should be somewhere high-traffic, so everyone has to read my tombstone. Like in the middle of a nightclub maybe.
target: 我一直认为我的最后一个休息地点 应该在高通车的地方, 所以每个人都得读我的墓碑。 就像在夜总会中间一样

source: I want my final resting place to be in the same hole I buried my prized bone collection in!
target: 我要我的最后一个休息地点 在同一个洞里 我埋葬了我的珍贵的骨骼收藏!

source: Burying my dead bones on top of all the bones I collected when I was alive would be the sort of thing my smart friend Liam would call "ironing."
target: 把我死去的骨头埋在我活着时收集的所有骨头上 就是我聪明的朋友 利亚姆 就会叫"冷"

source: "Well," say the mobsters, "I guess if I was gonna get buried alive in a shallow grave, I'd want some say on the spot too."
target: "好吧",黑道说:"我想如果我要活埋在浅坟中,我也想当场说几句".

source: "Here, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, take this burner phone. When you find your ideal resting place, give us a call."
target: "这里, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%拿着这个燃烧器电话 当你找到理想的休息地点,给我们打电话。"

source: You and your friends leave and continue your road trip. You wonder all the while where you'd most like to be buried. It's a tough choice!
target: 你和你的朋友离开 继续你的出行 你想知道你最想葬在哪里吗? 选起来很艰难

source: Days, months, years pass... finally, you're an old %MANWOMAN% near %HISHER% deathbed taking an invigorating wheelchair ride through the park.
target: 几天,几个月,几年过去了... 你终于老了 %MANWOMAN% 近处 %HISHER% 死因是坐着充满活力的轮椅穿过公园

source: There, up ahead, you see it. Beautiful trees, warm sunshine, a favorable lack of dog shit in the grass... it's the perfect burial spot!
target: 前面,你看见了 美丽的树木,温暖的阳光, 草地上最爱的狗粪... 完美的埋葬地点!

source: You pull your burner phone out of your fanny pack and call the mobsters to tell them the good news.
target: 你把你的手机从你的粉丝包里取出 然后打电话给黑道分子告诉他们好消息

source: "You found your spot? FINALLY!" they say. "We've been waiting in the desert for fuckin' decades!"
target: "你找到位置了吗? 终于" 他们说。 "我们在沙漠里等了几十年了!"

source: The mobsters arrive, and you use the last of your strength to dig your grave. You stagger into it with open arms, finally at peace...
target: 黑道分子来了,你用你最后的力量去挖你的坟墓. 你用开阔的手臂 错乱地走进它,终于平静下来了...

source: You'll gain +N2 MIND for finding your ideal spot when you're old and gray. But for now, you're young, hot, and road-tripping with your best buds!
target: 等你老了又灰了,你就会得到+N2 MIND 来寻找你的理想位置. 但现在你还年轻又热活 有你最好的花蕾

source: OW! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, did you just hit me with a shovel?!
target: 呜!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你刚才用铲子打我?

source: IT. IS. ON. MEET ME IN THE SHOVEL FIGHTING PIT, BITCH!
target: 这。事。没。完。来铲子格斗坑见我，混蛋！

source: You'd better not leave me out! SHOVEL FIIIIIGHT!
target: 你最好别把我扔在外面! 肖维尔·费克特!

source: Polly swings her shovel at you. You parry it with your shovel. You both duck as Scott nearly decapitates you with the edge of his shovel. SHOVEL FIGHT!
target: 波莉 挥起她的铲子来 你用铲子把它推开 你们两个都躲起来 斯科特 几乎用他铲子的边缘砍了你的头 肖维尔战斗!

source: "HEY!" the mobsters shout. "The fuck's goin' on? Keep diggin' those graves or we'll blow your brains out!"
target: "HEY!"黑道者大叫出场. "他妈的到底是怎么回事? 继续挖那些坟墓,否则我们炸出你的脑袋!"

source: Hey, put those guns away! You can't bring a gun to a shovel fight. That's cheating!
target: 嘿,把枪收起来! 你不能带枪去打铲 骗人!

source: You gotta respect the rules, bros. If you wanna play with us, grab a shovel!
target: 规矩要尊重,兄弟们 如果你想和我们玩,拿个铲子!

source: The mobsters look at each other while you and your friends shovel fight without a care in the world.
target: 黑道分子互相看对方 而你和你的朋友 却在世界上毫无顾忌地打斗

source: "Fuck the graves," one snaps. "We should just execute them."
target: "去他妈的坟墓",一个响起。 "我们应该执行他们。"

source: "We should...," says the other, "but honestly, that shovel fight does look fun. Can't we join them, just for a little bit?"
target: "我们应该..." 另一个说, "但说实话,铲子的战斗看起来很有趣。 我们就不能加入他们吗,只是一点点吗?"

source: "No! The boss would be furious if he found out we were goofing off on the job!"
target: "没有! 老板会生气的 如果他发现我们是在干这个!"

source: "But we always do whatever the boss tells us to do. 'Boys, go kill this guy.' 'Boys, bury this body in the desert.' 'Boys, pick up my lucky fedora from the dry-cleaner's.'"
target: "但我们总是做老板要我们做的. "孩子们,去杀这家伙" "孩子们,把尸体埋在沙漠" "孩子们,从干洗工那里接我的幸运的女神"

source: "Can't we finally do something WE wanna do for a change? I wanna shovel-fight!"
target: "我们最终不能做一些我们想做的事情来改变吗? 我想打铲子!"

source: "Eh... fine. What could it hurt? Give us some shovels, kids!"
target: "额... 还好。 可能会痛什么? 给我们一些铲子,孩子们!"

source: Oh, we'll give you shovels all right. NOW, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%!
target: 哦,我们会给你铲子所有的权利。 现在, %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%!

source: You and Polly swing your shovels HARD and knock the two mobsters out.
target: 你和 波莉 挥起你的铲子 HARD并击倒了两个暴徒。
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Dang, Polly. I didn't know we were doing a shovel fight with street rules.
target: 可恶 波莉. 我不知道我们是在用街上的规则 来打铲子的

source: And neither did they! Now let's get in the car and drive as far away from here as possible.
target: 他们也没有! 现在上车开车 尽量远离这里

source: Hands-down, that was the most fun way you've ever avoided being buried alive by the mob. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 手放下,这是你最有趣的方式 你曾经避免被暴徒活埋。 你得到了+N2 HYPE!

source: Your car is stopped at a red light when a slick red sports car pulls up next to you. The driver revs its engine in a deadly invitation to race.
target: 你的车停在了红灯口 当一辆滑翔的红色运动车停在你旁边时 车手在致命的比赛邀请中重回了引擎.

source: Fuck yeah, a street race! DRIVE, SCOTT!
target: 街上比赛! 开车,斯科特!

source: But the light is still red. We can't move yet.
target: 但灯光还红. 尚不能动.

source: Who cares?! Street racers don't play by the rules! DRIVE!
target: 谁在乎? 街上赛车手不按规矩来玩! 开车!

source: Scott peels out, and so does the other car.
target: 斯科特 皮脱出,而另一辆车也是如此。

source: WARP SPEED, SCOTTY! DRIVE LIKE THERE'S NO TOMORROW!
target: 警报,SOTTY! 开车像没有明天!

source: Okay, if you insist. But I'll go five miles above the speed limit, 'cause I'm a good boy!
target: 好吧,如果你坚持。 但我会走5英里 超过限速, '因为我是一个好孩子!

source: Ugh, fine...
target: 额,没事...

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, looks like it's up to you. SHOOT OUT THE OTHER GUY'S TIRES!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%,看起来它是你的决定。 射出另一个家伙的轮胎!

source: What? How? I don't have a gun.
target: 什麽? 怎么会? 我没有枪。

source: You don't?! But you called shotgun!
target: 你没有吗? 但你叫猎枪!

source: That means you sit in the passenger seat with a loaded shotgun and fuck up anybody who tries to mess with us!
target: 也就是说你坐在乘客座位上 拿着装满了猎枪 和谁想惹我们就干他

source: You're about to tell Polly that's not what shotgun means (anymore) when your racing opponent suddenly slams his car into the side of your car.
target: 你马上就要告诉 波莉 猎枪不是用来表示的, 赛车对手突然撞到车边。

source: WHOA! We almost went off the road! That wasn't very nice...
target: 呜哇! 我们差点就下路了! 这可不怎么好...

source: It sure wasn't. Looks like these motherfuckers wanna play dirty!
target: 肯定不是,我说,我... 看来这些混蛋想玩弄脏了!

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, since you already let me down on the shotgun, you'd better have a good idea on how to retaliate and win this race!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%既然你已经让我在猎枪上失望了 你最好有个好主意 如何报复和赢得这场比赛!

source: Sure, why not? Given all the -N2 MAGIC your car already burnt up during this race, things can only go up from here.
target: 当然,为什么不呢? 有了N2磁带控制系统 你的车在这场比赛中已经烧焦了 只有从这里才能上台

source: Time to play a little dirty and win this street race!
target: 是时候玩点肮脏的游戏 赢得这场街上比赛了!

source: The car pen is mightier than the car sword: write a strongly-worded letter and throw it to the other car as a paper plane!
target: 车用笔比"车用剑"更能打:写出一首有强烈口吻的来信,并把它扔到另一辆车上当作纸机!.

source: It's time to push the Big Red Button. No idea what it does, but desperate times call for desperate measures!
target: 时出推大红扣. 不知道它做什么 但绝望的时代要求采取绝望的措施

source: Okay, I'm in! Help me brainstorm some hate-mail!
target: 好,我进去了! 帮我把仇恨邮件都给我

source: "Dear Motherfucker..." Hmm, is that too strong of an opening?
target: "亲爱的混蛋..." 嗯,那太强烈了开场白?

source: I'm loving the attitude, but bringing the guy's mom into this might be too far. I suggest going with "Dear Shithead."
target: 我喜欢这种态度 但把那家伙的妈妈带进这案子可能太远了 我建议你用"亲爱的笨蛋"

source: Good call. "Dear Shithead: How dare you hip-check our car?! I am absolutely DISGUSTED!"
target: 说得好 "亲爱的笨蛋:你敢看我们的车? 我绝对是被吓坏了!"

source: "You are a deplorable jackass without a shred of redeemability, unfit for even the lowest dregs of society!"
target: "你是一个可悲的混蛋,没有一点可赎回的分量, 不适合即使是社会上最下等的渣滓!"

source: What's a deep lore jackass without a shed of red ear Billy in... uh, whatever you just said?
target: 没有什么大麻烦,没有红耳朵比利... 随便你怎么说?

source: Here, I'll explain it this way: I'm using words to describe the feelings you get when your least favorite team scores a touchdown.
target: 在这里,我用这个解释: 我用词来描述你最不喜欢的队伍打出达阵时的感受.

source: Oh, got it! Then you should end it with, "I'm mad at you, but it's okay, because everyone's having fun and that's what matters!"
target: 哦,对了! 那你就应该说:"我生你气了,但没关系,因为每个人都在玩,这才是最重要的!"

source: Perfect. You fold the finished letter into a paper airplane and throw it into your opponent's open window.
target: 完美无缺 你把写完的信折成纸机 扔到对手的开窗里

source: It punctures the driver's eyeball. He screams, thrashing blindly, and the car fishtails and crashes off-road.
target: 刺入驾驶员眼球 他尖叫,盲目地打, 和汽车鱼尾和坠出出道。

source: ...Oops.
target: ..Oops. 欧普斯。

source: Maybe he can read our letter later when he regains consciousness?
target: 也许他能读我们的信 等他恢复意识后?

source: The car suddenly explodes in a fiery inferno.
target: 车突然在烈火中爆炸

source: DRIVE, SCOTT!
target: 开车,斯科特!

source: Yup, cool, never speaking of that again. At least you all gained +N2 MIND by choosing the intellectual's weapon: the mighty pen!
target: 酷,别再提这个了 至少你们都通过选择知识分子的武器:强大的笔来获得+N2 MIND!

source: Really? Is it finally time to push THE Big Red Button?! The suspense has been killing me!
target: 真的吗? 终于该按下红色大按钮了? 悬念让我很伤心!

source: Looks like today is the fateful day. You and your friends gather your courage, hold your breaths, and... you push it!
target: 看来今天是命运的一天 你和你的朋友们 鼓起勇气 屏住呼吸 然后... 你推开它!

source: Nothing happens. Damn.
target: 什么都没有发生。 该死

source: This can't be right. Push it again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but do it right this time!
target: 这是不对的。 再来一次 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%但这次做对了!

source: You didn't know there was a way to push a button wrong, but fine. This time when you hit the button, "La Cucaracha" begins to play.
target: 你根本不知道有办法按错按钮 但很好 这一次你按下按钮,"La Cucaracha"开始出道.

source: What the... why? Is that all this button does?
target: 这... 为什么? 按钮就用这个吗?

source: I don't mind, I like this song. Play it again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 我不介意 我喜欢这首歌 再弹一遍 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: You hit the Big Red Button again. A cannon pops out of your trunk and fires a cannonball at your opponent's car!
target: 你又撞上"大红"按钮了 炮从后车厢里弹出 并发射出一发炮弹 攻击对手的车!

source: WHOA, that was awesome! Shame it missed, but damn, still wild.
target: 哇,这太赞了! 可惜没打中,但该死的,还是很狂野

source: Push it again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. MORE CANNON POWER!
target: 再来一次 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 更多罐头!

source: You push it again, and...
LA CUCARAAAACHA! LA CUCARAAAACHA! YA NO PUEDE CAMINAAAAR!
target: 洛杉矶卡拉亚阿卡! 洛杉矶卡拉亚阿卡! 哟,没有普德卡米纳阿亚尔!

source: Not this shit again! BRING BACK THE CANNON!
target: 别再这样了! 带回罐头!

source: You push the button again. Your opponent's car suddenly spins out, catches fire, and explodes in a spontaneous inferno.
target: 你再按下按钮 对手的车突然旋转出,起火了,自发地在地獄中爆炸.

source: ...Did we win?
target: 我们赢了吗?

source: Uh... push the button again, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 额... 再按下按钮 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: You do, and your car is filled once more with La Cucaracha's dulcet jaw harp as you drive off.
target: 你开车的时候 你的车又被拉库卡拉查的 下巴上装满了

source: Aside from all the manslaughter, the Big Red Button turned out to be a big fun time! You gain +N2 HYPE.
target: 除了所有过失杀人事件,"大红扣"也成了一个大乐趣!. 得到+N2 HYPE.  You.

source: So, fun story: you and your friends have been hotly pursued by a mob of pissed-off motorists for the past ten miles.
target: 有趣的故事: 过去十多英里里,你和你的朋友 被一群愤怒的汽车手 热地追逐。

source: What do we do, guys?! Why is that angry mob chasing us?!
target: 我们该怎么办,伙计们? 为什么那愤怒的暴徒追我们?

source: No idea, Scott. They're probably murderously jealous of how hot and fun and cool we are!
target: 不知为何 斯科特. 他们可能嫉妒我们有多热闹 多么有趣和酷!

source: ...Or it could have something to do with the +N2 MAGIC which I siphoned out of their gas tanks at the last stop.
target: ...或者它可能与+N2 MAGIC有关,我从他们的油箱里抽出 在最后一站。

source: What? Why did you do that?
target: 什麽? 你为什么这么做?

source: Have you SEEN the price of gas lately? We gotta save money where we can, and it was either selling someone's organs or tank-siphoning.
target: 最近你有没有看到汽油的价格? 我们得在可以的地方省钱 要么卖别人的器官 要么用油罐喷口

source: And since %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is selfishly hoarding that extra lung of %HISHERS%, this was the best I could do.
target: 从那以后 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 自私地囤积了多余的肺 %HISHERS%这是我所能做的最好的。

source: You know, I work really hard to make this road trip a road home, and I'm not appreciated for it!
target: 我努力地把这次公路旅行变成回家的路, 我不欣赏它!

source: Aww, I appreciate you, bro! I just don't want an angry mob to put a pitchfork in my heinie...
target: 啊,我很感激你,兄弟! ! 我只是不想让愤怒的暴徒 在我的鸡鸡上放一道草叉...

source: Maybe if I pull over and explain, they'll be cool about it and we can all group-hug?
target: 也许如果我停车解释一下 他们会很冷静的 我们可以一起玩吗?

source: I don't think that's gonna work, bud. Our only hope is getting away!
target: 我觉得这样行不通,伙计 我们唯一的希望就是逃出!

source: The car would move faster if we got rid of some heavy shit... %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, help me jettison some stuff from the car!
target: 如果我们把一些重物弄掉 车子会开得更快...  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%帮我把车里的东西丢掉!

source: Okay! You did overpack a little, to be fair. You help Polly toss out your novelty bowling ball collection, emergency anvil, and miniature black hole.
target: 好,我们走! 你做了一些外包装,公平。 你帮帮忙 波莉 抛出你的新颖的保龄球 紧急安眠药 和微型黑洞

source: It's not enough; they're gaining on us!
target: 还不够,他们追上我们了!

source: Ugh, they didn't even slip and slide a LITTLE on all those bowling balls? Lame!
target: 唉,他们甚至没有滑滑 滑出一点点在那些保龄球? 可恶!

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, we gotta find something else to throw out, quick!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我们要找到别的东西扔出去,快!

source: Jettison that heavy metal cassette you're listening to. It's... IT'S TOO HEAVY!
target: 吉提森那重金属磁带 你听到。 这是... 这么重!

source: As much as it breaks your heart, you must jettison your dear friend Troy, who's been riding with you all along during this trip.
target: 哪怕你伤心了,你必须抛弃你亲爱的朋友特洛伊 他在这段旅程中一直跟你一起骑马

source: Whoa, I didn't even notice the heavy metal music. How long has that been playing? I thought we were listening to the %MUSIC% station.
target: 哇,我甚至没注意到重金属音乐。 玩了多久? 玩得开心吗? 我以为我们在听%MUSIC%电台的节目

source: This is music? I thought the car was just screaming 'cause we were driving it too hard and fast.
target: 这是音乐吗? 我以为那辆车只是尖叫着 因为我们开得太快了

source: Nah, it's music. Metal's not my preferred genre, but I guess it was good ambiance for this high-stakes car chase.
target: 不,这是音乐。 金属不是我的最喜欢的流派, 但我猜这是很好的氛围 对于这个高考车追逐。

source: But it looks like it's time to kiss this soundtrack goodbye... farewell little buddy.
target: 但看来是时候吻这声道再见了... 再见,小朋友。

source: Whoa, this tape's so heavy I can't even eject it. Scott, can you throw it out the window?
target: 哇,这盘带子太重了,我甚至不能弹出它。  斯科特你能把它扔出窗户吗?

source: Leave it to me, bro. THIS ONE'S FOR ARM DAY!
target: 交给我,兄弟 这张是用来买军火的!

source: Scott suplexes the heavy metal tape out of the moving car.
target: 斯科特 将重金属磁带从移动的汽车上取出。

source: It's so heavy it cracks the asphalt when it hits the road and shatters.
target: 重得会撞到路面会破碎

source: A shard of cassette pierces one angry motorist's tire at the same time that heavy metal music pierces everyone's ears, and the tape dies in one final rock-and-roll scream.
target: 一张磁带的硬盘刺穿了一位愤怒的汽车手的轮胎,同时重金属音乐也刺穿了每个人的耳朵,而磁带在一次最后的摇滚尖叫中死去.

source: ...Well this silence is deafening.
target: ...这沉默让人耳聋

target: 让你觉得你的N2 MIND被压制了... 你浮起,活活在风中, 对接下来的事物没有控制力。

source: Who will you see when you lift the blindfold? Who will become the object of your affections? Scott? Polly? Aaravi? Calculester? Hex?
target: 举起眼罩,你见谁? 谁会成为你的爱对象?  斯科特?  波莉?  阿拉薇?  卡库莱斯特? 黑克斯吗?

source: With trembling hands, you finally remove your blindfold, and you see a face...
target: 手颤动,你终于脱下眼罩,看到一张脸...

source: It's quite a familiar face. It's YOUR face!
target: 这是一个相当熟悉的脸。 这是你的相貌!

source: Surprise, boo! It's a mirror! Looks like you were your own true love all along!
target: 惊喜,嘘! 镜子! 看来你一直都是自己的真爱!

source: We talked it over, and we decided you could use more self-love in your life.
target: 我们商量过了,我们决定你 可以在你的生活中多用点自我爱

source: Especially since, historically speaking, you're kinda obsessed with finding a significant other no matter the cost... it seemed unhealthy.
target: 特别是因为,从历史上讲, 你有点迷恋 寻找一个重要的其他,不管成本... 看上去不健康,我无法忍受

source: We hope that you will forgive our deception. We just want you to love yourself as much as we love being your friend!
target: 我们希望你们能原谅我们的欺骗行为。 我们只想你爱自己 就像我们爱做你的朋友一样

source: Aww, how sweet! You hug all your friends tight for caring about you.
target: 多么可爱! 你紧紧地拥抱你的朋友 关心你。

source: That night, you celebrate your new self-love by taking yourself out to your favorite restaurant, even springing for the fancy dessert.
target: 那晚,你庆祝你的新自爱 通过带自己出去 你最喜欢的餐厅, 甚至春天的甜点。

source: Then you go to the movies, and while you're reaching for more popcorn, you accidentally brush fingers with your other hand. Sparks fly!
target: 然后去看电影,当你伸手要更多的爆米花时,你意外地用另一只手刷手指. 火花飞了!

source: The date culminates when you invite yourself in "for coffee" and make sweet love to that hand. Awooga!
target: 约会的高潮是邀请自己加入"为咖啡",并给那只手做甜美的爱. 阿乌加!

source: Prom and summer camp might've been all about finding love, but on this road trip, you finally learned... to love yourself!
target: 舞会和夏令营可能都是为了找到爱 但在旅途中 你终于学会了... 爱自己!

source: You're driving along when you see a food truck parked on the side of the road. The people running it look awfully familiar...
target: 你开车的时候看到一辆餐车停在路边 管理它的人看起来很熟悉...

source: Sup, bitches? Welcome to the Totally Hexed Taco Truck. You here to try my special recipe?
target: 婊子们,你好吗? 欢迎来到全速快餐车 你是来试我的特制菜谱的?

source: Run. Seriously. Every "special recipe taco" Hex has made today has been absolutely inedible.
target: 运行。 说真的 今天制作的"特制"玉米卷饼 绝对是不可食用

source: Friend Aaravi is not exaggerating. I've studied the molecular composition of Friend Hex's tacos, and they more closely resemble crude oil than food.
target: 朋友们 阿拉薇 并没有夸张。 我研究了Hex朋友的玉米卷的分子组成,它们更接近于原油而不是食物.

source: C'mon, guys, let me practice! I can't learn to make tacos better if I don't work under the pressure of accidentally poisoning a customer with a taco!
target: 来,伙计们,让我练习! 吃玉米卷的不吃玉米卷 压着不小心用玉米卷毒死顾客,我学不起来做玉米卷了!

source: I'll take three tacos, please!
target: 我要三杯玉米饼,谢谢!

source: Uhhh, why don't we let this guy who just pulled up order first? Just to see what happens.
target: 呃,我们为什么不让这个家伙 谁刚刚拉了订单先? 只是为了看看会发生什么。

source: "Hello," says the new customer. "My name is... Heath Inspectorman, and I'm... a janitor. Yep, that's all true, don't fact-check it."
target: "你好"新顾客说. "我的名字是..." . . . . 希斯探长,我... 门卫 都是真的,别查事实"

source: Apologies, sir, but my fact-checking software can only be disabled by an administrator.
target: 抱歉,先生,我检查事实的软件只能由管理员来禁用

source: Your real name is Herman Tinnez, and you are a health inspector!
target: 你的真名是赫尔曼·廷内斯 而你是卫生督察

source: We're having a health inspection TODAY? Why weren't we given any warning?!
target: 今天要检查健康情况吗? 为什么我们没有发出警告?

source: "Because then you would've had time to prepare, and I wanted to catch you off-guard! MWAHAHAHAHA!"
target: "因为那样你就会有时间准备,而我却想抓住你,让你失去警惕! 万花齐放!"

source: "Oh, my phone's ringing... it's my husband. I need to take this, sorry."
target: "哦,我的电话响了... 我丈夫来了 我需要这个,对不起。"

source: "Hi honey... what? I can't right now, I'm working... ugh, he won't fall asleep AT ALL? Fine, but I'm singing it in the car, it's got better acoustics. One sec."
target: "亲爱的... 什麽? 我现在不能工作... 他不会睡着吧? 好吧,但我唱它 在汽车,它的声优。 等一等" 等一等 等一等

source: Okay, we've got a little time. Cal, what are our chances of passing this health inspection?
target: 好了,我们有一点时间。 卡尔,我们通过这次健康检查的机会有多大?

source: 1:50000. Even less if I am right in my suspicions that Hex has been breeding mosquitos in the walk-in freezer.
target: 1:50000. 如果我猜对了,海克思在冷藏室里 正在繁殖蚊子,那就更没有意义了

source: Don't hate on my science experiments!
target: 别讨厌我的科学实验!

source: Don't worry, I'm sure we can somehow pull this off in a weird, unexpected way. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, come up with a plan!
target: 别担心,我敢肯定,我们可以 以奇怪,出乎意料的方式做到这一点。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%拿出一个计划!

source: Cook the ultimate burrito for the inspector: a burrito so good it's worth the salmonella.
target: 煮出最好的卷饼给督察: 卷饼这么好,它值得沙门氏菌。

source: No one's dream is to be a health inspector. Ask him to tell you all about his childhood dreams, in the hopes he ditches everything to pursue his dream job!
target: 没有人梦想成为一名卫生检查员。 叫他把童年的梦想都告诉你 希望他能放弃一切去追求梦想的工作

source: It could work... but only with the combined might of all our abilities. We need to work together to achieve cooking nirvana!
target: 可能有用... 可能不会... 只能用我们所有的能力的力量来进行 我们需要共同努力,实现烹饪的硝香!

source: Can do! You donate some of your trip food to making the burrito. You lose -N2 STAMINA, but it's for a good cause!
target: 办得到! 你捐出一些食物 做卷饼。 你输了N2 Stamina,但这是为好理由!

source: You and your friends work together to create something magical in the food truck that day.
target: 那天你和你的朋友一起在餐车里创造出神奇的东西

source: You achieve total synchronicity; a perfect cooking flow state. You're a well-oiled, Michelin-star worthy, burrito-making machine!
target: 你实现了完全同步; 一个完美的烹饪流程状态。 你是个油气充沛的米其林明星 值得的布瑞多机器!

source: I do not wish to undermine you, Friend Aaravi, but I believe that in order to serve a chicken-filled burrito, we must have a working grill.
target: 我不想破坏你,朋友 阿拉薇但我相信为了给一个装满鸡肉的卷饼服务 我们必须有一个工作烤肉架

source: Fuck the grill! I'll just roast this chicken with my flaming dagger. We use what we've got!
target: 去他妈的烤肉! 我就用我的火把来烤这只鸡 我们用我们拥有的!

source: Oops, I dropped the tortilla on the floor... do you think the health inspector will notice a few ants in his beans?
target: 哦,我把玉米饼扔在地上... 你觉得卫生检查员会注意到 他豆子里有几只蚂蚁吗?

source: Eh, it'll be fine. I added a TON of habanero peppers to the sauce. His taste buds will be too burnt to taste ants, or anything really.
target: 嗯,它会好起来的。 我加了一顿花椒酱 他的口味会烧得太焦 无法尝到蚂蚁的味道, 或任何真的。

source: Finally, the health inspector returns. You slide him your masterpice: a greasy, weirdly-shaped burrito.
target: 最后,卫生检查员回来了。 你给他滑出你的大师调味料:一出油腻又怪异的卷饼.

source: "Uh...," he says, "I didn't order a burrito...?"
target: "呃..." 他说,"我没有点一卷卷卷饼..."

source: FOR FUCK'S SAKE, JUST EAT IT!
target: 他妈的的ake,只是吃它!

source: Aaravi shoves the burrito in his throat.
target: 阿拉薇 将卷饼塞入喉咙

source: "Oh, wow..." he says. "This chicken is immaculate! The skin's burnt to a smoky, nearly-ashen crisp, but the core is a buttery, medium-rare delicacy!"
target: "哦,哇",他说。 "这只鸡是纯洁的! 皮肤被烧成烟熏的,几乎是香味的脆脆,但核心是黄油质的,中度的精致"!

source: "The beans and queso envelope the chicken in a tender, gooey embrace, and the freezer-burnt ants you've mixed in add the perfect amount of crunch!"
target: "豆子和克索将鸡围入温柔的,可口的拥抱, 和冷冻-烧制的蚂蚁你混合了 完美的克克量!"

source: "And the aftertaste! It's a fiery, vibrant, explosive party of bacteria in the back of my throat! This burrito is absolutely 'salmonellicious'!"
target: "而后事也! 简直是场火爆活泼的细菌派对 这卷卷饼绝对是"沙门尼利克"!

source: Herman loves the burrito. Even as the ambulance takes him away, he assures you the food was "truly to die for."
target: 赫尔曼喜欢吃卷饼 即便救护车把他带走 他也保证食物是"真要死"

source: What a nice man -- and an accurate one! According to this news report I'm reading, he did die in the hospital from burrito-related injuries.
target: 真是个好人,一个准确的人! 根据我读到的这个新闻报道,他的确死于与卷饼有关的伤.

source: Y'all, I propose a toast: to Herman Tinnez -- RIP -- and to the best damn burrito this road trip's ever seen. +N2 HYPE for everyone!
target: 祝你们干杯,祝贺曼·廷尼斯 和这趟旅程中最精彩的卷饼 +N2 HYPE 给大家!

source: The health inspector returns. "I'm back! Let's get this inspection started. I want one taco, please."
target: 卫生巡视员回来了 "我回来了! 开始检查吧 我要一个玉米卷,谢谢。"

source: Say, Herman... you ever, uh... think of telling some total strangers about your childhood dreams?
target: 赫尔曼... 你曾经,呃... 考虑告诉一些陌生人 关于你的童年梦想?

source: "You want to hear about my dreams?" Herman asks, starry-eyed. "I'd LOVE to tell you! When I was a boy..."
target: "你想听听我的梦?" 赫尔曼问道, 星光之眼。 "我爱告诉你! 当我还是个孩子的时候... ..."

source: (I already don't care. I'm losing -N2 HYPE as he speaks.)
target: (我已经不在乎了) 我输了N2 HYPE,他说话。 )

source: "...my father was a firefighter. He was incredible; a real hero. Every day I watched him save lives, and I thought to myself..."
target: 我父亲是消防员 他真是不可思议,是个真正的英雄。 每天我看着他拯救生命,我心里想..."

source: "'These buildings wouldn't burn down so much if someone were making sure they're up to code!'"
target: "如果有人确保这些建筑符合密码,这些建筑就不会被烧毁"

source: "I wanted to change that. When I grew up, I wanted to be... A SAFETY INSPECTOR!"
target: "我想改变这一点。 当我长大的时候,我想成为... 安全检查员!"

source: But... you sorta did that, right? Aren't health inspectors and safety inspectors pretty much the same thing?
target: 不过... 你算是做了,对不对? 卫生监督员和安全监督员是不是差不多一样?

source: "NO! Safety inspectors are superheroes, saving people from potential fires and ceiling cave-ins! Health inspectors just stop restaurants from giving people salmonella..."
target: "没有! 安全检查员是超级英雄, 拯救人们从潜在的火灾和天花板洞穴! 卫生检查员只是阻止餐馆给人提供沙门氏菌...

source: But stopping a salmonella outbreak would also indirectly save lives.
target: 但是阻止沙门氏菌的爆发 也会间接地拯救生命

source: "Yeah, but who would notice, or care? You ever read a comic about a superhero who saved people from salmonella? Me neither."
target: "是的,但谁会注意到,或关心? 你读过漫画吗? 漫画里说一个超级英雄 曾拯救过人们免于沙门氏菌的折磨? 我也没有。"

source: Well, I think if you want to be a safety inspector, you should just go for it. Life's not gonna wait around for you to chase your dreams, dude.
target: 好吧,我想 如果你想做一个安全检查员, 你应该去。 生活不会等待你追逐梦想,伙计。

source: Logically speaking, safety inspection is quite similar to your current job, so if you are already good at this, you will likely succeed at that.
target: 逻辑上说,安全检查与你目前的工作相当相近,所以如果你已经擅长了,你很可能会成功.

source: Yeah, you should make a career change immediately. Like, now immediately.
target: 是啊,你应该马上改变职业 碞瞷

source: "Yeah... YEAH! You're right! I'm over this health-inspector shit. It's time to live my life for ME!"
target: "对曰. 对! 你说的对! 我受够了这个健康检查员的狗屁 今为我活出我活出活来!"

source: Herman rips his shirt off and walks confidently into the desert sunset to pursue his new dream.
target: 赫尔曼撕开他的衣服,并自信地走入了沙漠的日落去追求他的新梦想.

source: Why didn't he take his car?
target: 他为什么不开他的车?

source: Leave him be, Scott... leave him be.
target: 别管他 斯科特... 别管他

source: You saved the food truck, and gained +N2 SOUL for helping the health inspector find himself. Nice!
target: 你救了那辆餐车,还因为帮助卫生检查员找到自己而获得了+N2 Suul. 不错!

source: What do you get when you put a hotheaded adventurer, a sentient computer boy, and a chaotic cursed necklace in the same car?
target: 你放一个热头冒险家 一个有意识的电脑男孩 和一个被诅咒的混乱项链 在同一辆车里时会得到什么?

source: Apparently you get a food truck, if this truck you just pulled up to is any indication.
target: 显然你得到一辆餐车, 如果这辆卡车你刚刚拉到 任何迹象。

source: Welcome to the Aaravi, Hex, and Calculester's food truck! What can we get ya?
target: 欢迎光临 阿拉薇,Hex,还有, 卡库莱斯特餐车! 需要点什么?

source: One hamburger, please!
target: 请给我一个汉堡包!

source: Oof, sorry Charlie, we're all outta hamburgers. We can only serve cheeseburgers right now.
target: 哦,对不起查理,我们全都没汉堡了。 我们现在只能吃起司汉堡了

source: But... how does that...?
target: 不过... 这怎么... ?

source: Friends, I am having a problem. This cheese is not melting on this hot hamburger patty, which I believe breaks most laws of physics.
target: 朋友们,我有一个问题。 这起司不会融化在 热汉堡花地上, 我认为这打破了大多数的物理定律。

source: Whoa, you're not kidding. That cheese is hard as a rock.
target: 哇,你不是在开玩笑。 奶酪硬得像石头一样

source: It shouldn't be spoiled yet; I just picked it up from the store this morning. See, it doesn't even expire until after the Anthropocene ends.
target: 不应该被宠坏的,我今早从店里捡起的 人类灭绝前 也不会过期

source: What? That makes no sense. Let me see that package.
target: 什麽? 这根本说不通。 让我看看那个包裹。

source: ...Hex, this isn't cheese. This is "Edible Cheese-Flavored Product."
target: 赫克丝,这不是起司 这是"易食用起司口味产品".

source: "FDA-approved in seven states. Almost entirely nonpoisonous. Do not consume if pregnant."
target: "FDA批准在七个州。 几乎完全没有恶意 怀孕时不要消耗".

source: HEX! Why did you buy this?!
target: 赫克丝! HEX! 你为什么买这个?

source: I was in a hurry, okay? You said to get the first cheese I saw, and I saw a guy giving this stuff away for free in the parking lot.
target: 我赶时间,好吗? 你说要拿到我看到的第一块起司 我看到一个家伙在停车场免费送货

source: We cannot serve this "cheese!" Our customers could be pregnant, or sensitive to poison!
target: 我们不能为这"奶酪"服务 我们的顾客可能怀孕了 或者对毒药敏感

source: Does that mean you guys are just gonna throw it out? Can we have it?
target: 你们要扔出去吗? 我们能吃吗?

source: I suppose so; it is bad to waste food. But I do not think this "cheese" is legally recognized as food, so I do not recommend eating it.
target: 我想是的,浪费食物是不好的。 但我不认为这"芝士"在法律上被承认为食物,所以我不建议吃.

source: Don't worry, we won't! What ARE we gonna use this "cheese-flavored product" for, though?
target: 别担心,我们不会的! 我们用这"芝士口味"做什么?

source: The resilience of this "cheese" makes it the perfect material to treat open wounds. Lives will be saved!
target: 这种"芝士"的韧性使它成为治疗开口伤口的完美材料. 生命会得到拯救!

source: REVENGE.
target: 复问.

source: Say, that's not a bad idea...
target: 说,这不是一个坏主意...

source: We flash forward to an operating room where a woman is undergoing emergency surgery.
target: 我们向手术室转去 有个女人正在接受紧急手术

source: "She's losing a lot of blood, Doctor. It looks like the bullet ruptured one of her lungs."
target: "她失血过多了,医生. 子弹好像打碎了她的肺"

source: "Don't worry, there's still time to save her. Nurse, pass me the 'cheese.'"
target: "别担心,还有时间救她. 护士,把"芝士"递给我

source: "The cheese? Are you hungry, Doctor?"
target: "奶酪吗? 你饿了吗,医生?

source: "What? No! I'm not talking about the cheese on the complimentary charcuterie board; I'm talking about the 'cheese' that's used to seal open wounds!"
target: "什麽? 没有! 我不是在说在配方的"克克特"板上的起司;我指的是用来封开伤口的"克特""克特""!".

source: "What do they teach you kids in med school these days? Didn't you see my air quotes?!"
target: "他们教你的孩子 在医学院这些天? 你没看到我的空气引用吗?"

source: "I'm so sorry, Doctor. It must be the high pressure of the situation. I totally missed the air quotes."
target: "太遗憾了,医生. 一定是局势带来的高压。 我完全错过了空引用".

source: "Lives have been lost of over missed air quotes, Nurse."
target: "生活已经丢失了 过多的空气引号,护士。"

source: "I'm so sorry. Here is the 'cheese.'"
target: "真遗憾. 这是"芝士"。

source: Later, in the waiting room, the surgeon talks to the patient's husband.
target: 后来,在候诊室,外科医生与病人的丈夫交谈.

source: "Congratulations Mr. Auburndale, the surgery was a success. We removed the bullet from your wife's lung."
target: "贺之于先生. 奥本代尔,手术很成功 我们从你妻子肺里取出子弹"

source: "That's great news, Doctor! God bless you!"
target: "那真是好消息,医生! 上帝保佑你!"

source: "Now, for transparency's sake, I must inform you that Mrs. Auburndale now has a square of 'cheese' in her left lung."
target: "现在,为了透明起见,我必须通知你,夫人。 奥本代尔左肺现在有一个"芝士"的正方形. "

source: "It saved her life, but side effects to prolonged exposure to the 'cheese' may include gastrointestinal distress, diminished faith in the food industry, and -N2 MIND loss."
target: "这救了她一命,但长期被"芝士"所暴露的副作用可能包括胃肠忧郁,对食品工业的信心减弱,和-N2 MIND损失".

source: "...What? What?! You can't put cheese in my wife's lung! She's lactose intolerant!!!"
target: "... 什麽? 你说什么? 你不能把起司 进入我太太的肺! 她对乳糖不耐性!"

source: "Oh, not to worry, sir. 'Cheese' has no lactose. It's okay, my nurse missed the air quotes too."
target: "哦,不用担心,先生。 芝士没有乳糖 没关系,我的护士也错过了空气引用。"

source: Well, it's a great medical invention, if an unconventional one. You gain +N2 SOUL for discovering the practical applications of "cheese"!
target: 医学发明很棒,如果不是常规的 你因为发现"芝士"的实际应用而获得+N2 SOUL!

source: You make one more detour on the way to your destination. You ring the doorbell to Hailey the Harpy's house.
