source: And why is it every time we stop somewhere, we lose one or more of our key resources? It's infuriatingly inefficient!
target: 为什么每次我们停下来时, 我们都会失去一个或一个以上的关键资源? 实在是太低效了!

source: Yeah, it's kinda annoying and unhelpful too. Maybe we should only gain stuff, and not lose it when we don't have to?
target: 是啊,它有点烦人和无益。 也许我们只应该得到一些东西,而不应该失去它,因为我们不需要?

source: See? Scott gets it. Luckily for you all, I've figured out a way to do just that!
target: 看到没?  斯科特 得到它。 得到它。 得到它。 幸好你们都这样,我已经想出办法了!

source: Vera hands out some color-coded spreadsheets and planners, all labeled "Road Trip Optimization Initiative".
target: 维拉 手取一些彩色编码的电子表格和规划者, 都标注为“道路行走优化倡议”。

source: In order to reach our destination as fast as possible, we'll drive eighteen hours a day, ration our snacks, and sleep in the car with a brick on the gas pedal.
target: 为了尽快到达目的地,每天开行18小时,配给小吃,并用瓦斯踏板上砖块入住车内.

source: You get a five-minute bathroom break every four hours. If you can't hold it, use your assigned emergency urine bottle so as not to disrupt the schedule.
target: 你每四小时有五分钟的洗手间休息时间 无法持用时,使用指定应急尿瓶,以免干扰排行.

source: Vera, babe, you gotta chill. We're on vacation; quit obsessing, relax, and invite a little chaos in your life!
target: 维拉宝贝,你得冷静下来 我们在度假,别迷恋,放松, 让你的生活有点混乱!

source: Inviting chaos in my life sounds like the WORST possible way to relax!
target: 我的生活中招来混乱 听起来像是最糟糕的放松方式

source: Okay, baby steps. Wanna try listening to one of our relaxing tapes to help you unwind instead?
target: 好了,宝贝步子。 想听听我们放轻松的录音带吗?

source: Fine. Play me a tape if you must -- preferably one that ISN'T a waste of my precious time.
target: 精细。 帮我录一段带子,最好不要浪费我宝贵的时间

source: "Soothing Schadenfreude: a podcast to remind you that you're doing okay, at least compared to the shitty lives of these other people."
target: "舒舒德·克德:一个播客来提醒你,你做的很好,至少与这些人的糟糕生活相比".

source: "Sounds of the Sea: we put a mic underwater, now you get to listen."
target: "海之声:我们把麦克风放入水下,现在你听了".

source: "Welcome to 'Soothing Schadenfreude'," says the smooth-voiced host, "where we hope to remind you that whatever's going wrong in your life, it could always be worse."
target: "欢迎来到"舒顿克"(Soothing Schadenfreude),"平滑的收音机主持人说:"我们希望在这里提醒你,无论你生活中出了什么问题,都可能永远更糟糕".

source: This is exploitative and needlessly cruel... which is no big deal, but if this podcast is boring on top of that, I'm gonna be pissed.
target: 这是剥削和不必要的残忍... 这没什么大不了的 但如果播客无聊的话 我一定会生气的

source: "Our first guest is Howie Russo. Tell us, Howie: what was the worst day of your life?"
target: "我们的第一个客人是豪伊·鲁索. 告诉我们,豪伊:你一生中最糟糕的一天是什么?”

source: "Well...," sighs Howie, "it'd have to be the day I got fired from my job at the manure plant."
target: "嗯..." 叹道豪伊 "那一定是我被解雇那天"

source: "I got caught sleeping with the manager's wife... in the manure pile... we were escorted out of the building naked... AND I got a lifelong infection from the whole thing..."
target: "我被抓到和经理的妻子上床..." 粪堆里... 我们被护送离开这栋楼... 我从整件事中得到了终生的感染..."

source: "I see, Howie. And was that infection due to a sexually-transmitted disease, or the manure?"
target: "我明白了,豪维。 感染是因为性传染疾病还是粪便?

source: "The doctor said it's a mixture of both, and they're currently mutating into one super-infectious virus... at least I'm getting a disease named after me?"
target: "医生说这是两者的混合物,他们目前正在变异成一种超级感染性病毒. 至少我得到一个疾病 以我命名?"

source: What do you think, Vera? Not so boring after all?
target: 你觉得呢? 维拉? 毕竟没那么无聊吗?

source: Fine, I admit I'm entertained...
target: 好吧,我承认我很娱乐...

source: "Our next guest is Louise Wall. Louise, what was the worst day of your life?"
target: "我们的下一位客人是路易丝·沃尔. 露易丝,你人生中最糟糕的一天是什么?"

source: "Um... I don't know," says Louise. "I've had a pretty good life: I have good children, a loving husband..."
target: "额... 我不知道,路易斯说。 "我有一个相当好的生活: 我有一个很好的孩子,一个可爱的丈夫..."

source: "Really, Louise?" says the host in that eerily calm tone. "DOES your husband love you? Are you quite sure?"
target: "真的,路易丝?" 主持人说,在那种平静的语气。 "你丈夫爱你吗?" 你确信吗?"

source: "I... I think so... what are you implying?"
target: "我... . . . . . 我想是这样... 你在暗示什么?"

source: "Louise, you and the lucky listeners are in for a treat. We have a surprise guest for the night... meet my tender and passionate lover, Mr. Charles Wall."
target: "路易,你和幸运的听众们要来吃一顿. 我们有一个惊喜客人 晚上... 满足我温柔而热情的爱人,先生。 查尔斯·沃尔".

source: "Charlie!" Louise gasps. "What's happening? You're fucking this podcaster guy?! How could you do this to me?!"
target: "查理" 露易丝喘息 "发生什么事了? 你他妈是那个混混? 你怎么能这样对我?"

source: "Quite easily, actually," Charlie says. "I know I should feel guilty, but honestly, watching you shatter before my eyes makes me feel... at peace, somehow."
target: "其实很轻松" 查理说 "我知道,我应该感到内疚,但说实话, 看着你在我的眼前被打碎 让我感觉... 和平地,不知何故。"

source: Me too, Charlie... me too.
target: 我也一样,查理... 我也一样。

source: You gain +N2 MIND from the relaxing tape. But reveling in others' misery, while soothing, isn't very kind. You lose -N2 SOUL.
target: 从放轻松的磁带里得到+N2 MID. 但是在别人的痛苦中欢呼,虽然安慰,却并不十分善良. 你输了 -N2 SOUL。

source: You roll the tape and hear the mic plunging into the ocean. The rushing waves, babbling bubbles, and smooth current wash over you.
target: 你翻出磁带,听到麦克风涌入大海 冲浪,泡泡, 和光滑的流水洗你身上。

source: Then, suddenly, there's a voice on the tape! It says, "...as I was saying, I LOVE being a talking fish."
target: 然后,突然间, 磁带上有一个声音! 上面写着:"... 就像我所说的,我喜欢当条会说话的鱼"

source: "Then we 'sea' eye-to-eye on that, buddy!" another voice chuckles. "And to think, the dumb surface-dwellers don't suspect a thing!"
target: "然后我们"海"的眼睛 -眼睛在那,伙计!" 又一个声音笑。 "而想,愚蠢的表面居民 丝毫没有怀疑!"

source: "Look, here comes Sheldon! How ya doin', old 'chum'?"
target: "看,谢尔顿来了! 怎么样,老"Chum"?

source: "Hey, guys," says Sheldon. "I see you two are still 'hooked' on those awful ocean puns."
target: "嘿,伙计们",谢尔顿说。 "我看到你们两个仍然"被"吼" 在那些可怕的海洋双关语。"

source: "Of course we are; they make us so 'bubbly'! Another big advantage to being a talking fish is getting to use so many great ocean puns."
target: 当然了,他们让我们变得如此"笨"了! 成为一条说话的鱼的另一个大优势是 开始使用这么多的大型海洋双关语。"

source: "Wait a sec... there's something fishy going on here -- other than us. What's on your chest, Sheldon?"
target: "等一下... ... . . 这里除了我们之外,还有一些可疑的事情发生。 胸口是什么 Sheldon?"

source: "It's... a birthmark?"
target: "乃曰:"尔等所取之. 胎记"

source: "IT'S A MICROPHONE! Are you recording us to out us to the surface dwellers?! That's so 'shellfish' of you!"
target: "这是个微型手机! 你录制我们出去 与水面居民! 你真是个"鱼"!

source: "It's not just selfish, it's treason punishable by death! Someone call the merpeople!"
target: "这不仅仅是自私,而且是可处以死刑的叛国! 有人叫"美人"!"

source: "No, please don't have me arrested!" Sheldon begs. "We can all still have a 'merry time' together! ...Get it? Like 'maritime'?"
target: "不,请不要让我被捕" Sheldon乞求. "我们都可以一起过着"美满"的日子! 明白吗? 比如说"海洋"?

source: "Sorry, Sheldon. Not even that excellent pun can save you now."
target: "对不起,谢尔顿。 即使那顶优秀的双关语现在也救不了你".

source: The next several minutes of screaming, scuffling, and the hiss of an axe strongly suggest that Sheldon was executed. Then the tape goes silent.
target: 接下来几分钟的尖叫,打拐,以及一斧头的他强烈地暗示了谢尔顿被处决. 后取相带入寂.

source: WOW. That was... something. At least it distracted me from whatever was stressing me out before.
target: 哇呜。 这是... 东西。 至少它让我分心了 以前我紧张的是什么

source: You lost -N2 HYPE listening to slow, soothing ocean sounds, but you gained +N2 MIND relaxing (and learning where talking fish go when they die).
target: 你输了N2 HYPE听了慢而舒缓的海洋声音, 但你得到了+N2 MIND 放松(以及学习在鱼死后会说话的鱼去向).

source: You're driving, and Miranda is riding shotgun, giving you directions. Too bad she's the worst navigator in history.
target: 你开车,和 米兰达 骑着猎枪,给你指路 可惜她是最差的航海家

source: Soooo, according to this map thing... we should head "weest" to reach the ocean!
target: 苏,根据地图上的内容... 我们应该把"最"的脑袋伸到海洋去!

source: It's pronounced "west". And again, I'll remind you we aren't trying to drive straight into the ocean.
target: 其发音为"西". 再说一遍,我提醒你 我们不是想直接开入海洋

source: But I miss the ocean! I don't like the desert; it's too dry and sandy. It's all the worst parts of the beach, with none of the water!
target: 但我想念大海! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! 臣不喜沙漠;太干而多沙. 海滩上最糟糕的地方,没有水!

source: I understand, but can you rant later? Right now we need you to tell us when to turn.
target: 我明白,但你能不能晚点再说? 现在我们需要你告诉我们何时该转弯

source: Turn... turn... oh, that reminds me! %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, it's your turn to braid my hair!
target: 转... 转... 哦,这提醒了我!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%轮到你剪我的头发了!

source: Well, Miranda, that'll be pretty hard to do while I'm driving. I don't think you're really grasping the importance of the fact that I'm driving.
target: 这个嘛 米兰达我开车的时候很难做到 我想你没有真正理解 我开车的重要性

source: Look, Miri, your lovable ditz schtick is as cute as ever, but right now we really need you to focus on--
target: 米莉,你可爱的ditz schtick 一如既往地可爱, 但现在我们真的需要你 集中精力 --

source: Yes! You're exactly right, Polly. We DO need to focus.
target: 没错! 你说得对, 波莉. 我们确实需要集中精神。

source: Focus on this beautiful song I just made up about how great I am at being navigator!
target: 专心听这首我刚编的美丽歌 说我做航海家有多伟大!

source: "I can show you the road / Big, winding, confuuuusing! / Tell me, peasants, when did you last let a princess be your guide?"
target: "我可带你看看路/大,风,弄! 乡亲们,告诉我,你什么时候 才让公主做你的向导?

source: This would be the first and last time for me, personally.
target: 这将是我第一次也是最后一次,个人。

source: "A WHOLE NEW ROOOOOAD! / A motor-tastic way to move! / No one to tell us no, or where to go..."
target: "一个全新的房间! 机动车的动作方式 没有人告诉我们不,或者去哪里... ..."

source: YOU'RE supposed to be telling us where to go!
target: 你应该告诉我们该去哪儿!

source: Oh, right! Silly me. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you need to turn left five minutes ago.
target: 哦,对了! 蠢货  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你得在五分钟前左转

source: Goddammit. You'd honestly be better off if Miranda was distracted so you could just drive in peace. But what would distract her?
target: 他妈的。 老实说,如果 米兰达 分心了,让你能平静地开车 但是,什么会分散她的注意力?

source: Keep her mouth busy by using the Emergency Ice Cream.
target: 利用紧急冰激凌,让她的口腔保持紧张

source: Give her an assignment to write that you will review when you arrive at the next stop.
target: 给她一个任务写,当你到达下一站时,你会审查。

source: WOOHOO! ICE CREAM EMERGENCY! It's my favorite emergency!
target: 呜呼! 冰激凌紧急! 这是我最喜欢的紧急事件!

source: Scott uses the emergency hammer to break the case protecting your emergency ice cream.
target: 斯科特 利用紧急锤子破案 保护你的紧急冰淇淋

source: One of these days, you should really sweep all the broken glass out of the back of the car.
target: 有一天,你应该把车后部的玻璃都打碎了

source: This is ice cream, you say? I've never tried it myself. I used to have my serfs do all my eating for me...
target: 这是冰淇淋,你说呢? 我从来没有试过自己。 我以前让我的农奴们为我做所有的食物...

source: So this is your FIRST TIME having ice cream? Wow! I can't believe we get to be here for this big life milestone of yours!
target: 这么说这是你第一次吃冰淇淋了? 哗! 真不敢相信我们居然能在这里 为你们这个伟大的人生里程碑而战!

source: Yes, and I'm glad you're here, Scott. I'll need some guidance in losing my ice cream virginity.
target: 是的,我很高兴你在这里, 斯科特. 我需要一些指导 来失去我的冰淇淋处女。

source: Can do, bro. Just put your lips on the ice cream and go to town!
target: 我们能行的,兄弟。 把嘴唇放上冰激凌,去镇上!

source: Goodness me, this is fantastic! How have I never experienced this creamy delicacy before?!
target: 天啊,这太棒了! 我怎么从来没有经历过这种 奶油味的美味?

source: Just goes to show the magic that can happen when you step out of your comfort zone, boo.
target: 刚刚去展示的魔法 当你走出你的舒适区,嘘。

source: ...Uh, Miri, you know we have spoons, right? You don't have to plunge your face into the ice cream like a pig eating from a hay trough.
target: 蜜莉,你知道我们有勺子吧? 你不必像猪一样从干草槽里吃入冰激凌里去.

source: MMMPHH HRHOGH SDFKRISKK!!!
target: 玛克·哈克·史德克克!

source: The good news that is Miranda loves the ice cream, and the better news is that she can't babble with her mouth full. Sweet!
target: 好消息是,我们 米兰达 喜欢吃冰淇淋,更好的消息是她不能满口胡言乱语. 可爱!

source: You bask in the peace you've achieved by distracting Miranda and gain +N2 MIND! But by sacrificing your ice cream, you also sacrificed -N2 STAMINA.
target: 你通过分散注意力 来和平地呼唤 米兰达 并获得 +N2 MIND ! 但是牺牲了你的冰淇淋,你还牺牲了 -N2 Stamina。

source: An assignment? Brilliant! Father says a good monarch must be intelligent, in order to outwit their enemies and produce the thing known as "propaganda".
target: 任务? 厉害! 父亲说好君主必须聪明,才能战胜敌人并产生出被称作"宣传"的东西.

source: Well, if Miranda wants to be more intelligent, you sarcastically suggest she write up an essay on the importance of driving safety.
target: 如果... ... . . . . 米兰达 想要更聪明一点 你讽刺地暗示她写了一篇关于驾驶安全重要性的论文

source: Perfect, a topic I have no expertise on! I'll learn a lot and make you proud, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 好极了,我对这个话题没有经验! 我会学到很多,让你骄傲, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: And she does make you proud, at least in the fact that she's so busy writing you get a moment of peace and +N2 MIND as you drive.
target: 她确实让你骄傲 至少她忙于写作 让你在开车时得到一阵平静和+N2MIND

source: Looks like we're getting close to our next stop. Miri, ready to read us your essay?
target: 看来我们接近下一站了 米莉,准备好读你的论文了吗?

source: Sure! This is "The Majestic Metal Chariot: Driving Safely and In Style" by Princess Miranda Vanderbilt.
target: 当然! 这是公主的"磁铁战车:安全驾驶和有风格" 米兰达 范德宝.

source: "Driving safely is very very important, especially when carrying precious cargo such as a princess. You don't want her to get hurt!"
target: "安全驾驶是非常重要的,特别是在携带公主等贵重货物时. 你不想让她受到伤害!"

source: "That's why the first rule of driving safety is to disable all airbags, so in the event of a crash, no painful bag will deploy and bruise the princess' beautiful face."
target: "这就是为什么驾驶安全的第一个规则是使所有气囊都失效,所以在坠毁时,没有痛苦的气袋会部署并打伤公主美丽的相貌".

source: "The second rule is to remove all seatbelts. They're not even real belts! What pants do they hold? Do not be deceived by their confusing name."
target: "第二道是去掉所有的安全带. 他们甚至不是真正的皮带! 他们拿的是什么裤子? 不要被他们混淆的名字所欺骗".

source: "The third rule is to always be aware of your surroundings. If any other cars cut you off, that is high treason!"
target: "第三条规则就是永远了解你的周围环境. 如果有其他车切断你,那就是叛国".

source: "In these cases, it's necessary to execute the offending driver. Feel free to crash into them at high speeds to ensure a swift and deserved death."
target: "在这些情况下,必须处决违法的驾驶员. 自由地以高速撞上它们,以确保迅速而活该地死亡".

source: Well, how'd I do? Do I get an A?
target: 我怎么样? 我能得到A吗?

source: Uh... how about an A for effort?
target: 额... 努力来个A怎么样?

source: Really? Wow! I've never put "effort" into anything before. How exotic!
target: 真的吗? 哗! 我从来没有把 "努力" 之前的任何。 多么异国情调!

source: You and Polly share a look that says "holy shit someone needs to teach Miranda actual driving safety."
target: 你和 波莉 分享一个表情,上面写着:"有人需要教的狗屎" 米兰达 真正的驾驶安全。"
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: At least your distraction worked! Even if giving Miri homework was a total -N2 HYPE solution.
target: 至少你的分心有效了! 即使给米里做功课是全N2 HYPE的解决方案.

source: You, Scott, Polly, and Valerie are driving along when your car is suddenly enveloped in a dense fog.
target: 你,你是谁? 斯科特, 波莉瓦莱丽开车时 你的车突然被浓雾所包裹

source: Whoa, I can't even see the road anymore! We should pull over.
target: 哇,我连路都看不到了! 我们该靠边停车了

source: Kay, but if y'all get killed in the spooky murder fog, let's vow to return to this spot every ten years to reminisce and haunt people.
target: Kay,但是如果你们在恐怖的谋杀雾中被杀死, 让我们发誓每十年回到这个地方来回忆和纠缠人们。

source: That's ridiculous... wait, actually, there IS a mysterious figure coming out of the fog. Time to die, you guess.
target: 这太荒谬了... 等等,实际上, 雾里出现了一个神秘的人物。 是时候死了,你猜。

source: But as they get closer, they don't look so scary. In fact, their golden armor, cloak of woven stars, and glowing meteorite sword are quite impressive!
target: 但随着他们越来越接近,他们看起来并不那么可怕. 事实上,他们的金盔甲,编织出星空的斗篷,发光出流星之剑,都相当令人印象深刻!

source: Hey, stranger. You've got some big protagonist energy. What's your story?
target: 嘿,陌生人,你好吗? 你有一些巨大的主角能量。 你的故事是什么? 说吧

source: My name is Sylveria Moonshard. I'm on a quest to dispel this endless cursed fog that's made my kingdom unlivable.
target: 我叫西尔维里亚·穆恩斯哈德 我正在寻找消除这无尽被诅咒的雾 使我的王国无法生存

source: Townsfolk can't see, so they can't work, or drive, or identify their loved ones from a distance...
target: 城镇居民看不见,所以他们不能工作,开车,或者从远处辨认出所爱的人......

source: Yeah, I bet it's pretty inconvenient to live somewhere where nobody can see five feet in front of their face.
target: 是啊,我敢打赌,它是非常不方便 住的地方,没有人能看到 在他们的脸前面的五英尺。

source: I've spent years training to fight the evil wizard who cursed us with this calamity. Tonight is the night I plan to end this once and for all.
target: 我花了多年时间训练 来对抗邪恶巫师 谁诅咒我们 这场灾难。 今晚是我计划永远结束这一切的夜晚

source: What are you strangers doing here? Is it coincidence that we meet on the eve of my greatest battle, or is it destiny?
target: 你们这些陌生人在这里干什么? 是在我最伟大的战斗前夕相会,还是命运?

source: Oh, it's destiny, all right. We're just the minor NPCs who can sell you an amazing magic item that'll aid you on your adventure!
target: 哦,这是命运,所有的权利。 我们只是小的NPC 谁可以卖出你 一个惊人的魔法物品, 这会帮助你的冒险!

source: Really? Thank you! You're doing my kingdom a great service, and I'll make sure you're known throughout the land as heroes and--
target: 真的吗? 谢谢! 你为我的王国做了伟大的服务, 我会确保你在整个国土上被称作英雄和 --

source: Yeah, sure, sounds great. You have money, right?
target: 是啊,当然,听起来不错。 你有钱,对吧?

source: Yes, I've amassed plenty of gold during my travels. I only hope you have an item that's worth my coin.
target: 是的,我旅行时已经积累了很多黄金 我只希望你有一个值得我钱的货

source: You fuckin' hope so too, because you're gonna have to raid the car for something Val can sell this adventurer. What do you grab?
target: 你他妈也希望如此 因为你得去抢车 找Val能卖掉这个冒险家的东西 你拿什么来?

source: "The last Prongle in the Can. It's the most valuable resource: it's accumulated the scents and essential oils of all the other Prongles that came before it."
target: "最后的普龙格在罐子。 其最有价值资源:已经积累了之前所到来的其他所有普龙格勒斯的气味和基本油".

source: "This sacred receptacle contains the ashes of legendary fallen warriors. Whenever you're in danger, blow on it to summon their spirits to fight alongside you."
target: "这个神圣的贮器中包含了传说中被击倒的战士所活活活的骨灰. 每当你身处险境时,就吹去召唤他们的魂魄与你并肩作战".

source: Yes! This incredible chip has all the salty, greasy goodness you'll need to fuel you during your boss fight or whatever!
target: 没错! 这不可思议的芯片有所有的咸油油油油的好味 在你老板打架的时候你需要给你加油!

source: Wow, the last Prongle... you're so lucky you get to taste it, Sylveria!
target: 哇,最后一个普龙格... 你这么幸运你得到它的味道,西尔维里亚!

source: I dreamt of eating it myself, but I understand I'm not worthy since my hand couldn't fit in the tube to grab it.
target: 我梦到自己吃它,但我明白,我并不值得,因为我的手不能装入管子里来抓它.

source: Stupid big, hairy hands!
target: 笨手笨脚的毛发!

source: It's okay, Scott. With the money this adventurer's gonna give us, we can buy you more Prongles.
target: 没关系 斯科特. 有了这个冒险家会给我们的钱 我们可以给你买更多的普龙格斯

source: Thanks, but they won't be the LAST Prongle...
target: 谢谢,但他们不会是最后的普龙格...

source: The last deep-fried potato slice in a long line of deep-fried slices... what a rich, magical delicacy.
target: 最后一片深炸薯片 长线深炸薯片... 多么富饶的神奇的美德

source: And to consume this "final Prongle" before my final battle must surely be fate. Here's your +N2 MONEY; thank you for selling me this prophesied snack.
target: 在我的最后战役之前 消耗这个"最终的普龙格" 肯定是命运 这是你的+N2 钱;谢谢你卖给我这个预言小吃。

source: Thank YOU for being gullible enough to buy it!
target: 谢谢你这么狡猾 竟然能买到它!

source: Sylveria eats the Prongle, taking your -N2 STAMINA with it.
target: 西尔维利亚吃普龙格, 带走你的-N2 STAMINA。

source: Well? How's it taste, bro? At this point, the closest I can come to eating the last Prongle is living vicariously through you!
target: 怎么样? 味道怎么样,兄弟? 此时此刻,我最接近吃到最后的普龙格 正在你身边过着充满反常的生活!

source: It's delicious! The immense power the final Prongle absorbed from its fallen brethren is coursing through my veins!
target: 好吃吗? 最终的普龙格从 死去的兄弟身上吸收的强大力量 正在我血管中凝固!

source: I feel stronger, tougher, faster... and like I wanna eat more Prongles!
target: 我感觉更强,更强,更快... 喜欢我吃更多的普龙格斯!

source: LOL, yup. Addictive snack chemicals are a bitch.
target: 刘尔,Yup。 添加性零食化学剂是一母狗。

source: Farewell, kind vendors! I must go to confront the wizard and liberate this land from the endless fog!
target: 再见,好卖家! 我必须去面对巫师 解放这片土地 摆脱无尽的雾霾!

source: Good luck, girl. I gotta find a bank that'll convert these gold coins into legal tender.
target: 祝你好运,女孩。 我得找个银行把这些金币 变成合法货币

source: And I'm on a mission to find a Prongles tube big enough to fit my hand. I hope all our quests align like this again someday!
target: 我的任务是找到一个大到适合我的手的 普龙格斯管。 我希望我们所有的探索 有一天会再次如此

source: Yeah, exactly! These are the comingled ashes of vikings, knights, kung-fu masters, demigods, and... other categories of great warriors.
target: 没错,没错! 这些是维京人,骑士,武术大师,神通的骨灰,还有... 其他种类的伟大战士。

source: And their spirits can be at your beck and call for the low price of +N2 MONEY.
target: 他们的灵气可以在你叫喊 要求低价+N2 货币。

source: Wow, that's such a steal! I'll be invincible with a spectral army to fight by my side. Thank you so much for selling this artifact to me!
target: 哇,这真是偷东西! 以一相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 谢谢你这么卖艺术品给我!

source: Thank YOU for being gullible enough to buy it!
target: 谢谢你这么狡猾 竟然能买到它!

source: You all part ways, and some hours later, Sylveria Moonshard has arrived at the evil wizard's tower.
target: 你们都分道扬镳,几小时后,西尔维里亚·穆恩斯哈德已经到达了邪恶巫师的塔.

source: They have their confrontation. The wizard does an evil monologue. He casts some spells; she swings her sword. It's a whole epic thing.
target: 他们有他们的对抗。 法师作恶相独白. 他施了咒语,她挥起剑来 整部史诗.

source: Sylveria is struggling. This wizard is too powerful for her to defeat alone! With bloodied hands, she takes out her receptacle of ashes and says...
target: 希尔维里亚在挣扎 这个巫师太强大了,她一个人打不赢! 她用血染的手取出她所储存的骨灰,说...

source: O great warrior spirits, please aid me in my time of need!
target: 伟大的战士们,请在我需要的时候帮助我!

source: She blows the ashes into the wizard's face! They get his beard all dirty and sting his eyes, but obviously, no warrior spirits appear.
target: 她把灰烬吹入巫师的脸上! 他们把他的胡子弄脏了并刺伤了眼睛 但很明显,没有战士的灵魂出现.

source: "ACHOO!" the wizard sneezes. "Why the hell are you carrying a cigarette ashtray around? Are you THAT desperate for a special move? Die already!"
target: "阿合!"巫师打喷嚏. "你为什么带着烟灰缸到处跑去? 你这么急于采取特殊的行动吗? 死吧,死吧!"

source: The last words of Sylveria Moonshard before she's exploded by magic echo throughout the kingdom...
target: 希尔维里亚·穆恩斯哈德在被整个王国的魔法回声所爆炸之前的最后一句话...

source: I GOT SO SCAAAAAMMED!
target: 我得到了如此的尖叫声!

source: So we tricked that adventurer girl into buying an ashtray? Isn't that sorta... not nice?
target: 所以我们骗了那个冒险家女孩 买烟灰缸? 有点... 不好吗?

source: Oh, yeah, it was a very mean thing to do. But money's money!
target: 哦,是的,这是非常坏的事情。 但钱是钱!

source: But what about the -N2 SOUL we lost?
target: 但是我们输了N2SOUL呢?

source: Eh, who cares? SOUL can't buy me a new phone.
target: 谁在乎呢? 苏勒不能给我买新手机

source: Well said, Val. Let's ride!
target: 说得好,瓦尔。 开动吧!

source: You're driving and having a nice conversation with Moss when you see a girl with her thumb up on the side of the road.
target: 你开车和莫斯聊天, 当你看到一个女孩 用她的拇指在路边。

source: Ooh, another hitchhiker! Pick her up, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 哦,又一个搭便车的! 把她捡起来, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: You pull over and let her in. "Thank you," she says softly. "Just drop me off two miles up ahead."
target: 你停车让她进来 "谢谢你" 她轻轻地说 "就把我从前面两英里的地方放下去"

source: Can do! My name's Moss Mann. I'm the senior hitchhiker around this car, so I'll show you the ropes.
target: 办得到! 我叫莫斯·曼 医生 我是这辆车上的高级搭便车者,所以我给你看绳子

source: Moss spiritedly lays out all the juiciest gossip for your hitchhiker. Halfway through the story of Scott's weird jacket stains, you pass a big cliffside curve.
target: 莫斯满腔胡言乱语 为你搭便车的人 故事经过一半 斯科特夹克的污点很怪 你穿过了个大崖边曲线

source: "Look at that...," says the hitchhiker. "I drove on this curve myself, not so long ago... when my car pitched over that curve, and I DIED."
target: "看那个" 那个搭便车的人说 "我开车在这条曲线上, 不久之前... 当我的车在弯道上倾斜时,我死了。"

source: Wow, really? It's super cool how open you are about your death. I died in a similar way!
target: 痷盾? 超酷的,你对死亡的开放。 我死的方式也一样!

source: "Wait, what?"
target: "等等,怎样?"

source: We're, like, ghost-sisters from another mister! If that mister was "Mister Car Accident."
target: 我们是鬼姐妹,从另一个先生! 如果那个先生是"车祸先生"的话

source: "Uh... sorry, this is just... weird. This isn't how I expected this conversation to go."
target: "U. 对不起,这只是... 怪怪的,我说,你... 这场对话不是这么预期的".

source: "Normally I just drop the 'I'm already dead' bomb, everyone freaks out, and I vanish into thin air. I don't really have a follow-up..."
target: "诺玛莉,我只是扔了 '我已经死了'炸弹, 每个人都吓坏了, 我消失在了稀薄的空气中。 我其实没有后续计划..."

source: Well, hey, the "vanishing hitchhiker" routine is a classic. I respect it. But in a car with fellow ghosts and cryptids, it doesn't quite pack the same punch.
target: 那种"偷搭便车"的习惯是经典的 我尊重你,我爱他 但是在一辆带着同道同道的鬼魂和地窖的汽车里,它并没有完全装入同样的一拳.

source: Lucky for you, I'm an expert in exaggerating the truth for clout, and %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% here is always choosing wacky options to escalate situations!
target: 幸运的是,我是一个专家 夸大真相 影响力, 和%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 在这里总是选择 疯狂的选择 升级的情况!

source: The two of us can surely come up with a great secondary twist to add to your spooky tale. Any ideas, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 我们两个肯定能想出一个伟大的第二曲折 来增加你的恐怖故事。 任何想法, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: "Good stories need conflict and a charismatic villain. The twist is the hitchhiker didn't die at the curve; she was MURDERED BY THE CURVE."
target: "好的故事需要冲突以及一个魅力十足的恶棍. 扭轉是搭便车的人不是在曲线上死去;她被CURVE所迷惑".

source: "Include product placement in your urban legend."
target: "在你的都市传说中加入产品布置".

source: Ooh, I like it! Spooky nonsensical twists are integral to any good urban legend!
target: 哦,我喜欢! 任何城市传说中 都包含着无意识的扭曲

source: But it needs justification. WHY did the curve turn evil?
target: 但它需要解释。 曲线为什么变邪恶?

source: Maybe it was abandoned by its road-parents and it never got over it!
target: 也许它被路人抛弃了,却一直没被它克服!

source: MAYBE IT HAS A GUN!
target: 也许它有枪!

source: Sure! And now the curve is out for revenge, trying to find its road-parents and get back at everyone who drove all over it...
target: 当然! 现在曲线出来复仇,试图找到路人父母 回到所有开车过路的人身上...

source: And the curve is super mad at all the people who have nice parents, instead of its mean old crappy parents, so it kills them out of revenge!
target: 曲线对有好父母的人非常生气, 而不是它那卑鄙的老混蛋父母, 所以它为了复仇而杀死他们!

source: Yes! And just when all this intrigue you've built up reaches its zenith, you do the big reveal: THIS SHIT GETS IMMERSIVE!
target: 没错! 当你积累的这些阴谋 到达它的天花板, 你做大揭幕: 这狗屎得到的 IMMERSVE!

source: You're not just here to spook the driver who took you in. You're RECRUITING the driver, because this madness ends today!
target: 你来这不仅仅是要吓唬那个 收留你的司机 你正在催赶司机,因为今天结束了疯狂!

source: AND YOU HAVE A GUN! AND YOU GIVE THE DRIVER A GUN! GIVE EVERYBODY GUNS!!!
target: 你还有枪! 你给司机一把枪! 给大家枪!

source: Yes! This is THE SEQUEL: THE VANISHING HITCHHIKER TAKES REVENGE ON THE EVIL CURVE WITH A GUN.
target: 没错! 这是性爱: 妓女用枪在地狱里找回。

source: "Well, that's... complete nonsense," the ghost girl says. "But it'll definitely shake up my stale routine, so thanks, I guess!"
target: "[此是. 鬼女说,"完全胡说八道" "但那肯定会震撼我的老套,所以谢谢,我想!"

source: No problem! Helping fellow cryptids grow their legends and freak people out is my passion!
target: 没问题! 帮助那些密码学家们成长他们的传说 吓唬别人是我的激情!

source: You lost -N2 MIND trying to understand all those disconnected twists, but gained +N2 HYPE from the exciting tale you've created!
target: 你失去了N2 MIND 试图理解所有这些断开的曲折, 但从你创造的令人兴奋的故事中获得了+N2 HYPE!

source: Say, there's an idea! Urban legends are pretty much the last bastion that brands have yet to conquer. I'll make some calls.
target: 说,有一个想法! 城市传说几乎是品牌尚未征服的最后堡垒. 我会打几个电话

source: Some phone calls later...
target: 稍后会打几个电话...

source: Okay, I've got a retailer onboard! Here's your new story:
target: 好吧,我有一个零售商在船上! 这是你的新故事:

source: You were driving on a dark and stormy night, when suddenly, an empty bag of Vampire Bites was blown onto your windshield.
target: 你开车在一个黑暗而暴风雨的夜晚, 当突然, 一个空袋吸血鬼比斯被吹到你的挡风玻璃上。

source: You were about to wipe it off, but then you started reading the back of the bag.
target: 你本来打算把它擦掉的,但你开始读背包。

source: You couldn't believe that Vampire Bites are almost 100% organic, or that they now come in over twenty different flavors!
target: 你无法相信吸血鬼比特人几乎100%有机, 或者他们现在有20种不同的口味!

source: You were so busy reading that the curve snuck up on you, and you pitched over the edge!
target: 你忙着看,弯道就溜到你身上,你跑到边缘去了!

source: You lay dying at the bottom of the ravine, and as your chest collapsed and your vision went dark, your last thought was...
target: 你躺在沟谷底地上死去, 当你的胸口倒塌,你的视力变暗,你最后的念头是...

source: "What flavor Vampire Bites would I have purchased? Flaming Hot? Cheddar and Pickles? Lentil Soup?"
target: "我买什么吸血鬼比斯口味?" 火热? 切达和皮克? 兰蒂尔汤?"

source: Then, while your listeners are reveling in this story, you vanish, leaving mystery in your wake... and a 20% off coupon for a bag of Vampire Bites!
target: 之后,当你们的听众在故事中充满欢快的时候, 你们消失了, 留下了神秘的记忆... 和20%的优惠券 给一袋吸血鬼比特斯!

source: "Well, it's a bit of a shameless shill...," says the hitchhiker, "but if they're paying me to tell it like that, I don't care!"
target: "嗯,这是有点无耻的 shill..." 搭便车的人说,"但是如果他们付钱让我这样说,我不在乎!"

source: The ghost girl leaves, and you're left with that nonsensical urban-legend-turned-commercial robbing you of -N2 MIND.
target: 鬼女走了,你离开了 与那个不敏感 城市-地端- 转-商业抢劫你 - N2 MIND。

source: But with the sponsorship money she's making now, the ghost girl kicks you all +N2 MONEY in "creative consultancy fees", so that's cool!
target: 但是现在有了她赚的赞助金,鬼女把你们都踢了+N2 MOYY 的"创意咨询费",所以这很酷!

source: Tch, who cares about money? I'm in the cryptid rumor game for the sheer love of the craft!
target: 钱谁在乎? 我之所以在密码传闻游戏中 就是为了那只手的爱!

source: Not me; I'm definitely in it for the money. Let's spend it on something dumb!
target: 不是我,我绝对是为了钱 让我们花在愚蠢的东西上!

source: Zoe's been silently scrolling on her phone for the last several miles, but suddenly, she gasps.
target: 佐伊她的电话一直无声地滚动 数英里,但突然,她喘了口气。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%! STOP THE CAR!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%! 停车!

source: Okay... you pull over in the middle of the desert. Zoe jumps out of the car and starts walking in a random direction.
target: 好吧,我说... 你停在沙漠的中间。  佐伊 跳出车去,开始向一随机方向行走.

source: Sorry, I should explain. In 1983, the company Tatari developed a video game based on the movie "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray".
target: 对不起,我应该解释一下。 1983年,Tatari公司以电影"银河猫是一款银河街"为蓝本,开发出一款以"银河街"为蓝本的电子游戏.

source: You mean the movie about a cat from outer space who gets lost on Earth and befriends a plucky band of monster kids who help him return home?
target: 你是说一部关于一只从外太空来的猫的电影吗? 那只猫迷了路,结交了一群怪物小孩, 帮助他回家?

source: That's the one.
target: 即取一一为一.

source: I love that movie! I bet the game was an awesome tribute to my beloved childhood film!
target: 我喜欢那部电影! 我打赌这场比赛是对我爱的童年电影的赞美!

source: Eh... no. "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray: The Game" was actually total ass.
target: 额... 没有。 "银河猫是银河怪兽:游戏"其实是总屁股.

source: Good to know, but none of that explains why I'm walking aimlessly into the desert and getting sand in my new shoes.
target: 很高兴知道,但没有任何一个解释 为什么我走无目的地 走入沙漠 和得到沙在我的新鞋子。

source: Well, internet-legend has it that the game's reception was so bad, Tatari buried a bunch of the cartridges in the desert just to get rid of them.
target: 网路上说游戏的接收非常糟糕 塔特利为了摆脱它们 将一帮子弹埋入沙漠

source: I NEED a copy of GCiaGS:TG. It's a retro game collector's wet dream!
target: 我需要一份GCiaGS:TG的拷贝。 复古游戏收藏家的"湿梦"!.

source: The internet doesn't have exact coordinates, but if the buried cartridges are real, they're somewhere around this spot. Can you guys pleeeeease help me find them?
target: 互联网上没有精确的坐标 但如果被埋的子弹是真的 它们在附近 你们能帮我找到他们吗?

source: Sure, I'll help... meaning I'll make %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% do all the hard work while I sit back and take most of the credit.
target: 当然,我会帮... 意思是我会让%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 做所有艰苦的工作,而我坐着,并接受大部分的功劳。

source: Business as usual, then. Help Zoe find the burial site of these shitty retro games!
target: 照常办事 帮助 佐伊 找到这些烂游戏的埋葬地!

source: Teach a dog video games so it becomes very good at sniffing them out. GAMER DOG!
target: 教狗电玩,这样它就很能嗅出它们 游戏游戏狗!

source: Water this area of the desert with a potent energy drink, the best fertilizer for video games. The buried games will blossom right out of the ground!
target: 给沙漠的这片区域注入强大的能量饮料 最好的电子游戏肥料 埋藏的游戏会从地上开花的

source: Hmmm... training a dog to be a professional gamer... that could honestly be my true calling!
target: 那个... 训练一只狗成为职业游戏家... 这可以是我的真命天子

source: Zoe adopts a dog off Gregslist. It's got floppy ears, a wagging tail, and hopefully some video game prowess!
target: 佐伊 收养一条狗 从格雷格名单。 耳朵软,尾巴有皱纹 有希望能有电子游戏的优点!

source: Thus commences a training montage. Zoe does paw-eye coordination exercises with the dog, shows it Twatch streams, and feeds it lots of Doratos and Hill Dew...
target: 由此开始训练蒙太奇。  佐伊 和狗一起进行爪眼协调练习 展示它Twatch溪流 并喂它很多多拉多斯和丘地...

source: But none of it works. Shockingly, dogs aren't naturally good at video games, and you lose -N2 MIND trying to teach it.
target: 但都没用的 令人吃惊的是,狗自然地不擅长电子游戏,你失去了N2 MIND试图教它。

source: Dang. I guess you can't teach an old dog new tricks... and you can't teach a new dog old games, either.
target: 该死 我猜你不能再教老狗新把戏了 也不能教新狗玩老游戏

source: Wait! What's the dog digging up over there?
target: 单单! 那边的狗在挖什么?

source: Holy crap... IT DUG UP GALAXY CAT IS A GALAXY STRAY: THE GAME! It must've learned something after all!
target: 神圣的废话... 游戏! 肯定有学过的东西

source: WAIT! STOP, DOG! DON'T EAT THE CARTRIDGE!
target: 等会儿! Wait! 停下来,狗! 别吃这些饼干!

source: Okay, the dog might not have learned THAT much, but at least Zoe got her game! You all boot it up and play a bit.
target: 好吧,狗也许没有学到多少,但至少 佐伊 得到了她的游戏! 你们都把它踢出场来玩一玩

source: Wow, this game's even worse than I thought. Fuck it, let's give it to the dog.
target: 哇,这游戏比我想象的还要糟糕。 去他的,我们把它给狗。

source: Can I get one to chew on too?
target: 也可以给我一个吗?

source: Of course, buddy. Here, fetch!
target: 当然,伙计。 来,拿来!

source: At least you met a cute dog and crossed that off Zoe's geeky bucket list. Take +N2 HYPE!
target: 至少你遇到一只可爱的狗 把它划了下来 佐伊怪胎桶单。 带+N2 HYPE!

source: Good idea!
target: 不错的主意!

source: IS it a good idea? 'Cause it kinda sounds like a dumb idea.
target: 好主意吗? 因为这听起来有点像一个愚蠢的想法。

source: Well, it's no idea at all until we give it a shot.
target: 我们试一下才知道

source: You spend -N2 STAMINA worth of "Human Energy Ultra", the hottest energy drink on the market.
target: 你花N2STAMINA值"人类能源超强",是市场上最热的能喝.

source: You water a large swath of desert with it. If the cartridge cache is somewhere around here, this'll surely fertilize it!
target: 你用它给一大片沙漠浇水 如果子弹藏在这里,这肯定能受精!

source: So... now what? We just sit here, watching games grow?
target: 所以说... 现在怎么办? 我们只是坐在这里,看游戏成长?

source: Wait, do you guys smell... burnt pixels and abused nostalgia?
target: 等等 你们闻到... 烧了像素 虐待了怀旧?

source: It's the cartridges! They're sprouting on wirey vines out of the ground!
target: 是弹匣! 它们从地上喷出有线藤子!

source: Whoa. "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray: The Game" looks a lot more modern than I expected.
target: 呜呼. "银河猫是银河史特莱:游戏"看起来比我想象的更现代.

source: Oh no. The energy drink is accelerating up the shitty 80s games' growth so fast, they're mutating into their own shittier 90s and 00s remakes!
target: 哦,没有。 能量饮料加速了80年代游戏的成长 快速地,它们变了 自己狗屎90和00年代的再制造!

source: You watch the cartridges become CDs, then microchips, then redeemable codes for a fast-paced FPS with lootboxes and pay-to-win mechanics.
target: 看着弹匣变成CD,然后是微芯片, 然后是快速的FPS的可赎回代码, 上面有抢掠箱和付酬的机械师。

source: Bros, what do we do?!
target: 兄弟们,我们该怎么办?

source: We could... bail?
target: 我们可以... 保释?

source: NOT WITHOUT MY GAME! I see one more cartridge on the vine. Let's grab it and run!
target: 没有我的游戏! 我看见藤上还有一发子弹 抓住它,跑起来!

source: You grab it and run before you have to witness "Galaxy Cat is a Galaxy Stray: VR, now with NFTs". At least you gained +N2 HYPE finding the game!
target: 在你必须见证"银河猫是银河系的:VR,现在与NFTs"之前,你抓住它并跑. 至少你得到了+N2 HYPE 找到游戏!

source: Scott is in the driver's seat while you, Polly, and Aaravi chat about stuff and things.
target: 斯科特 坐在驾驶座上,而你, 波莉,以及 阿拉薇 聊东西和事情。

source: I gotta say, gurl, I didn't expect you to wanna hitchhike with us. I sorta thought you'd try to kill one of us by now.
target: 我不得不说,Gurl,我没想到你会想搭便车 我有点以为你现在会杀了我们中的一个

source: Whoa, that was a big bump! Did I hit something?
target: 哇,那是一个大颠倒! 我撞到什么东西了吗?

source: Nah, that'd be rude. I'm a guest here. I can find other monsters to slay when I'm back on an adventure.
target: 不,那太无礼了。 我是这里的客人 我回来冒险时,可以找到其他怪物来杀死他.

source: What do you mean, BACK on an adventure? This road trip IS an adventure, baby! I can't wait for all the action-packed hijinks you're gonna bring us along on!
target: 回到冒险中是什么意思? 这场出行是冒险 宝贝 我等不及要带我们一起走的 装满了手提袋的海怪了

source: Uhh, bros, I'm having trouble moving forward...
target: 兄弟们 我前进有困难...

source: What? But I didn't really plan on going on an adventure right now... I thought this was more like a vacation.
target: 什麽? 但我现在并没有打算去冒险... 我以为这更像是个假期

source: Okay, I can't get the car to budge at all. I think we're stuck in mud or something.
target: 好吧,我根本没法让车动了 我想我们被困在泥地里了

source: Ugh, great. Do we need to get out and push?
target: 不错 我们是不是需要出去推?

source: No, I don't think that'll work. It feels like we're sinking.
target: 不,我不认为会工作。 感觉我们好像在下沉

source: Sinking? The hell?
target: 沉着? 地狱?

source: Yup, look at that. It looks like the car's sinking into some kind of... quickasphalt? That's a new one.
target: 对,你看 看起来这辆车正在沉入某种... 快速的asphalt吗? 曰新来.

source: Oh... are we gonna die?
target: 哦... 我们是不是要死了?

source: No way! Quickasphalt is no match for adventuring badass Aaravi Mishra! What's the plan, boo?
target: 不会吧! 快速的asphalt 不适合冒险的坏蛋 阿拉薇 弥沙! 有什么计划,布?

source: What?! I dunno! I wasn't expecting to be put on the spot like this! I didn't even have time to look up a walkthrough!
target: 你说什么? 我不知道! 说不定是... 我没想到会这样被摆到现场! 我甚至没有时间找一个行走!

source: Oh, oof... does anybody have a plan B before we drown in asphalt, then?
target: 哦,这... 有没有人有B计划 在我们被沥青淹没之前?

source: There's always an entity to invoke in every situation. The best one to summon for asphalt-based enemies would be... Virginia, the West Goddess of country roads.
target: 每一情况都总有实体可以援引. 最好的一个召唤 的以沥青为主的敌人是... 弗吉尼亚,乡村道路的西女神

source: Reset reality and start again from last checkpoint to avoid the quickasphalt this time.
target: 重置现实,从最后的检查站重新开始,以避免这次的快速被吸。

source: Yeah, an invocation would work! We just gotta nail the summoning chant!
target: 是啊,引用会有用! 我们只要把召唤口号钉好!

source: COUNTRY ROADS, TAKE ME HOME...
target: 国家ROADS,带我回家...

source: TO THE PLACE I BELONG...
target: 到了我所相信的地方... ...

source: WEST VIRGINIA, MOUNTAIN MOMMA...
target: 韦斯特·维吉尼亚,摩马山...

source: TAKE ME HOME, COUNTRY ROADS!
target: 带我回家,国家roaDS!

source: You repeat the chant ad nauseam, your car and your -N2 MAGIC sinking lower and lower...
target: 你重复了口号 恶心,你的车和你的N2MAGIC 沉入低沉...

source: Until finally, with a blast of warm sunshine, peach cobbler, and Southern hospitality, Virginia the West Goddess appears!
target: 直到最后,随着温暖的阳光,桃子馅饼和南方的好客的出击,维吉尼亚出现了"西女神"!

source: "Well, bless your hearts!" Virginia says. "How did y'all get stuck in that quickasphalt? Ain't you seen it comin' from a mile away?"
target: "哦,祝福你的心!" 弗吉尼亚说。 "你们怎么被困在那个快速吸尘器里了? 你没看见它从一英里外飞来吗?"

source: Ugh, I let my guard down for one second... can you please just get us out of here, ma'am?
target: 我放松了警惕一下 一会儿... 请你让我们离开这里,夫人?

source: "I'm fixin' to! Y'know, this wouldn't've happened back in the day. We didn't have asphalt; just old, reliable dirt roads, and friends walkin' on 'em..."
target: "我正在准备! 你知道,这不会 发生在以前。 我们没有沥青,只有老而可靠的泥土路,朋友走在'时间上'......

source: "Walkin' among homes, where the buffalo roamed, and the deer and the antelope would play..."
target: "在家中走去,野牛漫游的地方,而鹿和羚羊会玩"

source: "But listen to me gabbin' on. I could talk 'til the cows come home! Let me fix you up right quick."
target: "但听我说" 我可以说到牛回家为止! 让我马上把你治好。"

source: Virginia touches the quickasphalt. It transforms into a bunch of dandelion seeds and blows away on a sweet westerly wind, allowing you to drive through!
target: 弗吉尼亚碰了快活的 它变成一串丹德利翁种子 吹去甜蜜的西风,让你开车通过!

source: YAASSS, we made it! That got my fuckin' blood pumping! What's our next quest, Aaravi?
target: 亚西斯,我们成功了! 这让我的血流成河! 我们接下来的探索是什么? 阿拉薇?

source: Ugh, THIS is why I need a vacation...
target: 呃,这就是为什么我需要休假...

source: Aaravi can be sour if she wants, but you had fun! You gain +N2 HYPE from your taste of true adventure.
target: 阿拉薇 她想吃就吃酸 但你玩得很开心 你从你真正的冒险品味中获得了+N2 HYPE.

source: What do you mean? How do you "reset reality"?
target: 你说什么? 你怎么"重现现实"?

source: You've never done it? It's easy. Watch this.
target: 你从没做过吗? 易为相. 看看这个

source: And we're back!
target: 我们回来了!

source: WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!
target: 刚刚发生了什么?

source: I reloaded my last save before we drove into the quickasphalt, duh.
target: 我重新装入了最后的一分钱 在我们开车进入快速吸尘器之前

source: But what does it mean to "reload a save"? How do you do it? What are the consequences of resetting reality?
target: 但"重装一分"是什么意思? 如何是道. 师曰. 重现现实的后果是什么?

source: It's -- wait, did we just hit a bump?
target: 等等,我们撞到撞了么?

source: Oops, sorry, I think I drove into the quickasphalt again. I was kinda distracted by you shattering my worldview.
target: 抱歉,我又开车进了速死站 你打破了我的世界观,我有点分心了

source: Dammit. Guess we're doing this once more, with feeling...
target: 该死 估计我们又在做这个了 感觉...

source: WAIT, DON'T--!
target: 等等 别...

source: Now, let's not fuck around this time. If I keep resetting reality over and over, something's gonna glitch.
target: 今次别乱来 如果我不断重现现实, 事情会出错的。

source: BUT HOW ARE YOU DOING IT?! Is it a meta thing? Are we rewriting timelines? Am I even the original Polly?!
target: 但你怎么做到的吗? 是元的吗? 我们是否要改写时间表? 我甚至连原创 波莉?!

source: Look, me resetting reality is just something you need to accept so that we don't keep accidentally driving into certain doom!
target: 听着,我重塑现实只是你需要接受的 以免我们不小心被逼入某种厄运!

source: Let's just drive around the quickasphalt and never bring this up ever again, okay?
target: 我们开车绕过快速的垃圾桶 永远不要提起这个 好吗?

source: But--
target: 但是... 说吧...

source: I SAID NEVER BRING IT UP AGAIN!
target: 我说再也不要拿了!

source: And you never do! You lose -N2 MIND, but after a cooling-off period, you're once again blissfully ignorant of the artificial reality you inhabit.
target: 你从不这样做! 你失去了N2 MIND, 但是经过一个冷却期, 你再次幸福地无知 你所居住的人工现实。

source: You even gain +N2 HYPE from what was surely nothing more than another silly road trip misadventure. Yippee!
target: 你甚至从另一个愚蠢的冒险中 得到+N2 HYPE。 万岁!

source: You're riding along when you pass a broken-down school bus. You can barely get a word out before Joy's jumping out to investigate.
target: 你一通过破校车就跟着走 在乔伊跳出调查前 你几乎不能说出去

source: The bus is filled with about twenty children and a redheaded woman in the driver's seat. Joy addresses the driver.
target: 公交车上装满了大约20个孩子和一个坐在驾驶座上被红发女郎. 乔伊在司机面前讲话

source: Oh my Goddess... um, hi, I'm sorry to intrude, but... are you Miss Fizzle? THE Miss Fizzle?
target: 哦,我的女神... ... . . . . . 打扰一下,但... . . . . 你是菲兹尔小姐吗? 菲兹尔小姐?

source: Yup. I'm Violet Fizzle, the one and only.
target: 对 我是紫罗兰·菲兹尔,唯一一个

source: Wow! It's such an honor to meet you! I grew up watching your TV show!
target: 哗! 见到你真是荣幸! 我长大了,看你的电视节目!

source: Oh, I watched that show too. "The Mythic School Bus", right? With the teacher who travels through space and time to teach her students lessons?
target: 哦,我也看那个节目。 "神话学校巴士",对不对? 和那个穿越了空间和时间的老师一起教她的学生吗?

source: Yup! Miss Fizzle did a lot, not the least of which continuing the tradition of powerful witches having their own TV shows.
target: 没错! 菲兹尔小姐做了很多事情,其中不乏延续了强大的女巫拥有自己的电视节目的传统.

source: Miss Fizzle, I can't overstate how much you inspired me as a young witch. I'd be honored to help you fix the Mythic School Bus.
target: 菲兹尔小姐,我不能夸大你给我的灵感 作为一个年轻的女巫。 我很荣幸能帮你修修神学院的校车

source: Fix it? It's not broken. I just pulled over to calm down, 'cause these kids are driving me nuts!
target: 修好了吗? 未有相断. 我只是停下来冷静下来, '因为这些孩子让我发疯!

source: Oh... is everything okay?
target: 哦... 一切都还好吗?

source: No! I can't take these brats anymore! Always doing internet dances during class, or filming pranks for YooToob, or whining about the bus not having WiFi...
target: 没有! 我再也受不了这些小屁孩了! 总是在上课时做网络舞蹈,或者为YooToob拍恶作剧,或者抱怨巴士没有WiFi...

source: And the parents are even worse! I've taken these kids to space THREE TIMES, and Freddie's dad STILL convinces him the Earth is flat!
target: 父母更惨! 我带这些孩子去太空了 弗雷迪的爸爸仍然说服他地球是平地的!

source: None of the kids give a damn about my field trips, and with this shit teacher's salary, I can barely afford the magic to get them there!
target: 孩子们都不在乎我的野外旅行 凭着这该死的老师的工资 我几乎买不起魔法让他们去那儿!

source: Seems like you need an assist. I bet my friends and I could take the kids on a fun, magical field trip and teach them a life lesson. It'd give you a break!
target: 看来你需要帮助 我敢打赌,我的朋友和我可以带孩子们 玩一个有趣的,神奇的野外旅行, 并教他们一个生活教训。 让你休息一下!

source: Scott, while my inner child is loving the suggestion, I don't think Miss Fizzle will hand over the care of her students to total strangers...
target: 斯科特虽然我的内在孩子喜欢这个建议 但我不认为菲兹尔小姐会把学生的照顾 交给陌生人...

source: Are you kidding? Take the brats; I don't give a shit. You got a field trip in mind?
target: 你在开玩笑吗? 带上那些小鬼 我才不管呢 你考虑过实地考察吗?

source: "A lesson in history! Let's go to England in the XIXth Century so these kids can learn fuckin' manners."
target: "历史教训! 让我们去十九世纪的英国 这样这些孩子就可以学会他妈的礼仪了。”

source: "A lesson in empathy! Let's travel into the inside of Miss Fizzle's brain so the students get to really understand how miserable they're making her."
target: "同情心的教训! 让我们进入菲兹尔小姐的大脑内部 这样学生们就能真正理解 他们让她变得多么悲惨了。”

source: You shift the bus into reverse and drive backwards through time to XIXth Century England!
target: 你把巴士换到倒车 开车经过十九世纪的英格兰

source: You force the students to attend a finishing school with a no-nonsense Victorian schoolmaster to whip them into shape.
target: 你强迫学生去一所毕业学校 由维多利亚州无意识的校长来鞭打他们

source: "Pay attention, children!" says the teacher. "You must be educated and obedient if you want to marry out of your stations and become rich one day!"
target: "孩子们,请大家注意!" 老师说: "如果你想从自己的站台结婚,有一天变得富有,就必须受过教育,服从!"

source: "Pfft, sounds lame!" says Freddie. "I don't gotta get married to be rich. I'm gonna go viral on Tock-Tock and be an internet celebrity!"
target: "Pfft,听起来很逊" 弗雷迪说. "我不必结婚才能发财" 我要在Tock -Tock上做个网络名人!"

source: "What is an... 'internet celebrity'?" asks the teacher. "Is it a noble title of some sort?"
target: "什么是... ... ...... ...... "网友名人""问老师. "这是什么高尚的头衔?"

source: No. It's a job, sort of. You have to get really lucky to earn money doing it, but--
target: 没有。 算是工作吧 有点像工作 你一定要很幸运 挣钱做,但 --

source: "Wait, so these children are still ASPIRING to work? Why are they not working yet?! They're already nine years old!"
target: "等等,所以这些孩子仍然希望工作? 他们怎么还没工作呢? 他们已经九岁了!"

source: "NUH-UH! I'm ten-and-a-half!" Freddie whines.
target: "NUH -UH!" 我十岁半了!" 弗雷迪在抱怨.

source: "Well, this won't do at all! You children should be working in the mines, or as metalcraft apprentices! Come along, it's time to teach you kids hard labor!"
target: "这根本没用! 你们这些孩子应该去矿山工作, 或者做金属工学徒! 来,是时候教你们这些苦力活了!"

source: Uh... is this okay?
target: 额... 这样行吗?

source: No, it's not. Miss Fizzle, shouldn't we put a stop to this?
target: 不,不是的,我说,我... 菲兹尔小姐,我们不该停止吗?

source: Nah, they'll be fine. The brats are always going on about mining and crafting anyway. This is probably a dream situation for them.
target: 不,他们会没事的。 臭小子总是在搞采矿和作弄 这可能是他们的梦境

source: Well... lots of shows go downhill if they run for too long. Looks like "The Mythic School Bus" is no exception.
target: 这个... 演出如果跑得太久 就会下山去 外观"神话学校公交"也不例外.

source: The kids return from their field trip after their eighteen-hour shifts. You're unsure if they learned anything, but you'd rather just leave this adventure and never look back.
target: 孩子们在18小时轮班后从外出旅行回来. 你不确定他们是否学到了什么 但你宁愿离开这次冒险 永远不要回头

source: You also lost -N2 MAGIC time-traveling, but at least you gained +N2 MIND learning so much, like how much the past sucked.
target: 你同样失去了 -N2 MAGIC 时间旅行, 但至少你得到了 +N2 MIND 学习这么多, 就像过去有多糟糕。

source: You want to drive the bus into Miss Fizzle's brain? What's that gonna teach the kids, besides how to induce a stroke?
target: 你想开公交车去菲兹尔小姐的大脑吗? 除了如何诱发中风之外,那还能教孩子们什么?

source: OMG. These old men must be the oracle! They're three wise seers who can answer our questions about the future!
target: 欧麦可。 这些老人一定是神谕! 他们三个聪明的见者,能回答我们对未来的问题!

source: What? No. As a real seer, I'm offended; and as a practitioner of common sense, I'm SUPER offended. These guys aren't oracles at all!
target: 什麽? 没有。 作为一个真正的观察者,我感到很生气;作为一个常识的实践者,我感到很生气。 这些人根本不是神谕!

source: We'll see about that! O wise old dudes: are you seers who will answer any three questions we ask?
target: 等着瞧吧! 智者们:你们这些见识者,会回答我们提出的三个问题吗?

source: No.
target: 没有。

source: Ah, seers, always speaking in riddles!
target: 啊,见鬼,总是用谜语说话!

source: Shit, I just wasted one of our questions! We only have two more. Scott, you ask one!
target: 妈的,我浪费了我们的问题之一! 我们只有两只了  斯科特你问一个!

source: Hmm, okay... hey, seer bros, will there still be math in the future?
target: 嗯,好吧... ... 说吧,我... 嘿,见识的弟兄们,将来还会有数学吗?

source: Probably.
target: 也许吧。

source: Aw, nuts.
target: 胡说八道

source: Well, since Hope is a "skeptical Sally", that means you get to ask the third question, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 既然"希望"是"怀疑的莎莉" 也就是说你可以问第三个问题 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: Ask the oracle to look into a future they can surely see: ask what it will be like to be an old person.
target: 问神谕,看看他们肯定能看见的未来:问一个老人会是什么样子。

source: Seek the Oracle's Endless Knowledge: ask how many people fit in the tub.
target: 求神道无尽知识:问浴缸里能容出多少人.

source: That isn't even fortune-telling. That's just sharing an experience that happens to be placed in YOUR future. There's no MAGIC involved!
target: 这甚至不是算命。 分享你未来的经验 也没有涉及MAGIC!

source: Ohhh, then that's what they must be missing! I'll get them some MAGIC from the car so they can use their powers!
target: 哦,那他们一定是错过了! 我会从车里给他们拿些磁性磁共振 让他们能用上他们的力量

source: Scott pours -N2 MAGIC into the tub. If it wasn't weird enough that monsters use magic to power their cars, it apparently also doubles as bath salts!
target: 斯科特 倒入-N2 MAGIC入浴缸. 如果怪物用魔法来给汽车提供动力还不够奇怪,显然它也作为浴盐而双倍地存在!

source: Thanks, sonny, that was kind of you. What were you askin' about again? What's it like to be old?
target: 谢谢,小子,你真好心 你又问了些什么? 年出岁出,何所相会?

source: Well... your back hurts... and your joints hurt... and your knee hurts... whenever it rains... and also just in general...
target: 这个... 你的背好痛... ... . . . . 关节也受伤了... 膝盖会痛... 每当下雨... 并且,从一般的...

source: AND EVERYONE AROUND YOU STARTS TALKING QUIETER!
target: 每个人你开始谈论 Quieter!

source: There's also your loved ones dying, and the world you knew becoming "the past"...
target: 还有你所爱的人死去, 而你所知道的世界成为"过去"...

source: ...but there's good things too.
target: . 但也有好东西

source: Like outgrowing your shame, allowing you to do fun stuff like take a bath in the middle of nowhere with your best friends!
target: 就像让你的耻辱扩大 让你做一些有趣的事 比如在荒郊野外和你的好朋友洗澡

source: And salami. Getting to eat all the salami you want is a great part of being old.
target: 并作香草. 吃你想要的香肠 也是年老的伟大部分

source: Ooh, that's true! Everyone knows salami is a grown-up food!
target: 哦,这是真的! 大家都知道,沙拉米是成年人的食物!

source: Yep! And when you're old and retired, you can eat salami all day, every day! Even in the tub!
target: 没错! 且老而退休后,能吃一日一日,一日一日! 连浴缸里都一样!

source: Hey, I told you NOT to bring your salami into the tub! You'll get the water all greasy!
target: 嘿,我告诉过你不要把你的香肠放进浴缸里! 你会得到的水 油腻!

source: DID YOU SAY SALAMI?! PASS THAT SALAMI, WILBERT!
target: 你说萨拉米? 过萨拉米,维尔伯特!

source: See, Hope? I told you these seers were full of wisdom about the future!
target: 看到没,希望? 我告诉你,这些见者充满了对未来的智慧!

source: *sigh*...
target: *叹息*

source: Man, you can't wait to get old and take salami-baths! You gain +N2 MIND from the oracles' wisdom.
target: 男人,你等不及要老了 和吃香肠浴! 你从神谕的智慧中获得了+N2 MID.

source: That isn't even fortune-telling. That's just using logic to reach a plausible conclusion. There's no MAGIC involved!
target: 这甚至不是算命。 利用逻辑得出一个合理的结论 也没有涉及MAGIC!

source: Ohhh, then that's what they must be missing! I'll get them some MAGIC from the car so they can use their powers!
target: 哦,那他们一定是错过了! 我会从车里给他们拿些磁性磁共振 让他们能用上他们的力量

source: Scott pours -N2 MAGIC into the tub. If it wasn't weird enough that monsters use magic to power their cars, it apparently also doubles as bath salts!
target: 斯科特 倒入-N2 MAGIC入浴缸. 如果怪物用魔法来给汽车提供动力还不够奇怪,显然它也作为浴盐而双倍地存在!

source: Thanks, sonny, that was kind of you. What were you askin' about again? How many people can fit in here?
target: 谢谢,小子,你真好心 你又问了些什么? 这里能容纳多少人?

source: Well, in my long life, I've learned that the best answers are gained through experience. Let's find out how many it can fit together!
target: 在我漫长的生活中,我学会了最好的答案是通过经验获得的. 让我们看看它能合在一起多少个!

source: Ooh, group bath in the desert! I'm in!
target: 哦,在沙漠里集体洗澡! 我进去了!

source: You, Polly, and Scott change into swimwear and get into the tub.
target: 你,你是谁? 波莉,以及 斯科特 换上泳衣,然后去浴缸

source: Man, who would've thought bathing in the middle of nowhere could be so relaxing?
target: 谁会想到在荒野中洗澡会这么放松?

source: Yup! Life's full of simple pleasures like these. You learn to appreciate 'em when you get older.
target: 没错! 生活充满了简单的乐趣,像这样。 你长大后会学会欣赏他们

source: Well, SOMEONE hasn't learned that yet, apparently...
target: 很明显,有人还没学过这个

source: ...Are you talking about me? I am NOT getting in a bath with you guys and three strange old men.
target: 你在说我吗? 我不会和你们和三个奇怪的老人 一起洗澡的

source: But it's so nice! And you seem stressed, Hope. What's better for stress than a warm bath?
target: 但这是如此的美好! 你似乎很紧张,希望。 何以能比取暖浴更能承受压力?

source: I think she's just being prideful 'cause she doesn't wanna admit she was wrong about everything.
target: 我觉得她只是很骄傲 因为她不想承认她错了

source: Ugh, it DOES look nice...
target: 唉,它看起来不错...

source: FINE! I'll get in. But if you ever tell anyone about this, your only future will be one filled with pain.
target: 不错! 我进去了 但如果你告诉别人这件事 你唯一的未来就是充满痛苦

source: Yeah, whatever. Shut up and get in, gurl!
target: 是啊,随便。 闭嘴,快进来,小妞!

source: You all spend a while in the bath, gaining +N2 STAMINA from your relaxed muscles -- and you learn that the tub can fit at least seven people! The more you know!
target: 你们都花一阵子在洗澡 从放松的肌肉里获得+N2STAMINA--你们学会了浴缸至少可以容纳7个人! 越多你就会知道!

source: Suddenly, four horseriding bandits come out of nowhere and box you all in! You're forced to stop the car.
target: 突然,四只骑马的土匪突然从天而降, 把你全部关进监狱里去! 你被迫停车了

source: We've got you surrounded! Come out with your hands up and your money out!
target: 我们包围了你们! 举起手来,把钱拿出来!

source: Here, have this -N2 MONEY! It's ALL we have!
target: 给,拿着这个,N2钱! 我们只有这些了!

source: (It's nooooooot.)
target: (出无相.

source: What about you, finn-guy? Give us your wallet!
target: 你呢,芬 -盖? 把你的钱包给我们!

source: Eh, okay. Good luck with that.
target: 嗯,还好。 祝你们好运

source: Hey! There's nothing in here! Where's your money?
target: 嘿 这里什么都没有! 你的钱呢?
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: You can ask my boss. Maybe you'll have better luck than me.
target: 你可以问我老板 也许你比我运气好

source: You think you're funny, huh? Stop messing with us, or we'll make you regret it.
target: 你觉得你很有趣,是吧? 别耍我们了,否则我们会让你后悔的

source: I doubt you can make me regret anything at this point. I have too many regrets already.
target: 我怀疑你现在能让我后悔什么 我已经后悔太多

source: And anyway, I'm not messing with anyone; I'm seriously broke. Most of my salary is paid in "experience".
target: 总之,我没有和任何人乱搞,我严重破产了。 我的工资大部分是用"经验"支付的.

source: Wanna steal my "experience"? I wouldn't recommend it, 'cause it certainly wasn't a pleasant experience; but please, be my guests.
target: 想偷我的"经验"吗? 我建议不要,因为那肯定不是一次愉快的经历;但是请做我的客人.

source: ...Hooray?
target: 霍雷吗?

source: Uh... look, we usually never ask our victims this, but... are you okay, bud?
target: 额... 我们通常不会问受害者,但是... 你没事吧,伙计?

source: Heh... that question's above my pay grade.
target: 哦... 这个问题的级别高于我的薪水。

source: (Polly, should we do something? Finn is really bumming me out...)
target: (波莉要不要我们做点什么? 芬恩真的让我兴奋... )

source: (We should absolutely do something. No negative nihilism allowed on this road trip! We gotta help Finn find meaning in life again!)
target: (我们绝对应该做点什么) 这条路不允许消极的虚无主义! 我们必须帮助芬恩找到人生的意义!)

source: Okay, guess that's more important than stopping these guys from robbing you. How will you bring joy back to Finn's life?
target: 好吧,猜这比阻止这些家伙抢劫你更重要。 你怎么给芬的生活带来快乐?

source: Finn is jaded by a life that's too mundane. He needs adventure... he needs to give himself over to a romantic life of banditry!
target: 芬恩被太平凡的生活所迷惑 他需要冒险... 他需要把自己交给 浪漫的盗匪生活!

source: Help Finn look for the something, anything that's truly valuable in his life... something worth being stolen!
target: 帮助芬寻找他生命中真正有价值的东西... 值得被偷的东西!

source: NOICE! I've been meaning to get into a life of crime! Let's do it!
target: 小声点! 我一直想进入犯罪生活! 让我们开始吧!

source: And so, without a second thought, you and your friends begin a life of banditry. You gain +N2 HYPE!
target: 所以,没有第二个想法, 你和你朋友开始 抢劫的生活。 你得到了+N2 HYPE!

source: But one day, the bandits call you all in for a meeting.
target: 但有一天,匪徒们叫你们来开会

source: Listen, guys, we need to talk.
target: 听着,伙计们,我们需要谈谈。

source: We appreciate how much you've helped us commit crimes; but in the end, we welcomed you to our group because we were worried about Finn.
target: 我们欣赏你帮助我们犯罪的程度;但最后,我们欢迎你加入我们的团体,因为我们担心芬恩.

source: Yeah, Finn seemed so jaded... so devoid of a spark in his life...
target: 是的,芬恩看起来很... 他生命中没有火花...

source: We knew we had to do something, 'cause banditry isn't just about robbing people; it's about escaping the numbness of traditional society... by robbing people.
target: 我们知道我们必须做点什么,因为盗匪不仅仅是抢劫,而是逃避传统社会的麻木...... 抢劫别人

source: But we're still quite worried about you, Finn.
target: 但我们仍然很担心你,芬恩。

source: About me? But I've been doing my best!
target: 关于我? 但我已经尽力了!

source: Exactly, that's the problem. You're just too efficient.
target: 没错,这就是问题所在。 你只是太有效率了。

source: You're working super hard to manage our finances, schedule our heists, and keep us on top of our tax fraud.
target: 你努力管理我们的财务 安排我们的抢劫 并让我们在税收欺诈之上。

source: You've turned banditry into a 9-to-5 job.
target: 你把盗匪变成9比5的工作了

source: But we've seen the passion you put in that... I'd say office work is to you what banditry is to us. Maybe what made you miserable wasn't your career... but your specific job.
target: 但是我们已经看到了你所投入的激情... 我想说办公室的工作是对你来说什么是盗匪对我们。 也许让你痛苦的不是你的事业... 但你的具体工作。

source: Hmmm... that could be true. My boss there is a massive asshole.
target: 那个... 这可能是事实。 我老板有个大混蛋

source: Ah, we know a thing or two about that. We used to have an awful boss, but then we staged a mutiny and stabbed him. Like... a lot.
target: 我们对此一两件事都了解 我们以前有个可怕的老板, 但后来我们策划了一场兵变,刺死了他。 喜欢... 经常

source: Have you tried stabbing your boss, Finn? Sometimes that does the trick.
target: 你试过刺你老板吗,芬? 有时候,这能做诡计。

source: ...Stabbing my boss probably wouldn't reflect well in my yearly performance review.
target: 刺我老板可能不会 很好地反映在我的年度业绩审查。

source: Fair enough. Then I hope you eventually find a better boss, one that brings the thrill of menial office work back into your heart.
target: 说得没错 我希望你最终能找到一个更好的老板 一个能让你的办公室充满激情的老板

source: Well, that was fun while it lasted. You part ways with the bandits and hit the road again... but you don't get back the MONEY they stole from you.
target: 玩得很开心 你和匪徒分开,又上路了... 但你不能拿回他们从你那偷来的金钱

source: Good thinking, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Surely Finn has something valuable other than MONEY (which he has none of)!
target: 不错的想法, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 芬恩除了货币外,肯定还有宝贵的东西。

source: What about a meaningful memento from Finn's mother; something nostalgic -- and very expensive -- that reminds him of the motherland...
target: Finn母亲的纪念品怎么样? 怀旧的 -- -- 非常昂贵的 -- -- 使他想起祖国...

source: Like her credit card! That glorious card which brought you so much wealth and happiness as a boy... got anything like that?
target: 像她的信用卡一样! 光荣的牌 带给你这么多财富和幸福 作为一个男孩... 找到类似的东西了吗?

source: Eh... no.
target: 额... 没有。

source: What about your tie, Finn? It's a key part of your whole "it's Monday at the office and I'm dead inside" aesthetic, so it must be important to you.
target: 你的领带呢,芬恩? 这是你整个"周一在办公室里 我死了"美学的关键部分 所以这对你来说一定很重要

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

source: You guys have it all wrong! Finn's biggest wealth isn't material; it's SPIRITUAL.
target: 你们都错了! 芬恩最大的财富不是物质的;而是SPIRITUAL.

source: Finn may feel miserable in his day-to-day life, but he still finds meaning in rare, precious moments amidst the routine...
target: 芬恩在日常生活中可能感到痛苦,但他仍然在日常中发现珍贵的稀有时刻的意义. .

source: An unforgettable night out with the co-workers; a moment of camaraderie in the office; even escaping his routine by hitting the road with us...
target: 和同事一起度过难忘的夜晚,在办公室里结交一阵友情,甚至与我们一起出道以逃避他所行的习惯......

source: ...those moments make everything else worth it.
target: 那一刻让其他一切变得值得

source: Sure... but that touchy-feely shit isn't something we can resell for profit, so I guess we're taking the tie.
target: 当然... 但是那些触摸的狗屎不是我们能卖出去赚钱的 所以我猜我们得打领带了

source: The bandits leave with your MONEY and Finn's tie.
target: 匪徒带着你的财团和芬恩的领带离开.

source: Well, there goes my favorite tie... good thing I have twelve identical ones.
target: 我最喜欢的领带... 幸好我有12个一样的

source: And hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: I should thank you.
target: 还有,嘿, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%:我应该谢谢你.

source: Your words made me think: I focus so much on the things I hate in life that I've forgotten to cherish the things I love. Thanks!
target: 你的话让我想到:我把太多的精力集中在生活中我所憎恨的东西上,这些东西我忘记了珍惜我所爱的东西. 谢谢!

source: You're rewarded with a rare, hopeful smile from Finn, and +N2 SOUL!
target: 芬恩给你的难得的充满希望的微笑 和+N2 SOUL!

source: You're driving along when you notice three adorable critters in bloody, singed cultist robes praying on the side of the road.
target: 你开车走的时候,你注意到三个可爱的 穿着血腥的,唱着邪教长袍 在路边祈祷。

source: Hey, wait a moment! Those are some of my followers! Pull over!
target: 嘿,等一下! 等会! 那些人是我的追随者! 停车!

source: Blessed be our eyes! Leader, we've been on a quest to find thee: the cult is being ravaged by a plague!
target: 保佑我们的眼睛! 领导,我们一直在寻找你:邪教正被瘟疫所蹂躏!

source: Of fire!
target: 火的火的风!

source: A... what now?
target: 一个... 现在怎么办?

source: It all started when we ran out of food. We were going to accept the sweet embrace of death, but someone suggested cooking grass.
target: 食物用光了,就从这里开始 我们本来要接受死亡的甜蜜拥抱 但有人建议做草

source: We were saved, but it turns out grass makes you poop... a lot.
target: 我们被救了,但结果发现草让你大便... 经常

source: After a few days, some people started getting sick. We highly suspect it was due to being surrounded by poop 24/7.
target: 几天后,一些人开始生病. 我们非常怀疑是被大便所包围

source: Surely we were hit with some evil curse. Poop always disappears by itself after a while!
target: 我们被诅咒了 便便总是会自己消失一段时间!

source: ...It does not. I clean up your poop, like, all day.
target: .没有。 我帮你收拾了一整天的便便

source: See? I told you guys!
target: 看到没? 我告诉过你们!

source: Well, we didn't know that, so we did the sensible thing: we set the poop on fire.
target: 我们不知道,所以我们做了明智的事: 我们把大便放火了。

source: But then the fire spread everywhere, as contagious diseases do... a most terrible plague of fire!
target: 但火蔓延到任何地方 就像传染病一样... 一场最可怕的火灾!

source: At least the sick followers got better?
target: 至少病的追随者都好起来了吗?

source: No, we eventually gave up and threw them into the fire.
target: 不,我们最终放弃了,扔入了火中。

source: We're lost without you, O powerful fluffy one. Please return!
target: 没有你,我们迷路了, 强大的风毛菊花。 请回来!

source: No way. I am on... this sort of sacred pilgrimage. It's called "Vacation". It's very sacred and very important.
target: 不会吧 我开始... 那种神圣的朝圣仪式 取"维克通". 其道甚圣而有重.

source: You gotta learn to clean up your own messes.
target: 你得学会清理自己的烂摊子

source: I had this idea: you know how they say "fight fire with fire"? I say we should start an even bigger fire to defeat the first fire!
target: 我有一个想法:你知道人们怎么说"用火来扑灭"吗? 不如我们再大点火来击败第一炮吧

source: Never mind. %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, let's brainstorm something that'll stop my followers from messing everything up (again).
target: 没关系。  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%让我们来集思广益 来阻止我的追随者把一切都搞砸

source: The Shrine of Common Sense: an effigy that protects the followers by repeating recordings of the Lamb's wisest commandments, such as "Do NOT eat that!"
target: 常识之圣道:通过重复"羊"最睿智的戒律的录音来保护追随者的神道,如"不要吃那"等.

source: Endless ball pit: keep the followers busy and entertained so they don't mess things up! It's like a body pit, but more fun!
target: 无尽的球坑:让追随者们忙活,娱乐,以免把事情搞砸! 像个尸体坑,但更好玩!

source: That sounds great, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, but I don't know if a few prerecorded teachings will be enough to keep the cult in check.
target: 这听起来不错, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%但我不知道一些预录的教义 是否足以控制邪教

source: Sure they will! You just have to find good advice that can be applied generally, like...
target: 当然会的! 你只需要找到可以普遍应用的好建议 比如...

source: "...Do NOT eat that"?
target: "... 不要吃那个"?

source: Yeah! That one has worked for Scott SO many times. Or like: "That's not a toilet!"

source: Oh, that's REALLY good advice too, trust me!

source: Okay, you've convinced me! I'm going to have the shrine set up right away.

source: A few days later, the followers are back at the cult space, or whatever remains of it.
target: 几天后,追随者们又回到了邪教的空间,或者说不管它残留什么.

source: How are you, fellow follower?
target: 追随者,你好吗?

source: Oh, not bad. Still hungry, though. I could eat a whole horse...
target: 不错 仍然饿了,虽然。 我可以吃一整匹马...

source: Do NOT eat that!
target: 别吃那个!

source: Aw, okay...
target: 哦,还好...

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

target: 嘿,伙计们! 外面的屋子都满了,所以我要借一碗多余的食物,好吗?

source: That's not a toilet!

source: Oh...
Hello, everyone! I found this rock that looks like our leader. Who wants to buy it from me? It's very rare!
target: 大家好,大家好,我们走! 我找到一块看起来像我们领袖的石头 谁想从我这里买? 甚为稀有!

target: 任何依赖稀缺来确定价值的市场必然会成为投机性的,只会给有关人民带来痛苦。

source: Aw... I wonder what can I do with the rock if I can't sell it...
target: 哦... 不知我卖不出去,怎么处理石头...

source: Do NOT eat that!
target: 别吃那个!

source: Whoa, just when I thought our leader couldn't be any wiser!
target: 哇,我以为我们的领袖 更聪明的时候!

source: Turns out there's nothing a little technology can't fix! You lose -N2 MONEY because talking shrines don't come for free, but you gain +N2 MIND from the Lamb's words of wisdom!
target: 原来,没有什么小科技不能解决的! 你输了N2钱是因为说话的神社不是免费来的,但是你从羊的智慧之言中获得了+N2 MIND!

source: Ooh, that works! You guys would like a ball pit, wouldn't you?
target: 哦,这工作! 你们想来个球坑,对吧?

target: 如果你说我们会的,我们会的! 我只有一个问题:什么是球?

target: 你不知道什么是球吗? 男人,在邪教的生活 比我想象的要困难得多。

target: 像是你为好玩而扔的圆形东西

source: Oh, like a rock? I get it now! You want us to dig a pit to stone people in as punishment!
target: 石头? 我现在明白了! 你想我们挖个坑把人扔进去作为惩罚!

source: Nooo, it's not a punishment! The ball pit is for fun! You can jump around in it or bury yourself in the balls.
target: 不,这不是惩罚! 球坑是用来玩的! 你可以跳来跳去 或者把自己埋在蛋蛋里

source: Ahhh, so you want us to bury people alive in the balls as punishment for their sins!
target: 啊,所以你希望我们把人活埋在蛋蛋里 作为对他们的罪孽的惩罚!

source: No, you dolt, the Leader just said it ISN'T a punishment.
target: 不,你个白痴, 领袖刚刚说,这不是惩罚。

source: Thank you. At least ONE of you was listening.
target: 谢谢 至少你们中有人在听

source: The Leader is commanding us to bury people alive in the balls for fun!
target: 首领要我们把人活埋在蛋蛋里 以取乐

source: NO! Do NOT bury people alive!!!
target: 没有! 不要把人活埋了! ! !

source: Sorry, Leader! Would you rather us kill the sinners before we bury them in the ball pit?
target: 对不起,队长! 你宁可我们先杀了罪人 然后再把他们埋在球坑里?

source: You know what, sure, whatever. At least if you're busy with that you won't have time to set your poop on fire.
target: 你知道,当然,随便吧。 至少如果你忙着处理这件事 你没有时间放火烧你的大便

source: A few days and -N2 MONEY later, the cultists have built the ball pit.
target: 几天后和-N2 MONEY,邪教已经建造了球坑.

source: With trial and error and only a few accidental deaths, they finally learn how to have fun in it! Whatever that means for them. You gain +N2 HYPE by proxy.
target: 加上审判和失误,只有几起意外死亡事件,他们终于学会了如何在其中取乐! 对他们来说,不管这意味着什么 您通过代理获得 +N2 HYPE 。

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of STAMINA. Good for you!
target: 嘿,你刚到达 大量的STAMINA。 不错!

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the STAMINA-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 也就是说你的目标是... 以斯大林为基地的 接续?

source: If so, there's a wacky adventure that could unlock a layer for that DESTINATION... wanna go for it?
target: 如果是这样,有一个疯狂的冒险 可能打开一层 的DESTING... 要不要去吗?

source: GO GO GO!
target: 滚开!

source: Nah, I'm good.
target: 不,我没事。

source: Great! The adventure will be waiting for you on the road.
target: 不错! Great! 冒险会等着你上路

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!
target: 对不起,打破了四号墙... 再见!

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白了,我只是想检查一下。 对不起,我打破了四号墙!

source: You're driving past a rest stop where you see some ghosts chatting outside their van. Polly rolls her window down and waves hello.
target: 你开车经过一个休息站 看到一些鬼魂在他们的车外面聊天  波莉 摇起她的窗户,挥起你的好。

source: POLLYYY! What's up, bitch?!
target: 波利! 玛丽! 怎么样,婊子?

source: Whoa... Polly's here? Haha... small world... gimme a hug, pretty girl...
target: 珃...  波莉在这儿吗? ... 这个世界... 给我一个拥抱,漂亮女孩...

source: You park the car and greet Polly's friends: Summer, Macarena, and Cheese, the Ghosts of Parties Past.
target: 你停车迎接 波莉朋友:夏克,玛卡丽娜,还有芝士,过去派对的鬼魂.

source: What are you guys doing here? You going on a trip?
target: 你们在这里干什么? 你要去旅行吗?

source: We're on our way to Veranotone. We've gone every year of our un-lives together!
target: 我们正要去 维拉没有人。 我们每年都在一起过不活的日子!

source: We just pulled over to buy gum for our festival survival kits.
target: 我们刚停车买口香糖 用于我们的节日活命包。

source: There are festival survival kits? I didn't know survival was so important at these things. I thought music festivals were all about going wild.
target: 节日生存包? 我不知道生存 如此重要的东西。 我以为音乐节都是关于疯狂的

source: They are, my hairy dude. But in order to party hard, you first gotta party prepare!
target: 他们是,我的发型帅哥。 但是,为了狂欢, 你首先要准备派对!

source: I'm packing a printout of the schedule to make sure we see all our favorite artists, a map of the grounds in case we get lost...
target: 我整理了时间表的打印图 以确保我们能看到我们最爱的艺术家 以及那些地方的地图 以防我们迷路...

source: ...water for drugs that dehydrate you, gum for drugs that make you grind your jaw, baby wipes for drugs that make you poop...
target: 水是用来给你脱水的 口香糖是用来让你磨下巴的 婴儿擦去让你拉屎的

source: Do ghosts poop?
target: 鬼会拉屎吗?

source: Not usually... but poop drugs... are powerful stuff...
target: 通常不会... 但大便药... 很有威力的东西...

source: So, have you guys made your festival kits yet? What'd you put in yours? I'm always looking for inspiration.
target: 你们做了节日用品包吗? 你都放了什么? 装了什么? 我总是在寻找灵感。

source: You're no Ghost of Parties Past, but you've been around the dance floor enough times to know the perfect addition to any festival survival kit...
target: 你以前不是派对的鬼魂 但你已经绕舞池 足够多的时间知道任何节日生存工具的完美补充...

source: The biggest risk is losing your friends and spending the whole festival stressed and looking for them. The solution is a red thread linking each one's index finger at all times.
target: 最大的风险是失去你的朋友 花光整个节日 压力很大 寻找他们 溶液是一条红色的线,将每个人的食指始终连在一起.

source: The biggest risk is wearing your legs down after three full days of partying. The solution is attending the festival on a horse.
target: 最大的风险是 三天的派对后 腿都脱了 解决方案是骑马参加节日活动.

source: Great idea! Between the crowds, the drugs, and our short attention spans, getting separated's a big possibility.
target: 不错的主意! 人群之间,毒品之间,我们短暂的注意力跨度, 分离是一个很大的可能性。

source: Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I know party prep isn't the most -N2 HYPE activity, but I appreciate you taking it seriously!
target: 谢谢 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我知道派对准备不是N2HYPE最活跃的活动 但我很感激你认真对待它!

source: Flash forward to the music festival. The Ghosts of Parties Past are deep in the throes of hard-partying.
target: 闪出音乐节. 党的幽灵们过去 深陷着硬党的苦痛中

source: Can we hit the bathrooms? I know I'm drunk and it's probably just a phantom-limb thing, but FUCK I need to pee.
target: 我们可以去洗手间吗? 我知道我喝醉了,这也许只是 幻觉的东西,但他妈的我需要小便。

source: We can't go now! The Grateful Undead is playing next, and I didn't do shrooms to NOT see the ghost of Jerry Garcia perform.
target: 我们现在不能走! 感恩的不死神在下一场比赛 我没有做洗手间 看不到杰里·加西亚的鬼魂表演

source: Whoa... that guy's hair is... so soft... I gotta touch it... nothing else has ever been more important to me...
target: 珃... 那家伙的头发... 这么柔软... 我一定要摸摸它... ... 摸摸它,我摸摸它,我摸摸它,我摸到它,我摸到它 没有什么比这更重要的了...

source: It's cool, this is what we got the thread for. Everyone tie an end to your fingers. Let's meet back up right here ASAP, okay?
target: 很酷,这就是我们有线。 每个人都把手指绑上 我们尽快在这里碰头 好吗?

source: Thirty minutes later, two festival attendees are tripping over the red thread covering the festival grounds.
target: 30分钟后,两名参加节日的人正从覆盖节日场地的红线上绊倒。

source: They turn the corner and see other festival attendees completely tied up in the thread like a spider's next meal!
target: 他们转过口来,看到其他的节日参与者像蜘蛛的下顿饭一样被完全绑在线上!

source: "Look out for those three ghosts!" the trapped people cry. "They're wandering aimlessly across the festival, trapping us all with a VERY LONG thread!"
target: "注意那三个鬼!"被困的人会哭. "他们漫无目的地游荡在节日中,用一线很长的线来困住我们!"

source: "But why?" ask the friends. "Were they killed at a music festival and now they're cursing us to a horrible fate?!"
target: "但为什么?"问朋友。 "他们是不是在音乐节上被杀了 现在却在咒骂我们"

source: "No," say the trapped friends, "we're pretty sure they're just super drunk."
target: "不",被困的朋友说"我们很确定他们只是超级醉".

source: Well, you didn't do the other festival-goers any favors, but the Ghosts of Parties Past appreciate the peace of +N2 MIND your thread idea gave them. Good work!
target: 你没有帮其他的节日活动 但过去派对的鬼魂们 都欣赏你的想法 +N2的平静 干得不错!

source: Great idea! Three days of straight partying is exhausting, so outsourcing all the walking and standing to a horse would save our +N2 STAMINA.
target: 不错的主意! 三天的直道派对很累 所以把所有的步行和站立都外包给马 就能拯救我们的+N2STAMINA

source: But aren't you guys ghosts? Can't you just float everywhere?
target: 你们不是鬼魂吗? 你就不能到处漂来漂去吗?

source: Yeah, but as a matter of principle, we're going with the horse thing. It's too dope of an opportunity to pass up.
target: 是的,但原则上,我们要去马的事情。 机会太难受了

source: Thanks, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I know party prep isn't the most -N2 HYPE activity, but I appreciate you taking it seriously!
target: 谢谢 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我知道派对准备不是N2HYPE最活跃的活动 但我很感激你认真对待它!

source: Flash forward to the music festival. The crowds are screaming and running in terror.
target: 闪出音乐节. 众相相相叫出而作恐怖跑.

source: "Beware the ghosts on horses!" they cry. "They'll trample any man, woman, or port-o-potty in their way!"
target: "小心马上鬼!" 他们哭了。 "他们会践踏任何男人,女人,或港口的"

source: "They must be the ghosts of some festival attendees who got trampled by a crowd, and they've returned to get revenge!" someone says.
target: 被人群践踏, 并回来复仇!" 有人说:

source: "Or maybe they're the three horsemen of the apocalypse!" someone else suggests.
target: "或者说,他们可能是启示录的三位马将",别人建议.

source: "Weren't there four horsemen, though?"
target: "相公道:"虽有四骑来相去相去相去相去?

source: "Oh, maybe? I can't remember. Let me look it up..."
target: "哦,也许? 我不记得了。 让我查查..."

source: "SHIT! I'M NOT GETTING ANY CELL SERVICE!"
target: "嘘! 我没有得到任何 任何服务!"

source: "Oh God, it really IS the end of days! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!!"
target: "哦,上帝,这真的是 结束的日子! 跑去你的生灵!"

source: This rocks. I'm NEVER going to another music festival without a horse. They cut through the crowds so well!
target: 这块石头 我再也不会去没有马的音乐节了 他们把人群切得这么好!

source: Same... I love my horsie... I named her "Om Nom Nom"... she's the bestest... 'cause she shares her tranquilizer with me...
target: 一样... 我爱我的荷西... 我给她取了个"Om Nom Nom"的名字... 她是最棒的... ... . . . 因为她和我分享了她的镇静剂...

source: Same... I love my horsie... I named her "Om Nom Nom"... she's the bestest... 'cause she shares her ketamine with me...
target: 一样... 我爱我的荷西... 我给她取了个"Om Nom Nom"的名字... 她是最棒的... ... . . . 因为她和我分享了她的克胺...

source: It's this way to the main stage, guys. We can take a shortcut if our horses jump over that bar counter! Giddy-up!
target: 这边走,到主舞台 如果马从酒吧柜台上跳下去,我们就能走捷径了! 开始!

source: Well, you didn't do the other festival attendees any favors, but your hot friends had fun, which is all that matters!
target: 你没有帮其他参加节日的人什么忙 但你的热门朋友玩得很开心 这才是最重要的

source: As you're driving, you see the Ghosts of Parties Past parked at a rest stop. You can't resist pulling over and saying hi to those sexy specters!
target: 开车的时候,你看到过去派对的鬼魂 停在休息站 你无法抗拒停车 和那些性感的光棍打招呼!

source: Heyyy, dudes! Good to see you! Wanna help me brainstorm a scheme real quick?
target: 嘿,伙计们! 很高兴见到你! 想帮我快速地 搞出一个计划吗?

source: Sure! What kind of scheme? Evil? Money-making? Color?
target: 当然! 什么样的计划? 邪恶? 赚钱? 颜色?

source: Whatever you want! I just wanna make this music festival an unforgettable night. I try to do something weird and memorable at every party we go to.
target: 随便你! 我只想让音乐节成为难忘的夜晚 我试图做一些奇怪和难忘的事情 在我们去的每一个聚会。

source: Like the time I bought fake gems and hid them around the club, then we spread rumors that the previous owner had buried his life's savings there before he died!
target: 就像我买假宝石 把它们藏在俱乐部里的时候 我们传出谣言说 之前的主人 已经把他的积蓄埋在那里了

source: Haha, yeah... everyone was so frantic... some lady throat-punched a guy for a plastic diamond... good times...
target: 哈哈,对了... 大家都这么疯狂... 有个女人用喉咙 给一个男人挖了个塑料钻石... 美好的时光...

source: I liked the time we went to a party pretending to be a group of paranormal investigators on break.
target: 我喜欢我们去派对的时候 假装是一群超自然调查员休息

source: Someone hired us to check if their house was haunted. I thought they were just high, but nope, their house was SUPER haunted!
target: 有人雇我们查他们家是不是闹鬼 我以为他们只是高,但不行, 他们的房子是SUPER闹鬼!

source: We had the best afterparty there... you haven't un-lived... if you've never tried Victorian ghost opium... it's... like... the tits...
target: 我们在那里举行了最好的晚会... 你没有不活... 如果你从未尝试过维多利亚鬼鸦片... 这是... 喜欢... 奶头...

source: It'll be hard to top either of those parties, or the ones that came before. I wanna make Veranotone great, but I've got schemer's block...
target: 很难在那些派对上或者之前的派对上 都占上风 我想做一个 维拉也不是什么好东西 但我有阴谋家的阻隔...

source: I'm sure %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% can help; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% pretty good at schemes! Got any ideas, bro?
target: 我当然知道 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 能够提供帮助; %HESHE%%VERB_'S_'RE% 不错的计策! 有什么想法吗,兄弟?

source: "Go to the festival site before it starts and bury bottles of alcohol under the ground. When the party's on, you bring a shovel and dig up your secret stashes!"
target: "去节地去,再起事去后将酒瓶埋地下. 派对开后,你拿铲子来挖出你的秘密藏品!"

source: "Deceive everyone with the most powerful persona imaginable: 'The Music Festival Inspectors'"
target: "用最有力量的人来打败每个人" "音乐节的巡视员"

source: Duuude, that's perfect! It's as funny as it is practical!
target: 杜德,这太完美了! 既有趣又实用!

source: Like, do you have any idea how much they charge for drinks at music festivals? We're gonna save a LOT of money.
target: 你知道音乐节的饮料要多少钱吗? 我们会省下一大笔钱的

source: You give the ghosts your shovels so they can carry out their scheme. You'll lose -N2 STAMINA when you have to dig things up with your hands later, but it's worth it!
target: 你给鬼的铲子,让他们可以执行他们的计划。 -N2 Stamina,你以后要用手挖东西,但值得!

source: Later, at the festival...
target: 以后,在节日...

source: Man, I'm really craving tequila shots. Didn't we bury some around here?
target: 伙计,我真的很想喝龙舌兰酒 我们不是埋了些东西吗?

source: Let me check the map... looks like there are two bottles of tequila buried thirty feet that way. Get the party shovels!
target: 让我检查一下地图... 看起来像有两瓶龙舌兰酒 埋在了30英尺的路边 去拿党铲!

source: Later, the ghosts see a woman proposing to her girlfriend. She says yes!
target: 后来,鬼魂们看到一个女人向女友求婚. 她答应了!

source: Aww, so sweet... we gotta toast to this... Cheese, dig up the champagne... it's, like, seventeen feet away or something...
target: 这么甜... 我们为这个干杯... 起司,把香槟挖出来... 大约17英尺远,或者...

source: Even later, the ghosts pass a festival attendee crying by the bathrooms. He explains that he lost his favorite jacket.
target: 甚至在后来,鬼也通过一个节日的出席者在浴室边哭泣. 他解释他失去了他最喜欢的外套。

source: Don't worry, dude. I knew my spirit was called to this party for a reason, and that reason is to give you my backup jacket! Just let me dig it up.
target: 别担心,伙计。 我知道这个派对是用我的精神来召集的 这也是为了给你我的后援夹克! 让我挖出来

source: And guess what... we buried extra tequila shots in the jacket pockets... what a great surprise from sober-us.
target: 你猜怎么着... 我们把龙舌兰酒的枪子 埋在了夹克口袋里 清醒的我们真是惊喜

source: Still later, just as the festival headliner is about to go onstage, a stage light falls on the bassist and kills him instantly! Oh no!
target: 之后,就在节日头条即将上台之际,一站台灯倒在了低音手上,当场就杀了他! 哦,不,不,不,不,不,不。

source: It's okay everyone, the show can still go on! Where'd we bury that backup bassist?
target: 没事了,大家好,演出还能继续! 我们把那个后援贝斯手埋在哪里了?

source: Over here... good news... I'm pretty sure he's still alive... and better news... I buried him with more tequila shots... yaaay!

source: ...What?

target: 对 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我想为你加油,但你使这非常困难。

source: Uh... giving advice is so hard... I have no idea how Coach does it...
target: 额... 给建议太难了... 我不知道教练是怎么...

source: Ugh... fine... but I have one last ace up my sleeve...
target: 唉哟... 不错... 但我还有最后一张王牌...

source: THE STRANGER!!!
target: 长相!

source: What about it?
