source: I mean, that's a prediction, sure. A very weird one.
target: 我的意思是,这是一个预测,当然。 很奇怪的一首歌 说起来很怪异

source: But the match is indeed interrupted by a stranger. Everyone is amazed.
target: 但这场比赛确实被陌生人打断了. 每个人都很惊讶。

source: Ha! Idiots... you saw the stranger coming from afar and how he looked like wanting to ask you a question, heh.
target: 白痴们... 你看到陌生人从远处来 他看起来想问你一个问题,呵呵。

source: The stranger interrupts you. He asks for directions. You help him and he leaves.
target: 陌生人打断你。 他问路。 你帮他,他就离开

source: Dang it. Yeah, asking for directions now seems like a way more obvious possibility than asking for the capital of Norway. What were you thinking?
target: 该死 是的,现在问路似乎比问挪威首都 更明显的可能性。 你当时在想什么?

source: Oh, that's so nice!

source: ...Maybe.

target: (特别是训练她耐心对付烦人的蠢货)

source: For helping a friend, you get +5 SOUL.
target: 帮助朋友,你得到+5 SOUL。

source: You part ways.

source: Today you won... because you believed in the heart of the cards!
target: 今天你赢了... 因为你相信牌心!

source: You give Hope the birthday card, but it's not her birthday!
target: 你给Hope生日卡,但这不是她的生日!

source: Dang, you didn't even need to be a fortune teller to nail that one; just a good friend!

source: ...Do you even understand how birthdays work?

source: ...Are you sure about that E thing?

target: 成为一个糟糕的算命人和更糟的朋友(因此将失去 -3 Suul),

target: 每个人对你缺乏考虑都感到沮丧。 他们决定,最好的补偿方法是将你的下个生日送给希望,所以它成为希望的第二个生日!

source: (But you're not invited to Hope's second birthday party, since you still were a terrible friend.)
target: (但你没有被邀请参加"希望"的第二个生日会,因为你还是个糟糕的朋友. )

source: Hope's Oober finally arrives, and she leaves.
target: 霍普的"Oober"终于到了,她离开了.

source: You're left to reflect on your poor choices today.
target: 让你思考你今天的糟糕选择

source: Heya, you just reached a high amount of MONEY. Good for you!
target: 嘿,你刚拿到一大笔钱 不错!

source: Does that mean you're aiming for... the MONEY-BASED DESTINATION?
target: 也就是说你的目标是... 钱根的续作?

target: 不错! Great! 冒险会等着你上路

source: Sorry for breaking the 4th wall... see ya!

source: Gotcha, I just wanted to check. Sorry for breaking the 4th wall!
target: 明白了,我只是想检查一下。 对不起,我打破了四号墙!

source: You're driving along when you see a fire hydrant explode. An aquatic knight in full armor steps out of the geiser!
target: 你看见消防栓爆炸就开车走了 水上骑士全副武装走出水上飞机!

source: HALT, METAL LAND HORSE! Come hither! I bid thine assistance in finding my way posthaste!
target: 哈尔特, 金属地马! 来来来来来来来 我请求你协助我找到后路!

source: ...Huh?
He's asking you to pull over and give him directions.
target: 他让你停车 给他指示

source: Oh, okay! He could've just said so.
target: 哦,还好! 他本可以这么说的

source: Goodmorrow! I am Brigadier Beluga, servant and soldier to the glorious Vanderbilt Crown.
target: 明天见! 我是贝卢加准将, 仆人和士兵 光荣的范德比尔特王室。

source: Oh, that's cool. We went to school with Princess Miranda. Not to brag, but we're pretty tight with the Vanderbilts.
target: 哦,这很酷。 我们跟公主一起上学 米兰达. 不是吹牛,但我们对范德比尔特夫妇很紧张

target: 不,这是在贝兰达王室指挥官 最近的一次辉煌战役中 帮助她获得胜利的荣幸!

source: The Commander is hard at work sieging aquariums and liberating the fish within to prepare for a full-scale invasion of this accursed dry land!
target: 司令官很努力地 围住水族馆 解放里面的鱼 准备全面入侵这片被诅咒的干地

source: ...Um, which thou didst not hear about from me.
target: . 嗯,你没有听到 从我这里。

source: However, this latest siege is posing a unique challenge. Those scoundrels hath built an impenetrable wall around the border of the aquarium!
target: 然而,最近的这次围困行动带来了独特的挑战。 那些无赖在水族馆的边界上 筑起一堵坚不可摧的墙!

source: I go now aid the Commander, but alas, I knowest not where to find the aquarium, nor do I even have a plan for whenst I arrive...

target: 我们可以帮你 兄弟 教练说不要留下任何士兵或队友!  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%赣或快?

target: 根本不需要对抗:只要问那些持有要塞的工人是否在为这些与围城有关的额外时间开账单.

source: A Trojan approach: cook some hot dogs and send them a much-needed hot dog vendor... but hide one or two Merkingdom soldiers inside the cart!
target: 特洛伊式方法:煮出热狗,送出急需的热狗供应商...... 但把一两个默金多姆的士兵藏在车里!

source: But peaceful negotiations are boring! I was hoping for a plan involving a catapult at least.
target: 但和平谈判是无聊的! 我本来希望有一个计划 至少包括一个弹弓。

target: 不,这是一个伟大的计划! 水上怪癖"工资""工人公平待遇"会倒下!.

target: 你给贝卢加准将去水族馆的路 说再见 后来,在战场上...

source: HEY! You there, on top of the wall! Why do you guys wanna resist us so damn bad?!
target: 哎哟! 你在那里,在墙上! 你们为什么这么想抗拒我们?

source: "Because it's our job!" the employee-turned-soldier shouts back.
target: "因为这是我们的工作!" 员工转身的士兵大叫回来.

source: Yeah, but do you even like doing it? We're fighting for King and country; what're you fighting for?
target: 是的,但你甚至喜欢这样做吗? 我们为国王和国家而战;你们为什么呢?

source: "I'm fighting for $10.75 an hour!"
target: "我为每小时10.75美元而战"

source: That's it? Tell me you're getting overtime pay for all the extra siege hours at least!
target: 就是这样? 告诉我你至少要付加班费 来支付所有额外的围城时间!

target: 你难道为你的遗孀和奴仆而获得一丁点粮食吗?你必定在战场上死亡。

source: "Uh... no, we don't get any of that."
target: "U. 不,我们没有得到任何这些。"

source: Sounds like you work for some real assholes. If you surrender now, we could start you off as a Merkingdom foot soldier for five clams an hour.
target: 听起来你为一些真正的混蛋工作 如果你现在投降 我们可以开始你当默金多姆脚兵 每小时五只蛤

source: "...Is that a lot of clams?"
Yeah, sure, whatever you wanna believe. Are you gonna surrender or what?
target: 是的,当然,无论你想相信什么。 你要投降吗?

source: Great idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Any idea involving hot dogs is bound to work!
target: 不错的主意 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 任何涉及热狗的想法 肯定会起作用的!

source: Tis a good plan, but alas, I have no dogs -- hot or otherwise...
target: 计划不错,但可惜,我没有狗 -- 热的或别的...

target: 别担心,我们有一些热狗 你可以有。 任何能帮你 成功完成特洛伊马骗局的东西!

source: Later, at the battlefront...
target: 后来,在战场上...

source: This is a brilliant plan! Merkingdom history will be forever changed by Commander Bellanda and the hot dogs that turned the tides of war!
target: 真是个绝妙的计划! 美林多姆历史将永远被贝兰达司令和扭转战争潮流的热狗所改变!

target: 说对了 这么说来,把你藏在车里太冒险了 我们需要更好的藏身之处... 跟着我走

source: "But I already have my tetanus shot."

source: I shan't disappoint you, Commander! GLORY TO THE MERKINGDOM!
target: 我不会让你失望的,指挥官! 欢呼到梦幻的!

source: The invasion goes swimmingly, and the Merkingdom takes another outpost! You gain +N2 SOUL for helping, but lose -N2 STAMINA giving away those hot dogs.
target: 入侵会游泳,默金多姆又占领了另一个前哨! 你因为帮忙而得到+N2 SOUL,但输了 -N2 StAMINA 送出那些热狗。

source: You're driving along when you see your old pal Brigadier Beluga on the side of the road, reading a map upside-down.
target: 你开车时看到老朋友贝卢加准将 在路边, 倒地看地图。

source: Ah! Hello again, valiant ones! Many thanks for thine assistance in Commander Bellanda's siege!
target: 摆! 勇士们,你们好! 非常感谢你协助贝兰达指挥官的围攻!

source: Tis wonderful and utterly convenient that ye have found me once more, for I once again find myself floundering on a quest to serve the Vanderbilt Crown.
target: 你再次找到我,我再次发现自己 正在为范德比尔特王室服务

target: 我在找阿曼达皇家女祭司 她正在参观圣所, 修道院只允许那些"信仰的飞跃"的人进入.

source: But... um... what if thou art wrong, and I leap off a cliff to my untimely demise?
target: 不过... 那个... 如果你错了,我跳出悬崖 来不及的死亡?

source: You mean you wouldn't risk dying to find your princess? Some knight you are!
target: 你是说你不会冒着生命危险去找到你的公主? 骑士你!

source: BOOOOO! FAKE FAN! FAKE KNIGHT IN SHINING ARMOR!
target: 呜呜! 假的,假的,假的,假的,假的,假的 晚上在阿摩尔发作!

source: You suspect that jumping off a cliff isn't Brigadier Beluga's only option. He could also try...
target: 你怀疑跳下悬崖不是贝卢加准将的唯一选择 他也可以尝试...

source: Ordering some pizza to be delivered to the Sacred Sanctuary, then following the pizza delivery person into the sanctuary!
target: 订了披萨送去圣所 然后跟随披萨送货人进入圣所

source: Praying for directions.
target: 祈取道场.

source: YES! PIZZA IS ALWAYS THE ANSWER!
target: 没错! 皮扎总是回答!

source: I know not what "pizza" is, but if it truly is "always the answer", I suppose this is the leap of faith I must take.
target: 我不知道什么是"皮扎",但如果它真的是"永远的答案",我想这就是我必须去的信仰的飞跃.

source: You're glad he's onboard, because you definitely only suggested this because you wanted pizza. You spend -N2 MONEY placing an order.
target: 你很高兴他上船 因为你绝对只是因为想要披萨 你花N2钱订了订单

source: 15-to-45 minutes later, you, Polly, Scott, and Brigadier Beluga are crouched uncomfortably behind a bush as the pizza delivery girl pulls up on her bike.
target: 15到45分钟后,你, 波莉, 斯科特贝卢加准将被困在树丛后 披萨送货的姑娘骑着自行车

source: Pizza delivery for... no way... this can't be right.
target: 送披萨... 绝对不行... 这不可能是错的。

source: She pulls out her phone and calls her manager.
target: 她拔出手机,打电话给她的经理。

source: I'm telling you, Michael: there's nothing but a big cliff out here. I think we've been pranked.
target: 我告诉你,迈克尔,这里除了悬崖外什么也没有 我想我们被恶作剧了

source: Yeah, I put the address in my GPS... it just says to "take a leap of faith in 700 feet."
target: 是的,我把地址 在我的GPS... 它只是说"在700英尺的高度上 开始一个信仰的飞跃"

source: ...You want me to try taking a leap OFF the cliff? ...Ugh, fine, but this better be brought up in my next performance review.
target: ...你想让我跳出悬崖吗? 呃,好吧,但最好在我的下次业绩审查中提出这一点。

source: With a sigh, the pizza girl ragdolls and pitches over the side of the cliff.
target: 带着一股叹息,披萨女孩被拉出布道并被扔出悬崖的一面.

source: ...Did we just make that girl jump off a cliff and die?
target: 我们是不是让那个女孩从悬崖上跳下去而死?

source: I didn't hear any screaming or bone-crunching, so she's probably fine! I bet she found the Sanctuary!
target: 我没听到任何尖叫或骨干出问题,所以她可能没事! 我敢打赌,她找到圣所了!

source: I suppose that is the best assurance I shall get. Fare-thee-well, Abovewaterians! Let us meet again, if I do not shatter all of my bones!
target: 我想这是我能得到的最好的保证 远去,水上人! 再来一次,如果我不把骨头都碎了!

source: Brigadier Beluga jumps over the cliff and falls like a lead balloon.
target: 贝卢加准将从悬崖上跳下,并像个铅气球一样倒下.

source: Dang... it's a shame the pizza girl jumped off the cliff before she could deliver our pizza.
target: 可恶... 可惜披萨女孩在送我们的披萨之前 跳下悬崖

source: Don't worry, Scotty! She left her bike box full of pizza here. We paid for a pizza, so we're eating a pizza!
target: 不用担心 斯科特哟! 她把自行车盒里装满了比萨饼 我们付了比萨饼,所以我们吃比萨饼!

source: Works for you! You and Scott eat someone else's pizza, have no regrets whatsoever, and gain +N2 STAMINA.
target: 为你效劳! 你和 斯科特 吃别人的披萨,没有任何遗憾,并获得+N2 STAMINA.
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: I am skeptical that that will work.
target: 我怀疑这是否可行。

source: Of course you are. Typical man, never wanting to ask for directions!
target: 当然了 典型的男人,从不问路!

source: But... I asked thee for directions...
target: 不过... 我问你要了方向...

source: Yeah, but did you try praying for them? Didn't think so! Let me show you how it's done:
target: 是的,但你尝试祈祷他们? 没想到! 让我告诉你怎么做到的:

source: Hey God. It's Polly. I know we don't get along, but let's set aside our status as frenemies with will-they-won't-they vibes and broker a temporary truce here.
target: 嘿,上帝,你好吗? 这是 波莉. 我知道我们相处不愉快 但我们还是把作为朋友的地位放在一边吧 他们不会... 他们的情绪和调解 暂时停战在这里。

source: Will you tell us where the Sanctuary is? Pretty please?
target: 你能告诉我们圣所在哪里吗? 漂亮吗?

source: ...I hearest nothing. Hath God abandoned us?
target: 我什么也听不到 说不定是... 上帝抛弃我们了吗?

source: Maybe, but I'm sure plan B will work: let's be so annoying that giving us what we want is easier than denying us!
target: 也许吧,但我相信B计划会奏效:让我们这么烦人,给我们想要的东西比否认我们容易!

source: HEY, GOD! C'MON, GOD! ANSWER US, YOU OMNIPOTENT BASTARD!
target: 嘿,上帝啊! 来啊! 来,上帝! 回答我们,你这讨厌的混蛋!

source: GOD! GOD! GOD! GOD GOD GOD GOD GOD GOD GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOD!
"WHAT DO YOU WANT?!"
target: "你想怎样?"

source: Holy shit... God?!
target: 可恶... 摆

source: "No, we're the monks of the Sacred Sanctuary," says the man in the magical doorway behind you. "Will you please be quieter? We're meditating in here!"
target: "不,我们是圣圣所的僧侣",在你身后神奇的门道上的人说. "你能不能安静点? 我们在这里冥想".

source: WAIT! Prithee, let me into the Sacred Sanctuary! I beseech an audience with the Royal Priestess Amanda Vanderbilt!
target: 等会儿! Wait! 普里西,让我进入圣圣所! 我恳求大家与阿曼达·范德比尔特女祭司同在!

source: "Fine, you can come in. But next time, can you just take the cliff entrance instead of screaming outside the back door?"
target: "好,你进来吧. 但下次,你能直接走下悬崖入口,而不是在后门外叫喊吗?"

source: Sweet, I knew we could do it! I always believed... in the power of being really annoying.
target: 甜心,我知道我们能办到的! 我一直相信... ... . . . 以非常烦人的力量。

source: You abandoned cold, critical logic and turned instead to blind faith and prayer. As a result, you lost -N2 MIND and gained +N2 MAGIC!
target: 你放弃了冷酷、批判性的逻辑,转而盲目的信仰和祈祷。 结果你输了 -N2 MIND 并获得了+N2 MAGIC!

source: You decide to stop when you see a certain big beluga who seems to be on the verge of having a heart attack...
target: 你决定当看到某个大白鲸 似乎快心脏病发作的时候停止...

source: Brigadier Beluga, my man! Why're you lookin' so stressed?
target: 贝卢加准将,我的人! 你为什么这么紧张?

source: Oh, 'tis you, my noble newfound friends...
target: 哦,"是你,我的崇高的新发现的朋友...

source: I am contemplating my likely fate, which will likely involve my head on a pike...
target: 我考虑我可能的命运, 这很可能涉及我的头在一匹小马上...

source: Beluga, Beluga, Beluga... what did you do this time, you zany rascal?
target: 贝卢加 贝卢加 贝卢加... 这次你做了什么,你这个混蛋?

source: Sigh... I was given a most crucial mission by none other than Her Royal Highness, Laudanda Vanderbilt...
target: 叹... 我接到一个最重要的任务 由洛丹达·范德比尔特殿下...

source: Beluga! Did you mix whites and colors when you were doing the royal laundry?
target: 贝卢加! 你洗皇家衣服的时候 混了白花和花花?

source: Alas, if only it were that...
target: 唉,如果只是这样...

source: Her Royal Highness is on a most critical diplomatic trip, in Hell.
target: 殿下正在地狱进行一场最关键的外交旅行

source: The Merkingdom doth attempt to broker some treaties with three of the Circles of Hell, for we have common enemies.
target: 默金多姆试图与地狱圈的三个条约进行调解,因为我们有共同的敌人.

source: But alas! Hell is so prone to betrayal and general treachery that they tend to be quite skeptical of any strategic alliance.
target: 但可叹! 地狱很容易被背叛和一般的背叛,以至于他们往往对任何战略联盟都相当怀疑.

source: After days of incessant diplomacy, Laudanda hath commanded I bring a few merdiplomats who are knowledgeable in the ways of Hell... but... but...
target: 经过几天的不断外交,劳丹达 命令我带几个 懂地狱道的美德克洛特人... 不过... 不过...

source: Beluga...?
target: 贝卢加... ?

source: Prithee, sparest me from narrating my embarrassing failures! Let us simply say the diplomats fell off a cliff, okay? They are no more, and soon shall I also be!
target: 普丽丝,别让我说出我尴尬的失败! 让我们简单地说,外交官们从悬崖上摔下来,好吗? 他们已经不再了,我很快就会了!

source: My bros, wait, I'm getting a bit lost with this much info... just to be sure: the "head on a pike" thing is like... a bad thing, right? We want to avoid that, or...?
target: 我的兄弟们 等等 我有点迷路了 这么多信息... 确定一下 "头顶上"的事儿就像... 一个坏事,对不对? 我们想避免,还是... ?

source: It's a bad thing, Scott; but Brigadier Beluga here is in luck, because the Prank Masterz are gonna save the day! We just need some costumes...
target: 事情很糟,我还是要说 斯科特贝卢加准将会很幸运的 因为恶作剧马斯特兹会拯救今天的 我们只需要一些服装...

source: And that's how, thanks to some expertly-crafted costumes, you infiltrate the diplomatic meeting.
target: 如此,多亏了一些精巧的服装, 你渗透到外交会议。

source: No one can tell you're not the real merdiplomats!
target: 没人能看出你不是真正的美德克洛特人!

source: Now you just need to help Laudanda secure a treaty with Hell, and she will surely pardon Brigadier Beluga.
target: 现在你只需要帮助劳丹达 与地狱达成条约, 她肯定会赦免贝卢加准将。

source: This might be your moment to shine, actually. After hours of fierce negotiation, the whole discussion seems to have reached a dead end.
target: 这也许是你发光的时刻,实际上。 经过数小时的激烈谈判,整个讨论似乎已无果而终。

source: The Merkingdom is failing to offer something valuable enough for Hell to accept the alliance.
target: 默金多姆没有提供 足够有价值的东西 地狱接受联盟。

source: What would be an unexpected asset for the Merkingdom to offer that'd tip the balance in favor of this treaty?
target: 默金多姆会提供什么意外资产 来为这个条约倾斜?

source: Being underwater gives the Merkingdom juicy intel to barter with. You can offer... THE FULL ICEBERG, EXPLAINED!
target: 水下让美金多姆多克多克情报可以交换 你可以提供... 满舱冰球, 宣告!

source: Hell is a very unpopular destination for tormented souls, but that's just because it's missing... its own catchy theme song!
target: 地狱是受折磨的灵魂非常不受欢迎的目的地,但这只是因为它不见了... 自己的流行主题曲!

source: You want to explain us... an iceberg?
target: 你想解释一下... 冰山吗?

source: Yeah, it's Internet slang to refer to the hidden depths of different topics and stuff, analyzed in super-entertaining videos.
target: 互联网上对不同话题和事物的 隐藏深度的称呼 是在超级登入视频中分析的

source: Yeah! Like Shrek's iceberg! I loved watching Shrek's iceberg explained!
target: 对! 就像史莱克的冰山! 我喜欢看史莱克的冰山解释!

source: You're offering us... a video analysis of an animated movie?
target: 你给我们... 动画电影的视频分析?

source: That's the offer that's supposed to convince us to make a strategic alliance that might lead to the deaths of countless soldiers in our ranks...?
target: 提议要说服我们结成战略联盟 导致我们队伍中无数士兵的死亡...

source: Hmph...
Our advisor is clearly speaking metaphorically here.
target: 我们的顾问在这里显然以隐喻的方式说话。

source: They meant we can share our intel on different fronts that could both prove useful in our crusade against Heaven and further Hell's general interests.
target: 也就是说我们可以分享我们在不同战线的情报 既可以证明对天国有帮助 也能促进地狱的普遍利益

source: So... no Shrek iceberg explained?
target: 所以说... 斯莱克冰山没有解释吗?

source: Anyway...
target: 总之...

source: In the Merkingdom, we value intel. We have many historians, spies, and arcane mages investigating esoteric-yet-potentially-useful fronts.
target: 在默金多克,我们重视情报 我们有很多历史学家,间谍, 和北极野人 调查 eoteric -yet - 潜在有用战线。

source: From the current location and strategies of various Old Deities in their quest to unmake reality... to the true identity of God.
target: 从现在的位置和策略 各个老神 追求不现实... 以上帝的真面目为证

source: Well... now that's something.
target: 这个... 现在,这是东西。

source: Not to mention our research on the Multiverse Theory or the Shards of the True Power...
target: 更别说我们对多相理论的研究了 更别说是真力量的沙德了

source: All of this could certainly be useful.
target: 所有这些当然都是有益的。

source: We would require, of course, that Hell also share its intel on these topics to build better strategies.
target: 当然,我们要求地狱也分享其有关这些议题的情报,以便制定更好的战略。

source: Of course, of course.
target: 当然,当然。

source: Good enough, then?
target: 够好了吗?

source: Throw in that "Shrek" thing too and we have a deal...
target: 扔出"Shrek"的东西,我们有一个交易...

source: Yes, yes. I am now utterly intrigued by this "Shrek Iceberg Explained"... Good idea...
target: 对,对。 我现在对这个"史克冰堡解释"感到非常好奇... 好主意 说得好

source: Sure. Shall we continue?
target: 当然可以。 我们继续吗?

source: ...What? We don't need intel on what's underneath the iceberg. We know: there's more iceberg.
target: 什麽? 我们不需要关于冰山下面的线索 我们知道,还有更多的冰山。

source: Yes, I won't lie: that is the case.
target: 是的,我不会撒谎的,就是这样。

source: No, no, I'm not talking about a LITERAL ICEBERG, goddammit!
target: 不,不,我不是说 液态的冰球,该死的!

source: It's a metaphor for the hidden depths of different topics, most commonly pieces of fiction. Like... "The Evangelion Iceberg".
target: 以隐喻不同话题的深奥,最常有的虚构作品. 喜欢... "伊凡格利翁·冰上".

source: What's an Evangelion?
target: 什么是"福音"吗?

source: What?! It's a cult classic anime; a work of art, one might say!
target: 你说什么? 这是一种邪教经典的动画; 可以说是艺术作品!

source: Why... why would we want to know more about this Evangelion? Why even make it a key component of our alliance with the Merkingdom?
target: 为什么... 为什么我们要知道更多关于这个福音? 为什么它甚至把它作为我们与默金多姆联盟的关键组成部分?

source: Well, you see, Evangelion has a pretty complex story built on intricate lore. It has angels!
target: 伊万吉利昂有一个非常复杂的故事 建立在复杂的神话上 里面有天使 ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! ! !

source: Angels have something to do with this Evangelion? We HATE angels!
target: 天使和这个Evangelion有关吗? 我们恨天使!

source: Yes. They are trying to provoke the Third Impact to end all life on Earth.
target: 对 他们试图挑起第三次撞击 以终结地球上的所有生命

source: Damned angels!
target: 可恶的天使!

source: Indeed. But the corporation known as NERV has built some mechas to fight the angels.
target: 确实如此 但被称为NERV的公司 已经建造了一些 mechas 来对抗天使。

source: They're trying to get beneath Tokyo-3. They want to make contact with Adam... but little do they know, someone else is there instead!
target: 他们试图进入东京3号线 他们想和亚当联系... 他们不知道, 别人在那里!

source: We could join forces with this NERV, then. These mechas could prove useful.
target: 那我们可以和NERV联手 这些薄膜可以证明是有用的。

source: Yes! We only need some very angsty teenagers to pilot them and enact a very depressing version of a romcom!
target: 没错! 我们只需要一些非常愤怒的青少年来驾驶他们,并颁布非常令人沮丧的romcom版本!

source: You know, I actually have the full anime on my phone. Let's check it out!
target: 我手机上有全动画 我们来看看!

source: Hmmmm... okay.
target: 垛... 还好。

source: You watch the full EVANGELION, including the old two movies and the four new ones.
target: 包括旧两部电影和新四部电影

source: We... just watched a cartoon. This is not real. It's a cartoon.
target: 我们... 刚刚看了一卡通。 这不是真的 动画片.

source: Ugh, it's NOT a cartoon! It's an anime!
target: 这不是卡通片! 这是动画!

source: You're kicked out of the meeting. NO ONE EVER UNDERSTANDS THE BEAUTY OF EVANGELION!
target: 你被赶出会议了 没有人会明白EVANGELION的美!

source: You lose -3 STAMINA because you are not kicked out in a peaceful manner. Ouch.
target: 你输了3个STAMINA,因为你不是被和平地踢出。 哎哟。

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

source: Hmmm... we're intrigued by this proposal...
target: 那个... 我们对此提案很感兴趣...

source: You... are...?
Yes. Surely this intelligent diplomat is talking about an anthem.
target: 对 这聪明的外交官肯定在谈论国歌

source: The Merkingdom excels at controlling the masses while keeping the population loyal to the crown.
target: 默金多姆在控制大众的同时 也使民众忠于王冠方面表现得非常出色

source: We are riddled with betrayal, always threatened by coups... we could learn from your expertise.
target: 我们充满了背叛 总是受到政变的威胁... 我们可以从你的专长中学习

source: Indeed, our noble aristocrat certainly meant this.
target: 我们的贵族的确有这个意思。

source: We must assume you didn't come to this important meeting empty-handed.
target: 我们不得不假设你不是空手而来的

source: Yes, we would love to hear a first draft of this anthem, to prove the value of this alliance.
target: 是的,我们很愿意听到这首歌的初稿, 来证明这个联盟的价值。

source: That's not a problem. Our wise diplomat here doubles as an anthem composer, and they most certainly brought a proposal.
target: 那没问题 我们的明智外交官在这里作为作曲家加倍,他们无疑会提出一项建议。

source: For you see, their artistry is fueled by the knowledge that they will be beheaded if they don't deliver their best work.
target: 如你所见,他们的艺术才能 来自于知识,如果他们不完成他们最好的工作, 他们将被斩首。

source: See? Look at the Merkingdom, always keeping their subjects motivated! How admirable.
target: 看到没? 看看美金多姆,总是让自己的臣民有动力! 多么令人钦佩。

source: Uh... eh... okay... here I go...
"Fuck everyone who's not in Hell! / Especially angels; throw 'em in a cell!"
target: "去他妈的所有不在地狱的人! 特别是天使,把他们扔进牢房!"

source: "Fuck everyone who's not in Hell! / Except for the Merkingdom, they're pretty swell!"
target: "去他妈的所有不在地狱的人! 除了默金多姆 他们很壮观!"

source: "Fuck everyone who IS in Hell! / 'Cause demons are fuckin' hot as hell!"
target: "去他妈的地狱里所有的人! 因为恶魔他妈的是热的地狱!"

source: "FUCKIN' HELL! / FUCK IN HELL! / LET'S ALL FUCKIN' GO TO HELL!"
target: "他妈的地狱! 他妈的地狱! 让我们都他妈的去地狱!"

source: It's not bad, but don't you think the third line is a little... misleading?
target: 不错,但你认为第三行有点... 误导?

source: No, it's a subversion of the established poetic form. It's deep. People will eat that shit up.
target: 不,这是对既定诗歌形式的颠覆. 入地深处. 人们会吃狗屎了。

source: True! I liked the wordplay. The song is catchy and accurate: we demons ARE hot as hell, aren't we?
target: 没错! 我喜欢这话剧 歌曲充满了捕捉力和准确性:我们恶魔是热的地狱,不是吗?

source: ...Sure. And surely that song is just one of several tools of mass control the Merkingdom can provide us if this treaty is signed, right?
target: 当然 这首歌当然只是 控制大众的好几种工具之一 如果签订条约 美金敦可以给我们提供,对吧?

source: If so, I'm in.
target: 如果是这样,我加入。

source: That is completely right. That... song was just the first of many boons to come your way. Shall we continue now?
target: 这完全正确。 那个... 歌声是很多人中第一个来你的路的 我们现在可以继续了吗?

source: What?
target: 什麽?

source: You're negotiating a game-changing alliance between two of the world's strongest kingdoms in order to take down Heaven... and your best offer is... a song?
target: 你正在商谈一个改变世界最强国 之间的联盟,以夺取天堂... 你最好的报价是... 歌吗?

source: Is this some sort of jape?
target: 这是某种JAPE?

source: So far, this negotiation has discussed the use of entire armies, the exchange of strategic territories, the creation of key diplomatic positions...
target: 到目前为止,这次谈判已经讨论了整个军队的使用,战略地盘的交换,关键外交立场的建立等.

source: ...and you want to tip the balance with a tune.
target: ...你想要用一首曲子来调头

source: Wait, wait, you haven't heard it yet. It's a great theme song!

source: But desperate times call for desperate measures.
target: 但绝望的时代要求采取绝望的措施.

source: You try to take the bedsheet off, but it weighs a ton. It's heavy, almost like it's carrying the weight of all your bad choices. But you must persevere.
target: 你试着把床单脱了,但它重一吨。 有点重,就像它 承载了所有你坏的选择的重量。 但你必须坚持下去。

source: You lift as hard as you can with your videogame-playing, unmuscular body. You risk herniating a disk, but you don't give up!
target: 以你的游戏 和肌肉不敏锐的身体 尽可能地用力地举起 你冒着偷取磁盘的风险 但你不会放弃的!

source: As the sheet finally lifts over your body and head, a blinding light surrounds you all. And then...
target: 床单终于抬起你的身体和头部, 闪烁的光线包围着你们。 礛...

source: ...A FLASH!
target: ..一个FLASH!

source: When you open your eyes again, you're you again! Corporeal-body you!
target: 你再睁开眼睛,你又变回你! 体质你!

source: You can feel again your flesh, and your bones, and the +N2 STAMINA flowing through your very tangible body!
target: 你可以再次感觉到你的肉体和骨头 还有从你身体里流出来的 +N2STAMINA!

source: The other versions of you are nowhere to be found. Did they ever exist to begin with?
target: 其他版本的你 找不到任何地方。 他们从头开始就存在过吗?

source: Goddammit... what a fuckin' trip.
target: 该死的... 真是个该死的旅行。

source: Yeah, bro... it was really weird seeing ourselves from the outside...
target: 癸... 外面看到我们真是奇怪

source: But at least it allowed us to learn a valuable lesson.
target: 但至少它让我们吸取了宝贵的教训。

source: That we should never do a sheet ghost prank again?
target: 我们再也不该做鬼牌恶作剧了?

source: That I need to do more butt exercises, because now that I've seen it from the outside it turns out my butt isn't buff enough?
target: 因为我从外面看到 屁股不够吗?

source: No!
target: 没有!

source: That we can't go through life taking it for granted. We have to savor every minute of it!
target: 我们不能把生活当做理所当然 我们必须每分钟都去救它!

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦,还好!

source: How do we savor life, though?
target: 我们如何拯救生活,虽然?

source: Well, for starters, we can go get some milkshakes and leave all this purgatory madness behind us!
target: 首先,我们可以去买奶昔 把这些炼狱的疯狂抛在脑后!

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: As you leave the graveyard, you can't help but wonder if there are more ghost versions of you all out there, quietly looking at you in their own purgatory loop.
target: 当你离开墓地,你不得不怀疑,你们是否有更多的鬼版本,悄悄地看着你们在他们自己的炼狱圈中.

source: You hope they're okay.
target: 希望他们没事

source: Raise the dead
target: 举起死者

source: YAAAASSS! This place is a snoozefest anyway!
target: 亚亚西斯! 这地方真是个小地方!

source: I don't know, Polly. Isn't raising the dead, like... a bad thing?
target: 我不知道,我说... 波莉. 养活死者不是... 坏事吗?

source: No, buddy, it's all A-OK if it's for a good reason, such as having fun.
target: 不,伙计,如果有好理由,比如玩得开心,就没事了

source: Oh, okay then!
target: 哦,那还好!

source: As the two of them discuss this, you can't ignore that there's something strange happening: a strong fog that rolls in from time to time.
target: 当他们两人讨论这个时,你不能忽视有奇怪的事情发生:一个时常卷入的强烈雾.

source: At one point, the mist covers everything, and a strange old woman appears, visibly concerned.
target: 一度,雾层覆盖了一切, 和一个奇怪的老妇人出现, 明显地担心。

source: You young fools! You're toying with forces you don't understand!
target: 你们这些年轻的傻瓜! 你玩弄的是你们不明白的势力!

source: This is the Graveyard of Graveyards, a place that transcends time and space; the inevitable graveyard that eventually claims us all.
target: 这是坟墓墓地,一个超越时间和空间的地方;是最终要求我们大家的不可避免的墓地。

source: Your disrespectful tomfoolery is a desecration of all things sacred in the Graveyard of Graveyards.
target: 你无礼的通克利 是对墓地墓地所有神圣事物的亵渎

source: This place breathes, this places knows... and this place isn't happy with what you're doing. Stop yourselves before the Graveyard decides to stop you itself.
target: 这个地方呼吸, 这个地方知道... 这个地方不满意你在做什么。 在坟墓开始之前 阻止你们自己

source: I hear you, old lady. I realize now that our actions weren't okay. We understand. Here, let's shake hands as a sign of our understanding.
target: 我听见了,老太太 我现在意识到我们的行动并不好 我们理解。 在这里,让我们握个手,以示我们的理解.

source: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!
target: 亚军!

source: Hehe, the hand buzzer: a true classic!
target: 手鸣器,真经典!

source: C'mon, guys. Let's go before this buzzkill goes back to raining on our parade!
target: 来,伙计们。 趁这小鸟还没回来 就要下雨了

source: You run through the fog until you feel like you've lost the old lady.
target: 你穿过雾,直到你觉得你失去了那个老太太。

source: As the fog surrounds you, you begin to lose your sense of space. You feel like you're nowhere.
target: 随着雾笼罩着你,你开始失去空间感. 你感觉自己无处可去

source: Before you can keep worrying about all this, Polly brings you back to reality.
target: 在你继续担心之前 波莉 让你回到现实中

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, my good friend, I appoint you Manager of Raising the Dead!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%我的好友 我任命你为养活死者的经理

source: Whoa, bro... that's a huge honor.
target: 哇,哥们... 真是个巨大的荣誉。

source: It is! Raising the dead is all about technique! But I'm too drunk to decide how we should go about this, so... chop chop!
target: 没错! 养活死人是技术问题! 但我醉了,无法决定我们该如何去处理这件事,所以... 砍断!

source: Yay...? Anyhow, you know what to do: make a choice.
target: 亚? 无论如何,你知道该怎么做: 做出选择。

source: Get a shovel and dig up the bodies of those buried long ago, beyond memories... the ones that could have been.
target: 找把铲子挖出那些埋在很久以前的尸体 超越记忆... 本来可以的

source: Use the power of the monkey's paw to bring back the person who's closest to you, so you can get back that what was left behind.
target: 利用猴子爪的力量,把最接近你的人带回,这样你就可以把留下的东西拿回.

source: Great idea! It's SHOVEL TIME!
target: 不错的主意! 是时候了!

source: You dig for hours. Shovel Time is way less fun than it sounds. It predictably drains -N2 STAMINA from you.
target: 你挖了几个小时。 时间比听起来有趣多了 估计会从你身上排出N2 Stamina

source: But it might be worth it, because you eventually find a mysterious coffin with a cryptic carving on it that says "REMOVED CHARACTER."
target: 但也许值得,因为你最终找到一个神秘的棺材,上面有一副加密的雕刻,上面写着"雷蒙德·夏克特".

source: So mysterious, so meta... you open it and as you do, a blinding light showers you all, imbuing you with the +N2 MIND of a big revelation!
target: 如此神秘,如此的元... 打开它,然后一阵闪闪发光的阵雨 让你充满了N2的灵感

source: Oh, my!
target: 哦,我的天呐!

source: Hey, bro! Welcome!
target: 嘿,哥们! 欢迎光临!

source: Scott, honey, it's you!
target: 斯科特亲爱的,是你!

source: Uh... how do you know my name?
target: 额... 你怎么知道我的名字? 说吧,我叫

source: It's me! Beatrice, your old friend!
target: 是我! ! ! ! 是我,我来了! 比阿特丽斯,你的老朋友!

source: I'm confused.
target: 迷惑相见.

source: About what, silly? You know me. We all went to Spooky Academy together.
target: 谈什么,傻子? 你认识我。 我们都一起上过史波克学院

source: I'm the uptight-yet-lovable queen bee who sometimes says stingy things because I'm oblivious to the manners of the commonfolk!
target: 我是那个不屈不挠的蜜蜂女王 有时会说些小话 因为我对普通人的礼仪漠不关心

source: ...Polly, what's going on?
target: ...波莉发生什么事了?

source: One time we built an empire by selling lemons. Don't you remember, Scott?
target: 有一次我们通过卖柠檬来建立一个帝国. 你不记得了 斯科特?

source: Didn't I do that with Miranda?
target: 我是不是跟那个 米兰达?

source: Miranda? Who's Miranda? No, no... you did that with your good friend Beatrice.
target: 米兰达? 谁 米兰达? 没有,没有... 你和你好朋友比阿特丽斯做了这件事

source: And Polly, what about you? You were always ready to teach me all about peasant stuff, like dating app etiquette!
target: 还有 波莉那你呢? 说吧,你怎么样? 你总是准备好教我所有关于农民的东西, 像约会应用礼仪!

source: And %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You were there too!
target: 还有 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你也在场!

source: Remember that time you wanted to ask me to the Monster Prom, and I fooled you into helping me assassinate the entire water polo team? Good times!
target: 记得那次你想约我 怪物舞会我骗你帮我刺杀整个水上小马球队? 美好的时光!

source: I think you're confused... all these things you're talking about happened with Miranda. Look, I even have pics.
target: 我觉得你很困惑... 你所说的这些事情都发生了 米兰达. 你看,我甚至有图片。

source: What's this? Who is this pinkish phony? I was there, not her! Have you forgotten about me? Did you replace me? That stings! We were good friends!
target: 这是什么? 这粉红色的假货是谁? 我当时在场,不是她! 你忘了我吗? 你代替我了? 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺痛! 刺! 我们曾是好朋友!

source: Scott, Polly, c'mon; I'm sure you remember! This can't bee happening...
target: 斯科特, 波莉来啊,我相信你记得! 这不可能发生...

source: ...Beatrice?
target: 碧翠丝?

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, why didn't you stop? There was a graveyard over there!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你为什么不停下来? 那边有个墓地!

source: Eh... graveyards are a snooze. And we visited one recently! What's with all these graveyards anyway?
target: 额... 墓地是打呼噜的. 我们最近拜访了一位! 这些墓地是怎么回事?

source: You guys know we don't have to stop at EVERYTHING we see on the road, right?
target: 你们知道我们不必在路上看到的一切停下来,对吧?

source: Yeah, but I don't know... It's what we do!
target: 是的,但我不知道... ... 说不定是... 这是我们要做的!

source: Sure, but so what? This isn't some kind of game with unavoidable rules! We can just choose NOT to stop there!
target: 当然,但又怎样? 这不是什么游戏 不可避免的规则! 我们可以选择不停止在那里!

source: What were we going to do there anyway? Exhume some old corpses? Raise the dead yet again? That shit is growin' older by the minute!
target: 我们到底要做什么? 挖出一些旧尸体? 复活死人吗? 这东西马上就老了!

source: Nah, hard pass, buddy.
target: 不,硬通过,伙计。

source: C'mon, I'm sure the next stop we find will be much more fun!
target: 来,我敢肯定,下一站 我们找到会更有趣!

source: Oh, okay!
target: 哦,还好!

source: And so, you drive past the graveyard.
target: 所以,你开车经过墓地。

source: As you pass the entrance, you can't shake off a strong, off-putting feeling...
target: 当你通过入口, 你无法动摇 强烈的,不抽动的感觉...

source: The feeling that you're leaving someone behind, stranded at the graveyard... but who?
target: 那种你抛弃一个人的感觉 被困在墓地里 但谁呢?

source: As hard as you try, you can't remember who that would be... Eh, probably nobody important!
target: 努力的你不记得了,那会是谁... 呃,也许没什么重要的事!

source: Ah, the monkey's paw. You remember buying it from the weird old man who only spoke in cryptic, vaguely-threatening sentences.
target: 啊,猴子的爪子。 。 。 你还记得从那个奇怪的老人那里买的吗? 他只用隐秘的, 隐蔽的句子说话, 威胁。

source: This paw comes with immense power. You can use it to wish for whatever you can imagine. But beware...
target: 这爪子有巨大的力量 你可以用它来许个愿 任何你能想象的 但当心...

source: ...Ugh, why do I keep trying? You never give a fuck about these ominous flashbacks!
target: ...我为什么要继续尝试? 你从不关心这些不祥的回放!

source: You'll just use the paw's dangerous magic power for something utterly dumb, like getting free drinks or pulling a prank.
target: 你会用爪子的 危险的魔法 做一些完全愚蠢的事, 比如免费喝酒或拉恶作剧。

source: It's the prank. We're doing the prank thing.
target: 恶作剧 我们做恶作剧的事情。

source: Fuck you.
target: 去你妈的

source: The monkey's paw! Are we sure, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? The weird seller said something about it being really dangerous...
target: 这只猴子的爪子! 我们确定吗? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 奇怪的卖家说它很危险...

source: Eh, I only remember him saying something about pranks... probably that we should only use the monkey's paw for important stuff... like pranks!
target: 我还记得他说过一些恶作剧... 也许我们只应该用猴子的爪子 来做重要的事情... 像是恶作剧!

source: Hmmm... yeah, it was probably that! We're good then!
target: 那个... 是啊,可能是那样的! 我们很好!

source: You use -N2 MAGIC to bring back a dead person who's close to you all... which technically counts as a good deed, right? So, +N2 SOUL for doing a solid for a dead person!
After making your wish, an unsettling amount of dark purple smoke emanates from the paw and seeps into the ground...
target: 许愿后,一股令人不安的深紫色烟从爪子中涌出并渗入地中. .

source: The ground starts vibrating in slow, heavy pulsations, as a deep guttural noise emanates from within it.
target: 地上开始在缓慢而沉重的脉冲中起震动,因为从地道内会发出深沟的噪音.

source: Then, a long charged silence, until...
target: 之后,一个长期充斥的沉默,直到...

source: A HAND ERUPTS FROM THE SOIL!
target: 一只手从苏尔!

source: Wait... I know that arm...
target: 单单... 我知道那个手臂...

source: Fuuuck.
target: 发作.

source: Fuck, fuck, fuck.
target: 他妈的,他妈的,他妈的。

source: This is not good... we need to leave.
target: 这可不妙... 我们得离开

source: But...
target: 不过...

source: NOW!
target: 现在!

source: She grabs your and Scott's hands, and you all leave the grave behind as the corpse continues clawing out of the underworld.
target: 她抓住你和 斯科特手,你们都留下坟墓 随着尸体继续从地下世界被挖出

source: As you run, you catch a glimpse of the tombstone, appearing through the fog. It's only a split second, but you can't ignore what it says:
target: 跑去时,你一眼就看到墓碑,从雾中出现. 仅分出一分秒,可不能无视所言:

source: Polina Geist.
target: 波利娜·盖斯特.

source: Crash a funeral
target: 办丧事吧

source: You find your friends and tell them you plan to crash a funeral. They're immediately onboard!
target: 你找到你的朋友 告诉他们你打算去参加葬礼 他们马上上船!

source: Ahh, funeral-crashing, one of my favorite pastimes. It's like wedding crashing, but for ghosts, geriatrics, and thrice-widowed girlbosses.
target: 啊,丧葬,我最喜欢的消遣之一。 这就像婚礼的崩溃, 但为鬼,老年, 和三wided女老板。

source: You all crash various funerals, wreaking all sorts of mourning havoc. You gain +N2 HYPE from all the havoc wreaked.
target: 你们都毁了各种葬礼, 制造了各种各样的哀悼灾难。 从所有破坏中 得到+N2 HYPE

source: There's something strange happening, though... a strong fog that rolls in from time to time.
target: 事情有点奇怪,虽然... 时而卷入的浓雾

source: At one point, the mist covers everything, and a strange old woman appears, visibly concerned.
target: 一度,雾层覆盖了一切, 和一个奇怪的老妇人出现, 明显地担心。

source: You young fools! You're toying with forces you don't understand!
target: 你们这些年轻的傻瓜! 你玩弄的是你们不明白的势力!

source: This is the Graveyard of Graveyards, a place that transcends time and space; the inevitable graveyard that eventually claims us all.
target: 这是坟墓墓地,一个超越时间和空间的地方;是最终要求我们大家的不可避免的墓地。

source: Your disrespectful tomfoolery is a desecration of all things sacred in the Graveyard of Graveyards.
target: 你无礼的通克利 是对墓地墓地所有神圣事物的亵渎

source: This place breathes, this places knows... and this place isn't happy with what you're doing. Stop yourselves before the Graveyard decides to stop you itself!
target: 这个地方呼吸, 这个地方知道... 这个地方不满意你在做什么。 在坟墓决定阻止你们之前 阻止你们自己!

source: I hear you, old lady. I realize now that our actions weren't okay. We understand. Here, let's shake hands as a sign of our understanding.
target: 我听见了,老太太 我现在意识到我们的行动并不好 我们理解。 在这里,让我们握个手,以示我们的理解.

source: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!!!
target: 亚军!

source: Hehe, the hand buzzer: a true classic!
target: 手鸣器,真经典!

source: C'mon, guys. Let's go before this buzzkill goes back to raining on our parade!
target: 来,伙计们。 趁这小鸟还没回来 就要下雨了

source: You run through the fog until you end up at someone's eulogies... which, of course, Scott and Polly want to crash too. Nothing is sacred.
target: 你穿过雾,直到你最后在某人的"通灵"... 当然, 斯科特 财务报告和审定财务报表 波莉 也想崩溃。 没有什么是神圣的。

source: So here you are, in front of the two obvious options when it comes to pranking a funeral...
target: 所以,你在这里, 在两个明显选择前 当它涉及到一个葬礼...

source: The classic of all classics: place a banana peel for someone to comically slip on once the eulogy is done.
target: 经典经典: 给别人贴个香蕉皮 等悼词完成后再滑倒

source: Buy a three-person horse costume online and crash the funeral. A horse suddenly crashing overly-serious events is always hilarious.
target: 网上买出一出三人马装并撞倒了葬礼. 突然撞倒过严重事件的马总是很搞笑

source: Banana peel? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you're a natural!
target: 香蕉皮吗?  %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%你是天生一对!

source: Go get that banana, you prankster!
target: 去拿香蕉,你这个恶作剧者!

source: You get a banana from the car, throw the banana away (losing -N2 STAMINA), and strategically drop the peel in the best spot possible.
target: 将香蕉丢出(丢出-N2 STAMINA),

source: As you sneak into the eulogy, you can hear snatches of the priest introducing the eulogies.
target: 当你偷偷进入悼词, 你听到牧师的被抢 介绍的eulogies。

source: "Losing a loved one is always a tragedy. We can only imagine the weight of bearing the loss of an entire family..."
target: "失去亲人总是悲剧" 我们只能想象承受整个家庭的损失的分量... ...

source: You can't hear the entire thing, but eventually the priest invites a man to say some words about the departed.
target: 你听不到整件事,但最终神父邀请一个人对逝去者说出一些话来.

source: You're too focused on not getting caught, but you get to hear some stuff, some disconnected sentences here and there:
target: 你太专注于不被抓住, 但你得到听到一些东西, 一些断开的句子在这里和那里:

source: "And then there's my little girl... anyone who met her knows that she could light up a room with her smile..."
target: "然后还有我的小女孩... 任何人遇到她,都知道她可以用微笑点亮房间......

source: "...and no matter what, she always found a reason to smile..."
target: "不管怎样,她总能找到一个微笑的理由..."

source: "...oh, God... I miss her smile..."
"...I'm sorry... I'm so sorry..."
By then you've made it back to where Polly and Scott are hiding.
target: 到时候你又回到了哪里 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 藏起来

source: Polly looks somber.
target: 波莉 看上去很悲伤。

source: I don't feel like pranking anymore, guys. Let's leave.
target: 我不再觉得自己是小人了,伙计们 我们走吧

source: ...Okay.
target: ...当然了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, can you get the banana peel back? This isn't fun anymore.
